tei:div.tei:p: bya::ba 'gu/ //shā chi/hā :muḥ//9 'a cu05 000ji 'ang 5055ji cu 7 bci kho migaX 507 khor
che ri phu ci da tshe — /— /— — dza tsho waXrge ——— ༷ rte

skru 2〉ཿ ki0 ( rmo ri / ༈ tunye / ’ 1 9 — / ( —4 zlo )ཿrāk+ṣaḥ/ kau ra cu bya/ /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(deb dang po/)ga skya'i dpe rnying bsdu sgrig lhan nas bsgrigs/ zung go'i bod rig pa dpe sgrun khang /

sngon 'gro'i gtam/de yang spyir 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi blo gros kyi rtsal las byung ba'i shes rig gi rnam grangs la zad mtha' mi mngon pa zhig yod mod kyang / 'dir skabs bab kyi brjod bya rang cag gangs can pa'i mes po gong ma rnams kyis shul bzhag /bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas lnga zhes kha rlung ltar grags pa las/ rig gnas chung ba lnga ni che ba lnga'i khongs su 'du zhing / de yang 'phral yun gyi phan bde sgrub pa'i thabs lam gnyis su nges pa ste/ bzo dang gso ba rig pa gnyis ni phyi dngos po'i 'byung 'phrod kyi nus pa bsdu len byas te skabs 'phral gyi bde ba tsam sgrub pa'i thabs dang / sgra dang tshad ma gnyis ni brjod bya dang rjod byed la rmongs pa'i ling tog bsal nas/ blang dor gyi mig 'byed de 'phral yun gnyis na'i bde skyid sgrub thabs dang / nang rig pa ni 'khor 'das lam gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad/ lung dang rigs pas gtan la phabs te gnas lugs la nges shes rnyed par bya ba ste/ de ni 'phral bde tsam ma yin par nam zhig gtan gyi bde skyid 'tshol ba'i thabs lam ma nor ba zhig yin/de lta bu'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs chen po de dag la deng sang 'dzam gling shar 1

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/nub kun gyis bod rig pa zhes ming nas 'bod cing / spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi lam bur bskyod pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs gtso bor gyur pa'i/ skye bo rnam dpyod can mang po zhig gis nang sems kyi bde skyid sgrub pa'i thabs lam ma nor ba zhig tu shes te/ yid dbang med du 'phrogs nas bkres pa zas dang / skom pa chu'i dpe ltar sbyang brtson byed bzhin pa ni mthong chos su gyur pa lags/ des na yun ring gi bde skyid 'tshol ba'i gang zag zhig yin phyin chad/ spyir bsam blo'i slob gso dang / nyams myong gi mthong rgya/ khyad par du bod kyi rig gzhung nas bshad pa'i sems bzang dang / spyod bzang la bslab tshul 'di dag bde skyid sgrub pa'i lam phyogs zhig tu rtsa 'dzin byed pa ni/ gtan bde 'tshol ba'i kha phyogs ma nor ba zhig yin pa mngon thub kyi yod/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na rang re'i mes po gong mas dka' ba brgya dang ngal ba stong gis bsgrubs pa'i rin bral gyi shes rig 'di dag /dus rabs kyi 'gyur ba dang bstun te bya thabs gsar gtod kyis/ nyam pa slar gso/ mi nyam gong 'phel gyi sgo nas/ sbyong spyod spel gsum byas te rang gi shes 'jon gyi nus pa mtho ru gtong ba tsam du ma zad/ 'dzam gling gi skye 'gro kun la ya rabs spyod bzang gi legs skyes 'bul thub pa bya rgyu ni/ rang re'i phrag thog tu bab pa'i 'os 'gan zhig yin/ de lta bu'i bod kyi rig gzhung chen mo de la brgyud srol tha dad pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta che/ po bco brgyad ces grags pa las/ da

sngon 'gro'i gtam/lam 'dir sgrub rgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kyi ya rgyal du gyur pa che ba bcu gcig ldan pa'i lam 'bras dang / bshad rgyud 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu'i nang gses dpal sa skya pa chen po'i bshad srol te/ mdo sngags bshad sgrub gnyisaldan gyi bka' srol bla na med pa zhig /da sngon bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs 'dir gnas pa'i skye 'gro'i bsod nams kyi bgo skal du gyur pa la/ gnas gzhi'i ming chos brgyud la chags te dpal ldan sa skya pa zhes mtshan thogs pa de la/mkhas grub kyi skyes chen gser ri'i phreng ba ltar bar ma chad par byon pa rnams kyi gsung / rim bzhin myur skyobs kyis legs sgrig dang dpe sdur sogs kyisapar skrun byas dang byed bzhin pa 'di ni/ thog mar 7sa skya khri 'dzin rin po che dang / mkhan rin po che yon tan bzang po/ mkhan rin po che rgya mtsho sogasakyis slob ston gyi bdag rkyen las byung ba zhig yin zhing / da sngon dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis rgyab skyor 'og /sa skya gong ma rnam lnga'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grel spel zhus te/ rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba dang chabs cig /da dung mu mthud de chos brgyud 'dir gtogs kyi dpe rnying dpe dkon rnams gtso bor gyur pa myur skyobs bya ched/ dpal sa skya'i dpe rnying nyams gso khang zhes pa'i las khang zhig ched gnyer byas pa'i spyi khyab gtso 'dzin pa/ lhag bsam rnam par dkar ba'i mkhan po rta mgrin rdo rje dang / dpe sgrig zhu chen pa/ shes rig dang nyams myong 3

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/gi lang tsho rdzogs pa'i dgen thub bstan smon lam/ las ma'i 'gan 'dzin pa/sku zhabs ngag dbang bzang po sogs kyis gnang ba brgyud/ rgyun par las mi lnga drug tsam gyis 'bad brtson byed bzhin yod pa las/da lam 'dir bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas zhib 'jug pa rnams kyi dgos mkho skong ched/ lo rgyus chos 'byung skor gtso bor byas pa'i deb drug dang / grwa sa khag gi slob gnyer gsar bu ba rnams kyi dgos mkho skong ched bsdus blo rtags gsum phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa rnams/ da lam par bsgrun zhus te rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba'o/ / ci'abyung char/ rang re'i mes po'i shul bzhag chos rig kun la kha zhe gnyisamatshungs kyi lhag bsam dkar ba'i mkhyen ldan rnams kyis/ phan tshun gzhog 'degs kyi sgo nas las gzhi 'di'i rigs la mthun sbyor gang mang gnang rgyu'i re smon dang bcas/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas 2008lo'i zla8tshes la na bde legs kyis/4

bsdu sgrig pa'i gtam// cho rigs rin chen lha yi 'phrul las byu nga / /byung 'di rin chen mi lus mdzes pa'i rgya na/ /rgyan mchog rin chen bsgrun pas dben pa'i brgyud / /brgyud pa rin chen shākya'i gdung de rgyal/ /de yang deng dus go la khyon du sna tshogs pa'i shes rig gi tsha rlabs dang 'gran rtsod kyi rno ngar brtas pa'i dus 'dir bzang phyogs nas go chod pa'i dngos rigs sna tshogs thon pa dang / ngan phyogs nas rkyen chung ngus kyang rang gzhan dmigs med kyi gnas su 'phen par byed pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bzo skrun byed pa'i dus skabs 'dir phan tshun brtse sems dang bsam zhig gis 'byor phyug ldan pa'i zhi bde'i 'dzam gling zhig bskrun par/ skye bo mi re ngo re'i lhag bsam dang 'bad rtsol la bsten dgos/ de'ang nga tshos sngar 'das zin pa'i gnas tshul la phyi mig zhig bltas nas da lta skyon yon la blang dor bya dgos pas/ re zhig lo rgyus yig tshang du 'khod pa/ 'dzam gling spyi'i chags 'jigs 'phel 'grib kyi gnas tshul dang yang sgos mi'i rigs kyi byung rim dang 'phel rim/ de'i nang gi rgyal rabs dang / rig gnas/ chos lugs dar tshul sogs la rtogs zhib mdzad de snang tshul dang gnas tshul/ drang bden dang brdzun pa / ya rabs dang ma rabs/ mthun sgriX dang ngo lkog rang don dang lhag bsam/

brtse chen 'od snang/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/gzur gnas dang phyogs res/ dgos dbang dang rang 'dod/ yar rgyas dang rjes lus/ shes ldan dang rmongs pa/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug sogs la phan bde zhes pa ngo ma gang dang gang gis 'ong gi yod med kyi blang dor ma nor ba zhig byed par nges par du spyi dang bye brag gi lo rgyus la blta rtog mdzad de snyigs 'dor bcud len bya rgyu ni shin tu nas gal po che yin/ des na cung zad shes yon ldan pa rnams kyis kyang rang kho na yongs grags bya rgyu'i slob rtsom rnams dor nas sngar gyi lo rgyus yig tshang sogs la 'chad spel rgyun bsrings mdzad rgyu dang dpal 'byor dang go thob cung zad ldan pa rnams kyis kyang rgyan po 'gyes pa dang / phan med kyi 'gran rtsod dang / 'chal rgyug bya ba/ shul bzhag gi rig dngos la nyo tshong byed pa sogs dor nas rang re'i ma 'ongs pa'i blo gsar rnams kyis 'dzam gling 'di'i thog nga tsho shar phyogs pa'i mi rigs kyi rig gnas dang grol rgyun thun min rnams 'dzin skyong dang 'phel rgyas kyi phyogs su bskyod thub pa'i meng gzhi zhig 'jog par 'bung 'tshal zhes kho bos gsol ba 'debs pa lags so//des na rang ljongs 'dir yang ris su ma chad pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs dang / chos 'byung / lo rgyus/ 'bel gtam gyi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mchis pa kun gyi rang rang so so'i khyad chos rtsal 'don la bsams te bltas na rin thang bral ba kho na yin kyang / 'dir nged sa skya'i dpe rnying bsdu sgrig khang 'di'i shes dpal zung gi nus pas ma lcogs pas gnas skabs grub mtha' bye brag pa zhig gi mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i pa stan 2

ba sgrig pa'i gtam/bcos 'ga' zhig rnam dpyod bkra ba'i rig 'dzin pa rnams kyi spyan sngar phyogs bsdus byas te khyon deb drug bsgrigs pa las/ deb dang po'i nang rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan 6147 1216)kyis mdzad pa'i rgya bod rgyal rabs dang /rgya bod kyi sde pa'i gyes mdo/ chos rje sa paṇa 61827251)gyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung chen mo/ 'gro mgon chos 'phags 6234728be kyis mdzad pa'i bod kyi rgyal rabs/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan63127399)gyis mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long bcas tshan pa lnga dang /deb gnyis pa'i nang bu ston rin po che rin chen grub 62907364)kyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung / deb gsum pa'i nang stag tshang rdzong pa dpal 'byor rgya mtshos (lha zung 'das gsal po med kyang rnam thar cung zad stag tshang lo tsā ba'i rang rnam du yod pas der gzigs la 'a/)mdzad pa'i rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ deb bzhi pa'i nang mkhas pa chen po dkon mchog lhun grub 64977557ngor 'a waṃ chos ldan gyi gdan rabs bas pa/)kyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung la mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs 6649775ngor mgon pa'i gdan rabs nyer drug pa/)kyis kha skong mdzad pa de dang / deb lnga pa'i nang rtag nag mkhan chen chos rnam rgyal snyeg nag thub bstan rnam rgyal dgon gyi gdan rabs bcu gnyis pa/)gyibs mdzad pa'i chos 'byung dang / mang thos paṇ+ḍi ta klu sgrub rgya mtshos 652 mkho yod bya rgod gnang kyi gdan rab lnga pa/)mdzad pa'i bstan rtsis kun btus gnyis/ deb drug pa'i nang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos yong gsar lnga rig slob nga gi mkha thog dang po/na mdzad pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdan rabs dang / lo rgyus dang rnam thar shin tu mang po ngo mtshar lha/ pad tshal/ dbus gtsang gi gnas

ba chen 'od snang/skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/yig gangs ri'i khrod kyi klog pa nyan bshad pa rnams la springs yig yang gangs ri'i khrod kyi sbong ba bsam gtan pa rnams la springs yig /paṇa chen shāka mchog 64287507thub bstan gser mdog can gyi gdan sa gnyi pa/) gis mdzad pa'i tshad ma'i chos 'byung dang dbu ma'i chos 'byung /de geg lo chen pos gangs can du bstan pa ji ltar bskyangs pa'i tshul mdor tsam du byas pa dang / mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags 65727641dgung lo so dgu la thub bstan yang pa can gyi mkhan po mdzad/ slar dgung lo re dgu la 'dar grang mo tshe'i gdan sa mdzad/) kyis mdzad pa'i pod chen drug gi 'bel gtam bcas spyan bstar zhus pa 'dis mkhas dbang skya ser kun gyis skabs 'di'i 'brel yod yig cha kun 'byor dka' ba'i ngal ba sel phyir yig rnying lo rgyus sngar bskrun zin pa dang ma zin pa'i phyogs mtshungs rnams legs bsgrigs byas pa'i dpe tshogs 'di bla ldan skyes bu'i phongs sel dam par 'gyur ba'i 'dun pa'ang bcangs bzhin yod la thugs 'dun legs par bskong ba'i grogs su'ang 'gyur nges lags so/ /'dir mdzad pa po'i rnam thar ni yongs grags yin pas ngal ba ma byas te mkhyen 'dod rnams kyis 'brel yod yig cha rnams las rtogs par 'tshal lo//skabs 'di'i legs sgrig gi brgyud rim nang rnam dkar kho nas rogs ram mdzad pa nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gi rgan dme bde legs lags sogs la ba'i rogs lhan rgyas la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin la/ slad mar phyogs gang spyi'i thad nas rogs ram zhus par thugs rje mi chung bar zhu zhes gsol ba'ang 'debs pa lagasathe(/ / zhes sa skya'i dpe rnying bsdu sgrig khang nas ba bstan smon lam gyis/4

dkar chagashākya rnams kyi rgyal rabs bzhugs so// rje ge'i grag pa rgyal mtshan/(1)bod kyi rgyal rabs bzhugs so/ / rje gzha grag pa sa mas/(9)rgya bod kyi sde pa'i gyes mdo bzhugs so// rje ju grag pa 7 ma'/(16)chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa chos 'byung chen po bzhugs so// mi rje sa paṇa/(23)bod kyi rgyal rabs bzhugs so// chos rgyal 'phags pa/(115)rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// bla ma dam bsod nams rgyal mas/(117)bskal pa ji ltar chags pa'i tshul/ (118)sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i sku gsum bzhengs pa dang rab tu gnas par mdzad pa'i tshul/ (127)rgya hor yul du bstan pa dar tshul/ (136)'phags pa pad+ma las 'khrungs tshul/ (142)1

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()'phags pa kha ba can pa'i sems can rnam smin grol la bkod pa/ (152)rta'i rgyal por sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i skor/ (156)bod kyi mi brgyud sri'u dang brag srin nas ho pa'i skor/ (163)bod yi gdung rabs dang po ji ltar byon pa'i skor/ (167)'phag pa'i sku las 'od 'phros pas chos rgyal 'khrungs pa'i skor/ (176)thon mi chen pos rgya gar nas yi ge bskur ba las rgyal po dge bcu'i khrims bcas pa'i skor/ (179)rgyal po'i thugs dam gyi lha rgya gar dang bal yul nas spyan drang pa'i sgor/ (189)bal mo bza' khri btsun gdan drang pa'i skor/ (196)rgya mo bza' kong jo gdan drang pa'i skor/ (207)mtha' 'dul yang 'dul lha khang dang 'phrul snang rwa mo che bzhengs pa'i skor/ (237)lha sa gnyis dang mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gtsug lag khang tshar nas rab gnas mdzad pa'i skor/ (254)gter sbas pa dang bod 'bangs chos la bkod pa'i skor/ (263)

shākya rnams kyi rgyal rab bzhugs //rgyal po yab yum mdzad pa rdzogs nas rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs dar thims pa'i sgor/ (273)dbon gras mang srong mang btsan gyi skor/ (292)'dul srong mang po rje rlung nam 'phrul gyi skor/ (292)khri lde btsog brtan me ag tshom gyi skor/ (293)chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi skor/ (299)sras mu yi btsan po'i skor/ (318)gra mu tig btsan po'i skor/ (320)sras ldeng khri'i skor/ (320)rgyal bo ral pa can gyi skor/ (321)rgyal po glang dar ma'i skor/ (329)mnga' bdag 'od srungs dang yum brtan gyi skor/ (333)yum brtan rgyal brgyud kyi sgor/ (334)slar bstan pa smad nas dar ba'i skor/ (335)'od srungs kyi rgyal brgyud skor/ (338)3
'tsheg 'od snang la /sa skya'i chogs nga chas bsdus/ ()jo bo gdan drang pa'i skor/ (339)ya che'i rgyal brgyud skor/ (340)yar lung jo bo'i rgyal brgyud skor/ (340)mjug byang / ri(343)

༄༅/ / shākya ba /dhi/shā bo/da gnyis)kyi rgyal rabs༄༅/ /na mo burnya ya/ lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug na gang gi gsung / /me tog thod dang rin chen phreng ba ltar/ /dul ba'i khur gyis kun du 'dzin byed pa/ /skye ba'i chu bo sgrol bar mdzad pa rgyal/ /srid pa gsumagyi bla ma bde bar gshegs pa/ mi 'jigs pa'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin par mdzad pa'i gdung brgyud/ 'jig rten na rigs thams cad kyi nang na bla mar gyur pa shākya rnams kyi rabs 'di bzung zhing kun chub par byasanas/ gzhan la rgya cher bsnyad na/ chos dang mthun zhing bsod nams kyi phung po 'phel bar byed do/ /zhes bde bar gshegs pa nyid kyis dri ma med pa'i mdo sde dag las mngon sum du gsungs pas na de brjod par bya'o//de yang thog mar 'jig rten 'dir lha dag babs pa las/ rim gyis mir gyur te/ de dag gis mi rnams kyi rgyal por bskos pa ni mang pos bkur ba'o/ /de'i rjes su 'od mdzes/ dge ba/ dge mchog gso sbyong 'phags/ spyi bo skyes/ nga las nu ste/ de drug ni tshe'i tshad kyang dpag tu med pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba yin no/ /de'i brla g.yas rol nas skyes pa mdzesapa ste/ gling bzhi la dbang ngo / /de'i brla g.yon pa las skyes pa nye mdzesate / gling gsum la dbang ngo / /de'i /nga pa g.yas pa las byung ba mdzes

ba chen 'od snang las/sa 'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/ ()ldan/ gling gnyis pa la dbang ngo / /de'i rkang pa g.yon pa las skyes pa nye ba'i mdzes ldan/ gling gcig pa la dbang ngo / /de dag ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po yin la/ 'di man chad ni sems can gyi bsod nams kyi stobs kyis rgyal phran du gyur to/ /yang mdzes ldan/ bzang po/ legs bzang / btang ba/ btang bzung / yan lag yan lag shing rta/ ngan spangs/skal ldan shing rta/rgya mtsho/rgya mtsho'i bu/ rgya mtsho chen po/sha ku ni/ sha ku ni chen po/ ku sha nye ba'i ku sha ku sha chen po/ legs mthong / legs mthong chen po/ rab thob/ rab thob chen po/ rab tu sgra bsgrags/ rab tu sgra bsgrags chen po/ 'od byed/ rtul phod/ lhun po ldan/ lhun po yon tan/'od zer/ 'od zer ldan/ 'od zer yod/ kun nas 'od zer/ de'i bu nas bzung ste/ tha ma rgyal po 'od zer gyi bar/ rgyal rabs brgya yul gru 'dzin du byung ngo / /de'i bu nas bzung ste/ tha ma rgyal po ma las rgyal ba'i bar rgyal rabs lnga khri lnga stong yul dmag gis mi tshugs par byung ngo / /de'i bu nas bzung ste/ tha ma rgyal po bzod dka'i bar/ rgyal rabs sum khri drug stong yul wā rā ṇa phyir byung ngo / /de'i bu nas bzung ste/ rgyal po tshangs pa byin gyi bar rgyal rabs brgyad khri bzhi stong yul gyim bhi la'i grong du byung ngo / /de'i bu nas bzung ste/ rgyal po glang pos byin gyi bar rgyal rabs sum khri nyis stong glang po che'i grong khyer du byung ngo / /de'i bu nas bzung ste/ rgyal po bal sna can gyi bar rgyal rabs lnga stong yul rdo 'jog tu byung ngo / /de'i bu nas bzung ste/ tha / rgyal po che 'dul gyi bar rgyal rabs

kya rnams kyi rgyal rabs bzhugs so//sum khri nyis stong grong khyer brang gi nyal du byung ngo / / de'i bu nas bzung ste/tha ma rgyal po rgyal byin gyi bar rgyal rabs sum khri nyis stong grong khyer ma rgyal ba las rgyal bar byung ngo / /de'i bu nas bzung ste/ rgyal po rgyal sde'i bar rgyal rabs sum khri nyis stong grong khyer ka na ya ka ba dzar byung ngo / /de'i bu nas bzung ste/ rgyal po klu'i lha'i bar rgyal rabs khri brgyad stongagrong khyer tsam par byung ngo / /de'i bu nas bzung ste/ rgyal po me lha'i bar rgyal rabs nyi ( lus nyi )khri lnga stong grong khyer ta la'i phreng du byung ngo / /de'i bu nas bzung ste/ tha ma rgyal po rgya mtsho'i lha'i bar rgyal rabs khri nyisastong ( da〉nyi khri )grong khyer ta ma lir byung ngo / /de'i bu nas bzung ste/ rgyal po blo gros bzang po'i bar rgyal rabs khri brgyad ( lu〉 brgya )stong bi si'i grong du byung ngo / /de'i bu nas bzung ste/ tha ma rgyal po mun sel gyi bar rgyal rabs nyi khri lnga stong grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu byung ngo / /de'i bu nasabazung ste/ rgyal po dbang phyug chen po'i sde'i bar rgyal rabs brgya grong khyer wā rā ṇa phyir byung ngo / /de'i bu nas bzung ste/ rgyal po rgya mtsho'i sde'i bar rgyal rabs brgyad khri bzhi stong grong khyer rtswa can du byung ngo / /de'i bu nas bzung ste/ rgyal po dka' thub spyod kyi bar rgyal rabs stong grong khyer gru 'dzin du byung ngo / / de'i bu nas bzung ste/ rgyal po sa'i gdong gi bar rgyal rabs brgyad khri bzhi stong grong khyer rto can du byung ngo / /( lus de'i bu byung ngo / //de'i bu nas bzung ste/ rgyal po sa'i bdag po'i bar rgyal rabs 'bum phral gcig wā rā ṇa sri/ byung ngo / /de'i bu nas bzung ste/

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()rgyal po sa 'dzin gyi bar rgyal rabs 'bum phrag gcig grong khyer dmag gis mi tshugs par byung ngo / /de'i bu nas bzung ste/ rgyal po lha chen po'i bar rgyal rabs brgyad khri bzhi stong grong khyer mi thi lar byung ngo / /de'i bu nas bzung ste/ rgyal po mu khyud kyi bar rgyal rabs brgyad khri bzhi stong drang srong gis dka' thub spyod pa grong khyer mi thi lar byung ngo / /de'i sras byung ba de bzhin du sbyar te/sra ba'i mu khyud/rko ba/ nye bar rko ba/ rko ba yod/ kun nas rko/gya nom snang /thos pa'i sde/chos kyi sde/ rtogs pa/ rtogs pa chen po / rtogs pa'i sde/ mya ngan med/ mya ngan bral/ brtan pa'i sde/ dga' ba sbyar/ glen ( da〉 lu〉gleng )bar/ skya rengs/ phyogs kyi bdag po/ rdul can/gcod byed/ kun dga'/ me long gdong / bskyed pa/ kun nas bskyed/skye bo'i khyu mchog bza' btung can/ bza' btung mang po can/ mi thub pa/gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ gnas pa/shin tu gnas pa/ stobs chen/ stobs chen zhon pa/ legs pa'i blo gros/ brtan pa shon/ gzhu ban pa/ gzhu brgya ( nas lu〉 brgyad )pa/ ga khu kyi dgu bcu pa/ ga rdo kyi rgyal/ ga khu kyi bkra/ ga khu kyi sra/shing rta bcu pa/ shing rta brgya ( lu〉brgyad na〉 brgya )pa/ shing rta dgu bcu pa / shing rta khra bo/ shing rta rgyal/ shing rta sra ba/ de'i bu nas bzung ste/ tha ma rgyal po kri kri'i bar rgyal rabs bdun khri bdun stong grong khyer kun tu snang du byung ngo //de'i dus su sangs rgyas 'od srungs 'jig rten du byung ngo //kri kri'i bu legs skyes so/ /de'i bu nas bzung ste/ tha ma rgyal po rna ba can gyi bar rgyal rabs brgya grong khyer sdi 'dzin du byung ngo //de la sras gnyis/

shākya rnams kyi rgyal rab bzhugs so//go ta ma dang / bha ra bhā dza'o/ /go ta mas bu ram gyi shing gi lo ma la sa bon bzhag pa las sras gnyis te/ de gnyis kyi ming yang nyi ma'i rig bsas ma/go ta ma'am/ yan lag skyes sam/ bu ram shing pa zhes/ming bzhin 'jig rten du grags so/ /de'i chung ba bu ram shing pa nas bzung ste/ bu ram shing nas 'phags skyes po'i bar rgyal rabs brgya yul gru 'dzin du byung ngo / /de la bu lnga las/ che ba bzhi ni skar mda' gdong / lag rna/ glang po che 'dul/dka' thub can/ 'di bzhis ser skya'i grong khyer bzung ste/ shin tu phod pa che bas shākya zhes grags so/ /der mis gang nas grong khyer lhas bstan bzung ngo / /bu phyi ma ni rgyal srid dga'o/ /gong 'og rnams la bu med par gyur nas thams cad kyi rgyal po dka' thub can gyis byas so/ /de'i bu gnas 'jog de'i bu sa khyim/ de'i bu nas gzung ste/ shing rta bcu pa'i bar rgyal rabs lnga khri ( lus hwa khri )lnga stong grong khyer ser skyar byung ngo //de'i bu shing rta brgya pa/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ shing rta dgu bcu pa/ shing rta khra bo/ shing rta rgyal/ brtan pa'i shing rta/ gzhu brgya pa/ gzhu brgya pa/ gzhu dgu bstob/ gzhu rgyal/ gzhu bkra/ gzhu brtan no/ /de la bu gnyis te/seng ge za 'gram dang / seng ge'i nga ro'o/ /'dzam bu gling gi gzhu thogs gang ji snyed pa de dag gi nang nas ni seng ge za 'gram mchog go /de la bu bzhi ste/ zas gtsang / zas dkar/ bre bo zas/ bdud rtsi zas so/ /bu mo yang bzhi ste/ gtsang ma/ dkar mo/ bre bo ma/ bdud rtsi ma'o/ /zas gtsang gi sras gnyis ni/ bcom ldan 5 / dga' bo'o/ /zas dkar gyi

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/ ()gnyis ni/shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan dang / rgyal ba'o/ /bre bo'i gnyis ni/ma 'gags pa dang / ming chen no/ /bdud rtsi zas kyi gnyis ni/ kun dga' bo dang / lhas byin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sras ni sgra gcan 'dzin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi ( na〉〈lus yum kyi )brgyud pa ni grong khyer lhas bstan no/ shwakya'i rgyal po legs par rab sad kyi bu mo che ba sgyu 'phrul/ chung ba sgyu 'phrul chen mo'o/ /de'i sras ni bcom ldan 'das la/che ba la ni dga' bo'o/ /de ltar na mang pos bkur ba'i 'khor ba'i phreng ba ni sgra gcan 'dzin gyis chad do/ /zhes mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo las 'byung mod kyang / kho bos legs par bsams na de ni mi rung ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir bskal pa 'di nyid la sangs rgyas stong 'byung ba yin la/ de dag gi rigs kyang la la bram ze/ la la rgyal rigs su 'khrungs par bskal pa bzang po las gsungs la/ rgyal rigs su 'khrungs pa rnams la rgyal po'i rigs rnams kyi nang nas bla mar gyur pa mang pos bkur ba'i rgyud 'di med par gyur na rgyal rigs gzhan gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su mi rung ste/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rabs brgyud med pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te 'khor los sgyur ba'i rabs brgyud du gyur pa zhig yin na ni mang pos bkur ba la mi thug tu mi rung ngo / /des na mngon par 'byung ba las gsungs pa de ni/ go ta ma'am shākya zhes yongs su grags pa'i rgyud dam/ yang na ya thog ring mo 'di la dbang phyug shin tu che ba de ni sgra gcan 'dzin gyis zad sdu la dgongs so snyam du bdag gi rnam

shākya rnam kyi rgyal rab bzhugs so// par rtog pa la bsam mo/ /de lta na mang pos bkur ba nas sgra gcan 'dzin gyi bar la ni/ spyir rgyal rabs sa ya phrag gcig dang khri phrag bdun dang stong phrag bzhi dang / brgya phrag lnga dang brgyad song la/ bye brag tu nyi ma'i rigs(dang / yan lag skyes kha dang / bu ram shing pa zhes grags nas rgyal rabs lnga khri lnga stong dang brgyad cu ( lu〉 brgya 2 dgu )song ngo / /de bas kyang go ta ma mi rabs gcig gis snga'o/ khri1kya zhes grags nas rgyal rabs lnga khri lnga stong dang bco brgyad song ngo / /gong du de dag las ( na〉 lus ma )grags so//de dag la yang tshad med pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba drug dang / gser dang /dngul dang /zangs dang /lcags kyi 'khor losasgyur ba dang bzhi ste/ 'khor los sgyur ba bcu dang / gzhal du med pa'i rin po che'i phung po chen po bde bar gshegs pa bcu gcig ni che ba'i che ba yin la/ gzhan ni de lta ma yin no/ /de ltar( zha 〉 lus na )bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i/ che ba'i khyad par lta zhog gi 'jig rten dang thun mong ba'i sku che ba'i khyad par la stos/ 'di lta bu'i rigs dang / rus dang / cho 'brang dang / phun sum tshogs pa dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa dag 'khor ba'i phreng ba bcad nas/ bsod snyoms kyi 'tsho bas 'tsho bar byas nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'jug par mdzad na/ gzhan dag phyag dar khrod kyi 'dam rdzab lta bu'i khyim la chags nas/ kun tu 'dzin par byed/ des na mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan bsngags pa la'ang sbyar bar bya'o//skyo/ bral dri med thub pa skye nu'i gtso/ /rnyan mor byed

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()pa'i gdung brgyud rnam dag pa//rdul bral mdo yi don bzhin kho bo yis//dpal ldan sa skya'i dben gnas dam par bsdus//dge ba 'di yi bu ram shing pa'i gsung //lham me lhang ngesaphyogs mtshams thams cad du//yon tan mtho khyad dpag tu med ldan pa//'gro ba'i rab rib kun du sel bar shog/bde bar gsheg pa'i yon tan bsngag pa 'di//blo gsal khyod kyi phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor du//'gro ba'i sna bar grag pa ra gyur cig dang //thub pa'i rgyal mtshan myur du 'thob par 'gyur/'i kya rnam kyi rgyal rabs kya'i dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsdus pa'o//'di thams cad la spel bar gu bsod nams dpa gtu med par bcom ldan 'ad kyis gsungasapa lags so//

༄7/ /bod kyi rgyal rabs bzhugs so/ /༄tsho/ /oṃ su sti siji/ bod kyi rgyal po khri bdun ldeng gcig dang //legs drug lde brgyad btsan bzhi zhes bya ste/ /nyi shu rtsa drug sngon gyi rgyal po yin/ /skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu drug dang / /shin tu skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bzhi/ /de ltar gdung rabs bzhi bcu tham pa ste / / de yis bod 'bangs spyi yi skyid res khyer/ /'on kyang dam chos dar las 'grib pa med/ /rje lde gnya' khri btsan po deng khri btsan po dang //mu khri btsan po sri khri btsan po dang / /gdags khri btsan po khris ye btsan po dang / /gri gum btsan po gnam gyi khri bdun yin/ /spu (〈 〉'od lu〉 spu)lde gung rgyal ldeng gcig bya ba'o/ /ngo legs 'og rgyu legs dang sho legs dang / /'bro zhing legs dang i sho legs dang ni/ /gcen ring gnam zi legs ni zhal snga bgyi/ /gcung zi gnam zi legs te legs drug go /lde mnam/ 'phrul po gzhung btsan/ lde sman bum/ lde snol nam/ lde snol po/lde se snol lam/ lde se rnal po/ lde rgyal po ste ( zhes sa la lde )brgyad do/ /rgyal tho lo sa ( 〉 lu〉re long )btsan/ de man chad 'bangs dang gnyen bsres te la lam ( 〉 lu〉'o ma )sde/bza' khri rgyal na ( na〉 〈lu〉ban )bu/ bzhes pa'i sras khri btsan nam/ des sman bza' klu rgyal dbang bzhes pa'i sras khri sgra yungs btsan/9des sman bza' klu rgyal dbang

ba chen 'od snang la /ga skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()( lu〉btsan )bzhes pa'i sras khri thog rje/ thog btsan te btsan bzhi'o/ /de yan chad mi rje mdzad nas gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa drug thal lo/ /des ru gyong bza' steng rgya mtsho ma bzhes pa'i sras tho tho ri snyan btsan/ des dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes te pang kong phyag brgya pa dang / gser gyi mchod rten khru gang pa dang / yi ge drug pa dang /tsirta ma ṇi'i kol phor nam mkha' la byon/des lha lung bza' ma mo rje ( lus rje )bzhes pa'i sras khri gnyen bzung btsan/ des 'brom bza' byang gnyen te pa bzhes pa'i sras 'bro gnyen lde ru / des mchims bza' klu rgyal ngan pu 'tsho ba bzhes pa'i sras rgyal stag ri gnyen gzigs/ des bol gol ( lu〉 'ol )bza' stong btsun gyi 'bro sman bzhes pa'i sras gnam ri srong btsan/ des tshe spong bza' 'bri ma gtogs ( zhan lu〉mdog )this skong bzhes pa'i sras srong btsan sgam po/ des btsun mo gsum las/ mo bza' khri mo gnyan gyi sras/ gung srong gung btsan/ de'i zhal ( na〉zhang (lus zhal )'bros byas te yab kyi sngon du 'das pas phyed ces bgyi'o/ /des wa zhwa bza' mang po rje bzhes pa'i sras mang srong mang btsan/ de'i zhang tshe spong gis bgyi'o/ /des 'bro pa ( lu〉 za )khri chen khro ma lod kyi sras dur srong mang po rje rlung nam/ des mchims bza' mtshams me tog bzhes pa'i sras me khri lde gtsug brtan/skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu/ /btsan lngar byed na ma dag ste/ /'on kyang phyed dang bcu lags so/ khren tu skyid pa'i rgyal rabs phyed dang bzhi ni me khri ldes btsun mo drug bzhes pa las/ rgya rje yag 'byam gyi sras

bod kyi rgyal rabs bzhugs so//mo gyim phya gon ju'i sras khri srong lde btsan/ des btsun mo bzhes pa'i tshe spong bza' rma rgyal mtsho skar ma la sras bzhi 'khrungs te mu khri btsan po gzhen pa la gshegs/ mu tig btsan po thar pa la gshegs/ mu ne btsan pos rgyal sa lo gcig zla ba dgu byas nas yum gyis bkrongs pas phyed ces bya'o/ khri lde srong btsan gyis rgyal sa bzung ngo / /des 'byo bza' lha rgyal gung skar ma bzhes pa'i sras gsum gyi che ba khri btsan ( na〉 gtsang (lus ba 'a )ma/ lho bum thang du bcug nas 'brom bza' legs rje dang /sna nam bza' me rje the'u dug gis bkrongs/ glang dar ma sprel mgo mi sdug pa glen pas rgyal sar ma btan/ chung ba khri gtsug lde ral pa can gyis ( lus rgyal po bgyis)te shin tu skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bzhi lags so / / de yan chad mi rje mdzad nas rgyal po'i rabs ( na〉 lus bzhi )bcu la mu yi dang khri lde gnyis mched lags pas gdung rabs so dgu lags so / / dam pa chos kyi dbu rnyed nas rgyal po'i rabs bcu bzhi lags so/ /yang brjod par bya ste/ dang po rgyal po gang du 'brungs pa dang / yab dang ji srid 'grogs pa dang / tshe yi tshad dang rgyal sa ji tsam bzung ba dang / gang du 'das sa rnams gzhung 'di bstan par bya ste/ 'on kyang gnam ri srong btsan yan chad la ni de zhib tshegs gzhung nas bstan pa med/ 'on kyang mi rje mdzad nas gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa drug la/ ( lus lo )drug brgya dang drug cu rtsa drug thal/ dam pa'i chos dbu rnyed nas ni gdung rabs lnga la lo grangs brgya dang lnga bcu thal zer/ sdong btsan sgam po me mo glang gi lo la

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ ()'khrungs/ spyan ras gzigs te bcu gsum lon nas yab/ /'das nas chab srid lo grangs drug cu dgur/ /bzung nas spyir lo brgyad cu gya gnyis nas( lu〉na)/ /'phrul snang bcu gcig zhal la thim mo skad/ /'phan yul zal mo sgang du 'das kyang zer/ /nges par thugs rje chen po lags pas na / / spyan ras gzigs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo//gung srong bcu gsum bzhes nas chab srid ni/ /lo lngar bzung ste bco brgyad lon nas 'das/ /slar yang yab kyi rgyal srid bzung ngo skad/ /me pho khyi la mang srong 'khrungs nas ni/ /lo skor gcig nas mes 'das mang srong des/ /bco lngar srid bzung nyi shu rtsa bdun dpyid/ /rtsang ( lu〉 gtsang )gi bar snang zhes byar 'das so skad/ /dur srong ma bltams pa nas yab 'das te/ /chu pho byi ba'i lo la bsgrags su bltams/ /cig car srid bzung nyi shu rtsa dgu na/ /'jang gi yul du 'das te bur gnyer ni/ /cog gru khong khri dag gis bgyis so skad/ khri lde gtsug brtan lcags 'brug dpyid kyi dus/ /pho brang ldan dkar 'das( lus ga grungs)te lo gzhug la/ /yab 'das cig car srid bzung dgung lo ni/ /drug cu rtsa gsum bzhes nas chu rta la/ /yar 'brog sbas pa bya bar 'das so skad/ khri srong lcags rta'i dpyid ka brag dmar du / / 'khrungs nas bcu gsum lon nas yab 'das te/ /cig car srid bzhes bzhi bcu rtsa gsum bzung / /lnga bcu rtsa drug lon te shing glang la/ /zung 'phrang nang du 'das zhes gsal bar thos/ /mu ni btsan po chu stag brag dmar gzungs/ /rtsa lnga lon na~X srid bzung lo gcig dang / /zla dgu

bod kyi rgyal rab bzhug so// srid bzung spun phur yum gyis bkrongs//gcung po khri lde srong btsan shing 'brug ston/ /brag dmar du 'khrungs nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas/ /gcen grongs rgyal srid sum cu so gcig bzung / /spyir lo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi bzhes pa na/ /me bya'i ston gar sgrags kyi phur 'das so/ khri gtsug lde btsan ral pa can zhes pa/ /me pho khyi la 'o cang de( na〉 de lu〉 ste)'ur bltams/ /gsum gyi gcung po yon tan ldan pa 'di/ /bcu gnyis lon nas yab 'das rgyal sar bton/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi rgyal sa bzung ba las/ /'dzam gling sum gnyis dag gi rgyal po bgyis/ /rje btsun phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa 'di/ /lcags bya sum cu rtsa drug 'das so skad//chu pho rta la khri srong rgyal sa bzung //lcags mo bya la khri gtsug lde btsan 'das/ /de yi bar la dgu bcu go dgu ru / / dam chos shin tu dar te skyid pa'i rabs/ /de nas dam chos khrims bsnubs rgyal srid nyams/ /chos kyi dbu g.yogs glang dar rgyud la smin/ /bod spyi khur ba med de sil bur gyur/ /dam chos nub kyang rim gyis dar bar 'gyur/ /gsum gyi gcen po rtsang ma lcags pho dbyug /( lu〉 mo lug)rgyal srid ma bzung lho brag bum thang du/ /'bro bza' legs rje sna nam mang mo rjes/ /dug gis bkrongs te de yi srid brgyud bzhugs/ /bar pa glang dar sprel mgo chu mo lug /bco lnga lon tshe yab 'das bcu ( lu so )dgu la/ /gcung 'das de nas rgyal srid bzung nas ni/ /zla ba drug tu tshul ngan rgyal po byas/ /lcags mo bya yi mjug tu dam chos bsgrubs/ /de nas zla ba phyed dang bsan dag tu/ /sdig rgyal byas te de

ba chen 'od snang la /gsu'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ ()dag spyir bsdams nas/ /lo gcig zla phyed bgyis te khyi lo la/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi rdo rjes bsad/ /'od srungs yum brtan dag ni spun yin te/ /'od srungs chu mo phag la spur phur skyes/ /de ma thag tu srid bzung lo gsum na/ /shing mo glang la yar lung sa ( lus sa)'phangs (〈lus dar )'das/ /yum brtan sum cu drug la shi zhes zer/ /de gnyis ring nas dus ngan mgo tshugs so//phyi yi so ka shor nas bod nang 'byugs// pha pad ( lu〉phas phad )gsum po de la btsog pa med/ /dpal 'khor chu mo glang la 'phangs dar 'khrungs/ /bcu gsum bzhes nas yab 'das de nas ni/ /bco brgyad rgyal srid bzung ba'i bar la ni/ /gtsug lag khang brgya ( lu〉brgyad )bzhengs shing chos la gus/ /mes kyi spyod pa dag la shin tu smad//so gcig chu lug yar lung shar bor grongs/ /de nas bod kyi khrims 'khrugs dus nyams te//sa mo glang la khyeng sku1ga byung ngo skad/ /me mo bya la bang so'i dur rnams brus/ /dpal 'khor sras gnyis stod smad gnyis su gyes/ /yab mched drug gis rgyal sa khong bur bzung //yang smras pa / khri yer btsan po'i ring la/srung dang sdom ( na ldems lus sdom )dang /gnam bon po gshen po che chung byung / gri gum btsan po grongs nas spu lde gung rgyal gyi ring la zhang zhung dang / sru sha'i bon pos gshen gyi dur bon byung / tho tho ri snyan btsan gyi ring la dam pa'i chos kyi dbu rnyed/ gnam ri srong btsan gyi ring la rgya nag nas rtsis byung / srong btsan sgam po'i ring la dam pa'i chos kyi srol bstod/ mtha /zhi lho bal phal che ba dbang du

bod kyi rgyal rabs bzhugs so// 'dus nas mkhos chen po drug mdzad skad/ khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la/dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ khri lde srong btsan gyi ring la skad gsar chad kyis dam pa'i chos gtan la phab/ yab sras de gnyis kyis gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa brgyad brtsigs/ khri gtsug lde btsan ral pa can gyi sku ring la gtsug lag khang stong rtsa brgyad brtsigs lags so/ /dpal 'khor btsan gyi sras gnyis kyi che ba/ bkra shis brtsegs pa btsan gyi bu gsum gyi che ba dpal sde'i brgyud ni/ gung thang pa/ klu rgyal ba/ spyi pa/lha rtse ba/ glang lung brtsad skor ba rnams yin no//bar pa 'od sde'i brgyud ni / grom pa/ srad pa/ nyang stod pa/ yar lung gi lha chen dpal 'bar la sogs pa yin no/ /chung ba skyid sde'i brgyud ni/ mus pa/ 'jad pa/ nyang stod na rtog (〈khu〉rdog ma )'ga' yod/ dpal 'khor btsan gyi sras chung ba / khri skyid lding gi bu gsum gyi che ba/ dpal gyi mgon gyi brgyud ni/ mar yul pa lags/ bar pa bkra shis mgon gyi brgyud ni shad zhung phyi nang dang /pu rang dang / ya rtse ba lags/ chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyi brgyud ni/ khu bu la sogs pa mon yul rnams na yod do/ /zhes thos so/ /rgyal rabs ma dag payang mang du mthong rgyu mtshan du mas dpyad cing brtag pas dag pa 'ga' zhig kyang mthong nas/sbyir pu sti gcig tsam las legs par ba yis te/ mdor bsdu shin tu dag pa 'di/shākya'i dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal ga skya'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o//'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig/ //5

༄༅/ /rgya bod kyi sde pa'i gyes mdo bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig gang la brten pa yis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel ba'i tshul/ /dge 'dun sde la rag las pas/ /de yi dbye ba brtsam par bya/ /spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'phel ba'i tshul la gnyis te/ rgya dang bod do/ /rgya la bzhi ste/phal chen pa dang / thams cad yod par smra ba dang / gnas brtan pa dang /mang pos bkur ba'o/ /phal chen gyi sde la lnga ste/ shar gyi ri bo'i sde dang /nub kyi ri bo'i sde dang / gangs rir gnas pa'i sde dang / 'jig rten las 'das par smra ba'i sde dang / btags par smra ba'i sde'o/ /de la yang kha cig bzang po lam pa yang zer ro/ /thams cad yod par smra ba la bdun te/gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde dang / 'od srung ba'i sde dang / sa ston pa'i sde dang / chos srung ba'i sde dang / mang du thos pa'i sde dang / gos dmar can gyi sde dang / rnam par phye ste smra ba'i sde'o/ /yang kha cig na mang du thosapa la yul 'khor bzang po yang zer ro/ /rnam par phye ste smra ba la rgyal sras lam pa yang zer ro/ /gnas brtan pa'i sde la gsum ste/ rgyal byed tshal na gnas pa'i sde dang / 'jigs byed ri la gnas pa'i sde dang / gtsug lag khang chen la gnas pa'i sde'o/ /mang pos bkur ba la gsum ste/ sa sgrogs16

rgya bod kyi pa'i gyes mdo bzhugs so//rigs kyi sde dang / rjes su srung ba'i sde dang / gnas ma bu'i sde ste bco brgyad do/ /de ltar sde pa tha dad par bklag pa'i 'khor lo nas/ yul don slob dpon bye brag gis/ /tha dad rnam pa bco brgyad gyes/ shwakya seng ge'i bstan pa ni/ /de ltar rnam pa bco brgyad du/ /gyur te 'gro ba'i bla ma de/ /sngon gyi phrin las dbang gis yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de thams cad kyang gnyis su 'dus te/ mdo sde pa dang / bye brag tu smra ba'o/ /phal chen pa ni dang po yin la/ de las gzhan pa ni phyi ma yin no/ /zhes mkhas pa chen po gsung ngo / /gnyis pa bod kyi sde pa rnams ni/ thams cad yod smra'i sde pa rnams kyi mkhan po'i bye brag gis sde rigs so sor bstan to/ /dbus kyi sde bzhi la klu mes dang /sba dang / rag sha dang / 'bring tsho'o/ /klu mes la sde bzhi/ rgyal lha khang nas mched pa zhang skor dang / rgyal sar khang nas mched pa klan skor dang / yer pa ba ring nas mched la sdog skor dang / sol nag thang po che nas mched pa klu mes kyi skor ro/ /sba la gnyis su byung ste/yung nga gur nas gyes pa'i sba gcen gyi brgyud/ lan pa rta bres nas gyes pa'i rgyud la sba gcung gi brgyud do/ /rag tsho la gnyis te/ lan pa spyil bu nas gyes pa'i rag sha gcen gyi brgyud dang / go ro mtshar rna nas gyes pa'i rag sha gcung gi brgyud do/ /lhas kyi klu mgon nas gyes pa'i 'bring tsho stod pa dang / skar chung lha khang nas gyes pa'i 'bring tsho bar pa dang / snye thang brag sna nas gyes pa'i 'bring tsho smad pa'o/ /smad tsho ni sba rag gi bye brag yin pas me shākya byang chub kyi spra dang rag sha la sdom pa blangs nas

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()'phan yul 'jog po'i klu gong bzung / de la dar byang chub gsal bas sdom pa blangs nas rdol po 'on 'chang rdo rje bzung / me shākya byang chub ( lus bzang po )la/ zhang shākya seng shes sdom pa blangs nas phod mod lha khang bzung /de tsho las mched pa la smad tsho zer ro//ra sgreng dang /'or dang /gsang phu gsum jo bo'i gnas gsum zer nas smad kyi sde rigs bzhi po gang du'ang mi gtogs mod kyi/ da lta ni ra sgreng sba rag sbrel/ 'or rma tsho dang 'brel/ gsang phu 'bring tsho dang 'brel lo/ /gtsang gi sde gnyis la lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi skor la/ stod smad bar gsum byung / lo tsho stod pa la gsum ste/ stag la byang chub gyi stag tsho dang / rgya shākya'i be rje'i skor gyi rgya tsho dang / skyo shes rab rdo rje'i skor gyi skyo dang / de gsum bsdams na rgya tsho stag tsho skyo tsho gsum ste/ stod kyi khrag tsho gsum yin/ a me zhu gcig ma'i skor dang / li blo gros gzhon nu'i skor dang / 'dar rdo rje rin byu gyi skor la/ 'dar tsho gsum zhes zer te/ de dag la shad tsho li tsho 'dar tsho gsum zer ro/ /lo tsho smad pa la khral tsho phyed dang drug yod de/ kyi zhal gnyis/brlag tsho glang tsho gnyis/na ga rgyan gong / rgyan gong ba mo skor ro/ /de la na ga rgyan skor gsum khral tsho phyed du byed de/ de'i skor la/ phan gyi bya tsha dang / pa tshab kyi ma ( lu〉la )jo phug lha khang dang / mgur mo lha khang dang / sna bzhi lha khang rnams yin mod kyis/ zha lu'i gseb du song nasamed do/ /rgyan tsho ( lus gong bzhi )wa mo skor la nyid kyis 'ong kha/ sna ris gong ma/ shab kyi 'dar snang dang /18srad kyi ltang ldang de tsho las mched pa

rgya bod kyi sde pa'i gyes mdo bzhugs so// ni / wa mo skor zhes bya ba yin/ mar la thad nas mched pa ni rgya tsho yin/dbye'i lha khang nas mched pa skyo tsho yin/ skad des lho brag tu byon nas mkhan po byas pa la rtswa tsho zhes byas te/ gnyal lho brag g.yo ru stong pa gsum la sde pa gnam gyi skar ma tsam zhig yod de/ stag lo lha khang nas gyes pa la stag tsho zer/ 'phrang brag dmar las gyes pa tsho la zha tsho zer/lha khang me ru nas gyes pa la zhu tsho zer/ 'ol tshal grags pa de de nas mched pa yin/ shab kyi na rang sgo mtsho nas gyes pa tsho la 'dar tsho zer/ kyi tsho la stod smad bar dang gsum ste stod pa la khral tsho bzhi/ grang chung skor dang / rgya tsho dang /( lu〉stu tshodang /)war tsho'o/ /rba gtsug chen gyi mkhan po byas nas grang chung nas gyes pa tsho la grang chung skor zer/ rgya shākya ban+desamakhan po byas nas nyi rong khong brkyang bzung nas de las mched pa tsho la rgya tsho zer/ kyi ston brtson 'bar gyis mkhan po byas nas dug chung bzung nas de nas mched pa tsho la khri tsho zer/ sa phug 'dzin gyis sa rbad kyi mkhan po byas pa tsho la sar tsho zer/ kyi tsho bar pa la gnyis te/ 'khris ( lusargodang )bya bskyungs skor/ kyi tsho smad pa la gnyis te/ gye re glang ra nas mched pa la glang ra skor zer/ myug gi gnas sar nas mched pa la ur tsho zer/ lce shes rab rdo rjes mkhan po byas nas zha lu nas mched pa la ka bzhi dang gdung drug mgo ral pa can dang bdun bya ba byung ste/ ka bzhi ni gur/ dga' ba gdong gnyis/ g.yus yi ser gnyis te bzhi'o/ /gdung drug ni kho re lha khang dang / re lha /bye dang / pho 'gal dang / 'dol chung

nga tshe tshe na 'od snang la /sa skya'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/ ()gnyis/zha phud dang rgya thang ngo //mgo ral pa can ni nyang stod byang chad do//de tsho la zha lu skor( 〈 〉 zer ro//) gsum pa klag tsho la gsum ste/ klag byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po mdzad nas chu mig bzung ste/ de nas mched pa la chu mig skor zer/ klag gi grogs po 'gar gyis bsnyems pa bzung sdog gis spun gsum bzung ba yin mod kyis/ sde pa tha dad kyi ming ma byung / klag byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan bu/ klag shākya ye shes kyis mkhan po byas pa'i rkyang btsun spra mos bzung ba'i gnas skor la/ rkyang tsho zer/ glang tsho la stod smad gnyis byung ste/ glang btsun byams pas kri gong bzung nas de nas mched pa la glang tsho stod pa zer/ des g.yas ru gtsang 'phrang bzung nas de las mched pa la smad pa zer/ gnyis pa tshong tsho la gsum ste/ stod smad bar pa'o/ /stod pa laganyis/ skal rgyan skor ro/ /bar pa la gnyis/ gnas rnying pa dang gnas sar skor ro/ /tshong btsun gyis shab kyi lha mo lung bzung nas de las mched pa la/ gnas rnying zer ro / / lcang ra nas mched pa gnas sar skor ro//tshong tsho la ( lu〉dze )smad pa lnga'o/ /( lu〉la )tshong btsun ( lu〉bsnyen )gyis rtsis kyi yang dben bzung nas rtsis lha khang phul ba'i tshe kho rang gi nye gnas lcang btsun la gtad/ des mkhan po mdzad pa tsho la lcang skor zer/ de la gsum byung ste/rtsis pa skor la lcang tsho smad pa zer/ lce dang bye mda' ba tsho la bar pa zer/skyegs dang ze thang dang shong khur skor tsho la stod pa zer/ de nas a mesatshong btsun yo lcags sha ris nyang ṭ+wāṃ phul nas bzung ba'i tshe/ khong gis

rgya bod kyi sde pa'i gyes mdo bzhugs //mkhan po mdzad nas ra blo gros bzang po dang khams pa rin chen bzang po dang gnyis rab tu byung bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad nas/ de gnyis la nyang tsho gtad/ de gnyis kyis mkhan po byas pa la ra tsho dang / khams tsho bya ba byung ste/ ra la phyug tshang dgra bcom gyis ngur smig phul nas de'i skor la ra tsho zer/ khams pa'i mkhan bu khro ba 'bar ba rgyal mtshan gyis tshul chen 'og ma dang / yung gis gnas sar bzung ste/ khams pa'i mkhan bu gcig gis rong gi lcang mkhar bzung / de tsho khams tsho'o/ /de gnyis la nya tsho skor du grags so/ /de nas a mes la bya chos mkhar po che phul ba'i tshe/ khong gis mkhan bu rgya rgyal bu tshul les bya tshos nas brang thang bskyed do/ /de'i mkhan bu ko yes 'byung gis dmu bskyed/ de gnyis las mched pa tsho la bya skor/ de a mes mar byon pa'i shul du yon bdag mo gnyos mos smon gro phul/ de'i mkhan bu mar pa ye shes rdo rje la gtad/ des mkhan po mdzad nas rnal po grags pa rgyal mtshan rab tu byung ste/ mkhan phug bzung / mar pa'i mkhan bu gcig gis rgyus thang bzung / mar pa'i mkhan bu gnyi ba chen pos dong phug bzung / de nas mched pa la dong nag skor zer/ tshas kha thung brag dmar po bzung / de nas mched pa la kha thung skor zer/ myong ros nang gong gi mang ra bzung / de nas mched pa la mang ra skor/ tsho btsun gyi mkhan bu zhang pa tshab khrod pas ra sogs mtshar la bzung / desamakhan po gyas pa'i dge mthong gis rong sa do dang / stag tshal mkhar sar dang rgyan mkhar rkyang thur tsho bzung /2zhang gis khyim ser gyi snang khrod dang /

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()brag gzhong dang / btsan mo lding dang / rtsis kyi yang dben bzung de tsho la de tsho skor zer/ spyir khams su bka' drin zhus pa la de tsho dang mnyam por shangs pa sde pa dbu dkar ba dang / 'o brgyad spun gnyis kyis kyang phyin pa yin mod kyi sde pas gru mo spangs rtsa brtsigs te/ tshong tsho'i gseb tu song /'o brgyad spun gnyis kyis sde gang yang ma bzung / spyir de ltar yin pa la 'bre gnyis kyi byung lugs ni/ 'bro ston gzhen nu tshul khrims kyis rta nag bye tshang bzung nas mkhan bu krog ge chung la brten nas yar stag sde chos lung gi skor tsho mched/ bar shangs kyi bye phug nas shangs kyi 'bre tsho mched do / / 'jad du 'bre tsho ba bzhi la nyang btsun smon lam rgyal mtshan gyis stong (〈lu〉sde )khrod bzung nas de'i skor tsho mched do/ /lcang btsun dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis khyel gyi lug lam bzung nas lcang tsho mched do/ /mi btsun rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis 'jad kyi mar stong bzung nas mi tsho stod smad du gyes so/ /gnas brgyad pa'i mkhan po la brten nas de dag gi sde skor gyes so/ /lam mo bye tshang nas rta nag gi 'bre tsho gyes/ 'o bskol phya'i ston tshang man chad nas dbus kyi rtag phru dgon pa man chad bye tshang nas chad do//wa zhwa ye shes g.yung drung gis 'o thug gi ra sha bzung / de nas sna nam 'dre sna bzung / phyis stag gis gnas mo che bzung / de'i lam stegs su khor re khang 'bor bzung / de nas ldan gyi gre shod bzung / de'i mkhan bu sog ston yon tan tshul khrims kyi bla mas ldan gyi ba so thang bzung / kho re gnyan pa gong dang / khu lung lha graX spyang nyang smad bud kha bzung / 'dres

rgya bod kyi sde pa'i gyes ma rdo bzhugs so//brdas dang 'tshal zhabs dang dpag tshal bzung / sog gi mkhan bu yang 'dul ba 'dzin pas stag gi dpe can brtsigs/ sog gi mkhan bu dge bshes zhus klas po che bzung / de thams cad la wa tsho zer ba yin/ de rnams ni smad nas yar mched pa'i lugs yin no/ /stod nas mar dar ba la / 'dzim pa shes rab 'od kyis 'dzim gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ de nas mched pa tshol bu tsho smad pa la rgyal gyi thang dmar rtsag gis dur lung bzung / sa skor gyi deng lag kha/ mdo thang gi 'gyes lung / btsan 'khor gyi ri chung / rong gi the lung ste/ gnas drug po mched do/ /byang chub sems dpa' brag chi lung bzung nas/ yar dmu rdzing bzung / mar dgun lhasabazung ste/ de tsho byang chub sems dpa'i skor ro/ /mon gro 'dul ba 'dzin pas a khyu ( lu〉rta )shal gyi mon mkhar bzung ba'i bu tsho bar pa'o/ /pu tsho stod pa la tho ling gser khang / rgya zhing gi lha khang / kha char gyi lha khang /snying po'i gtsug lag khang / na mo'i gtsug lag khang / nya tsho rigs dang /tsha tsha sgang la sogs pa pu tsho stod pa'o/ /blo ldan gang gis sde pa yi/ /dbye ba rnam dag shes 'dod na/ /mkha pa rnams kyi sbyar ba yi/ /legs pa'i gtam 'di shes pa ra gyis/ /'disabastan pa dang sems can thams cad la phan par gyur cig/ dge'o// //

༄༅/ /chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i chos 'byung chen mo bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /mnyam med mtshungs med dpa' bo shākya seng ge chos kyi rgyal po bcom ldan lha yi lha/ /dpe med zla med skyes mchog smra ba'i seng ge sangs rgyas stobs bcu mnga' ba dgos pa thams cad mkhyen/ /mi mchog mi phul drang srong rgyal ba seng ge dgra bcom 'dren pa thub dbang rkang gnyis gtso/ /'gro mgon 'gro ba'i bla ma mi yi seng ge ston pa bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo / / skye med chos gang gis ston skyes bu skye rgu'i skye rgyun spang phyir skye ba skye bar yul ser skyas byin pa ser skya'i grong dang ma ga spyi la sogs su/ gang gsung dbyangs gsung gi sgra yi sgra dbyangs gdul bya de dang de la gang du bka' mdo sder bde gshegs bde ba bstsal thabs lan gcig ma yin pa ra yang dang yang / tshu po ji lta ji ltar gsungs pa de ltar de ltar gang gis bde nas bder 'gro kho bos gdul bya blo gsal blo yi nor can rnam gang la/ gang rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos kyi byung tshul rnam pa sna tshogs dus nyin dang nyin la tshul 'di dang 'di zhes legs gtam legs bshad 'o/༈/sdom ni gsum ste chos sde ngos gzung dang / /bshad nyan tshul dang 'bras bu'o/ /chosani lung dang rtogs pa gnyis/ /lung chos bka' dang bstan bcos te/ /bka' la gsung ba po'i che ba rang bzhin gnyis/ /ston pa'i che ba rnam gsum ste/ /sems bskyed tshogs bsags sangs rgyas pa caX/4/ /rang bzhin la gsum sgra bshad mtshan

cho rje 4skya paṇ+ḍita sa mdzad pa 'i chos 'byung chen mo bzhugs so//nyid dbye/ bstan bcos tshul yang de dang mtshungs/ ༈ /rtogs pa'i chos lam dang 'gog pa yin/ bshad tshul la bzhi ste bshes gnyen dang / snod rung bshad thabs 'dun tshul lo/ ༈ /bshes gnyen don tshul bla mar 'os/ ༈ /snod rung thos don mi gnyer dang / ༈ /don ma yin dang don med spong / ༈ /bshad thabasachos ni ngos bzung dang / khyu dang ngo bo man ngag bzhi/ ༈ /'jug tshul gdul bya dgos pa dang / ༈ /'brel dang nyams len dbang gis bzhi/ /mnyam tshul gsum dang 'bras bu gsum/ ༈ /spyir rtog ldan 'jug pa'i yul la/ las da nga 'bras bu gsum gyis khyab pas 'dir chos nyan bshad la 'jug pas kyang / spyi don gsum du shes par bya ste/ gang bshad bya dang nyan bya'i chos kyi rang bzhin ngos gzung ba dang / chos de ji ltar bshad cing nyan pa'i tshul dang / ༈ bshad nyan byas pa'i 'bras bu bsam pa'o/ ༈ /dang po la gsum ste/ chos kyi sgra bshad pa dang / sgra 'jug pa'i yul dang / skabs kyi chos ngos gzung ba'o/ /dang po ni dharmā zhes pa'i dha ra na 'dzin par byed pa'i don gyis na chos zhes pa yin pas de la gsum ste/ gzhi 'dzin pa dang / mtshan nyid 'dzin pa dang / lhung ba lasa'adzin pa'o/ /dang po ni chos can sgra la sogs pa yin te chos mi rtag pa la sogs 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos te/ de thams cad kyis rang rang gi mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa ba shes rab las/ mtshan nyid med pa'i dngos po ni/ /'ga' yang gang na'ang yod ma yin/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni dngos po 'ga' zhig thur du lhung ba lcags kyu la sogs pas 'dzin pa ltar/ bye brag ngan 'gro dang / spyir 'khor ba tsam dang /25

ba chen 'od snang la /sa 'a chos 'byung gces bsdus/()theg pa dman par lhung ba las 'dzin pa gsum las/dang po ni mi dge ba bcu spong zhing /dge ba bcu nyams su len pa ste/rin phreng las/'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu//chos spyod pa ni bde bar nyal//zhes so//gnyis pa ni chosathams cad bdag med par sgom pa ste/des 'khor ba'i rgyu bdag 'dzin zlog pa'i phyir ro//rnam 'grel las/bdag lta'i sa bon spangs pa'i phyir//slar mi gshegs pa nyid yin no//zhes so//gsum pa ni thabs shes rab zung 'brel du sgom pa ste/sdud pa las/thabs dang shes rab shes rab pha rol phyin la sbyor//zhes pa dang /bslab btus las/stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can//zhes so//gnyis pa sgra 'jug pa'i yul ni bcu ste/rnam bshad rig pa las/chos ni shes bya lam dang ni/༈/mya ngan 'das dang yid kyi yul/༈/bsod nams tshe dang gsung rab dang / /'byung 'gyur nges dang chos lugs la'o//zhes so//gsum pa ni sgra bshad pa'i nang nas theg pa dman par lhung ba las 'dzin pa dang /yul bcu'i nang nas lam dang mya ngan las 'das pa dang bsod nams dang gsung rab kyi chos te/de dag las bsod nams su gyur pa tsam ni phyi rol pa la'ang yod pas ston pa'i bstan pa thun mong ma yin pa ni lhag ma gsum yin no / / de yang mdzod las/ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te//lung dang rtogasapa'i bdag nyid do//de 'dzin byed dang smra byed pa//sgrub par byed pa kho na yin//zhes pas rtogs pa dang /lung gi chos so//dang po lam dang 'gog pas bsdusapa 'phags pa rnams kyi rgyud la mnga' ste/rgyud bla ma las/gang zhig gang gibangachags bral ba//bden gnyis mtshan nyid can de chos//chags bral nyid ni 26

chos rje sa skya pa rmi lha mdzad pa'i chos 'byung chen mo bzhugs so//'gog pa dang / /lam gyi bden pa dag gis bsdus/ /zhes pa gang zhig 'dod chags dang bral bar bya rgyu 'gog pa'i bden pa dang / gang gis 'dod chags dang bral bar byed pa 'phags pa rnams kyi mnyam gzhag yul can snang ba med pa'i shes rab lam gyi bden pa'o/ /yang na rtsa ba shes rab las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa/ /bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang / /dam pa'i don gyi bden pa'o/ /zhes pas tha snyad pa dang rig pa'i shes pas rtogs bya kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa gnyis so / / gal te don dam pa ni rtogs bya dang bstan bya ma yin te/ shes pa dang brjod pa'i yul ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa bstan pa'i mdo las/kun dga' bo chos ni rna bas nyan par mi nus te/ brjod du med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa dang / spyod 'jug las/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min/ /zhes pas so zhe na / brjod du med pa'i don de nyid lung gis sgro btags nas brjod pas kun rdzob tu gdul bya'i blo la rtogs pa'i chos kyi don spyi gzugs brnyan tsam 'jog cing rgyud la go ba 'phen par byed pa ste/ dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ 'di 'dug pa na med sta nge 'dzin rgyal 'i mdo sde na bod/yi ge med pa'i chos rnams ni/ /nyan dang bshad par nus ma yin/ /'on kyang des ni sgro btags nas/ /nyan dang bshad par byed pa yin/ /zhes so/ ༈ /gnyis pa lung gi chos ni brjod bya bden gnyis ston pa'i rjod byed ngag tshig dri ma med pa yin pas de la bzhi ste/ sgra bshad pa dang / mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi dang / mtshon bya'i dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni ā ga ma zhes pa yid ches pa mi bslu ba'i don gyis na lung ste/ rnam 'grel 27

ba chen 'od snang lag skya'i cho 'gung gces bsdus/ ()las/ lung ni yid ches tshig yin te/ /nyes pa spangs phyir brdzun gyi tshig /smra bar mi 'gyur rgyu med phyir/ /nyes zad lung du shes par bya/ /zhes so/ ༈ /gnyis pa rgyu'i khyad par ni chos kyi rgyu mthun pa'i rgyu las byung zhing byed pa'i khyad par lam gyi dmigs pa gsal po ston par byed thabs kyis gzhan gyi rgyud la rtogs pa khyad par can skye bar byed pa'i rang gi ngo bo'i khyad par ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs kyisabasdus pa mtha' dag zhes pa'am/ yang na rtogs par byed pa'i thabs ston pa'i ming tshig yi ge'i phreng ba zhes 'chad de legs so/ ༈ /gsum pa ni grub mtha'i dbang gis tha dad du 'gyur te/mdzod las/chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dag /gang rnams thub pas gsungs de dag /tshig gam ming yin de dag kyang / /gzugs dang 'du byed dag tu 'dus/ /zhes pas bye brag smra bas ming sgra spyi gzugs sems byung ba gsum las tha dad pa'i mi ldan pa'i 'du byed du 'dus par 'dod la / mdo sde pas sgra rang gi mtshan nyid phung po lnga las gzugs kyi phung por 'dus par 'dod cing / sems tsam pas lung chos kyi mtshan gzhi chos lnga ldan te / ngo bo rnam rig sna tsho gos dang / rnam par sbyar ba rkyang pa'i sgra sna tshogs dang /rgyud nyan pa po'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa dang / byed pa mngon par 'dod pa'i don khyad par can la brda sprod par byed pa yin la/ rnam rig gi tsho gos brgyad las kun gzhi dang nyon yid dang / sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa ma yin gyi drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa de la yang rtog bcas rtog med gnyis las sgra spyi 'dzin pa'i rtog pa'o zhes 'dod do/ /'on kyang dngos po dang wo pa'i brjod bya rjod byed thams cad lung chos su 'thad do/ /gsungs pas zhen pa'i brjod bya shog bu la 28

chos rje ga paṇ+ḍi lha mdzad pa'i cho 'byung chen mo pa'i sa so//snag tsho'i 'bur du dod pa yi ge'i gzugs su rang mtshan dang dngos kyi brjod bya'i yi ge de 'di 'dra zhig yod ces blo yul du lam gyis dran pa spyi'i mtshan nyid dang / zhen pa'i rjod byed gzugs dang tshor ba dang zhes pas nyan thos pa'i shesapa la grag pa'i sgra rang mtshan dang dngos kyi rjod byed chos 'chad pa'i sgra de 'di 'dra zhig yod ces dran pa spyi mtshan te/ de thams cad lung gi chos yin no/ /bzhi pa dbye ba ni tshul gsum pa'i sgron me'i mdo las/ bka' dang bstan bcosaganyis su chos rnams 'dus/ /legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel dang / /de yi dbang gis shākya'i bstan pa 'di/ /'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas par 'gyur/ /zhes pas bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis las/ dang po la gnyis te/ bka' gsung ba po ston pa'i che ba brjod pa dang / desagasungs pa'i bka'i rang bzhin bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgya cher rol pa las/mnyam med mtshungs med nga la su yis bstan/ /chos rnams rang gis rtogs nas rab ston pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha mi'i ston pa yin/ /zhes pas gzhan gyis ma bstan par rang gis ji lta bar rtogs pa ston pa sangs rgyas nyag gcig ste / skabs kyi rgyal ba shākya thub pa yin la/ de'i rnam par thar pa yang nyan thosadang / theg pa chen po dang / gsang sngags la grags pa du ma yod pa las/'dir mdo rgya cher rol pa dang / mngon 'byung dang / mya ga las 'das pa dang /'dul ba lung la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brangs te/ theg pa thun mong la grags pa mdo tsam zhig brjod par bya'o/ /de yang lung las/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du tsho gos bsags shing / /bar 29

'tshen na 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan seng ge de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas/ dang po bskyed dka' ba'i bsam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs ji ltar bskyed pa dang / bar du bsgrub dka' ba'i sbyor ba pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du tshogs ji ltar bsags pa dang /tha ma thob dka' ba'i 'bras bu rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas ji ltar brnyes pa'i tshul gsum las/ dang po ni/ de la dang po rigs sam nusapas snying rje'i bsam pa rab gsal cing / sbyor ba dang bsam pa phun sum tshogs pas/ byang chub sems ni yongs su bzung / /zhes pas/ sngon theg pa chen po'i rigs la gnas pa'i tshe/ las kyi nus pas dmyal ba'i lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi la me'i shing rta 'dren pa'i gyad cig tu skyes so/ /de'i tshe shing rta 'dren pa'i zla bo stobs chung pas ma 'drongs pa la/ gshin rje'i skyes bus lcags kyi mdung rtse gsum pa brang du btsugs te lcags kyi tho bas brdeg cing bsnun pa la shin tu brtse ba skyes te/ kye gshin rje'i skyes bu/ 'di la ma bsnun ciga'adi'i skal ba bdag gis drang bar bya'o/ /zhes pa dang / gshin rje'i skyes bu a wa rab tu khros nas/ sems can so so rang gi las kyi bgo skal la spyod pa la/khyod ci byar yod ces te/ gnya' bar lcags mdung rtse gsum pa btsugs nas tho ba me 'bar ba rab tu bsnun pas/ der tshe'i dus byas te sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skyes so/ /zhes mdo drin lan gsab pa las 'byung ngo / /de nas 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid du rdza mkhan gyi bu khye'u snang byed ces bya bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa chen po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byon pa la shin tu 30

chos rjes skya paṇ+ḍi lhas mdzad pa'i chos 'byung chen mo bzhugs so// dad pa skyes te/ gdugs gsar pa gcig dang / mchil lhum gsar pa 0 khyag dang / rdza'i bum pa chus gang ba gcig byi dor byas pa mchod par phul nas 'gron bu brgyas kyang gtor te/ gzhan don du de lta bu nyid thob par 'dod pas/de bzhin gshegs pa khyod sku ci 'dra dang / /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang dpe byad dang / khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog /ces pa dang / bskal pa bzang po las/ nga ni sngon tshe dman par gyur pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub de la/ /'jam gang zhig ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang po byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /zhes pa'i tshig gis smon pa'i sems bskyed do/ ༈ /gnyis pa tshogs bsags pa ni/ lam lnga dang sa bcu bgrod pa ste/ 'dir chos kyi bdag med pa la mos shing tshogs lam gyi rtags chos zab mo la mi skrag pa la sogs pa thob pas grangs med pa gsum gyi dang po rtsom ste/ tshogs lam la 'jug pa'i tshe rgyal po'i pho brang rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya bar rgyal po tshe rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i sras/ rgyal bu brtson 'grus spyod pa zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa 'od 'phro ba'i phung po chen po zhes bya ba/ nyan thos phrag khrig phrag bsnyen cu rtsa gnyis dang bcas pa 'jig rten du byon pas/ tshad med pa bzhi dang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang / phar phyin drug gis bsdus pa'i byang chub kyi lam yang dag pa bstan par mdzad do/ khye'u des kyang de la dga' ba dang dad pa skyesanas de lo bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug tu bsnyen bkur ba nas bzung ste/ bskal pa grangs med pa gcig tu sangs rgyas bdun khri lnga stong la tshogs gnyis 31

ba chen 'od snang lags skya'i chos 'gung gtse0bsdus/ ()bsags pas tshogs sbyor gyi lam gnyis las 'das te sa dang po rab tu dga' ba thob par gyur to/ /de yang phung po'i rgyun la brdar btags pa'i skye gnas shig stong bzhi'i rang bzhin bar gyi bskal pa brgyad cu la bskal pa gcig tu rtsis so/ /zhes 'chad do/ /de nas grong khyer 'dzam bu chu po'i gser zhes bya bar rgyal po mdzes par snang ba zhes bya ba'i snang chen po tshong dpon shes rab bzang po zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag ces bya ba nyan thos bye ba phrag bcu dang bcas pa 'jig rten du byon pa la rjes su bstan pa thob cing de la lo stong du bsnyen bkur ba nas bzung ste/ bskal ba grangs med pa gcig tu sangs rgyas bdun khri drug stong la tshogs gnyis bsags pas sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa dang / gsum pa 'od byed pa dang / bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba dang / lnga pa sbyang dka' ba dang / drug pa mngon du gyur pa dang /bdun pa ring du song ba ste/ ma dag pa'i sa bdun non nas sa brgyad pa phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin zhes bya bar gyur pas slob dpon bram ze rin po che zhes bya ba'i rig byed gsum grangs nges par sbyor ba dang bcas pa shes pa 'khor lha lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu ri bo gangs can la gnas pa zhig la rig byed bslab bas nas mkhas par gyur pa dang / bram ze'i khye lha nu'ibadag yul du mchi na bdag gis bgyi ba ci mchis zhes smras pa dang / khyod kyisagar sha pa ni lnga brgya byin cig ces smras so/ /de nas des bsnyen bkur gyi rgyu btsal ba'i phyir yul dbus kyi grong khyer dag tu ljongs rgyur song ste/ mthar gyis rgyal po dgra thul zhes bya ba'i pho brang pad+mo can zhes bya ba'i tshong 'dus kyi 32

chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa mdzad pa'i chos 'byung chen mo bzhugs so// dbus su phyin te/ de'i tshe dgra thul gyis bram ze mar me'i bdag po zhes bya ba la rgyal srid byin te gnyis ka chos kyi rgyal srid skyong ba dang / mar me'i bdag po la khye'u 'od gsal zhing mdzes pa zhig btsas pas bram ze mtshan mkhan gyis byang chub tu lung bstan te/ de'i ming mar me mdzad ces bya bar btags so/ /de nas ma ma dag gis bskyed bsrings te ring po ma lon par mkhas par gyur pa dang gtsang ma'i lhas bskul te/ bas mo'i 'khor gyi nang 'dir ni/ /yon tan 'byung gnas gyur pa med/ /drang srong rgyal mtshan gnas na ni/ /byang chub dam pa rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes gsan pa dang / khyim spangs te rab tu byung bas de nyid kyi mtshan mor sangs rgyas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad ces bya bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe rgyal po dgra thul gyis bram ze mar me'i bdag po khyod kyi srasazhig sangs rgyas so zhes thos pa/sa de bdag gi drung du gshegs su gsol/ gal te mi gshegs na bdag dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang bcas pa mchi'o zhes pho nya btang ba dang / de bcom ldan 'das nyid la gsol bas dgra bcom pa bye ba phrag brgyad cu dang / byang chub sems dpa' stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang bcas pa dgra thul gyi pho brang du spyan drangs te nam mkha' la lha rnams me tog dang rol mo/ sil snyan glu dbyangs dang bcas te/ bzhugs pa mthong nasakhyed ci byed dris pa dang / khyod kyis mi shes sam 'di na de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad bzhugs so zhes zer ro/ /de skyi bungs zhes byed de kye ma sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa ni u dum wa ra'i me tog bas kyang ches rnyed par dka' ba'o/ /da ni bdag gis slob dpon gyi yon ni phyis gsab par bya ste/33

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung ge bsdus/()thog mar dar sha pa ni lnga brgya po 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod par bya'o//snyam du dgongs nas me tog btsal ba la rgyal pos me tog btsong du med pa'i khrims bcas pas ma rnyed pa de'i tshe bram ze'i bu mo bzang len ldan gyis me tog yis bdun gsang te nyos nas chu'i bum par sbas pa khye'u yi mthus nam mkha' la 'thon te/de nas khye'u sa me tog de nyid nyor byin zhig ces smras pa dang skye ba thams cad du khyim thab tu khas len na sbyin no zhes zer ba la/bu mo/de skad ma zer cig bdag ni rtag tu tshangs par spyad pa spyod do//zhes smras pa dang /de ltar na'ang lan cig de ltar khas long dang phyis kho mos dge ba'i bar chad mi byed do zhes pa la/skye ba thams cad du khyim thab tu gyur cig ces khasablangs te/ut+pal lnga nyos nas udzi po lnga phul gnyis mo rang gi mja pa'i sna la bar bzhag de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad ga la ba der yis lnga po thams cad gtor te/khri snyan sa le'i lngags pa bting pa nyan thos kyis brtul pa dang slar yang bting nas mar me mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa kun nas spyan bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa thugs su chud par mdzod la ri dwags kyi lngags pa la zhabs bzhag par mdzod cig de byon pa mchod pas mnyes par byas te/ral pa gser gyi mdog can stan du bting nas mar me mdzad kun nas spyan ral pa 'di la zhabs bzhag bdag lung bstan pas dbugs dbyung du gsol/phyag gis drang du gsol/gal te zhabs mi 'jog gam lung mi ston na 'di nyid du lus bskam par bya'o//zhes yid dam brtan po byas pa dang /ston pas de'i lhag pa'i bsam pa thugs su chud nas/ral pa de la lo bcu gnyis su zhabs bzhag te/4

chos rje sa pa ṇ+ḍi7mdzad pa'i chos 'gung tho rmo ba lugs so// g.yas phyogs nas glang po che'i lta stangs kyis gzigs shing nyan thos rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed rnams khye'u 'di'i sgra la sdogs pa ma 'jog cig de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni lha dang bcas pa'i mchod gnas yin te/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi bskal pa bzang po zhes bya ba la skye rgu rnams kyi tshe lo brgya pa'i dus su bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa dang / de dga' ches te nam mkha' la shing tā la bdun srid du mngon par 'phags nas/ ting nge 'dzin bye ba phrag khrig brgya phrag stong yang mngon du byas nas sa brgyad pa thob snye/ji skad du/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad la ut+pal lngas/ /gtor te ral pa gdan du bting byas pas/ /mi skye'i chos la bzod pa thob gyur nas/ shākya'i rgyal por 'gyur zhesang lung bstan/ /zhes pa dang / 'dul ba lung las/ gang tshe mar me mdzad kyis nga / /lung bstan gyur pa de yi tshe/ /sa brgyad pa ni thob gyur cing / /dbang bcu dag kyang thob par gyur/ /zhes so/ /sa bdun man chad du dngos su lung bstan pa mi 'byung ste/ mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub semasadapa'i sde snod las/ mar me mdzad kyi pha rol na ngas dkar po'i chos la ma spyad pa gang yang med de lung ma bstan no/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mtshan ma dang bcas pas spyod par gyur to/ /zhes so/ /de nas mar me mdzad de bsnyen bkur ba nas bzung ste bsal pa grangs med pa gcig la brgya lus pa na/ de bzhin 35

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()gshegs pa skar ma'i rgyal po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byon pa la/ skyes bu khyu mchog khyod 'dra'i dge sbyong chen po gzhan dag lha yul sa la'ang med/ /ces tshigs su bcad pa gcig pas zhag bdun gyi bar du bstod cing bskor ba byas pa'i brtson 'grus kyis bskal pa dgu'i tshogs 'dums par gyur to/ /mdo gang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa las/ bram ze dam pa 'di ring du/ /de bzhin gshegasapa legs bstod pa'i/ /stobs dang brtson 'grus rdzogs pa 'di/ /bskal pa dgu zhig 'dums par gyur/ /zhes so/ /de nas 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par bltas pa zhes bya bar/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba byon nas bsnyen bkur ba nas bzung ste/ bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig 'das pa na/bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid skye rgu rnams kyi tshe lo nyi khri pa la/ grong khyer gnyen ldan du sangs rgyas 'od ldan byon pa na bram ze'i khye'u bla ma zhes bya bar gyur pa des/ mnyes par byas pa'i mthar thug par grangs med pa gcig tu sangs rgyas bdun khri bdun stong la tshogs gnyis bsags pas/ sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba dang / dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros dang / bcu pa chos kyi sprin te dag pa'i sa gsum brnyes pa'o/ /'dul ba lung las/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa nas/ /'dren pa yul 'khor skyong gi bar/ /bdun khri lnga stong tshang ba yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod do/ /sangs rgyas legs mdzad nas bzung nas/ /dbang po'i rgyal mtshan thub pa'i bar/ /bdun khri drug stong tshang ba yi/ /sangs rgyasarnams ni ngas mchod do/ /sangs rgyas mar me mdzad nas ni/ /sangs rgyas 'od srungs bar dag tu/ /bdun khri bdun stong tshang ba yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas 36

chos rje ga paṇ+ḍi7 mdzad pa'i chos 'gu pa mā mo bzhugs so// mchod do/ /zhes pa dang / mdzod las/ rnam gzigs mar me rin chen gtsug /grangs med gsum gyi tha mar byung / /dang po shākya thub pa yin/ /zhes pas grangs tshad dang bcas par 'dod la/ theg chen pas ni ma yin no/ /de ltar grangs med gsum du sangs rgyas dang sems can la phar phyin drug gis tshogs gnyis bsags pas dga' ldan du skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar po zhes bya bar gyur to/ // gsum pa sangs rgyas brnyes pa'i tshul ni/rgyud bla ma las/ thus rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tsho gos kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /lhums su zhugasadang bltams pa dang / /bzo gnas dag la mkhas pa dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor du dgyes rol dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang / /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / /bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs rnga ra ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'bor lo dang / /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes pas mdzad pa bcu gnyis te/ dga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'pho ba dang / yum gyi lhums su 'jug pa dang / lu zhi'i tshal du bltams pa dang / bzo'i gnas la mkhas pa dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyis dgyes par rol pa dang / nges par 'byung ba dang / dka' ba spyod pa dang / byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / bdud btul ba dang / sangasargyas pa dang / chos kyi 'bor lo bsgor ba dang / mya ga las 'das pa'i mdzad 37

gye 'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/ ()pa'/ /༈ 'di yang nyan thos pas dang po dgu tsho gis lam gyi dang / tha ma gsum sangs rgyas kyi sar 'dod la/ theg pa chen pos dang po dgu sa bcu'i dang / tha ma gsum sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa'o/ /zhes 'chad cing / kha cig chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos par zhes pas thams cad kyang thub pa nyid kyis mdzad par 'dod do/ /de la mdzad pa dang po ni/ nyid kyi bsod nams kyi mthu dang / sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs kyis lha'i rol mo'i sgra dag las/ byang chub semasadapa' la bskul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ bsod nams rgya chen tshogs mnga' dran rtogs dang / /blo gros mtha' yas shes rab 'od mdzad pa/ /mtshungs med stobs mnga' mthu rtsal rgya che ba/ /mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan dgongs par mdzod/ /skyes mchog khyod kyi bsod nams dpal gyis ni/ /dga' ldan pho brang shin tu mdzes mod kyi/ /'on kyang thugs rje'i thugs dang ldan pas na/ /'dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan du ni char pa phob/ /snod gyur gang du nor bu rin po che/ /bzhag na dpal dang ldan par 'gyur ba bzhin/ /nor bu rin chen lta bu dri med thugs/ /'dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan du ni char pa phob/ /ces pa gsan pa dang /gling dang / dus dang / yab yum dag la gzigs pas skabs mkhyen nas gshegs par rtsom pa dang / lha rnams la rjes su bstan pa mdzad de/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan mthon po zhes bya ba gzhal yas khang chu zheng dpag tshad drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pa'i nang du seng ge'i khri la bzhugs nas/ grogs po dag ngas 'chi 'pho rnam par sbyong bar zhes bya ba'i chos bshad kyi tshur shog chos snang ba'i sgo brgya 38

cho rjes sbya pa rdzita mdzad pa'i chos 'byung chen mo bzhugs so// rtsa brgyad 'di dag po ni byang chub sems dpa' 'chi 'pho ba'i tshe bstan par bya'o/ /de la dad pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste/ bsam pa mi phyed par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dang ba ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste sems rnyog pa can dwangs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i chos bshad pas/ lha'i bu brgyad khri bzhi stong byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /lha'i bu sum khri nyis stong mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob bo/ /lha'i bu bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa drug chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go zhes so/ /de ltar lha rnams smin par byas te/ gang gi tshe na dga' ldan gnas mchog nas/ /'dren pa skyes bu seng ge 'chi 'pho tshe/ /lha rnams dag la tshig tu smra ba ni/ /grogs dag bag med spyod pa spong bar gyis/ /gang tshe ngas ni byang chub thob gyur te/ /'chi med 'gro ba'i chos char 'bebs pa'i tshe/ /rnam par dag pa'i sems dang ldan pa khyed/ /chos kyi dam pa nyan pa'i phyir gshegs shig /zhes gsung bas na ba'i mi pham pa rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur nas/ thod dang rgyan rnams bkrol nas/ grogs po dag shes par gyis shig kho bo ni mi rnams 'dul ba'i phyir 'dzam bu'i gling du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gro ste/ khyed la ni mi pham pas chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas lha rnams kyis smra bas pa/ kye byang chub semasangadapa' 'dzam bu'i gling pa ni deng sang 'od srungs rdzogs byed dang / kun tu rgyu gnag lhas kyi bu dang / yang dag rgyal ba can dang / mi pham skra'i lwa ba can dang /ka ta'i bu nog can dang / gcer bu pa gnyen gyi bu ste rtog ge pa drug dang / bram ze rgyu rgyal dang / bram ze rna ltos dang / bram ze bzang ldan dang / bram ze tshangs39

ba chen 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()pa'i tshe dang / bram ze pad+ma'i snying po dang / bram ze dmar po ste rjes su sgrogs pa drug dang / rengs byed kyi bu lhag spyod dang / sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur dang /kun tu rgyu rab bzang dang / bram ze'i khye'u kun rgyal dang / rmeng srong nyon mongasamed dang / steng rgyas 'od srungs dang (te// snyoms par 'jug pa drug ste/rtog ge ba drug gsum bco brgyad kyis ma rungs par bgyid pas der gshegs pa'i skabs ma lags so/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ grogs po dag dung gi sgras sil snyan gzhan rnams sam/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis 'od gzhan ltar de rnams nga nyid kyis zil gyis gnon par nus so/ /zhes so/ /de nas lha rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma'am zla ba'am seng ge la sogs pa gang gi rnam pas yum gyi lhums su bzhud ces zhus pa las/ tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu gzi brjid dam pas smras pa/ glang po che'i rnam pas bzhud par rigs so zhes zer ro / / de nas byang chub sems dpa' lo bcu gnyis na yum gyi lhums su 'jug par shes nas/ gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu bdud rtsi don du gnyer ba dag ni/rang gi lus mi snang bar byas/ 'dzam bu'i gling du bram ze'i cha byad du skye ba bzung nas bram ze rnams la 'di skad ces gang zhig rnam pa 'di lta bur mngal du zhugs na/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / khyim na gnas na 'khor los bsgyur ba'am/ rab tu byung na lha dang mi'i ston par 'gyur ro zhes rig byed 'don du la dzud do/ /lha'i bu gzhan dag kyang der skye ba blangs nas rang sangs rgyas rnams la 'di skad ces/ 'phags pa dag da ste lo bcu gnyis na byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums su 'jug gis zhing 'dir 'or cig ces bskul ba dang /40

chos rjes paṇ+ḍi lha rimadzad pa'i chos 'byung chen mo bzhugs so// rgyal po'i khab na rang sangs rgyas glang po che zhes bya ba dang / wā rā ṇa sri'i rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya rnams shing tā la bdun srid du nam mkha' la 'phags te/me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs nas lus ye shes kyi mes zad par byas te ring bsrel 'ba' zhig bor zhing nam mkha' la gshegs so/ /de'i tshe lha'i bu rnams kyi bsam par yul chen po drug na rgyal po'i pho brang bdun yod de/ ma ga dh+wa dang / ko sa la dang / bad sa la dang / yangs pa can dang / 'phags rgyal dang / bcom brlag dang / ha ri pu ra zhes bya ba thams cad skyon dang bcas par rig nas/ lha'i bu ye shes tog gi rgyal mtshan la sogs pas/ byang chub semasadapa' nyid gang du skye bar bzhed zhus pas/ grogs po dag rgyud dang / cho 'brang 'khor dang / yo byad la sogs pa yon tan drag cu rtsa bzhi dang ldan pa'i rigs dang / yum yang mkhas pa dul ba/ mang du thos pa des pa la sogs pa yon tan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa'i mngal du 'jug go /zhes gsungs so/ /de rnams kyis bltas pas shākya'i rigs dang / shin tu legs par rtogs kyi bu mo lha mo sgyu 'phrul nyid la snang ngo zhes sgrogs par byed de/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir kun tu bltas pa na/ /rgyal rigs rgyal brgyud che ba gang yin pa/ /kun kyang skyon dang bcas par rjes bsams nas/ shākya'i rigs ni skyon dang bral bar mthong / /zhes so/ // gnyis pa lhums su 'jug pa ni/ me mo yos kyi lo dpyid zla tha chung skar ma sa ga'i lha'i tshe sprul pa lus len kyi tshul bram ze rnams kyi rig byed las 'byung ba bzhin du glang po che'i rnam pas/ yum gso sbyong la gnas pa'i slo 41

'tshen na 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung sto4bsdus/ ()g.yas pa nas lhums su zhugs te/ glang chen thal dkar mche ba drug ldan pa/ /rkang bzhi mdzes dang ldan par zhal bzhes nas/ /drang srong gnas shes pa ni ji bzhin du/ /yum gyi lhums su bde bar zhugs par gyur/ /zhes so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i khab tu dge ltas brgyad byung ste/ khang pa dga' dang bya mang 'byung / /shing dang me tog kha bye zhing / /longs spyod 'phel zhing sgra rnams 'gro pa/ /gter rnams kha bye 'od gsal ba'o/ /de nas yum gyis rgyal po la gsol ba/ gser gyi drwa bas rgyab g.yogs spyi gtsug dmar/ /thal dkar mche ba drug dang rab ldan zhing / /dung dang kha ba dngul mdog lta bu yi/ /glang po'i mchog cig khong du song snyam bgyid/ /de zhugs nas ni bdag gi lus dang sems/ /sngon chad mthong thos myong bar ma gyur pa'i/ /bsam gtan mnyam par bzhag par bzhin du gyur/ /zhes pa dang / rgyal pos dge ba'i tshogs chen po yang byas so/ /de nas yum gyi lhums su byang chub sems dpa' nye bar spyad pa tsan dan sprul gyi snying po las byas pa'i rin po che bkod pa zhes bya ba'i gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs te/ der zla ba bcu zhig zag med kyi bde ba la longs spyod cing lha dang mi'i skye rgu phrag khrig phrag sum cu rtsa drug smin par byas so// /// gsum pa bltams pa ni de nas zla ba bcu 'das te btsa' ba'i dusal babs pa dang / zas gtsang ma'i skyed mos tshal du me tog rnams kha 'bus pa dang / gter chen po nyi khri kha 'bus pa dang / rin po che la myu gu skyes pa dang /sgra snyan pa rang 'khrol ba la sogs pa snga ltas sum cu rtsa gnyis byung ngo / /de'i tshe lha mo sgyu 'phrul lu zhi'i tshal legs par brgyan par gshegs pa dang / gtsang 42

chos rje skya paṇ+ḍi rtas mdzad pa'i chos 'byung chen mo bzhugs so// ma re lnga rnams kyis phyag bya ba'i shing ljon pa blak+ṣa zhes bya bas lha mo la btud tsho de phyag byas so /de nas yum gyis phyag g.yas pa shing de nyid kyi yal ga la 'jusate bya brnyeng mjaraXng bzhugs pa'i tshe/ yum la gnod pa med par sku rtsibasalogs g.yas nas dpyid zla ra ba nya'i nyin la nyi ma shar ma thag skar ma rgyal la btsas pa na/ lha rnams kyis me tog gtor zhing / lha'i dbang po brgya byin rgan mo gcig tu sprul nas blangs pas de'i nga rgyal bcag pa'i phyir nang du gshegs te slar la zhus pa bsal ba'i phyir byon pa na/ brgya byin dang tshangs pas ka shi rka'i ras kyis blangs so/ /de'i tshe mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas rin po che bkod pa tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du mchod pa'i phyir gyen du bteg nas khyer ro/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' bos dri zhim po'i chus khrus byas pa dang / ko'u shi ka nga thong gsungs nas ma brten par phyogs bzhi dang steng 'og tu gom pa bdun bdun bor ba dang pad+ma byung ste/ nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog go/phul lo/ /skye rga na 'chi mthar phyung ngo / /bdud kyi sde gzhom mo/ /zhes dam bca' bas seng ge'i sgra bsgrags so/ /yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod bltams tshe/ /sa chen 'di na gom pa bdun bzhud de/ /nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog ces gsungs / /de tshe mkhas pa khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /de'i tshe bkra shis pa'i dge ltas sum cu rtsa gnyis byung ste phyogs mtshams thams cad du snang bas khyab pa dang / ma ga ṅgār pad+ma chen po'i bu gzugs can snying po dang / ko sa lar tshangs byin gyi bu gsal rgyal dang /'phags rgyal du mu khyud mtha' yas kyi bu rab snang dang / ko'u shāshrī ra 'phags 43
