ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()spyan ras gzigs kyis 'dul ba'i zhing khams su gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin no//zhes gsungs te/ thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po pun ḍa rī ma'i me tog lta bu zhig 'phros te/ 'jig rten gyi khams snang bar byas te/ nub phyogs bde ba can du song nas sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs por thim mo yang sangasargyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer zhig 'phros te/ mtsho pad+ma can du thim par gyur nas mtha' 'khob kha ba can 'dul ba'i sangs rgyas sprul sku gcig 'byon par lung bstan no/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams de na rin po che gser gyi sa gzhi la/ mig mangs ris su bris pa las/ /'byung ba sa rdo bya ba'i ming yang med/ /ye shes gsal ba'i me 'bar bas/ /'byung ba me yi ming yang med/ /yan lag brgyad ldan chu 'bab pas/ /'byung ba chu yi ming yang med/ /byang chub shing gis mdzes pa la/ /shing rtsi nags kyi ming yang med/ /bsam gtan zas kyis 'tsho ba la/ /bkres shing skom pa'i ming yang med/ /tshul khrimasarnam dag gos gyon pas/ /snal ma gos kyi ming yang med/ /rang gi 'od dang ldan pa las//nyi zla bya ba'i ming yang med//thams cad bzod pa'i stobs ldan pas//'thab cing rtsod pa'i ming yang med/ /bde ba chen bo ma lags pa/ /sdug bsngal bya ba'i ming yang med/ /mya ngan 'das pa ma lags pa/ /'khor ba bya ba'i ming yang med/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum ma lags pa/ /sems pa can bya ba'i ming yang med/ /rdo rje tshe la mnga' brnyes pas/ /rgas shing 'chi ba'i ming yang med/ /'byung bzhi'i lus 'di ma blangs pas/ /na tsha bya ba'i ming yang med/ /pad+ma'i sdong por rdzus skyes pas/ /skye ba rnam bzhi'i ming yang med/ /bde ba can gyi zhing 144

rgyal rab gsal ba'i long tham chos 'byurigs la ba'i me long bzhugs so// khams de na/ chos rgyal bzang po mchog ces bya ba bzhugs pa des/ sangs rgyas la me tog 'bul ba la/ mtsho pad+ma can gyi 'gram du/ 'khor rnams me tog thu ba la btang dus mtsho'i nang na pad+ma'i sdong po chen po gcig la yal ga ni gnya' shing tsam/ lo ma ni phub tsam/ de'i 'dab ma stong ldan gyi dkyil na/ ze'u 'bru rdza ma tsam zhig la 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba zhig mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang rgyal po la zhus pas/ ngo mtshar skyes nas gzings chen po zhig byas/ mchod pa sna tshogs thogs te/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis pad+ma'i sdong po de'i rtsar byon nas mchod pa phul/ smon lam btab ste ze 'bru de tshal pa bzhir gshags pa'i nang nas mtha' 'khob kha ba can 'dul ba'i gnyen po rdzus skyes kyi sprul pa'i sku/zhabs gnyis kha rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ zhal gnig phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis thugs nar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og ma na shel dkar gyi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma na pad+ma dkar po bzung nas snyan gyi thad du kha phye ba/mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba lta bur yod pa/ ri dwags e na ya'i lhags pa phrag pa g.yon pa la bkal nabs nu ma bkab pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing rin po ches dbu brgyan pa/zhal 'dzum zhing yid du 'ong ba/ 'od dang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba zhig byon pa dang / rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa dga' zhing mgu la yi rangs par gyur te/ rol mo du ma dang bcas nas rgyal po'i pho brang du gdan drangs so/ /de nas rgyal pos sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /pad+ma 145

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/ ()can nas pad+ma'i ze 'bru las/ /brdzus te zhakhrungs pa'i sprul sku zur phud can/ /gangs ri'i mdog can rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /yid 'ong gzugs mdzes mthong bas sems yid 'phrog/ngo mtshar mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sprul sku 'di//bdag gi gdung brgyud 'dzin pa'i rgyal bu'am/ /sems can don mdzad sprul pa'i sku gcig lags/ /zhes gsol bas/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyisabaka' stsal pa/ yan lag brgyad ldan pad+ma rgyas pa'i mtsho/ /pad+ma las zhakhrungasargyal sras sprul pa'i sku/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /kun+da'i mdog can rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes/ /mtshan dpe ngo mtshar ldan pa'i sku mchog 'di/ khyod kyi rgyal brgyud 'dzin pa'i 'os min cing / /mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi rgyal khams der/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /gang la gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku gcig lags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i tshe sa yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos te lha rnams kyis me tog gi char phab bo/ /de nas sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyis sprul sku de'i dbu la phyag bzhag nas bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu mtha' 'khob kha ba can na gnas pa'i sems can rnams 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang ma thul/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis kyang 'dul bar ma gyur/ da lta'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang 'dul dka' ba de/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthu la brten nas 'dul bar 'gyur ba legs so/ /legs so/kha ba can na gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyis/ 'phags pa khyed kyi sku mthong zhing / yi ge drug pa'i sgra thos nas/ de ma thag tu ngan song gsum las thar te/bde 'gro mtho ris kyi lus thob par gyur cig sa ba can na gnas pa'i 'dre 146

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long spro mchos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//srin dang / gdon bgegs dang / sha za la sogs pa sems can rnams kyi mdangs 'phrog pa/ srog la bar du gcod pa de dag thams cad kyis 'phags pa khyed kyi sku mthong zhing yi ge drug pa'i sgra thos nas/ gnod pa'i bsam pa rab tu zhi ste/ phan bde dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig kha ba can na gnas pa'i sems can stag dang / gzig dang / dom dang / dred dang /gcan gzan ma rungs pa gdug pa'i sems dang ldan zhing / ngar skad thos pa tsam gyis sgrag par byed pa/ srog phrogs nas/ sha la za zhing / khrag la 'thung ba de dag gis 'phags pa khyed kyi sku mthong zhing / yi ge drug pa'i sgra thos pa tsam gyis gdug pa'i bsam pa rab tu zhi nas/ phan tshun pha ma ltar byams pa la gnas par gyur cig kha ba can na gnas pa'i sems can gang dag bkres dang sgom pas lus gzir cing / sdug bsngal la nyam thag pa de dag thams cad 'phags pa khyed kyi sku mthong zhing / yi ge drug pa'i sgra thos pa tsam gyis zas sgom bdud rtsi'i char bab nas/ ci 'dod pa'i yid tshim ste/ bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar gyur cig kha ba can na gnas pa'i sems can ngan pa dang / long ba dang / nad pa dang / dbang po ma tshang ba dang / mgon med cing skyabs med par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyis/ 'phags pa khyed kyi sku mthong zhing / yi ge drug pa'i sgra thos pa tsam gyis nad thams cad las yongs su thar zhing / dbang po thams cad tshang la mthu stobs dang ldan par gyur cig kha ba can gyi sems can rnams kyis 'phags pa khyed kyi sku mthong ba dang / 'chi ba'i tshe bsring bar gyur cig na ba'i sman chen por gyur nas nad las thar bar gyur 147

'tshe tshen 'od snang las/sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()cig mgon med pa rnams kyi mgon du gyur cig skyabs med pa rnams kyi skyabs su gyur cig mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi yul du/ yi dam lha'i skal ba ni thugs rje chen po yin no/ /yi dam khyed la brten nas ma 'ongs pa'i dus su mtha' 'khob der sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa byon nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi skal ba ni yi ge drug pa 'di yin te/ snying po 'di la brten nas/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su mtha' 'khob der/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur te/ dam pa'i chos la longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ / yi ge drug pa 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig tu bsdusapa'i bdag nyid/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi rtsa ba gcig tu bsdus pa'i snying po/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga dang gsang ba'i bdag po rnams kyi snying po yig 'bru re re nas bsdus pa'i gzungs sngags/ dge legs dang yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ phan bde'i dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam chen po yin no/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ chos thams cad kyi snying po gsung mchog yi ge drug pa 'di lan cig mthong bas kyang / phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob ste/ 'gro ba sgrol ba'i ded dpon du 'gyur ro/ /thos pas kyang bde 'gro mtho ris kyi lus thob ste/ 'gro ba sgrol ba'i ded dpon du 'gyur ro/ /grog sbur ram/ dud 'gro 'chi kha ma'i rna bar thos na/ lus de las grol te bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dran pas kyang gangs la nyi ma phog pa dang 'dra ste/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las ngan gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas/148

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long sprom chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /reg na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa'i dbang bskur thob pa yin no/ /lan cig bsgom pa tsam gyis thos bsam sgom gsum gyi go chod nas/ snang tshad chos skur shar/ 'gro don phrin las kyi gter kha phye ba yin no/ /lus la bcang na rigs kyi bu de'i lus sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel du gyur nas/ bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kyis mi tshugs shing / me dang / chu dang / dug dang / mtshon dang / steng 'og gi gdon ldosogs pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /yi ge drug pa 'di rin po che'am/ ras sam/ shog gu'am/shing shun nam/ tha na sa dang /rdo la sogs pa la bris na chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong 'bri ru bcug pa yin te/ tshe 'dir bde skyid la longs spyad nas/ tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas pa'i 'brasabu thob par 'gyur te/ de la the tshom dang yid gnyis ma byed cig gzhan yang ri'i rgyal po ri rab srang la gzhal bar nus kyi/ yi ge drug pa lan cig bzlasapa'i bsod nams kyi tshad ni sus kyang bgrang bar mi nus so/ /rdo rje'i brag la kā shi da'i ras kyis lo brgya brgya na lan re phyis na zad par nus kyi/ yi ge drug pa lan cig bzlas pa'i bsod nams kyi tshad ni sus kyang bgrang bar mi nus so / / rgya mtsho chen po'i chu thigs pa re re nas bgrang bar nus kyi/ yi ge drug pa lan cig bzlas pa'i bsod nams kyi tshad ni sus kyang bgrang bar mi nus so/kha ba can gyi rdul phra rab rtsi shing nags tshal rnams re re nas bgrang bar nus kyi / yi ge drug pa lan cig bzlas pa'i bsod nams kyi tshad ni sus kyang bgrang bar mi nus so/ /de bzhin du/ khang pa dpag tshad brgya til gyis bkang ste nyin 149

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()re bzhin rdog po re re nas phyir bskyur na zad par nus kyi/ yi ge drug pa lan cig bzlas pa'i bsod nams kyi tshad ni sus kyang bgrang bar mi nus so/ /zla ba bcu gnyis su nyin mtshan med par char gyi rgyun mi chad par 'bab pa'i rdog po re re nas 'dren par nus kyi/ yi ge drug pa lan cig bzlas pa'i bsod namasakyi tshad ni sus kyang bgrang bar mi nus so/ /'di lta ste/ rigs kyi bu mang du brjod mi dgos kyis/ nga dang 'dra ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba la bsnyen cing bkur bas mnyes par byas pa'i bsod nams kyi tshad ni bgrang bar nusakyi / yi ge drug pa lan cig bzlas pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i tshad ni sus kyang bgrang bar mi nus so/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ oṃ gyis lha skye 'chi'i sngag bsngal sel/ ma yis lha ma yin 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal sel/ ṇi yis smi skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal sel/ pad kyis dud 'gro bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal sel/me yis yi dwags bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal sel/ hūṃ gis dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal sel/ sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags gyur pas/ /dam cho'i/thamasacad bsdus pa'i bcud/ /'gro ba kun gyi dpal du shar/ /yi ge drug pa'i dbang cig bskur//sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po'i dbang //de ring khyed la bskur bar bgyi//sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus nas ni/ /rig sngags rgyal po'i dbang cig bskur/ /oṃ ni sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin/ /ser sna med pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus chos kyi sku/ /dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ma ni bzod pa'i pha rol phyin/ khro ba med pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /bde ba chen po longs spyod rdzogs/ /dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ṇi ni tshul 150

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long pa ma chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// khrims pha rol phyin/ /nyon mongs skyon bral bcom ldan 'das/ /sku gsum lhun grub sprul pa'i sku/ /dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /pad ni bsam gtan pha rol phyin/ /rnam g.yeng med pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ shes bya thamasacad mkhyen pa'i sku/ /dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /me ni brtson 'grus pha rol phyin/ /le lo med pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /mkhyen brtse 'gro la khyab pa'i gsung / /dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /hūṃ ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /phrin las kun 'dus bcom ldan 'das/ /mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa'i thugs/ /dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gsung yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgra/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /chos kyi snying po bla na med/ /dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dbang bskur dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ spyi bor 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ni ye shes lnga dang ldan/ /ma ni thugs rje kun la khyab/ /ṇi yis 'gro drug 'dren par byed/ /pad kyis sdug bsngal thams cad zhi/ /me yis sdig sgrib sreg par byed/ /hūṃ gis yon tan thams cad 'das/ /yi ge drug pa'i byin rlabs kyis/kha ba can pa'i sems can rnams/ /thar pa'i lam la 'khod par shog /rgyal ba kun gyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /yang snying 'dus pa'i snying po 'di/ /phan bde kun gyi 'byung gnas yin/ /dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /mtho ris bgrod pa'i skas ka yin/ /ngan song 'gog pa'i sgo mo yin/ /'khor ba sgrol ba'i gru gzings yin/ /kun pa sel ba'i sgron me yin/ /dug lnga 'joms pa'i dpa' bo yin/ /sdig sgrib bsreg pa'i me dpung yin/ /sdug bsngal brdung ba'i tho ba yin/ /131

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i gnyen po yin/ kha ba can pa'i chos skal yin/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos du ma dang / /thos bsam sgom gsum thams cad kyi/ /snying po gcig tu bsdus pa'i bcud/ /gcig chog rgyal po rin po che/ /yi ge drug pa 'di zlos shig /gzungs sngags 'di yi byin rlabs kyis/ kha ba can gyi mtha' 'khob der/ /sems can smin grol lam la 'bod/ /dam chos dar zhing rgyasapar 'gyur/ /che ltas lung bstan to/ /'phags pa pad+ma la 'khrung bas pa las/ yi ge drug pa'i phan yon bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //lnga pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis kha ba can pa'i sems can rnams smin grol la bkod pa'i skor/ de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigasakyis/ kha ba can pa'i sems can rnams kyi don la dgongs nas/ sangs rgyasasnang ba mtha' yas kyi drung du/ byang chub tu thugs bskyed nas/ pus mo g.yasapa'i lha nga sa la btsug ste thal mo sbyar nas/ smon lam btab ste/ bdag gisakhams gsum rigs drug gi sems can thams cad bde ba la 'god par gyur cig khyad par du bod kha ba can gyi sems can thams cad bde ba'i lam la 'god par gyur cig bdag gis sems can 'dul dka' ba de rnams thar pa byang chub kyi lam la ma 'khod kyi bar du/ rang ngal zhing dub nas zhi bde'i bsam pa skad cig kyang mi skye bar gyur cig gal te skyes pa na nga'i mgo 'di ardza rka'i dog pa ltar tshal pa bcur 'gas shing / lus po yang pad+ma'i 'dab ma bzhin du dum bu stong du bye bar gyur cig ces brjod nas/ dmyal ba'i gnas su byon/ yi ge drug pa'i chos bshad phan pa dang bde ba la bkod/ dmyal ba tsha 152

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long zhwam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//grang gi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ de nas yi dwags kyi yul du byon/ yi ge drug pa'i chos bshad/ phan pa dang bde ba la bkod/ bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ de nas dud 'gro'i gnas su byon yi ge drug pa'i chos bshad/ phan pa dang bde ba la bkod/ bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ de nas mi'i gnas su byon yi ge drug pa'i chos bshad/ phan pa dang bde ba la bkod/ skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ de nas lha ma yin gyi gnas su byon yi ge drug pa'i chos bshad/ phan pa dang bde ba la bkod/ lha ma yin 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ de nas lha'i gnas su byon yi ge drug pa'i chos bshad/phan pa dang bde ba la bkod/ lha 'chi lhung gi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas so/ /de nas mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su byon te gzigs pas/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum rdzing dang 'dra ste/ ri dwags kyi gling du 'dug de rnamasal yi ge drug pa'i chos bstan nas/ phan pa dang bde ba la bkod par mdzad/smad mdo khams snang gsum zhing dang 'dra ste/ bya'i gling du 'dug de rnams la yi ge drug pa'i chos bstan nas/ phan pa dang bde ba la 'khod par mdzad/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi yur ba dang 'dra ste/ gcan gzan gyi gling du 'dug de rnams la yi ge drug pa'i chos bstan nas/ phan pa dang bde ba la bkod par mdzad do/ /de nas lha sa dmar po ri'i rtse la byon te/ yar la gzigs pas/ 'o thang gi mtsho 'di dmyal ba mnar med kyi gnas su 'dug cing / sems can khri phrag du ma btso sreg dang / bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal bzod brlag med pa/nyam thag pa'i skad ngan sna tshogs 'don cing 'dug pa rnams gzigs pas/133

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 2 rgyung gces bsdus/ ()spyan chab shor ro/ /de yang spyan g.yas pa nas mchi ma zhig thang la lhung bas jo mo khro gnyer can du gyur te/ rigs kyi bu khyod kha ba can pa'i sems can gyi don byed pa la sdug bsngal bar ma byed cig kho mos kyang sems can gyi don byed pa'i grogs byed gsungs te/ spyan g.yas pa la thim par gyur pa de ni phyi ma'i dus kyi bal mo bza' khri btsun yin no/ /yang spyan g.yon pa nas mchi ma zhig thang la lhung bas jo mo sgrol mar gyur/ rigs kyi bu khyod kha ba can pa'i semasacan gyi don byed pa la sdug bsngal bar ma byed cig kho mos kyang khyod kyis sems can gyi don byed pa'i grogs bgyi'o gsungs te/ spyan g.yon pa la thim par gyur to/ /de ni phyi ma'i dus kyi rgya mo kong jo 'di yin no/ /de nas 'phags pas mtsho 'gram du byon te/ yi ge drug pa'i chos bshad nas/ snying rje tshad med pas bden pa'i tshig don brjod pa/ thog med dus nas las ngan bsags pa'i mthus/ /gting mtha' med pa'i dmyal ba chen po 'dir/ /bzod dka'i sdug bsngal du mas gtses pa rnams/ /rnam grol thar pa'i gling la 'khod par shog /dug mtsho khol ma'i nang du 'tshod byed cing / /dmyal ba'i me yis rtag tu bsreg byed pa/ /skyabs med nyam thag smre sngags 'don pa rnams/ /phan bde'i char gyis rtag tu bsil bar 31ga /tsha grang bkres skom du mas gzir ba yi/ khri phrag du ma mtsho 'dir gnas pa rnams//lus 'di bor nas bdag gi zhing khams su//rigs bzang chos ldan rnams su skye bar shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes gsungs pas/ sems can dmyal ba po de rnams tsha grang gi sdug bsngal zhi nas/ lus bde ba dang ldan/ semasang sdug bsngal dang bral nas/ thar pa byang chub kyi lam 154

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long tham chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//la 'khod par mdzad do/ /de ltar khams gsum rigs drug dang / kha ba can pa'i sems can 'dul dka' ba de rnams thabs du ma'i sgo nas bde ba la bkod pas/ thugs shin tu ngal bar gyur nas sems nyid ngal gso'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs so/ /de nas slar po ta ri'i rtse mo nas gzigs pas/ kha ba can pa'i sems can rnams brgya'i cha tsam yang bde ba la 'khod snyam pa mi 'dug nas/ thugs shin tu mug par gyur nas/ rang zhi bde'i bsam pa cig skyes pa'i skad cig nyid la sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthus/ rang gi mgo tshal pa bcur gas shing / sku lus dum bu stong du zhig par gyur te/ der sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas skad cig la byon te/ 'phags pa'i dbu dang sku lus tshal par zhig pa rnams chun por phyag gis bcing ste/ 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /chos rnamasathams cad rkyen yin te/ /'dun pa'i rtsa la rab tu gnas/ /gang gi smon lam ci btab pa/ /de ni de lta nyid du 'gyur/ /gang gi smon lam mthu btsan pas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /bden pa de yis skad cig la/ /nges pa nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ rigs kyi bu khyod sdug bsngal bar ma byed cig khyod kyi dbu tshal pa bcur gas pa 'di zhal bcur byin gyis brlabs so/ /zhal ras bcu po pha rol phyin pa bcu/ de'i steng du a mi khyo ba dang bcas pas zhal bcu gcig par byin gyis brlabs so/ /bcu gcig dbu la 'od dpag med pa bzhugs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las rnams rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ khyod kyi lus pad+ma'i 'dab ma 135

ba chen 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()bzhin stong du bye ba 'di/ phyag stong du byin gyis brlabs so/ /phyag stong 'khor los skur ba'i rgyal po stong / /phyag stong gi mthil du spyan stong du byin gyisabarlabs so/ /spyan stong bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong / /gang la gang 'dul de la de ston pa'i/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas stong gis rab tu bsngags pa ste/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul bar rgyal bas lung bstan nas/ /gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs te/ kha ba can pa'i semasacan rnams 'dul ba'i don du/ sku lus kyi sprul pa mang po bstan nas/ semasacan thams cad smin cing grol bar mdzad do/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigasa~Xbasnye phyug spyis/ kha ba can pa'i sems can rnams smin grol la bkod pa'i ga'u ṭ+wāṃ sna shā//rta//'i rgyal por sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i skor/de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug des/ thabs du ma'i sgo nasa'agro ba sems can gyi don mdzad de/ dge sdig gi blang dor gyi dpe bstan pa'i phyir/ mdo za ma tog las/ rta'i rgyal po cang shes ba la ha'i skur sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad par gsungs nas/ de'ang rgya gar lho phyogs kyi tshong pa/bsod nams dman pa mang po zhig phyi'i rgya mtsho la nor bu len par chas te/rang rang gi mkho ba'i yo byad du ma dang bcas nas/ gru gzings chen por zhugasapa las/ zhag bdun lon pa'i tshe/ mi 'dod pa'i rlung gis bar gcod byas pa 'di lta ste/ nyin gung sprin nag na bun 'thib pa bzhin/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer 156

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long tham chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// bsgribs nas mun par byas/ /'jigs pa'i rlung dmar sa gzhi g.yo ba ltar/ /rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad 'gyel bar gyur/ /rgya mtsho'i g.yor mor seng ge mchongs pa bzhin/ /dba' klong gzugs pas gnam sa bdeb pa tsam snang pa rnams ni gcig la gcig 'jus shing / /rang rang nye du'i ming nas 'bod cing ngu / / skrag cing dngangs nas 'o dod 'bod byed cing / /mgon med nyam thag mchi ma khrag tu 'byin/ /de yi mod la gru yang zhig par gyur/ /de nas tshong pa rnams kyis gru zhig pa'i shing la legs par 'jus pa dang / yang mi 'dod pa'i rlung chen po gcig gis phyogs gcig tu ded nas/ srin mo yod pa'i siṅga la'i gling zhes pa de'i 'gram du bskyal la/ der tshong pa rnams gcig gis gcig la ming nas 'bod cing skam la slebs so/ /der srin mo rnams kyis tshor te/ bud med gshon nu ma shin tu mdzes par sprul/ bza' btung mang po khyer nas tshong pa rnams kyi rtsar 'ong ste/ khyed cag rnams 'o ma brgyal lam/ nyon ma mongs sam zhes sems gso shing / blo brid nas bza' btung gis tshim par byas so/ /tshong pa rnams kyis ni srin mo yin par ma shes te/ bud med shin tu mdzes par mthong nas rab tu dga' ste/ phan tshun mthun pa'i gtam byas so/ /der srin mo rnams kha 'cham par khyed cag tshong pa rnams lung pa'i phu ya gir ma 'gro zhig zer ro/ /bud med re res tshong pa re re khrid nas rang gi khyim du phyin te/ bza' mi byas/ bu tshas 'brel nas dga' mgur longs spyod do/ /skal ngan lasakyis mnar ba'i tshong pa rnams/ /mi 'dod log pa'i rlung gis khyer ba na/ /'gro ba 'khrul pa ri dwags rgyar tshud 'dra//'chi bdag lag tu tshud nas thar thabs 157

ba chen 'od snang las/skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()med/ /de la chung mar 'dzin pa'i bsam brlag tsho/ /srin mo lha mor mthong ba'i 'khrul snang can/ /bslu brid zas kyis rab tu tshim pa na/ /sngar gyi sdug bsngal rmi lam bzhin du brjed/ /de yi yid kyang dga' bas tshim par 'gyur/ /zhesapa'i sgra byung ngo / /de nas ded dpon 'a po des/ srin mo'i gling yin par ngo shes/ sdug bsngal zhid yi mug par gyur nas/ da lta skyid par byung ste/ phugs ci 'dra zhig 'ong bsams nas/ sems shin tu ma bde bar gyur te/ lung pa'i phur ma 'gro zer ba de na ci yod dam bsams nas/ ded dpon rang gi chung ma gnyid du song ba dang / mtshan nas don te lung pa'i phu der bltar phyin pas/ lcags kyi khang pa sgo med pa zhig gi nang na/ skad log di ri ri 'dug nas/ ci yin bsams nas nyan pas/ rgya gar gyi tshong pa'i skad du ngo shes nas/ de'i rtsa na shing sdong po gcig 'dug pa la 'dzegs pa dang / de'i nang na su yod pa yin byas pas/ de'i nang gi mi rnams na re/ 'di'i nang na nged tshong pa lam nor ba rnams yod zer/ khyed rnams 'dir dus ji tsam na tshud byas pas/ nged rnamasakyang khyed cag rnams dang 'dra ste/ gru gzings mi 'dod pa'i rlung gis khyer nas 'dir sleb ste/ bud med 'di rnams kyis khrid/ 'di rnams srin mo yin par ngo ma shes pas/ bza' mi byas/ bu 'ji 'brel skyid par gyur pa las/ khyed cag rnams gling 'dir tshud pa dang / nged cag rnams lcags khang sgo med 'dir bcug go / da ni nged rnams rim gyis za'i yod/ nged rnams kyi sdug bsngal srog dang bral ba'i dngangs skrag 'di la bsam la/ khyed cag rnams da lta nyid du brosashig da lta 'bros pa'i skabs yin no/ /lcags khang 'dir tshud nas 'bros sa /58

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// yang med la/ thar thabs kyang med do zer ro/ /yang ded dpon na re/ 'o na nges pa nyid du 'bros te/ thabs med byas pas/ khong rnams na re/ 'bros pa'i thabs 'dug go /nged rnams kyang 'bros dgos bsam ste/ 'dod yon la chags pas lan/ khyed cag rnams ci dang gang la yang ma chags par bros shigade la 'bros pa'i thabs ni/ 'di nas la chung zhig brgal ba'i byang ngos na gser gyi bye ma'i dkyil na/ g.yu'i chu mig gcig 'dug de'i mtha' be+eḍūr+ya'i ljang pas bskor ba zhig 'dug ste/ tshes bco lnga'i nub mo/ nam mkha' nas rta'i rgyal po ba la ha zhes pa/ sgal pa'i steng na mi brgya re tsam zhen chog pa shin tu mdzes pa zhig zla ba'i zer dang 'grogs nas der 'ong bar yod par 'dugagayu'i chu mig nas 'thungs/ be+eḍūr+ya'i ljang pa nas zos/ gser gyi bye ma la 'gre 31ga lan gsum byas rting / lus sprug sil ba zhig byabs nas/ rta skad mi'i skad du bton nas/ rgya gar ba'i tshong pa srin mo'i gling du tshud pa su yod gang yod thams cad nga'i rgyab tu zhen cig ngas ni khyed rnams rang gi yul du bskyal lo zer ba'i sprul pa'i rta mchog zhig 'ong gi yod zer/ de la zhen nas/ longs spyod dang bu tsha gang la'ang ma chags par mig btsum nas bros na thar zer ro/ /ded dpon gyis de bzhin byed dgos bsams nas/ phyir sleb/ rang gi chung ma srin mo nyal ba'i mal du zhugs pa dang / chung mas tshor te/ 'di skad ces zer ro rdo / tshong pa blo nyes rang srog rang gis gcod/ /bsam pa gzhan du btang na khyod nyid phung / /tshong dpon khyod gar phyin lus re grang zer ba la/ tshong dpon gyis bdag dri chu 'dor du phyin no zhes rdzun smras so/ /de nas ded dpon gyis 159

ba chen 'od snang lag skya'i cho 'byung gce bzhus/ ()tshong phrug rnams lkog tu bsags nas lo rgyus rnams zhib par bshad pa dang/thams cad bros par kha 'cham mo/ /de nas tshes bco lnga'i nub mo/ srin mo rnams la spyo byed kyi rdzas byin nas/ gnyid du song ba dang/ ded dpon gyis tshong phrug rnams khrid nas la sgyung brgal ba'i byang ngos/ gser gyi bye ma'i steng /g.yu'i chu mig gi drung / be+eḍūr+ya'i ljang pa yod pa'i rtsar/ rta'i rgyal po ba la ha sgug tu phyin to/ /de nas ring po ma lon par/ zla ba'i zer la 'ja' tshon gyi 'od dang bcas te/ rta'i rgyal po nam mkha' nas byon no/ /der rta mchog des/g.yu'i chu mig nas 'thung / be+eḍūr+ya'i ljang pa nas zos/ gser gyi bye ma la 'gre ldog lan gsum byas/ lus sprug sil ba zhig byas nas/ mi'i skad du btan nas/ tshong pa srin mo'i gling du tshud pa su yod/ thams cad nga'i rgyab tu zhen cigasrin mo'i lang tsho/ bu chung / longs spyod gang la yang ma chags par mig tshum zhigangs ni khyed rang rnams kyi yul du bskyal lo gsungs pas/ ded dpon na re/'gro ba 'dren pa'i rta mchog sprul pa'i sku/ /bdag cag tshong pa rnams dang lhan cig tu/ /rgya mtsho'i gling du nor bu len du 'ong / /bsod nams zad pas gru chen rgya mtshor zhig /log pa'i rlung gis srin mo'i gling du ded/ /las ngan 'chi bdag srin mo'i gling du tshud/ /de la 'bros pa'i thabs ga' na ma mchis pas/ /rta mchog thugs rje can gyis bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes smras te/ ded dpon gyisarta'i mjing pa la zhon nas rna mchog la mchongs/ tshong phrug rnams kyis rta'i rgyab tu zhon te/ srin mo'i khang pa bu dang longs spyod gang dang ci thams cad la ma chags par gyis shig yid la 'gyur ba tsam yang ma byed cig rgya mtsho'i mthar 160

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long tham chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// ma sleb bar du mig tshum cig gsungs te/ rta mchog des nam mkha' la khyer ba dang / srin mo rnams kyis tshor te/ bu tsha khrid byung nas 'di skad zer ro/ /mthon por brtsigs pa'i sa mkhar bsgyur 'od dam/ /mthun par 'grogs pa'i bza' mi bskyur phod dam/ sha nas chad pa'i bu tsha bskyur phod dam/ /zhim por za ba'i bza' btung bskyur phod dam/ /mi ngan pa khrel med po zhes zer nas/ la lasani bu tsha nam mkha' la 'phyar/ la las ni gos kyi g.yab mo byas pas/ tshong phrug rnams kyis thos pa dang / snying gi dkyil du mda' phog pa ltar byung nas/ shin tu yang bden bsams nas phyi mig bltas pas/ ded dpon ma gtogs pa thamasacad chags nas phyi mig bltas pas thams cad lhung ngo / /lhung ba dang srin mo rnams kyis bzung ste/ sngar gyi lus mdzes pa de med par srin mo'i gzugs su byas nas/ mgo gzing ba nu ma phrag pa la bkal/ mche ba gtsigs khanas/ dar cig kyang sdod dbang med par zos song ngo / /de nas rta mchog gis rgya mtsho'i 'gram du sleb pa dang / tshong dpon la mig ltos la bobs shig zer ro/ /der mig bltas pas/ rta'i rgyab na tshong phrug thams cad mi 'dug nas/ shin tu sdug bsngal bar gyur nas/ rta mchog rgyal po nga'i tshong phrug rnams ga re zer zhing ngus pas/ rta mchog de'ang lag pa sa la brdab cing mchi ma phyung nas 'di skad do/khyod kyi bsod nams zad pa'i tshong phrug rnams/ /rang yul 'dzam bu'i gling la ma bsam par/ /las ngan srin mo'i gling la chags pas phung / /pha ma 'dod pa'i grogs la mi bsam par/ /lang tsho srin mo'i gdong la chags pas phung / /nye du phan pa'i bu la mi bsam par//bslu brid srin mo'i bu la chags pas phung / /161

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()kye ma kye hud sems can snying re rje/ /rdo rje slob dpon bsad pa'i slob ma de/ /mnar med dmyal ba'i gnas su chud pa na//bla ma thugs rje che yang ci zhig bya/ /bu tshar lta ba phyin ci log gyur nas/ /mi 'dod log pa'i rlung gis khyer ba na/ /pha ma brtse dung che yang ci zhig bya/ /bslab bya phan pa'i tshig la mi nyan par/ /tshong phrug phyi mig bltas pas lhung ba la/ /rta mchog 'phur rtsal che yang ci zhig bya / / tshong dpon ma ngu da dung nga la nyon//tshe 'di'i bde sdug rmi lam sgyu ma bzhin//ri gzar chu dang nam mkha'i glog sprin 'dra/ /de ltar 'khor ba'i bde la ma chags shig /ces rta mchog des bden pa bzhi'i chos bshad/ tshong dpon gyis mchi ma nyis nas/ tshong dpon rang gi khyim mthong ba'i sar bskyal lo/ /rta mchog de'ang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du bzhud do/ /de nas tshong dpon gyis rang gi khyim du phyin pa dang / pha ma nye du thams cad der 'dus te/tshong dpon la 'dus nas ngus so/ /de nas dga' ba'i gtam byas so/ /de nasayang tshong phrug rnams kyi pha ma nye 'brel rnams byung nas/ nga'i pha ga re/ nga'i khu bo ga re/ nga'i tsha bo ga re/ mi re re'i ming nas 'bod cing ngus so/ /de nas྾ dpon gyis tshong phrug rnams kyi pha ma nye du rnams bsags te/ dang po rgya mtshor zhugs pa/ 'jig pa'i rlung dmar gyis gru zhig pa/ mi 'dod pa'i rlung gis ded nas srin mo'i gling du bskyal ba/ srin mo yin par ngo ma shes nas bza' mi byas/bu tshas 'brel ba'i steng du srin mo yin par ngo shes nas/ 'bros pa'i thabs btsal bas/ lcags kyi khang pa'i mis 'bros pa'i thabs bstan pa/ rta'i rgyal pos bslab bya mdzad pa la ma nyan par tshong phrug rnams kyis phyi mig bltas pas 162

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long pa mchos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// lhung ba la sogs pa rgyas par bshad pas/ thams cad 'khor ba la skyo ba skyesanas/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches/ dam pa'i chos la 'khod par gyur to/ /dpe de bzhin du/ tshe 'di la chags nas sdig pa byas pa rnams/ tshong phrug phyi mig bltas pas lhung ba dang 'dra ste/ 'khor bar 'khyams nas ngan song nas thar ba'i dus med do/ /tshe 'di la mi chags par dam chos nyams su blang ba rnams ded dpon dang 'dra ste/ mtho ris thar pa'i bde ba thob nas sangs rgyas par sna do/ /rta'i rgyal por sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i le'u ste drug pa'// ba/du/na pa/ bod kyi mi brgyud spre'u dang brag srin mo nas chad pa'i skor/de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs des/ ji kyi 'phrul ston pa'i spre'u zhig la/dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa byin nas/ bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su bsgom du btang ngo / /der spre'u des/ brag rog po gcig la bsgom ste/ de'ang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa dang / chos zab mo stong pa nyid la mos pa byed cing yod dus/ las kyis mnar ba'i brag srin mo zhig der 'ong nas/ chags pa 'dod pa'i brda mang du bstan nas song ngo / /rting la brag srin mo de bud med kyi chas su byas te/ spre'u la khyod dang nga gnyis bza' mi bya'o zer bas/ spre'u na re/nga 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dge bsnyen yin pas/ khyod kyi khyo byas na nga'i sdom pa 'chor byas pas/ brag srin mo na re/ khyod nga'i khyo mi byed na nga tshe'i dus byed do zer nas/ spre'u'i rtsar nyal lo/ /de nas brag srin mo langs te/spre'u la 'di skad ces zer ro/ /kye ma spre'u'i rgyal po chen po khyed/ /cung zad 163

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()bdag la dgongs shing gsan du gsol/ /bdag ni las kyi dbang gis srin mo'i rigs su skyes/ /'dod chags rgyas pas khyed la zhen cing chags/ /chagasapa'i dbang gis khyed la bskor zhing gsol/ /bdag ni khyed dang khyim thabs mi byed na/ /tha ma srin po zhig dang 'grogs nas kyang / /nyin re la'ang sems can khri re gsod/ zhub re la'ang srog chags stong tsam za/ /srin po'i phru gu dpag med skyes gyur nas/ kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'di nyid du/ /srin po'i grong khyer dag tu gyur nas ni/ /gang yod sems can srin pos za bar 'gyur/ /de bsabadag la dgongs nas thugs rjes zungs/ /zhes gdung ba'i skad kyis mchi ma phyung bas/ der byang chub sems dpa' spre'u'i bsam par/ 'di'i khyo byas na ni sdom pa 'tshor la/ ma byas na ni sdig pa tshabs che bar 'dug snyam nas/ skad cig la ri bo po ta lar 'phags pa'i drung du phyin nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye ma 'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje can/ /bdag ni dge bsnyen sdom pa srog bzhin bsrungs/ /bdud rigs srin mo chags pa'i 'du shes can/ /gdung ba'i smre sngags sna tshogs bton gyur nas/ /bdag la bskor zhing sdom pa 'phrog tu byung / /de la ci ltar byas na sdom pa bsrung / /byams mgon thugs rje can khyod dgongs su gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ brag srin mo'i khyo gyis shig gsungs/ jo mo khro gnyer can dang / jo mo sgrol ma gnyisakyis kyang / nam mkha' nas de ni shin tu legs so gsung ngo / /de nas 'phagasapas spre'u dang / brag srin mo gnyis bza' mir byin gyis brlabs nas/ kha ba can 'dir yon tan gsum dang ldan te/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi 164

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyun chad med par 'byung ba/ rin po che'i gter kha bye ba/ phan bde dang dge legs phyogs bcur rgyas pa sogs byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas spre'u dang /brag srin mo gnyis bza' mi byas pas/ 'gro ba rigs drug nas tshe 'phos pa'i spre'u phrug rnams spyod lam mi 'dra ba drug skyes so/ /de yang / sems can dmyal ba nas tshe 'phos pa'i sbrel phrug de/ngo nag la sdug sran che ba cig 'dug yi dwags kyi gnas nas tshe 'phos pa'i sprel phrug de/ bzhin mi sdug pa zas la gdung ba zhig 'dug dud 'gro'i gnas nas tshe 'phos pa'i sprel phrug de/ glen la rod ngan pa zhig 'dug mi'i gnas nas tshe 'phos pa'i sprel phrug de/ shes rig rgyas pa sems chung ba zhig 'dug lha ma yin gyi gnas nas tshe 'phos pa'i sprel phrug de/ thu la phrag dog che ba zhig 'dug lha'i gnas nas tshe 'phos pa'i sprel phrug de/ ngang rgyud ring la sems dge ba zhig 'dug go /der sbrel phrug drug po de ni pha byang chub sems dpa' spre'u sa/ nags ma bya tshogs bya ba/ shing thog mod pa zhig tu bskyal nas lo gsum bzhag bo /lo gsum lon pa dang /spre'u byang chub sems dpa' bltar phyin pas/ las kyi dbang gis sprel phrug lnga brgyar 'phel 'dug go /de nas shing thog rnams zad/ gzhan za rgyu med nas pha mas ci yang ma zos kyang / pha ci za ma ci za zer zhing / lag gdengs la nyam thag ste/ dbul phongs so/ /der byang chub sems dpa' spre'u bsam par nga nyon slongs pa'i dbang du song ba ni min/ 'phags pa'i bka' bsgrubs pas sprel phrug 'di tsam du song 'dug snyam nas/ skad cig la ri bo po ta lar phyin 165

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()nas/ 'phags pa la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye ma/ khyim thabs 'bor ba'i btson rar ma shes shing / /bud med bdud kyis bslus pa ma shes pas/ /bu tshas 'khor ba'i 'dam du bdag tshud do/ /'dod pa dug gi lo mar ma rtogasapas/ /snying rjes chags par gyur pas bdag bslus so/ /'dod pas bsdamasashing sdug bsngal ri yis non/ /nyon mongs dug zos las ngan rims kyisabatab/ /sdug bsngal phung pos bdag nyid mnar gyur na/ /kye ma kye hud byamasamagon thugs rje can/ /da ni ji ltar byas na bu tsha gso/ /'phags pas gnang bas bdag ni 'di ltar 'gyur/ /da lta yi dwags grong khyer lta bur 'dug /phyi ma dmyal bar skye bar the tshom med//de phyir bdag la thugs rjes bskyab tu gsol//zhes gsol ba btab pas/ 'phags pa'i zhal nas khyod kyi rigs kha brgyud rnams ngas bskyang ngo gsungs nas/ 'phags pa yar bzhengs de/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/bra bo/ so ba rnams ri rab kyi khong seng nas blangs te/ sal gtor bas yul der ma rmos pa'i lo tog gis gang bar gyur to/ /de nas spre'u byang chub semasadapa' des sprel phrug rnams der khrid de/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog la gtad nas/ da zo dang byas pas/ zo dang gong po ri yin zer ro/ /de nas sprel phrug rnams kyisalo tog zos pas tshim par gyur nas/ sbu yang thung du song / mjug ma yang thung du song ste/ smra shes nas mir gyur to/ /zas su ma smos pa'i lo tog za zhing /gos su shing lo gon par gyur/ de ltar na bod kha ba can pa'i mi 'di rnams pha spre'u dang / ma brag srin mo gnyis las chad pa yin pas/ rigs gnyis su bye yod do/ /de la pha spre'u byang chub sems dpa'i rigs su gyur pa ni/ ngang rgyud 166

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ba mchos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//ring ba/ dad pa che ba/ snying rje che la brtson 'grus che ba/ dge ba la dga' ba/tshig 'jam pa/ smra mkhas pa de ni pha'i rigs so/ /ma brag srin mo'i rigs su gyur pa ni/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang che ba/ tshong dang khe spog la sems pa blo 'dod dang 'gran sems che ba/ gad mo cher dgod pa/ lus stobs dang snying stobs che ba/ spyod pas skad cig kyang mi tshugs pa/ blo sna mang ba/ byed snyen pa/dug lnga rgyas pa/ gzhan gyi skyon thos na dga'/ khro gtum pa de ni ma'i rigs so//de'i dus der ri rnams ni shing nags su song / klung thams cad ni chus khengs yod pa/ kong chu lag kha phye nas/ chu thams cad der song ste/ kong chu lag tu thim mo/ /de nas thang thams cad la zhing byas/ grong khyer mang po brtsigs/ de nas ring por ma lon par/ rje gnya' khri btsan po bod kyi rgyal po la byon nas/rje dang 'bangs su bcos skad do/ /bod kyi mi brgyud spre'u dang brag srin mo nas chad pa'i le'u ste bsnyen pa'o// //brgyad pa/ bod rgyal po'i gdung rabs dang po ji ltar byon pa bstan pa'i skor/ de nas bod rgyal po'i gdung rabs rim par byon pa rnams bshad par bya ste / de'ang / gnam la khri bdun/ stod kyi steng gnyis/ bar du legs drug sa la sde brgyad/ 'og gi btsan gsum zhes pa ltar/ rje gnya' khri btsan po nas/ re re nas bgrang ba'i gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun na/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sprul pa lha tho tho ri snyan shal byon te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dbu brnyes pa yin no/ /de'ang / bka' chems ka khol ma las/ rgya gar gyi rgyal po shākya ri brag pa'i gdung brgyud chos rgyal mya ༷/1 med nas rim par byon pa/ rgyal po

ba chen 'od snang la /sa 'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/ ()skyabs sing dang / dmag brgya pa gnyis lhan du skyes so/ /rgyal srid la ma 'cham pa'i dus su/ dmag brgya pa la bu gsum byung ba'i chung shos/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang ldan pa zhig rgyal srid la dbang ma thob par/ lhas lung bstan pa bzhin/ bu mo'i chas su byas te bod kyi yul du sprugs pa yin kyang zer la/ bu ston rin po che'i chos 'byung na/ ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi brgyud lnga tshigs sam/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i brgyud lnga tshigs sam/ yang na bad sa la'i rgyal po 'char byed kyi bu/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang ldan pa zhig yin par gsungs la/ gang ltar na yang / rje gnya' khri btsan po yin par don mthun no/ /de'ang bod kyi yig tshang las/ dang po lha ri rol po'i rtse la babs te gzigs pas/ gangs yar lha sham po mtho ba dang / yul yar lung bzang bar mkhyen nas/ btsan thang gong ma'i ri la babs pas/ phyugs skyong ba'i rdzi'u rnams kyis mthong ste/ rtsar byung nas gang nas 'ong dris pas/ gnam la mdzub mo ker ba dang / 'di ni nam mkha' nas 'ong ba'i lha sras yin par 'dug pas/'o cag rnams kyi rje bcol lo zer te/ gnya' bar khri byas btegs nas 'ong pa na / rje gnya' khri btsan po zer te/ sangs rgyas mya ga las 'dag na lo nyis stong song ba na/bod kyi rgyal po la snga ba de yin no/ /des pho brang lum bu bla mkhar brtsigs/de'i sras mu khri btsan po/ de'i sras ding khri btsan po/ de'i sras so khri btsan po/de'i sras me khri btsan po/ de'i sras gdags khri btsan po/ de'i sras srib khri btsan po/ 'di yan ni gnam gyi khri bdun zer te/ sras rnams kyis rim pa bzhin chib kha thub tsa na/ yab rnams rim pa bzhin du rmu thag la byas nas/168

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long tham chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin 'gro yang zer/ khri bdun bang so nam mkha'i dbyings la btab/ /lha yi lus la ro med 'ja' ltar yal/ /zhes so/ /sgrib khri btsan po'i sras/ gri gum btsan po/ de la sras gsum byung ba/ sha khri/ nye khri/bya khri gsum yin no/ /rgyal po gri gum btsan po de/ thugs gdon gyis bslusate / blon po long ngam rta rdzi zer ba zhig la/ khyod kyisanga'i 'thab ya byed dgos zer nas/ long ngam na re/ rje ci lags/ nga 'bangs shig gis rje'i 'thab ya mi 'ong zhus kyang / dbang med du bcol bas 'thab par chas/ skar ma sag dang sari'i nyin 'brug dus byas so/ /der rgyal pos/ khyi mo nyan gyi rna gsang ma bya ba'i sprul pa'i khyi zhig yod pa/ long bam gyi rtsar nyan btang bas/ long ngam gyis de bzhin ngo shes nas gnangs nyin rgyal pos nged rang gsod du 'ong ste/ dmag gi 'khor ma khrid par/ rgyal po'i dbu la dar nag gi thod bcing / dpral bar me long btags/ phrag pa g.yas la wa ro bkal/ khyi ro g.yon la bkal/ ral gri klad la bskor/ glang dmar la thal sgro bkal byung na/ nged rang gis mi thub cesasmras so/ khyi mo des rgyal po la de bzhin du zhus pas/ de ltar byed gsungs te/gnangs nyin de ltar byas nas/ long ngam gsod du byon/ bso sgra btab pas glang dmar 'grogs te/ thal sgro ral bas thal tshub kyis mig kheng / wa ros dgra lha yal/ khyi ros pho lha yal/ ral gri klad la bskor bas rmu thag chad/ der blon po long ngam gyis rgyal po'i dpral ba'i me long la gtad nas mda' brgyab pas rgyal po bkrongs so/ /rgyal po'i sras gsum po ni/ kong po dang / nyang po/spo bo gsum gyi yul du bros so/ /der blon po long ba pa gyis rgyal srid phyogs /69

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()nas rgyal po'i btsun mo la rta rdzi bcol lo/ /der yum btsun mo des rta mtshor phyin nas/ gnyid log pa'i rmi lam na/ yar lha sham po'i sprul pa mi dkar po zhig dang 'brel ba rmis/ gnyid sad tsa na/ lngas mgo nas g.yag dkar po zhig long nas song ba mthong / de nas zla ba brgyad song tsa na/ yum btsun mo de la khrag gong po lag mgo tsam 'gul shes pa zhig skyes byung ba bskyur bar ni sha nas chad snying rje bar byung / gso ba la ni kha mig gang yang mi 'dug nas/'brong ru dron mo zhig tu bcug gos thung gi ngar pas dril bzhag pas/ zhag 'ga' song dus bltas pas/ khye'u zhig byung 'dug de'i ming yang 'jang gi bu ru la skyes zhes grags so/ /des lo bcu lon dus nga'i pha dang / phu bo rnams gar song zhes/ a ma la dris pas/ a mas sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams zhib par bshad pa dang / ru la skyes kyi thabs sna tshogs kyis nyang chu skya mo nas yab kyi bur btsal te/ phying yul dar thang du yab kyi bang so brtsig blon po 'o nga bar bsad/phu bo gsum gdan 'dren phyin pas/ sha khri dang / nya khri gnyis gdan ma drongasate / kong po dang / nyang po'i rje mdzad nas da lta yang gdung brgyud yod do/ /spo bo'i yul nas/ sras bya khri gdan drangs te/ yar lungs su bzhugs/ sku mkhar bying nga stag rtse brtsigs/ yum gyi sras bya khri la 'jus nas/ lha la dmod bor bas nam mkha' nas sgra byung ste/ khyod kyi bu de kun las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /bu de kun las rgyal zer kyang spu de gung rgyal du grags so/ /rgyal po 'dis rgyal sa bzung ste/ blon po ni ru la skyes kyis byas so/ /rgyal blon 'di gnyis kyi dusasu / g.yung drung gi bon byung ste/ ston pa gshen rab mi bo bya ba stag gzig 'ol 170

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long bam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// mo'i lung rings su sku 'khrungs/khams chen po brgyad la sogs pa bon po'i chos thams cad/zhang zhung gi yul nas bsgyur te dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/bon la rigs dgu ru phye ste/rgyu'i bon po la rigs bzhi/'bras bu'i bon po la rigs lnga'o//'bras bu'i bon rigs lnga ni/g.yung drung theg pa bla na med pa la zhugs pa ste/bde 'gro mtho ris kyi lus thob par 'dod do//rgyu'i bon po rigs bzhi ni/snang gshen bal thod can/'phrul gshen bal tshon can/phywa gshen ju thig can/dur gshen mtshon cha can no//de la snang gshen bal thod can gyis phywa dang g.yang 'gug lha dang sman gsol/dge legs dang dpal bskyed nas mi nor rgyas par byed/'phrul gshen bal tshon can gyis mdos dang yas gtong /srid dang rten 'dzugs/'phral phugs kyi 'gal rkyen thams cad sel bar byed do//phywa gshen ju thig can gyis/legs nyes kyi lam ston/yin min gyi the tshom sel/zag bcas kyi mngon shes 'chad par byed do//dur gshen mtshon cha can gyis gson gyi bgegs sel/gshin gyi dur 'debs/chung gi sri gnon/gnam gyi rgyu skar blta/sa'i 'dre btul ba yin no//thamasacad rnga shang gi sgra 'brol ba ste/chab srid ni sgrub ste ste'u bsgyur ro//bon gyi lo rgyu las/rje gnya' khri ba'i po'i dus su bon dar/rgyal po gri gum la tha po bon bsgrub/rgyal po spu de gung rgyal gyi dus su bon dar/rgyal po khri srong lde ba 'a gyi dus su bon bsnub/rting du bon gyi bla ma rnya — li sho ka ra bya bas/khams na bon gyi me ro bslang nas/dbus gtsang du phebs/bon cho thams cad gter na brtan/ri zhing /dar lding /dge lding /zhen tsa kha/bzang ri/bog thang la sogs pa bon po'i sde ga mi bon rgyas par byas zer/bon la'ang /bsnya pa snga dar/bar dar/phyi dar gsum byung 7

brje ga 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()la dun gzhan yang shing bsregs pa'i snying po sol ba/ ko ba bzhu ba'i snying po laspyin byung / lcags rdo/ zangs rdo/ dngul rdo gsum rnyed nas/ sol bas rdo gsum bzhus nas/ dngul zangs lcags gsum bton/ shing la bug pa phug nas gshol dang gnya' shing bcos/ /mthun gnyis gnya' ru bsdebs pas thang rnams zhing du rmos/ /rgya mtsho yur la drangs nas zhing la sa bon btab/ /de'i gong na zhing la so nam med/ yab gri gum btsan po dang / sras spu de gung rgyalaganyis la stod kyi steng gnyis zer/ steng gnyis bang so g.ya' dang spang la btab/ de'i lag dpon ru la skyes kyis byas so/ /sbu de gung rgyal gyi sras/ a sho legs/ de'i sras de sho legs/ thi sho legs/ de'i sras gu ru legs/ de'i sras 'brong zhen legs/ de'i sras i sho legs/ de rnams bar gyi legs drug zer/ legs drug bang so g.ya' spang mtshams su btab/ /de'ang spang la 'ja' tshon rgyas pa 'dra/ i sho legs kyi sras/ za nam zin lde de'i sras lde 'phrul nam gzhung btsan/ de'i sras bsnol nam lde/ de'i sras bsnol nam/ de'i sras lde bsnol po/ de'i sras lde rgyal po/ de'i sras lde sprin btsan/ 'di rnamasani sa'i lde brgyad do/ /lde brgyad bang so chu bo'i gzhung la btab/ /de'ang mtsho la kha ba bab pa 'dra/ rgyal po lde sprin btsan gyi sras khri btsan nas/ de'i sras khri dgra dpung btsan/ de'i sras khri de thog btsan/ 'di gsum la 'og gi btsan gsum zer/ btsan gsum bang so gangs dkar rtse la btab/ de'ang gangs la na snyen chags pa 'dra/ khri de thog btsan gyi sras/ lha tho tho ri snyan shal zhes bya ba / 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sprul pa des/ dgung lo brgyad cu'i bar du 172

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhug so//rgyal srid bskyang ste/ ma brtsigs lhun gyis grub pa'i sku mkhar chen po pho brang lum bu bla mkhar gyi rtse la bzhugs pa las/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis 'od ma'i tshal nas lung bstan pa bzhin/ bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel la/ nam mkha' nas mdo sde za ma tog snying po yi ge drug ma/ spang skong phyag brgya pa/ gser gyi mchod rten khru gang pa/ tsi ma n-i su tsā'i skol phor/mu tra'i phyag rgya rnams nyi ma'i 'od zer la 'grogs te/ rgyal po'i pho brang gi steng du babs pa las/ khyed nas gdung rabs lnga na 'di'i don shes pa'i rgyal po zhig 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes/ sbong btsan ma po la zer/ nam mkha' nas lung bstan/ rgyal pos kyang rten de rnams ngo mtshar che bar ni dgongs/ gang yin ni ma mkhyen te/ gnyen po gsang ba zhes mtshan gsol nas/ rin po che'i khri la bzhag nas mchod pa phul bas/ de'i yon tan gyis rgyal po slar gzhen sha can du gyur nas/ dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu thub ste/ sku lus gcig la sku tshe gnyisathub ces grags so/ /rgyal po des dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes pa yin no/ /de yi bang so rang gi yul du btab/ /yul gyi ming ni phying lung dar thang zer/ /bang so de yang sa phung sbra 'dra yod/ /lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi sras khri snyan gzugasabatsan/ des kyang gnyen po gsang ba la mchod pa byas pas chab srid rgyas par byung ngo / /de yi bang so don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs/ /de yang 'phul med saphung brdal ba 'dra/ /de'i sras 'brong snyan lde mā rgyal po des dwags po'i yul nas mchims bza' klu rgyal/ klu mo na/bya ba'i btsun mo zhig blangs pas/ srasadamus long zhig 'khrungs pas/ ming yang dmus long dkon pa bkra zhes grags173

pa tshe chen 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()so / / mchims bza' klu rgyal de dang po shin tu mtshar ba zhig yod pa la/ rting du sngo la rid par byung bas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyod dang po shin tu mtshar ba zhig yod pa la/ na ba ni min nam/ 'di 'dra yod pa ci yin gsungs pas/ nga rang gi yul na zas shig yod pa de/ 'di ru med pas lan pa 'dra zer bas/rgyal po'i zhal nas/ 'o na zas de cis kyang long la zo gsungs pas/ der g.yog mo dam pa zhig zas de len btang bas/ der mos sbal pa'i ro mang po mar gyis btsos te/ khal mang po blangs byung bas/ de rnams mdzod du sbas/mis ma mthong bar byas shing lkog tu zos pas/ sha bkrag sngar bzhin rgyas shing 'od dang ldan pa byung ba dang / rgyal po'i thugs la zas de yon tan can zhig 'dug pa la/ ngas kyang za dgos bsams te/ btsun mo med pa'i shul du/ lde chab kyi sgo phyes nas nang du byon pa dang / mdzod nang na sbal ba'i ro mang po mar gyis btsos pa'i rkyal pa mang po 'dug nas rnam rtog skyes te/ rgyal po la bsnyung du mdze byung ngo //de nas rgyal po yab yum gnyis ka gson por bang sor bzhugs nas/ sras la zhal chems bzhag pa ni/ yab mes kyi thugs dam gnyen po gsang ba la mchod pa gyis/ 'a ci'i yul nas sman pa bos la/ mig phye nas rgyal srid zungs shig gsung ngo / /'brong snyan lde ru'i bang so zhang mdar brtsigs bang so'i ming kyang gson chas zlum por grags/ /zhes so/ /de nas dmul long dkon pa bkras/ gnyen po gsang ba la mchod pa phul zhing mos gus byas pas/sman pa bos nas mig phye bas/ skyi shod stag gi ri la gnyan 'gro ba gzigs pas na/ mtshan yang stag ri gnyan gzigs zhes grags so/ / stag ri gnyan /74

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long nga mchog 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//gzigs bzhi bcu lon dus 'das/ /de yi bang so don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs/ /gral ni khri snyan gzung btsan g.yon na yod/ /de yang 'phul med saphung brdal ba 'dra/ /stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi sras gnam ri srong btsan yin la / rgyal po 'di'i dus su/ rgya nag nas sman dang rtsis byung / rgya dang gru gu btul/ byang nas tsha rnyed/ sku mkhar khri brtsigs 'bum brdugs bya ba brtsigs/chab srid lo drug cu bzung nas 'das so/ /de yi bang so don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs/ /gral ni khri snyan gzung btsan g.yas na yod/ /de yang 'phul che rtsig pa sog khar yod/ /ming kyang gangs ri sog kha lags so skad/ /ces so/ /de ltar phan bde thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi ma/ bod rgyal po'i gdung rabs/ shesabya rab gsal nas/ sang rgyas mya spron las 'das nas/lo nyis stong dus/ rje gnya' khri btsan po byon/nyis stong lnga brgyan/lha tho tho ri snyan shal byon gsung bar 'dug rje gnya' khri btsan po nas/lha tho tho ri snyan shal yan la gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun la lo lnga brgya song 'dug par nges zer na'ang / chos dang 'brel pa'i rgyal por mi 'dug pas/ lo rgyus rgyas par ma bkod/ lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi dus su/ dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/ lo brgya dang nyi shu thub/ de nas gdung rabs bzhi/ gnam ri srong btsan yan la/ lo brgya dang bcu gcig lon pa yin zhes ka tshigs chen mo na bshad yod do/ /'di dag ni zur tsam bsdus pa yin gyis/ rgyas par 'dod na ka tshigs chen mo dang / bka' chems ka khol ma/ rgyal rabs dpag bsam ljon shing rnams la gzigs shig bod rgyal po'i gdung rabs dang po ji ltar byon pa bstan pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //175

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()dgu pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku la 'od zer bzhi 'phros pa las/ chos rgyal 'khrungs pa'i skor/ de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyisabod kha ba can gyi sems can rnams 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas/sku la 'od zer bzhi 'phros te/ de'ang spyan g.yas pa nas 'od zer gcig 'phrosade / bal po'i yul du song ba/ bal po'i yul thams cad 'od zer gyis khyab/bal po'i rgyal po de ba lha yang 'od zer gyis khyab par byas/ grong khyer kho bom klu'i pho brang yang 'od zer gyis snang bar byas so/ /de nas 'od zer de rnams 'dus nas/ rgyal po de ba lha'i btsun mo'i lhums su zhugs so/ /der zla ba dgu ngo bcu lon pa na/ lha gcig khyad du 'phags pa zhig 'khrungs te/ lha gcig de ni 'jig rten las khyad du 'phags pa/ sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangasachags pa/ zhal nas ha ri tsan+dan gyi dri bro ba/ rig pa'i bstan bcos thams cad la mnga' brnyes pa zhig sku 'khrungs te/ de ni bal mo bza' khri btsun 'di yin no / / yang spyan g.yon pa nas 'od zer gcig 'phros pas rgya nag gi yul du song ste / rgya nag gi yul thams cad 'od zer gyis khyab par mdzad/ rgya rje tha'i dzung rgyal po yang 'od zer gyis khyab par mdzad/ pho brang zem shing khri sgo yang 'od zer gyis khyab par mdzad/ de nas 'od zer de rnams 'dus te/ rgya rje btsan po'i btsun mo'i lhums su zhugs so/ /der zla ba dgu ngo bcu lon pa na/ lha gcig khyad du 'phags pa gcig sku 'khrungs te/ lha gcig de ni 'jig rten las khyad par du 'phags pa/ sku mdog sngo la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal nas ut+pal sngon po'i dri bro ba/ rigs pa'i bstan bcos thams cad la mnga' 176

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ba mchos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// brnyes pa zhig 'brungs te/ de ni rgya mo bza' kong rdzo 'di yin no/ /yang zhal nas 'od zer gcig 'phros te/ bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su/ brag la chu rgyag pa'i 'phrong la phog pas/ mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i gnyen po gsang ba 'bru drag chos sku'i rnam par gyur te/ de ni yar 'phrang gi yi ge drug pa 'di yin no/ /rmong thugs ka nas 'od zer zhig 'phros te/ kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su song /bod kha ba can gyi yul thams cad 'od zer gyis khyab par mdzad/ yang bsnon sbra stod tshal yang 'od zer gyis khyab par mdzad/ pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling yang 'od zer gyis khyab par mdzad/ rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan kyang 'od zer gyis khyab par mdzad do/ /de nas 'od zer de rnams 'dus te/ rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan gyi btsun mo 'bri bza' thod dkar ma'i lhums su zhugs pa dang / bkra shis pa'i ltas kyis phyogs thams cad du khyab par gyur to/ /der zla ba dgu ngo bcu lon pa na/ sras khyad par du 'phags pa zhig me mo glang gi lo la/pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling du sku bltams te/ dbu la sangs rgyas a mi khru ba bzhugs pa/ phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan pa/ dbu sgra mthon mthing du yod pa zhig bltams so/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis rlabs/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ lha rnams kyis me tog gi char phab ste / g.yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /de yang mthong lugs rnam pa gsum du byung ste/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi snang ba la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs des/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthu la brten nas/ bod kha ba can pa'i sems can rnams smin grol la bkod nas/ mtha' 'khob kyi yul 'dir/ mun 177

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()pa'i rum du sgron me sbar ba ltar gyur te/ rin po che'i gling du gzigs so/ /sabacu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snang ba la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis/ mtha' 'khob kha ba can pa'i sems can rnams chos la bkod pa'i phyir du/ sprul pa'i rgyal por sku sprul nas/ gang la gang 'dul gyis semasacan gyi don byed pa'i snang ba byung ngo / /mi nag tha mal ba rnams kyi snang ba la/rgyal po la sras 'gran zla dang bral ba'i ngo mtshar ba zhig 'khrungs par mthong ngo / / der rgyal bu de nar lon dus/ bzo dang / rtsis dang / sgyu rtsal dang / rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing yon tan dang ldan par gyur pas/ blon po rnamasan re/ 'o cag tsho'i rje 'di ni yon tan du ma dang ldan te/ thugs shin tu sgam mo zer bas/ mtshan yang srong btsan snam po zhes grags so/ /de nas rgyal po de dgung lo bcu gsum lon dus/ yab 'das te/ rgyal sar byon pa yin no/ /de nas chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po de'i thugs kyi dgongs pa la/ bdag gis kha ba can 'dir sems can gyi don byed pa la/ sa phyogs gang du phyin la bsgom snyam pa dang / bdag gi yab mes lha tho tho ri snyan shal/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sprul pa des/ lha sa dmar po ri'i rtse la bzhugs 'dug pa/bdag gis kyang yab mes kyi 'khas kyis bcag bas pa'i sa cha/ bkra shis shing nyams dga' ba'i sa gnas der phyin la/ sems can gyi don byed par dgongasate / der yar bsnon sbra stod tshal du dgongs man la/ nangs par gro bteg ste/yar 'phrang yi ge drug pa'i drung du khal phog sal ma rnams bzan la skyel nas/der gro btab bo/ /de nas rgyal pos chab la sku khrus gsol/ chu'i nang na 'od 178

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long tham chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// zer kha dog sna tshogs pa zhig khra cam me 'dug pa blon po sna chen pos mthong nas/ rgyal po la zhus pa/ rje ci lags/ chu'i nang du 'od zer 'di lta bu 'ong ba shin tu ngo mtshar che lags zhus pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas zhang blon chen po nyon cig mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi yul 'dir sems can thams cad smin grol la 'god pa'i lam/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo / phan bde dang yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i gnyen po/ kha ba can pa'i chos skal/ yang snying 'dus pa'i snying po/ gsang ba 'bru drug chos kyi sku'i yig 'bru/ gsung mchog yi ge drug ma gcig brag 'di la 'byon par 'dug 'dis kyang sems can mang po'i don byed par 'dug go gsungs te/ brag de la mchod pa phul ba dang / brag de las 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phros te/ pha rol gyi brag de la phog nas/ phan tshun 'ja'i mdangs su 'brel pas na/ grong de'i ming yang 'ja' mdangs bya ba yod de/ brag de la'ang /spyan ra gzig khar sa pa sta/ dpal rta mgrin la sog pa/rting du bal po'i lha bzo ba 'bur du brkos/lha'i sku rang chas su byon yod do/ /de nas byon te dmar po ri'i steng du pho brang btab nas bzhugs so/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku la 'od zer bzhi 'phros pa las/ chos rgyal 'khrungs pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //bcu pa/ blon po thon mis rgya gar nas yi ge bsgyur ba las/ rgyal posadage ba bcu'i khrims bcas pa'i skor/ de nas chos dge ba bcu la brten pa'i rgyal khrims 'cha' ba/ 'dod yon lnga spel ba/ phan tshun du skyes bskur la/mnga' 'og gi 'bangs rnams la chos kyi bka' bsgo ba la/ bod na yi ge meng 179

ba go 'od snang la /skya'i chosang gces bsdus/ ()pas/ blon po dbang po rno ba bdun rgya gar du yi ge slob tu btang pas/ mtha' 'dre rnam pa gsum la thug nas log pas/ de nas thon mi a nu'i bu/ thon mi sa sto ṭa zhes pa yid gzhungs pa dbang po rno ba/ yon tan du ma dang ldan pa zhinayod pa la/ gser mang po bskur nas rgya gar du yi ge slob tu btang ngo / /der blon pos rgya gar lto phyogs su phyin te/ yi ge'i sgra la mkhas pa bram ze li byin zhes bya ba yod zer ba thos nas/ bram ze ga la ba der phyin te/ gus par phyagabatsal te gsol ba/ thugs rje rab rgyas rnam 'phrul lha yi rigs/ /yon tan ldan pas bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs/ /tshe sngon yon tan sbyangs pa song ba'i mthus/ /lung rigs yi ge'i sgra la phul du phyin/ /mkhas grub rig 'dzin bram ze chen po khyed/ khong zad bdag la dgongs shing gsan du gsol/ /bdag ni mtha' 'khob bod kyi blon po yin//bdag gi rgyal po thugs rje chen po lags/ /bcu gsum lon nas rgyal sa rab bzung ste/ /rin chen khri yi steng du bzhugasapa'i dus/ /'khor 'bangs rnams la chos kyis tshim pa dang / /dge ba bcu yi rgyal khrims kha bca' ba la/ /bdag gi yul na yi ge'i srol med pas/ /bdag la phyag rten rgya chen bskur nas ni/ khyed kyi yul du yi ge slob tu btang / /mkhas pa khyed kyis sgra tshad yi ge'i tshogs/ /ma lus bdag la gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes zhus nas/ gser rnams phyag tu phul ba dang / bram ze chen po des/ gser phyag tu bzhes nas lan mdzad pa/ legs par nyon cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /thon mi zer ba'i blon po rig pa can/ /bden gnyis don rtogasablon chen khyed la ni/ /yi ge'i sgra dang snyan ngag la sogs dang / /gzhan yang 180

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long 0pa cho 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhug so// yon tan ngo mtshar can rnams kun/ /blon chen khyed la bdag gis bslab par bgyi/ khyod kyis mtha' 'khob bod kyi rgyal khams su/ /'gro ba rnams la yi ge'i sgra tshad dang / /lung rig man ngag rnams kyis tshim par mdzod/ /ces smras te/rin po che'i gzhal yas khang du khrid nas yi ge'i 'bru bstan pas/ der blon po thon mis rig pa'i rtsal phyes/ shes rab kyi sgron me bteg nas yi ge bslabs pas/ na ga ra'i sde tshan/ ga ta'i sde tshan rnams mang du yod pa/ bod la mi 'gyur bas dbyangs yig la bkod/ 'chi lha'i yi ge wartu la klu'i yi ge lhun grub tshang ma bod kyi yi ge la bkod/ rgya yi yi ge lnga bcu ni/ /yi ge gtso bo sum cu la/ /'phul yig bcu dang mtha' rten bcu/ /rgya yi yi ge re re bzhin/ /rang gang spyod pa ma gtogs pa/ /kun la khyab pa gcig kyang med/ /de dag thams cad khong du bsdus/ /de la dpe byas bsdus pa ni/ /bod yig sum cu gtan la phab/ /yi ge'i 'bru ni re re bzhin/ /bzo'i rnam 'gyur legs par bcos/ /yi ge'i gtso bo nyi shu la/ /ka kha ca cha ja nya ta tha pa pha tsa tsha dza wa zha za ya sha ha a/ med kyang rung ba'i yig 'bru gcig wa/ 'phul yig lnga dang / ga da ba ma 'a/ mtha' rten bcu/ ga da ba ma 'a nga na ra la sa/ shin tu gces pa'i yi ge lnga/ ga da ba ma 'a/rkang pa can gyi yi ge dgu/ ka ga ta da na nya zha sha ha/ rgya la med pa'i yi ge drugaca cha ja zha za 'a/ yi ge bu ni bcu drug la/ ka ga nga da ta na pa ba ma ca ja nya tsa dza la ha/ yi ge ma ni bdun du bcos/ ka ga ba za/ kun gyi ma ni/ ra la sa/ 'dogasatham cad kyi ma gsum/la la sgos su ma bzhi yod/ ka ga ba za la'i ma/ yig 'grubazhi po 'di la/la khon 'dogs/la la sgos su bu gnyis yod/ kho dang ha gnyis la yi bu/ /181

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()tsa dang dza gnyis ra yi bu/ /'phul dang mtha' brten mi byed cing / /ma bu gnyisaka mi byed pa'i/ /rang sa 'dzin pa'i yi ge bcu/ kha cha tha pa tsha wa zha ya sha a/ ga ba yi ge kun tu rgyu/ /ma dang bu gnyis ka byed/'phul dang mtha' brten gnyis ka byed/steng na zha ltar lding ba gsum/ /na ro gi gu 'greng po ste/ /'di gsum yi ge kun la khyab/ /'og na gdan ltar mdzes pa gsum/ /ya ta ra ta khas kyu ste/ /ya ta 'dogs pa'i yi ge bdun/ /kya khya gya pya phya bya mya/ /ra ta 'dogs pa'i yi ge bcu ga jig sku thod/ kra khra gra pra phra bra skra sra shra dra hra/ zhabs(kyu'i yi ge kun la khyab/ kyu khyu kru khru/ ya ta ra ta gnyis la'ang khyab/ 'dogs dang sdeb sbyor blo la shar ro/ /gzhan yang lā: lha'i yi ge 'dra/ ha dang 'a gnyis kyi yi ge'i bu byed pa dang /na log sha logatha log byed pa sogs no/ skṛ ta'i skad/bod du gzung sngags su 'gyur dus/yi ge'i rnam dpyod la mabs pa'i pa gro rnams kyis rting du bcos so/ /de la dpe byas nas yi ge dbu can du byas/wartu la klu'i yi ge 'dra/ de la dpe byas nas yi ge zur can du byas so/ /'di ni zur tsam yin gyis/ rgyas par 'dod na thon mis/ dang po yi ge'i rnam 'gyur gyi bzo brtsam/ ka mad sum cur bsgyur/ sdeb sbyor bsgrig pa'i gzhi ma/ thon mi'i mdo rdzi'i sgra mdo bya ba yod kyis de dag la gzigs shig gzhan yang blon po thon mi des/ paṇ+ḍita lha rig pa'i seng ge la/ sgra'i bstan bcos thams cad bslabs nas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par gyur te/ 'dus pa rin po che'i tog mdo za ma tog spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig rnams bod du bsgyur/ lo rgyus gcig na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa yang bsgyur zer ba'ang 'dug mdor na blon po thon mi de/ bslab shes kyi yon 182

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// to du ma la mkhas par gyur to/ /de nas blon po bod du byon pa'i dus su/ bram ze la gsol ba/ thugs la btags so rgyal ba'i sras/ /bka' drin che'o ngo mtshar che/ /byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje can/ /rig pa dri med kyi nam mkha' la / / thabs shes gnyis kyi rgyu skar shar/ /smon lam dag pa'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs//sgra tshad yi ge'i nyi zla shar/ /'gro ba ma rig mun pa sel/ /bde gsal yid kyi rgya mtsho la/ /rig pa blo yi chu bran 'khor/ /smon lam dag pa'i chu bya lding / /sgra tshad yi ge'i nor bu bzhugs/ /'gro ba'i dbul phongs sel bar byed/ /sgyu lusadri med sdong po la/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi yal ga rgyas/ /bslab shes yon tan me tog shar/ /sgra tshad yi ge'i 'bras bu smin/ /bdag cag blon po thon mi la/ /ma lus gnang ba thugs la btags/ /rgya gar yul du phyin pa yin/ /mkhas grub khyed dang mjal ba yin/ /yon tan gzhi ma yi ge yin/ /ma lus khong du chud pa yin/ /bod yul dbus su 'gro ba yin//rgyal pos dga' ston mdzad pa yin//rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong ba yin//rgyal pos dbu mdzad blon 'bangs la / / sgra tshad yi ge spel ba yin/ /kun la rgyas par byed pa yin/ /thugs la btags so rgyal ba'i sras/ /zhes brjod de/ zhabs spyi bos blangs/ theg pa chen po'i chos du ma dang bcas te bod du phebs/ bsu ba dga' ston bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas/ rgyal po dga' ston gyi gdan sar byon pa la/ blon po thon mis/na ro/ gi gu/ zhabs kyu sogs sde tshan du byas te/ yi ge'i phud phul ba/ zhal ras gsal la ngang mdangs gang ba bzang / /gdams ngag zab la ma chad tha dad dang / /las ngan bag chags thams cad bsal mdzad pa/ /'phags pa ma 183

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/ ()pham yang dag dam pa lags/ /bde gshegs bden nges ye shes te/ /ting 'dzin zhi nyid rig cing gzigs/ /nyon mongs tshogs bcom mgon po mchog /dug gsum bdud 'dul kun tu thul/ /thon mi'i yi ge'i phud 'di/dzin khog sna rdo'i lha khang la brag la brkos na yod do/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs kyi sras/ /srong btsan sgam por mtshan gsol ba'i/ /chos rgyal khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod pa dang / rgyal po shin tu dgyes nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la dgongs nas/ bkur sti dang phu dud du mdzad do/ /rgyal pos blon po la yon tan che ba'i bkur sti mdzad pa dang / blon po gzhan rnams phrag dog gis kun nas bslangs te/ rje yis 'bangs la 'di lta bu'i bkur sti mi 'os so zhes dril bsgrags pa dang / blon po thon mis de dag gi 'gran sems gcog pa'i phyir du/'di skad zer ro/ /nga drin chen gyi blon po thon mi ngas/ /lam bgrod par dka' ba'i rgya gar du/ /lus tsha grang che yang dka' ba spyad/ khong mkhas pa bram ze li byin la/ /yid gus pa'i tshul gyis mos gus byas/ /nor rin chen gser gyi phyag rten phul/ /don rnyed par dka' ba'i yig 'bru bstan/ /blo the tshom sel ba'i mdzub khrid byas/ /tshig dbyangs yig rnams la mkhas par bslabs/ /rgya yig lnga bcu tham pa de/ /bod yig sum cur gtan la phab/ /rang mkhas pa'i nges shes blo la shar/ /'phral yon tan thams cad khong du chud/ /dus da lta dga' la phyi ma skyid/ /yul mtha' 'khob bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/ /mi mkhas pa sleb pa'i snga ma yin/ /nga mun pa sel ba'i sgron me yin/ /rje rgyal po nyi zla'i tshul du bzhugs/ /grogs blon po'i khrod na nga tsam med/ /bod kha ba 184

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long zhwa mchos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//can pa'i mi rnams la/ /nga thon mi bka' drin mi che'am/ /thon mi'i nga rgyal zer/zhes zer bas/blon po rnams gcig la gcig lta zhing / 'gran sems med par gyur to / / dus de tsa na/ yang grags kyi blon po sum brgya la/ phyi nang bar ga4gyi sa po 'di rnams kyi ming thang yig 'a mo nas bsdus/ming chen gyi blon po bcu drug yod/ med thabs med pa'i blon chen bzhi/ zhes pa/ rgyal po'i sku gsung thugs kyi zhabs rtagaphyi nang bar gsum gyi bya ba byed pa'i blon po/ byang chub sems dpa'i gdung brgyud blon po bcu drug gi thog drangs pa'i blon po sum brgya yod do/ /de'ang phyi blon btsan po drug nang blon bzang po drug bka'i 'phrul blon bzhi'o/ /de la nang blon bzang po drug ni/ 'phrul gyi sna chen rig bzang / bra 'gig shad po rgyal gyi khram bzang / sto yin/cog ro rigs pa'i skad bzang / sto ro/lhar gzigs shog po bstan bzang / khams pa/ga'i gnyags ston 'phel bzang / rgya ma yar ston/sbas lcang dpal gyi legs bzang / sbas kyi skyed thag ring mo'ang zer/la sogs te/blon po brgya tham pas/ rgyal po'i sku'i zhabs tog dang / nang gi bya ba thams cad byed do/ /phyi blon btsan po drug ni/ byang gi khyung po yin/khyung po sbu na bzang btsan/par stod pa/lam khri bde lhag khri btsan/'phan yul rgyal ba/mu khri rdo rje gnam btsan/ 'jad pa/mthing gi byang chub mchog btsan/yong rgya pa/thar pa klu'i dpal btsan/par lung sto pa/rong po 'phrul gyi lde btsan la sogs pa'i blon po brgya tham pas phyi blon byed/ shar phyog rgya dang / mi nyag gi yul nas bzo dang rtsis kyi dpe blangs/ lto phyogs rgya gar gyi yul nas dam pa chos kyi sgra bskur/nub phyogs sog po dang / bal po'i yul nas zas nor longs spyod kyi gter 185

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()mdzad/ byang phyogs hor dang yu ge ra'i yul nas khrims dang las kyi dpe blang /mdor na phyogs bzhi la dbang bsgyur zhing longs spyod nas/ 'dzam gling phyed kyi kha lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po mdzad do/ /thon mi sa sto ṭa/ mgar stong btsan yul bzung / stod lung sgo pab/'bri se ru gong ston/'bri khung ba/nyang khri bzang / kho ser ba / yang ston la sogs pa blon po brgya tham pas bar gyi khod snyoms/ rgyal posabaka' stsal pa bzhin/ dge ba bcu'i khrims bca' ba ste/ bzang la bya dga' ster/ ngan pa la chad pa gcod/ mtho ba khrims kyis gnon/ dma' ba thabasakyis skyong / sku bsrung sde bzhir spyad/ phu chu rdzing du bskyil/ mda' chu yur bar drangs/ bre srang gtan la phab/ zhid la lhu ru spyad/ mi la yi ge bslabs/ rta 'a/mdongs su bris/ legs pa'i dpe srol btsug ste/ 'thab mo byas pa la chad pa/bsad pa la che chung gi stong byed pa/ brkus pa la brgyad 'jal ngos dang dgu/ bye byas pa'i yan lag gi phran bcad nas yul gzhan du sprugs pa/ rdzun byas pa'i lce gcod pa'o/ /gzhan yang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song zhing / dad pa dang mos gus bya ba/ pha ma la drin du gzo zhing bkur sti bya ba/ mi drin chen dang pha khu rgan gsum gyi yi mi gcod cing / bzang po'i lan byed pa/ mi ya rabs dang rigs btsun pa la mi rgol cing dang du len pa/ las dang spyod pa thams cad ya rabs kyi rjes su 'brang ba/ lha chos dang yi ge la blo 'jug cing don shes par bya ba/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches shing / mi dge ba 'ba' zhig la 'dzem pa/ mdza' bshes dang khyim mtshes la phan 'dog cing gnod sems mi bya ba/ gzhi drang por bya zhing blo sems dpang du 'jog pa/ zas chang la tshod 186

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long zhwam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// 'dzin cing khrel yod par bya ba/ bu lon dus su 'jal zhing / bre srang la g.yo zol mi bya ba/ ma bskos shing ma bcol ba'i bya ba la rtog 'jug mi bya ba dang /gros kyi nang du bud med kyi kha la mi nyan cing rang tshugs 'dzin pa/ yin min gyis ma tshang ba byung na/ yul lha bstan srung dpang du btsugs nas mna' byed pa la sogs te/ dge ba bcu la dpe byas nas/ bod khrims nyi shu/ skyi shod/ shom ra ru gtan la phab ste/ rje blon kun gyi phyag rgyas btab ste/ nyi zla'i 'od lta bur khyab par mdzad do/ /de ltar mdzad pas rje btsan 'bangs rnams skyid/ /bstan pa rgyas shing rgyal srid phyogs bcur 'phel/ /chos kyi bka' khrims mdzad pas 'bangs rnams bka' la nyan/ /mi rje lha yis mdzad pas rgyal khams thams cad skyid/ /pho dpa' rta mgyogs longs spyod lha dang mnyam/ /blo gtad chos la byas pas 'di phyi gnyis dar skyid/ /'thab dang rtsod pa spangs pas thams cad pha mar shes/ /kun la yi ge bslabs pas sangs rgyas bstan pa dar/ /mi dge'i bshes gnyen med pas dge bcu'i nor bu rnyed/ /kun gyi gtsug tu khur bas skyid pa'i nyi ma shar/ /thams cad sprul pa yin pas khral dang 'u lag med/ /nam mkha'i mthong la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad shar/ /dog mo'i sa la pad+ma 'dab brgyad skyes/ /bar gyi ri la bkra shis rtags brgyad tshang / /ljon shing thams cad dga' ba'i tshal du 'thibs/ /bya rnams kun kyang ca co du ma sgrogs/ /sa rnams kun kyang rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ /lha rnams kun gyis me tog char pa phab bkra shis nyams su dga' ba'i brag lha'i tshal/ /ljon shing star kha sdong po'i bsil grib la/ /chos rgyal chen po khri yi steng na bzhugs/ /dpa' mdzangs 'phrul ldan 187

ba 'a 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung sa bsdus/ ()blon po'i tshogs dang bcas/ /bod 'bangs 'khor dang bcas pas mtha' ma bskor/ kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa 'ja' yi gur/ /rgyal po bzhugs pa'i mkha' la gdugs ltar 'khyil/ /bu ram rgun 'brum ka ra zhal zas sogs/ /ro bskyoldan pa'i zas kyi tshogs rnams kyang / /rgyal pos gsol zhing 'khor rnams tshim par byed/ /chos rgyal chen po'i sku yi skyo sangs la/ /'bag dang seng ge g.yag seng stag seng dang / /rnga bro mkhan dang gar mkhan la sogs kyis/ /re re bzhin du gar dang rtsed mo 'bul/ /lha yi rnga bo che dang pi wang dang / /rol mo sil snyan rnams kyis mchod pa dang / /sman mchog a ga ru dang tsan+dan dang / /dri zhim bdug sbos rnams ni rlung ltar g.yo/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan lhab lhub dang / /sna tshogs dar gyis nam mkha' gang bar mchod/ /yid 'ong mdzesapa'i bu mo bcu drug gis/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan bcas me tog thogs nas ni/ /glu dang gar gyis rna ba'i dga' ston 'gyed/ /dga' bde skyid pa'i bka' khrimasamadzad pa'i tshe/ /bod 'bangs mi res rta re zhen nas rgyug sang re'i rtse la dar re phyar gin bzhag /dam pa chos kyi rnga chen dam pa brdung / /dge ba bcu la bstun pa'i rgyal khrims bcas/ /'dod yon lnga dang bstun pa'i longs spyod spel/kha ba can pa'i rgyal khams 'di nyid du/ /dge bcu'i rgyal khrims mkha' la nyi zla bzhin/ /bod yul gangs can khrod 'dir khyab par mdzad/ /blon po thon misashā // /bye /'o ge bsgyur ba las/ rgyal pos dge ba bas khrims bcas pa'i 188

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long tham chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// bcu gcig pa/ rgyal po'i thugs dam gyi lha rgya gar dang / bal po'i yul nas spyan drangs pa'i skor/ des nas sprul pa'i rgyal po chen po de'i thugs kyi dgongs pa la/ bdag gis mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi yul 'dir/ sems can gyi don byed pa la/ yi dam gyi lha zhig bzhengs dgos te/ de'i rgyu ni rin po che gser dngul las byas na ni/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su sems can bsod nams dman pas dus kyi tha ma la bzhigs pa'i dogs yod/ sa dang rdo las byas na ni rgyu ngan/ shing gi rigs la byas na ni 'gas/ bdag gi yi dam gyi lha bzhengs pa'i rgyu gang legs dgongs te/ 'phags pa la gsol ba btab pas/ tho rangasakyi dus su sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'phags pa nyan thosadang / lha'i bu dang bu mo la sogs pa thams cad sprin 'dus pa ltar/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la byon nas/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang / 'phags pa kun tu bzang po gnyis kyis/ rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba phyag tu bzung nas/ rgyal po la dbang bskur/ sku khrus gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab par mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bkra shis brjod/ lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyis sprin gyi gseb nas lus phyed thon tsam byas nas/ lha'i rol mo sna tshogs kyis mchod pa byed cing me tog gi char phab bo/ /de ma thag tu rgyal po'i sku la 'od zer sna tshogs pa zhig 'phros nas/mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi yul thams cad 'od zer gyis khyab par byas nas gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pa re res sems can gyi don byas nas/ mtha' 'khob de yang rin po che'i gling lta bur gyur to/ /de nas lha rnams kyis mgrin 189

ba chen 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()gcig tu rgyal po la 'di skad ces zhus so//sprul pa'i rgyal po byang chub sems//mgo nag yongs kyi rje khyed kyis/ /mos gus bsod nams bsags pa'i rten/ /yi dam lha gcig spyan 'dren na/ /rgya gar yul gyi lho phyogs su/ /siṅga la yi rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ /rang byon khas pa ṇi'i rgyab/ /glang chen nyal ba'i bye ma'i 'og /tsan+dan sprul gyi snying po las/ /grub pa'i rang byon spyan ras gzigs/ /ngo mtshar can zhig de na bzhugs/ /de ni rgyal po'i yi dam yin/ /zhes zer te/ mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa la/ yi dam gyi lha de spyan 'dren pa la/ mis mi rnyed pas/ sprul pa zhig btang dgos dgong pa dang / de ma thag tu rgyal po'i smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas/ sprul pa'i dge slong a ka ra ma ti shi la zhes pa/ dbu la sangs rgyas 'od dpag med bzhugs pa zhig spru'akhanas/ yi dam de spyan 'dren pa la btang ngo / /de nas sprul pa'i dge slong des/rdzu 'phrul gyis rgya gar lho phyogs su byon pa dang / grong khyer dbus 'gyur bya bar slebs te/ de na rgyal po ut+pal ge sar zhes pa/ rgyal po de gdung brgyud nang pa sangs rgyas pa yin pa la/ phyis phyi pa mu stegs pa'i chos lugs bzung nas/nyin re la ra lnga lnga bsad nas/ dbang phyug chen po'i rten la mchod do/ /rgyal po'i pho brang de'i g.yon na/ sngon sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gis rab gnasamadzad pa'i mchod rten pad+ma'i 'khor lo can bya ba bzhugs so/ /der sprul pa'i dge slong des/ mchod rten de'i bum pa'i thad kyi nam mkha' la skyil krung mdzad cing bskor ba mdzad pas/ rgyal po'i pho brang gi yang thog nas gzigs pas ngo mtshar du gyur nas/ rgyal pos sprul pa'i dge slong de pho brang du gdan drangs pa 190

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long bam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// dang / dge slong 'byon du ma gnang ste/ nan gyis zhus pas/ dge slong gi zhal nas/ ngas ji ltar zer ba'i kha la nyan na khyed kyi pho brang du 'ong / mi nyan na mi 'ong gsungs pas/ rgyal pos dge slong gis ji ltar gsungs pa la nyan par mdzad nas/ rgyal po'i pho brang du byon nas mchod gnas mdzad do/ /der dge slong gi zhal nas/ khyed sngar nang pa sangs rgyas pa yin par 'dug pa la/ phyi rol pa'i chos lugs 'di bsgyur nas/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lugs su gyis la / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song shig ces gsungs pas/ rgyal posade bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes so/ /yang dge slong gi zhal nas/ rgyal po khyed kyis lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs shig lha khang de rnams kyi nang du tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po dang / tsan+dan gor shi dzi'i sku brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs shig ces gsungs pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ tsan+dan sprul gyi snying po ni 'og min na yod pas nga la len pa'i mthu med/ tsan+dan gor shi ṣa ma la ya'i byang phyogs na dug sprul gdug pa can gyis 'khril yod pas/ ngas len mi nus/ lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs pas chog zer ro/ /yang dge slong gi zhal nas/ tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po nga la rgyus yod pas len du 'gro dgos/ khyed kyis 'khor g.yog lag cha dang bcas pa thong zhig gsungs pas/ der rgyal po yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa siṅga la'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram du byon pa dang / rdo'i kha rla pa ṇi rang byon de'i sku rgyab na glang po che mang po nyal 'dug go /der dge slong gi zhal nas/ glang po che 'di rnams kyi nang nas kha shar du lta ba/ sna dmar ba/ 'jing khung na gi wang gi zar bu yod pa 'di'i 'og na/ tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po yod do gsungs pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/191

ba chen 'od snang la /ga skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()glang po che'i 'og tu tsan+dan 'ong ba ci lags zhus pas/ dge slong gi zhal nas/dbyar tshad pas gdung ba'i dus su tsan+dan gar yod rnams bsil ba yin zhing /tsan+dan gyi lo mas kyang tshad pa'i sdug bsngal sel ba yin pas/ glang po ches tsan+dan gar yod ngo shes nas tshad pa byung tshe de'i steng du nyal ba yin gsungs so//der glang po che de rnams dkrogs nas/ de'i 'og gi bye ma brkos pa dang / tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po'i sdong po zhig 'dug go /der yang rgyal po'i zhal nas/ mi'i yul na tsan+dan sprul gyi snying po mi 'ong ba la/ 'dir 'ong ba ci lags zhus pas/dge slong gi zhal nas/ sngon sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig 'jig rten du byon pa'i dus su/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa zhig gi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'og min du byon nas/tsan+dan sprul gyi snying po'i gang bu zhig blangs byon pas/ de'i nang na 'bru bzhi 'dug pa la/ 'bru gsum sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig la phul/ 'byu gcig jo bo khan pa ṇi la phul nas dbu'i spyi gtsug tu bzhag pas/ rlung gis bskyod de sku rgyab rte lhung / de sa sa non pa'i thog tu tshes bco lnga'i nub mo zhig mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bdud rtsi 'pho bas brlan nas myu gu byung / sangs rgyas gser thub 'jig rten du byon tshe me tog rgyas/ sangs rgyas 'od srung 'jig rten du byon tshe 'bras bu smin/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'jig rten du byon nas sdong po chen por gyur yod pa las/ shākya thub pa mya ngan las 'das tshe/ sdong po de 'gyel nas bye mas non pa yin gsungs so/ /der bye ma'i 'og nas sdong po de bton nas/yal ga rnams bcad/ sdong po de la srub bzhir 'dug pa la/ de nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas nas/192
