rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ba ma chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// slar sdong po de la thim pa dang / dal bus chod cig bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /der sdong po de tshal pa bzhir gshags pa'i nang na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhal bcu pa/ zhi zhal gsum/ khro zhal bdun/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las 'grub pa/ de'i steng na a mi khru ba bzhugs pa/ rtsa phyag bcu po phyag mtshan dang bcas pa/'od dang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba zhig byon no//tsan+dan de la tshal pa brgya rtsa brgyad byas/ sku brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs te/ lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad du bzhugs so/ /de nas yang tsan+dan gor shi ṣa len pa la/ dus skabs dang bstun te glang rdzis bstan nas gor shi ṣa blangs/snga ma ltar byas so//de nas dge slong gis mchod rten pad+ma'i bum pa'i nang nas/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi ring bsrel bre gang bsnams nas slar rgyas btab bo/ /de nas rgya mtsho'i gling la byon pa dang / 'jag ma re re'i steng na/ sangs rgyas re bzhugs par gzigs nas/ 'jag ma phon cig kyang bsnams so/ /de nas chu bo ni rā& ra'i 'gram du byon pa dang / bye ma 'bru re'i steng na sangs rgyas re bzhugs par gzigs nas bye ma bre gang yang bsnams so/ /de ltar tsan+dan sprul gyi snying po la byon pa'i spyan ras gzigs/ tsan+dan gor shi ṣa byang chub kyi ljon shing gi yal gachu bo nai rā& ra'i bye ma/ ku sha'i 'jag ma phon gcig dben gnas chen po brgyad kyi sa la sogs te/ rgya gar gyi rdzas yi dam gyi lha la sogs pa dge slong gis spyan drangs te/ bod du byon nas rgyal po la phul bas shin tu dgyes par gyur to/ /de nas yang rgyal po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa la/ da rung lho bal gyi phyogs na/ sbas pa'i sprul sku/ phyi rabs sems can gyi don byed pa'i rten ngo 193

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()mtshar can yod dgongs nas/ yi dam gyi lha la gsol ba btab pas/ rang byon de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer zhig 'phros te/ bal po'i yul du song ngo / /de la gtad nas gzigs pas/ rgya gar dang bal po'i mtshams kyi nags khrod chen po zhig na/ tsan+dan ha ri'i sdong po 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba zhig la rang byon mched bzhi byon par gzigs/ de nas yang sprul pa'i dge slong de rten de rnamasaspyan 'dren du btang ngo / /der dge slong gis mang yul gyi grong du byon pa na/yul de na yams nad kyis mi mang po 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal mthong / de nas byon pa na/ grong khyer yam bu ya 'gal bya ba na/ mdze nad kyis mi mang po 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal mthong / de nas byon pa na rgya gar dang bal po'i mtshams na steng gdon zhig gis glo bur du mi mang po 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal mthong / de'i nagasakhrod na/ ji bo zhig gis ma he mang po skyong gin 'dug pas/ ma he las dang skal bar ldan pa zhig gis/ nyin mo'i rigs kyi nags khrod der phyin nas/ tsan+dan ha ri'i sdong po 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba zhig 'dug pa la bskor ba byed cing nu ma gtor bas dgongs mo rdzi bo la/ ma he bdag pos na re/ khyod kyisanga'i ma he'i 'o ma bzhos 'dug zer ba la/ rdzi bo na re/ ngas ni ma he'i 'o ma bzhos pa med/ma he ni nyin mo'i rigs la nags khrod ya gir 'gro'i 'dug go zer ro//de'i sang rdzi bo dang / ma lha'i bdag po gnyis kyis 'grogs te/ nags khrod der bltar phyin pas/ ma he de tsan+dan ha ri'i sdong po 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba zhig la skor ba bskor nas/ nu ma gtor gin 'dug pas ngo mtshar du byas so / / de nas sprul pa'i dge slong des rgyal po'i thugs dam tsan+dan gyi sku de las194

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// 'byon par mkhyen nas/ tsan+dan de snya res bcad pa dang / sku bzhi las gsum byung ste/ stod kyi de na re/ dal bus chod la nga mang yul gyi grong du shog cig bya ba'i sgra thos/ de gshags pa'i nang nas/ 'phags pa wa ti zhes bya ba zhig byon no / / de'i 'og ma des sgra byung ste/ dal bus chod la nga grong khyer yam bu ya 'gal du zhog cig bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /de gshags pa'i nang nas/ 'phags pa dbu gang zhes bya ba zhig byon no/ /de'i 'og ma des sgra byung ste/ dal bus chod la nga rgya gar dang bal po'i mtshams su zhog cig bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /de gshags pa'i nang nas/ 'phags pa lja ma li zhes bya ba zhig byon no/ /de'i 'og ma des sgra byung ste/ dal bus chod la nga bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i yi dam la 'gro'o zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /de nas 'phags pa wa ti ni mang yul gyi grong du bzhugs/ 'phags pa dbu gang ni grong khyer yam bu ya 'gal du bzhugs/ 'phags pa lja ma li ni rgya bal gyi mtsham ba(su bzhugs so / / sku de gsum bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ grong tshan so so'i dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa gsum las thar ro/ /de nas sprul pa'i dge slong des 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra 'di da ltar po ta la'i rtse la bzhugs/ kha rla pa ṇi spyan drangs te/ bod kyi yul du phebs nas chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po la phul bas/rgyal po shin tu dgyes par gyur nas/ yi dam gyi lha dang mjal bas/ da ni sems can gyi don byed pa la tshegs med do dgongs so/ /de nas sprul pa'i dge slong a ka ra ma ti shī la zhes bya ba de'ang / slar 'od du zhu nas/ rgyal po'i smin mtshams su thim par gyur to/ /rgyal po'i thugs dam gyi lha rgya gar dang / bal 195

'tsheg 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos yang gces bsdus/ ()po'i yul nas spyan drangs pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //bcu gnyis pa/ bal mo bza' khri btsun gdan drangs pa'i skor/ de nasayang sprul pa'i rgyal po de'i thugs dgongs la/ bdag gis kha ba can gyi yul 'dir/ theg pa chen po'i chos dar bar byed pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gcig rgya gar na bzhugs/ gcig bal yul na bzhugs/ gcig rgya nag na bzhugs/ sku de gsum gang na bzhugs pa'i yul der/ theg pa chen po'i chosadar yod pas/ sku de gsum gang rung zhig ji ltar byas la gdan 'dren dgongasate / tsan+dan gyi sku rang byon de la gsol ba btab pas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gnyis 'phros te/ gcig shar du song / gcig nub tu song / nub tu song ba de la brten nas gzigs pas/ nub phyogs bal po'i yul na rgyal po de ba lha zhes pa la/ sras mo lha gcig khri btsun zhes pa/ sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal nas ha ri tsan+dan gyi dri bro ba/ rig pa'i bstan bcos thams cad la mnga' brnyes pa zhig bzhugs par gzigs/ de spyan drangs na bcom ldan 'das dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad dang / theg pa chen po'i chos thams cad bod du gdan 'drong bar gzigs so/ shar du song ba de la brten nas gzigs pas/ shar phyogs rgya nag gi yul na/ rgya rje tha'i dzung rgyal po bya ba la / sras mo lha gcig kong jo bya ba/ sku mdog sngo la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa / zhal nas ut+pal sngon po'i dri bro ba/ rig pa'i bstan bcos thams cad la mnga' brnyes pa zhig bzhugs par gzigs so/ /de spyan drangs na bcom ldan 'das dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad dang / theg pa chen po'i chos thams cad 196

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long nga mchos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// bod du spyan 'drong bar gzigs so/ /de nas rgyal po de 'jig rten las khyad du 'phags shing / thugs bsgoms pas rmi lam du byung ba ltar mdzad de/ nangs par blon po thams cad rgyal po'i drung du phyag byed du byung ste/ btsan po'i sku la bsnyung mi mnga' lags sam/ sku zo mdog legs sam/ thugs bde ba dang ldan pa lags sam zhes mgrin gcig tu zhus pas/ shin tu'ang bde ba dang ldan te/mdang nga'i rmi lam du nub phyogs nas bal rje'i sras mo bu mo mdzes ma zhig dang / shar phyogs nas rgya rje'i sras mo bu mo mdzes ma zhig dang / 'di gnyis nga'i khab tu byung ba rmis so gsungs pas/ blon po mgar na re/ rgyal po'i mnal lam du byung ba'i lha gcig de gnyis nged blon po rnams kyis spyan ci 'drong byed pas/ mnal lam de gzhan la mi gsung bar zhu zhus so/ /de nas blon po mgar na re/ nged rang phyi nang bar gsum gyi blon po/ gtso bo mi drug gi 'tsho gis rten gyi zas chang / sha gzugs re dang bcas pa khyer la/ sang snga bar brag lha'i ne'u thang la/ ljon shing star ga sdong po'i rtsa rgyal po'i khri'i drung du 'tshogs shig cesasmras so/ /de'i sang blon po gtso bo drug po 'tshogs pas/ 'tshogs rten gyi sha gzugs drug byung ba/ gnyis la rkang pa re/ gnyibs la lag pa re/ gcig la brang so/ gcig la dal mo rnams byung ba bsgrigs pas/ sha khog ma nyams pa zhig byung ba dang / thon mi na re/ rten 'brel legs/ da lan gyi 'dun gros 'di la gros ma byas par blo mthun par byung bas/ gang bsam thams cad 'grub par 'dug 'dun ma rgya ma chung zhig zer ro/ /mgar na re/ 'dun ma rgya mi chung bar byed do/ /nged rang tsho'i rje 'dis dgung lo bcu drug bzhes/ gzhan du mi rung 197

ba chen 'od snang la /4skya'i chos 'byung ba rjes bsdus/ ()bas rgyal srid 'dzin pa la bal yul na/ bal rje sras mo mdzes ma zhig yod par 'dug pa de dang / rgya nag gi rgyal po la sras mo mdzes ma zhig yod pa de gnyis 'dir btsun mo la spyan 'dren pa yin no zhes smras pas/ thams cad kyis legs so zhes kha mthun par byas so/ /de nas mgar gyis rgyal po'i drung du phyin nas/ snga sor bal yul gyi lha gcig de spyan 'dren pas/ bka' gnang bar zhu byas pas/ rgyal pos gser gyi dong rtse lnga bskur nas/ 'dis zhu rten gyis shig gsung ngo / /rin po che be+eḍūr+ya'i rmog la/ pad+ma rā ga'i phra rgyab pa zhig bskur nas/'di lnga gcig de'i rin du phul cig gsung ngo / /rgyal po des bka' lung mi 'dra ba gsum btud mar gsungs 'ong gis/ de'i dus su 'di gsum ma nor bar re re bzhin du phul cig gsungs nas/ bka' shog gi sgrom bu gsum bskur/'phral gyi zas gos rgyan la sogs pa bskur te/ rta dang drel/ rnga slo la sogs kyi khal mang po brdzangs so/ /lam 'phrang gang du'ang / jo mo khro gnyer can la gsol ba 'debs kyin song zhig gsung ngo / /de nas blon po mgar gyis rje la phyag byas te/ rdzong dang yo byad rnams khyer/ khal rnams ded nas/ blon po rta pa brgya tham pa bal yul du chas so/ /der bal yul rin po che'i gling / grong khyer kho bom klu'i pho brang / rgyal po de ba lha bzhugs pa'i sgo drung du slebs so/ /der rgyal po'i drung du zhu ba btang ste mjal ba la/ gser gyi dong rtse lnga po zhu rten du phul/ rin po che be+eḍūr+ya'i rmog la/ pad+ma rā ga'i phra btab pa de rgyal po'i drung du bzhag nas/ mgar na re/ rgyal po chen po/ rin po che be+eḍūr+ya'i rmog 'di/ yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan te/ mi nad phyugs nad byung ba'i dus su rmog 'di 198

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long spro mchos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhug0so// gon nas grong khyer gyi mtha' bskor na mi nad phyugs nad thams cad chad/ sad ser byung dogs pa'i dus su 'di gon nas zhing rnams mtha' bskor na sad dang ser ba thub/ 'brug pa byed pa'i dus su 'di gon nas 'thab na g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /'dzam bu'i gling na rmog 'di las lhag pa'i nor med pas/gong thang dbyad kyis mi chod/ 'di lha gcig de'i rin du 'bul lo/ khyed kyi lha gcig mdzangs ma de/ nged bod kyi rgyal po'i btsun mo la bka' gnang bar zhu byas pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyed bod kyi rgyal po de snying gdon gyis bslusasam/ sems 'khrul pa zhig 'dug nga ni sangs rgyas 'od srungs nas deng sang phan chod la rgyal brgyud ma chad pa yin/ khyod dang gnyen zla min te/ 'on kyang khyod sa thag ring nas sleb 'dug pa/ khyod rang gi yul du log la/ khyod kyi rgyal po de la/ chos dge ba bcu dang bstun pa'i rgyal khrims 'cha' nus sam mi nus dris shog de nus na lha gcig ster/ mi nus na mi ster gsung ngo / /der mgar gyis bka' shog gi sgrom bu gsum yod pa'i dang po de/ rgyal po'i phyag tu phul bas/ de kha phyes nabs gzigs kha pas/ mthing 31ga la gser gyib bris(pa/ bal po'i yi ger 'dug pa 'di ltar ro/ khyed bal po'i rgyal po la dge ba bcu'i khrims yod/ nga bod mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po la de bzhin med de/ rgyal po khyod khrims yod pa la dga' nas bu mo ster na/ ngas sku lus kyi sprul pa lnga stong du sprul nas/ dge ba bcu dang ldan pa'i khrims snga dro zhig la 'cha' nus par byed do / / de ngo mtshar mi che'am/ de ltar byas kyang bu mo mi ster na/ ngas sprul pa'i dmag khri phrag lnga btang nas/ khyod gsod/ lha gcig phyogs/ grong khyer thams199

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()cad bcom la bzhag go bya ba 'dug pas/ rgyal po de shin tu skrag par gyur to/ /rgyal po de skrag kyang mi sgrag pa ltar byas nas/ khyod kyi rgyal po de kha tsho shin tu che bar 'dug khyod kyi yul na gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i nus pa yod dam med dris shog de yod na bu mo ster/ med na mi ster gsung ngo / /yang mgar gyisabaka' shog gi sgrom bu bar ma de rgyal po'i phyag tu phul nas/ rje gcig lags/'phrin re la bal bod kyi lam thag ring la yar 'gro mar 'gro byas na/ lha gcig gdan drang pa'i thabs med/ khyed kyi gsung de'i lan du/ bka' shog 'di legs pa gzigs par zhu byas pas/ der rgyal pos gzigs pas 'di ltar ro/ khyed bal po'i rgyal po la gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i nus pa yod/ nga mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po la de bzhin med de/ rgyal po khyod lha khang brtsig pa la dga' nas bu mo ster na/ ngas sku lus kyi bkod pa lnga stong du sprul nas/ lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad du bzhengs te/ sgo thams cad khyod kyi phyogs su bstan la bzhag go / de ngo mtshar mi che'am/ de ltar byas kyang bu mo mi ster na/ sprul pa'i dmag khri phrag lnga der btang nas/ khyod bsad/ la gcig phrogs/ grong khyer thams cad bcom la bzhag go bya ba 'dug pas/ rgyal po de shin tu skrag par gyur to/ /rgyal po skrag kyang mi skrag pa ltar byas nas/ khyod kyi rgyal po de kha tsho shin tu che ba zhig 'dug ste/ khyod bod kyi yul na 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod rgyu yod dam med/ de yod na bu mo ster/ med na mi ster/ da lan song la dris la shog zer bas/ yang mgar gyis sgrom bu tha ma de rgyal po'i phyag tu phul nas/ 'phrin re re la yul du log pa mi 'ong bas/ rgyal po khyed kyi gsung de'i lan 'di lags 200

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//pas gzigs par zhu byas pas/ de rgyal pos kha phyes nas gzigs pas 'di ltar ro/ khyed bal po'i rgyal po la longs spyod yod/ nga bod mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po la de bzhin med de/ rgyal po khyed nor longs spyod yod pa la dga' nas bu mo ster na/ ngas sku lus kyi bkod pa lnga stong du sprul nas/ rin po che/ gser/dngul/ dar zab gos dang rgyan/ bza' btung la sogs kyi longs spyod dpag tu med pa byed cing / khyad par phyogs bzhi nas las sgo phye ste/ mtha'i nor thams cad nga'i sgo drung du 'ong zhing / longs spyod dang ldan par byed do/ /de ngo mtshar mi che'am/ de ltar byas kyang bu mo mi ster na/ sprul pa'i dmag khri phrag lnga der btang nas/ khyod bsad/ lha gcig phrogs/ grong khyer thams cad bcom la bzhag go bya ba 'dug pas/ rgyal po de'i thugs la rgyal po smra ba lan cig yin pa / de bzhin du bden srid snyam nas/ shin tu thugs ma bde bar lha gcig bod la brdzangs par dam bcas te/ zhal ngo nag par bzhugs pa dang / lha gcig na re / yab ci nyes zhus pa dang / yab rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyod bod rgyal po'i btsun mo la 'gro dgos par 'dug gsungs pas/ lha gcig na re/ yul ngan pa chos dang longs spyod med pa pha ma dang mi 'phrad pa'i sa thag ring sa der mi 'gro zer bas/ yab rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyod de skad ma zer 'gro dgos/ bod kyi rgyal po de sprul pa'i rgyal po mngon shes rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan pa zhig yod par 'dug ngas ji skad smras kyang / blon po des yul du ma phyin par yi ger lan yod gin 'dug pa khyod mi 'gro ba de shes nas/ sprul pa'i dmag khri phrag lnga 'ong ste/ nga bsad/ khyod phrogs/ yul khams grong khyer thams cad 'joms201

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()par 'dug pas 'gro dgos gsungs so/ /der lha gcig gi bsam pa la nga rang gi yul 'di bzhag nas/ bod mtha' 'khob yul ngan pa/ chos med pa/ pha ma dang mi 'phrad pa'i sa thag ring po der 'gro dgos pa/ yab kyi bka' ni bcag tu med bsams nas/ lha gcig gis mchi ma btan nas/ yab la 'di skad ces zhus so/ /kye ma yab gcig rgyal po chen po lags/ kha ba can ni mtha' 'khob kla klo'i yul/ /dam chos ma dar bod yul mun pa'i gling / /mi ni rigs ngan gdol pa sha za'i rigs/ /bkres shing dbul ba yi dwags rgyal khams 'dra/ /de 'dra'i gnas su bu mo 'gro dgos na/ /yab kyi mchod gnasadagos 'dod 'byung ba'i lha/ /mthong thos dran reg yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje bdag la zhu/ /thub pa'i rgyal tshab byams mgon rin po che/ /mtshan dpes rab brgyan phan bde 'byung ba'i gter/ /byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo bdag la zhu/ /tsas jo mo sgrol ma thugs rje can/ /'gal rkyen bar chod sel phyir bdag la zhu/ /rin chen stag sha de dang rat+na de/ /bod yul dbul ba sel phyir bdag la zhu/ /rin chen 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i longs spyod dang / /zasaskom bdud rtsi'i dpal la spyod pa'i gzhi/ /be+eḍūr+ya yi lhung bzed bdag la zhu/kha ba can ni bkres shing sgom pa'i gnas/ /rin chen bang mdzod mang po bdag la zhu/ kha ba can ni bsil zhing grang ba'i yul/ /tshe gcig dros pa'i gos kyang bdag la zhu/ /de ltar mtha' 'khob bod kyi rgyal khams der/ /bdag gi spyod lam bya ba ji ltar bya/ /yab gcig rgyal pos bdag la bka' stsol cig /cesagadung ba'i skad kyis mchi ma phyung nas zhus pas/ yab kyis thugs kyi dkyil du 202

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long zhwam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// brtse ba'i tshig phyung nas gsungs pa/ nga yi snying dang 'dra ba'i bu mo khyod/ /bod ces bya ba khyad par 'phags pa'i yul/ /ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi mgul/ /bsil la mdzebs pa lha gnas gzhal yabang khang / /ngo mtshar med byung phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /chu bo bzhi 'bab rtsi shing nags kyis mdzes/ /'bru sna lnga 'khrungs rin chen sna tshogs 'byung / /rkang bzhi kun khyab rtsi thog mar la spyod/ /rgyal po lha yin 'khor rnams byang chub sems/ /dam chos med kyang rgyal po'i bka' khrims yod/ /de 'dra'i gnas su bu mo khyod song shig /bdag gi yi dam mi bskyod rdo rje dang / /rje btsun byams pa chos kyi gcor lo 'di/ /'dzam bu gling pa tshe lo nyi khri'i dus/ /rgya gar chos rgyal kri sku'i thugs dam du/ /rin chen sna tshogs 'dus pa'i phung po la/ /sangs rgyas 'od srungs dag gis rab gnas mdzad/ /sprul pa'i lha bzos lugs su blugs pa las/ /thog mar byams pa chos kyi 'bor lo bzhongs/ /de yi rjes la mi bskyod rdo rje ni/ /ngo mtshar dpag med mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyis spras/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas dad ldan rten du bzhengs/ /mthong thos dran reg yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /sa steng 'gran zla kun dang bral ba 'di/ /ma 'ongs sems can bsod nams bsag pa'i phyir/ /lha mi'i ston pa shākya'i rgyal po de'i/ /dgung lo brgyad pa'i tshad du lung bstan mdzad/ /de yi dus su 'od kyis 'jig rten khyab/ /lha rnams kun gyis me tog char pa phab/ /de ltar yon tan ldan pa'i rten mchog 'di/ /bdag gi mig gi 'bras ltar gces na yang / /mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/ /rje btsun byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo 'di/ /'gro kun dge la bkod phyir bdag 203

ga tshe chen 'od snang la /tsho 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()gis brdzangs/ /tsan+dan jo mo sgrol ma rang byon 'di/ /'jigs pa brgyad sogasabar du gcod pa rnams/ /nye bar zhi nas dge legs rgyas pa'i phyir/ /mdzesapa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/ /rin chen stag sha de dang rat+na de/ /dbul phongs sdug bsngal sel phyir khyod la bskur/ /rin chen dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i longs spyod gter/ /be+eḍūr+ya yi lhung bzed chen po 'di/ /zas sgom bdud rtsi'i char pa 'bebs pa dang / /bkres skom sdug bsngal sel phyir khyod la bskur/ /rin chen gser dngul dar zab rgyan dang bcas/ /glang chen rnga mo drel dang bcas pa'i khal/ /gzhan yang mkho ba'i yo byad zad gos rnams/ /gang la ci 'dod bu mo khyod la bskur/ /rigs bzang yid 'ong mdzes pa'i bu mo bcu/khyod kyi skyo grogs byed pa'i 'khor du brdzangs/ /e ma 'bral bar mi phod bu mo khyod/ /gtam gyi rting ma yin no yid la chongs/ kha ba can gyi rgyal po'i pho brang der/ /blon po bod 'bangs rnams dang 'grogs pa'i dus/ khyod kyi spyod lam bya ba 'di bzhin gyis/ /gsungs te/ 'jig rten mi chos la dgos pa'i bslab bya dpag tu med pa mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal pos blon po rnams la gnang sbyin dang /dga' ston bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad do/ /jo bo dang byams mgon gnyis ni shing rta byas na lam bgrod par dka' bas/ khal gyi steng du bzhugs par 'dod pa la/ gang gis kyang ma khyog nas/ sprul pa'i mdzo mo dkar mo gnyis kyi khyog par gyur nas/ jo bo dang / byams mgon gnyis mdzo mo re'i steng du bzhugs/rin po che'i khal du ma dang bcas/ lha gcig khri btsun kyang dre'u dkar mo gcig la chibs/ mdzes ma'i bu mo bdu/ bod blon dang bcas pas bskor te bod du 204

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byurigs la ba'i me long bzhugs so// chas so/ /bal po'i blon po 'khor g.yog rnams kyis mang yul gyi grong bar du skyel thung byas so/ /brag dang chu 'thab pa'i 'phrang la khal rnams phog rin po che rnams phreng skyed byas/ lha rnams zhabs thang du byon kyang zer/ de nas drel dang /rnga mo/ glang po che sogs la khal bkal/ lha rnams rang rang gi khal la chibasanas byon te/ bod kyi yul du chags phebs so/ /der bod blon dang bod 'bangs rnams kyis rol mo du ma thogs te/ bsu ba rgya chen po byas so/ /de nas rgyal pos dga' ston gyi gdan sar byon te/ lha gcig khri btsun dang mjal ba la mthong lugs gsum du byung ste/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi snang ba la/ rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis mdzad pa ba lcaganyis kyi tshul gyisasems can gyi don byed pa'i snang ba byung ngo / /sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snang ba la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i sku sprul/ jo mo khro gnyer can bal mo bza' khri btsun du sku sprul nas/sems can gyi don byed pa'i snang ba byung ngo / /mi nag tha mal pa rnams kyi snang ba la/ rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis skyems la gsol res byed pa dang / skud pa 'khel res byed pa'i snang ba byung ngo / /de nas rgyal po dang bas mo gnyis blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pa pho brang du bzhugs pa la/ rgyal po ni yi dam lha'i drung nas phyir mi 'byon par/ mchod pa 'bul zhing smon lam 'debs so/ /der lha gcig khri btsun gyi thugs kyi dgongs pa la/ rgyal po 'di rigs gzugs dpal gyis mdzes shing / yon tan du ma dang ldan pa zhig 'dug pa la/ phyi rol du ye mi 'byon pa 'di/ mtha'i dmag la 'jig pa yin thag chod/ de la mi 205

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa pa'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()'jig pa'i thabs cig byed dgos/ rin po che be+eḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed la gsol ba btab na/ zas chang dpag tu med pa 'ong bas/ bod 'bangs rnams la byin nas las la bskul te/ mkhar las rgya chen po zhig bya dgos bsams te/ der rgyalapo la'ang zhus/ phyi nang gi blon po bka' la gtogs pa thams cad la'ang grosabyas te/ be+eḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed zas sna mang pos bkang / rin po che'i khri la bzhag nas gsol ba btab pas/ zas chang ci 'dod pa byung ba dang / bod 'bangasarnams la byin nas/ shing mo lug gi lo la mkhar las kyi ming bting / mtho dman gyi tshad la gyang skor sum cu brtsegs pas mtho zhing rgya che ste/ logs re la rgyang grag re yod pa sgo mo che lho phyogs su bstan pa/ mkhar dmar po dgu brgya/rtse mo rgyal po'i sku mkhar dang stong tham pa/ mkhar thams cad kha bad rin po che'i rgyan/ mda' yab/ pu shu/dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra 'khrol ba/ de'i bkod pa mdzes shing / legs pa'i dbang du byas na/ lha'i dbang po'i rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dang 'dra ste/ blta bas chog mi shes pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyisabargyan pa/dar sna tshogs kyi dra ba dang dra ba phyed pas brgyan te yid du 'ong ba'o//'jigs pa'i dbang du byas na/ srin po'i grong khyer laṅka pu ri dang 'dra bar mkhar thams cad kyi rtse la mtshon cha dang mdung dar dmar po bcu re 'phyar te dar yug gis sbrel ba'o/ /btsan pa'i dbang du byas na/ mtha'i dmag dpung byung yang / mi lngas bsrungs pas thub pa'o/ /gzhan yang lho phyogs kyi lcags ri la / zabs su 'dom bcu'i dong brus nas/ de'i steng du spang leb bsgrigs/ de'i steng du so phag bsgrigs pas/ de'i steng du rta gcig gis rgyugs kyang / rta bcus 206

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long zhwam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//lan du rgyugs pa lta bu'i sgra 'ong ba'o/ /lho phyogs su so phag gi mkhar la dpe blangs nas/ brag lha bkra shis kyi gzhal yas khang bya ba/ khri btsun rang gi sku mkhar dgu thog yod pa zhig brtsigs te/ mtha' gru che zhing mtho la legs pa/bkod pas mdzes pa zhig brtsigs so/ /rgyal po'i sku mkhar dang / btsun mo'i sku mkhar gnyis kyi bar lcags zam gyis sbrel te/ de'i 'og na/ dar dang / rnga yab dang / dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra 'khrol ba/ rgyal po yab yum phar gshegs tshur gshegs mdzad pa'o/ /de lta bu'i pho brang 'gran zla dang bral ba ngo mtshar che zhing mdzes pa zhig legs par tshar nas/ rje blon kun gyis dga' ston rgya chen po ༷dzad do/ /bal mo bza' khri btsun gdan drangs pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'// /ba/cu gsum pa/ rgya mo bza' kong jo gdan drangs pa'i skor/ de nas yang blon po mgar gyis/ rgyal po'i drung du phyin te/ rgya nag gi lha gcig de'ang gdan 'dren pa'i bka' gnang bar zhu zhes zhus so/ /yang rgyal pos gser gyi dong rtse bdun bskur nas/ 'di la zhu rten gyis shig gsungs so/ /rin po che'i khrab la pad+ma rā ga'i phra brgyab pa zhig bskur nas/ 'di lha gcig de'i rin du phul cig gsungs so/ /gser phye bre gang bskur nas 'di gar dgos su thong zhig gsungs so/ /rgyal po des bka' lung mi 'dra ba lan gsum btud mar gsung du 'ong gis/ de'i dus su 'di gsum re re bzhin gtod cig gsungs nas/bka' shog gi shog dril gsum bskur ro/ /'phral gyi yo byad gos dang rgyan la sogs pa/ rnga mo dang / drel la sogs pa la bkal ba'i khal mang po brdzangs 207

nga tshe chen 'od snang la /ga skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()so / / nyin mtshan dang lam 'phrang gang du'ang rje btsun ma sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs gin song zhig gsungs so/ /de nas mgar gyis rgyal pos bskur ba thams cad khyer khal rnams ded/ blon po rta pa brgya dang lhan du me pho spre'u'i lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad skar ma rgyal dang 'dzom par rgya nag tu chas so/ /der rgya nag zim shing / bkra shis khri sgo/ rgya rje tha'i dzung bzhugs pa'i pho brang gi sgo drung du slebs so/ /de na ni mi khyim 'bum tsho tsam yod pa/ logs re la nyin lam re yod pa sgo mo che bzhi yod pa/ mthong ba tsam gyis dngangs zhing 'jigasapa zhig 'dug go /der rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po'i blon po rta pa brgya tham pa/ rgya mo kong jo 'dod pa la slebs so/ /ge sar dmag gi rgyal po'i blon po rta pa brgya kong jo 'dod pa la slebs so/ /stag gzig nor gyi rgyal po'i blon po rta pa brgya yang kong jo 'dod pa la slebs so/ /bha ta hor gyi rgyal po'i blon po rta pa brgya yang kong jo 'dod pa la slebs so/ /mi rigs mi 'dra ba'i gnye bo rta pa lnga brgya rgya rje'i drang du dus gcig la slebs so/ /der rgya gar ba rnams shar sgo na yod/ge sar rā rnams lho sgo na yod/ /stag gzig pa rnams nub sgo na yod/ hor rnams byang sgo na yod/ bod blon rnams byang shar mtshams su bsdad do/ /der blon po gzhan ma rnams kyis zhu rten phul te mjal phrad byas so/ /bod blon rnams kyis mjal bar zhus pas/ skug tu bcug 'ag bdun song ba dang /rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa pho brang gi phyi rol du byon pa la/ mgar gyis gser gyi dong rtse bdun po de/ zhu rten du phul/ rin po che be+eḍūr+ya'i khrab la pad+ma rā ga'i phra brgyab pa rgyal po'i drung du bzhag ste/ mgar na re/ rgyal po chen po rin po che 208

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// be+eḍūr+ya'i khrab 'di/ yon tan du ma dang ldan te/ mi nad phyugs nad byung ba'i tshe khrab 'di gon nas grong khyer la bskor ba byas na nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur/sad dang ser ba byung ba'i tshe 'di gon nas zhing bskor na/ sad dang ser ba thub/'brug pa byed pa'i tshe 'di gon na g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /'dzam bu'i gling na khrab 'di la gong thang dpyad pas mi chod/ 'di lha gcig de'i rin du 'bul lo/ khyed kyi lha gcig mdzangs ma de/ nged bod kyi rgyal po'i btsun mo la gnang bar zhu byas pas/ rgyal po des mgar la mig 'bur tshugs su gzigs nas/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis mi 'os pa'i khrel gad chen pos bgad de/rgyal po de'i zhal nas mi srid pa'i gtam shin tu mtshar che/ nga ni rgya nag spyi bo rgyal po nas deng sang phan rgyal brgyud ma chad pa zhig yin/ khyod bod kyi rgyal pos nga'i stobs dang mnga' thang gi dod mi pher te/ 'on kyang khyed rnams thag ring nas phebs 'dug da lan phyir log la/ khyod rang gi rgyal po de la dge ba bcu dang ldan pa'i rgyal khrims 'cha' e nus dris la shog de nus na bu mo ster/mi nus na mi ster gsungs pas/ blon po mgar na re/ 'phrin re re la/ rgya bod kyi bar la phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas na/ lha gcig spyan drangs pa'i thabs med/khyed kyi gsung de'i lan du/ nged bod kyi rgyal pos 'di bskur ba lags zer nas/ shog dril dang po de rgyal po la phul bas/ rgyal pos kha phye nas gzigasapas/ mthing 3|ga la gser gyis bris pa/ rgya nag gi yi ger 'dug ste/ khyed rgya nag gi rgyal po la khrims yod/ nga bod kyi rgyal po la chos khrims med de/ rgyal po khyed dge ba bcu'i rgyal khrims yod pa la dgyes nas bu mo ster na/ ngas sku 209

nga tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()lus kyi bkod pa lnga stong du sprul nas/ dge ba bcu'i khrims nyi ma gcig la 'cha' nus pa byed do/ /de ngo mtshar mi che'am/ de ltar byas kyang bu mo mi ster na/ngas sprul pa'i dmag khri phrag lnga btang nas/ khyed bsad/ lha gcig phrogs/yul khams thams cad bcom la bzhag go zhes bya ba 'dug pas/ rgyal po de shin tu skrag par gyur te/ skrag kyang mi skrag pa ltar byas nas/ khyed bod kyi rgyal po de kha pho shin tu che bar 'dug khyed bod kyi yul na gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i nus pa'i stobs yod dam med/ de bzhin yod na bu mo ster/ med na mi ster/ da lan song la dris la shog gsungs pas/ yang mgar gyis bka' shog gi shog dril bar pa de rgyal po'i phyag tu phul nas/ 'phrin re re la bod du 'gro ba mi 'ong bas/ rgyal po khyed kyi gsung de'i lan 'di lags pas gzigs par zhu byas pa dang / rgyal pos kha phye nas gzigs pas 'di ltar ro/ khyed rgya nag gi yul na chos dar/ gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i stobs yod/ nga bod kyi rgyal po la gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i nus pa med de/ rgyal po khyed gtsug lag khang brtsig pa la dgyes nas/ lha gcig ster na/ ngas sku lus kyi bkod pa lnga stong du sprul nas/ gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs la/ sgo thams cad khyed kyi phyogs su bstan no/ /de ngo mtshar mi che'am/ de ltar byas kyang bu mo mi ster na/ngas sprul pa'i dmag khri phrag lnga btang nas/ khyed gsod/ lha gcig phrogs/yul khams thams cad bcom la bzhag gi zer ba 'dug pas/ rgyal po de shin tu sgrag par gyur to/ /der sgrag kyang mi skrag pa khad byas nas/ khyod kyi rgyal po de kha pho shin tu che bar 'dug khyod kyi yul na 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod pa 210

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// yod dam med/ de yod na bu mo ster/ med na mi ster/ da lan song la dris la shog zer bas/ yang mgar gyis shog dril tha ma de rgyal po'i phyag tu phul nas/'phrin re la rgya bod bar la 'gro mi 'ong / rgyal po khyed kyi gsung de'i lan 'di lags pas gzigs par 2 kyi zhes zhu/sa pas/ der rgyal 21sa kha phyes nas gzigs pas 'di ltar ro/ khyed rgya nag gi rgyal po nor longs spyod yod/ nga bod kyi rgyal po la longs spyod de bzhin med de/ rgyal po khyed nor longs spyod yod pa la dgyes nas bu mo ster na/ ngas sku lus kyi bkod pa lnga stong du sprul nas/ gser dngul gyi longs spyod/ 'bru dang / dar zab dang / gos dang / rgyan dang / zas kyi longs spyod rnams lha'i longs spyod la 'gran nus pa tsam byed la/gzhan yang phyogs bzhi nas las sgo re phyes nas/ khyed mtha'i nor rdzas thams cad kyang dbang med du nga'i sgo drung du 'du zhing / longs spyod dang ldan par byed do / / de ngo mtshar mi che'am/ de ltar byas kyang lha gcig mi ster na/ ngas sprul pa'i dmag khri phrag lnga btang nas/ khyod gsod/ lha sa khrig phrogs/ yu 'as khamasathams cad bcom la bzhag gi bya ba 'dug pas/ rgyal po de sngar bas kyang skrag par gyur te/ rgyal po de'i thugs la nga'i bu mo 'di 'dod mkhan mang yang /phugs su bod kyi rgyal po 'di la ster dgos pa 'dra bsam zhing / thugs ma bde bar pho brang du byon no/ /de nas yab rgyal po dang / yum gas mo dang / srasargyal bu dang / lha gcig rnams gros byas pas/ yab na re/ chos rgya gar nasabyung ba yin/ khong drin che bas rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po la ster gsungs so/ /yum ser sna che bas stag gzig nor gyi rgyal po la ster zer ro/ /rgyal bu lus rtsal 211

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()bzang ba la dga' bas/ hor la ster zer ro/ /lha gcig rang skye gzugasalegs pa la dga' bas/ mi tshe hril por 'grogs pa'i rten grogs gal che zer nas/ ge sar dmag gi rgyal po la mos pa byung ngo / /der bod la dga' ba gcig kyang ma byung ngo / /der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyed gnye bo rnams la nye ring med/ rig pa gang rno ba zhig la ster bas/ rig pa 'gran zer ro/ /rgyal po de'i bla g.yu bzhag sgor mo bya ba/ che chung ni phub chung tshad tsam pa/ bkrag che ba/mig gcig mtha' na yod pa/ mig gcig dkyil na yod pa/ nang gi mig kyang phug gi spa rim lta bur yod pa de dang / dar yug gcig blon po tshan lnga po la gtad nas/ g.yu 'di'i mig tu dar yug 'di sus tshud pa la/ lha gcig ster zer ro/ /der blon po gzhan rnams dbang che bas/ sngon la khong tshos g.yu khyer te / thabs sna tshogs byas nas/ nyi ma mang po lag 'grim gyis brgyus pas/sus kyang ma tshud nas/ blon po mgar la gtad de/ nged rnams kyis nu ji ltar byas kyang ma tshud/ khyed rang e tshud ltos shig zer nas/ g.yu dar yug dang bcas pa gtad do/ /der mgar rig pa can des/ sngar nas rgya'i grog ma gcig zan dang 'o mas gsos te/ mtheb mo tsam du song ba dang / de'i sked pa la dar skud btags te/ dar yug gi spyi bo bsdus nas btsam ste/ grog ma de g.yu mig tu btsud do/ /dar g.yu de lag tu blangs nas phu btab pas/ rlung gis ded nas/ mtha'i mig tu thon byung ngo / /de nas grog ma'i rked pa nas dar skud dkrol te/ nur gyis 'then pas/ g.yu mig tu dar yug tshud do/ /nged kyisa'adi bzhin byung yod pas/ lha gcig zhu byas pas/ da rung rig pa 'gran no zer 212

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ba pa chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// nas/ bod la brnyas pa byas ma byin no/ /yang de'i sang lug lnga brgya gtad nas/'di rnams sang gi nyi ma la bsad zin pa/ bshas zin pa/ sha zos zin pa/pags pa mnyes zin pa la lha gcig ster zer ro/ /der bod blon rnams kyis mi res lug re bsad/ so sor bshas/ sha logs shig tu spungs/ pags pa logs shig tu spungs te/ sha snang mo tsam re tshwa la bsgres shing sgrin la skyur te/zar bcug pas/ zos zin to/ /pags pa rnams gral mgo nas phur ba re byasabatang bas/ gral gzhug tu snum byug ran par byung / yang 'og ma des snum byug ste phur ba re byas pas gral mgor thul lo/ /gzhan ma rnams la bltas pasagang yang ma zin par 'dug go /nged kyi 'di bzhin byung yod/ gzhan gyis ma byung bar 'dug pa/ lha gcig zhu'o byas pas/ da rung rig pa 'gran zer nas ma byin no/ /yang chang ben brgya gtad nas/ 'di rnams sang gi nyi ma phyed tshun la 'thung zin pa/ ma bor ba/ ma bzi ba su byung ba la lha gcig ster zer ro/ /yang mgar gyis bod blon rnams la snod chung chung re btsug nyung re drangs te/ thog mar hub re 'thung cig byas pas/ 'thung zin pa/ ma bo ba/ ma bzi ba byung nas/gzhan rnams la bltas pas/ phor pa chen po chang gis bkang ste/ 'thung ma zin dogs nas khrog rgyab pas/ bzi zhing skyugs te bo 'dug go /yang nged kyis 'di bzhin byung yod/ gzhan gyis ma byung bar 'dug pas/ lha gcig zhu'o byas pas/da rung rig pa 'gran zer nas/ bod la brnyas pa byas ma byin no/ /yang rta ma brgya/ bu brgya gtad nas/ 'di tsho ma bu phyogs gcig tu ngo shes pa la lha gcig ster zer ro/ /yang gzhan gyis ma shes/ mgar gyis rta ma bu rnams phyogs213

ba chen 'od snang la /sa sbya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()gcig tu bzung nas zhag gcig tu rtswa byin cing chu ma byin no/ /de'i sang rte'u rnams kyi khrod du btang bas/ rang rang gi ma gang 'dug rtsa nas 'o ma 'thungasaso / / der ngo shes/ nged kyis ngo shes/ gzhan rnams kyis ma shes pas/ lha gcig zhu'o byas pas/ da rung rig pa 'gran zer nas ma byin no/ /yang de'i sang bya mo brgya bu brgya gtad nas/ 'di rnams ma bu phyogs gcig tu sus ngo shesagal lha gcig ster zer ro/ /yang gzhan gyis ma shes/ mgar gyis thang yangasacig la/ sbang ma gtor nas bzhag ste/ der bya rnams kha gtad do/ /de gnyisaganyis lhan du zos so/ /skye'i 'og nas za zhing spyod pa 'tshub pa 'di rnams bu yin/ de min rnams ma yin no byas pas ngo shes/ nged kyis ngo shes/ gzhan gyis ma shes pas/ lha gcig zhu zho byas pas/ da rung rig pa 'gran zer nasayobyin no/ /yang gsam gyi shing sdum po brgyad gtad nas/ 'di rnams kyi mgo mjug sus shes pa la ster zer ro/ /yang gzhan gyis ma shes so/ /mgar gyis shing de rnams chu 'gram du khyer nas chu la bskyur bas/ rtsa ba ldi bas thur du song / rtse mo yang bas gyen du lus so/ /nged kyis ngo shes/ gzhan gyis ma shesapas/ lha gcig zhu byas pas/ da rung rig pa 'gran zer nas ma byin no/ /der dgong cig pho brang nas rnga bo che brdung ba dang / blon po gzhan rnams pho brang du song / bod blon rnams kyi gnas mo de na re/ blon po gzhan rnams pho brang du song / khyed cag tsho yang mi 'gro'am/ phyin pa legs so zer bas/ mgar na re/nged la shog kyang mi zer/ rnga de ci yin cha med byas pas gnas mo na re/ blon po gzhan rnams song ba na/ khyed la shog mi zer kyang / 'gro ba yin mod zer ro/ /214

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//der blon pos rnga de la skyon can du go nas blon po rnams khrid/ sgo re re bzhin 'dren gin/ sgo la rams dang tshos kyi khu bas mtshan ma 'debs na pho brang du phyin no/ /pho brang na blon po gzhan rnams 'tshogs 'dug go /der rgyal pos/ do dgong blon po thams cad la ston mo zhig byas nas/ srod kyi mun nag la/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyed rang blon po thams cad phyir song la/ rang rang gi khang pa rnyed pa gyis shig de sus rnyed pa la bu mo ster gsungs so/ /der mgar gyis pho brang nas mar me g.yar te/ sgo re re bzhin 'den gin/ sngar gyi mtshan ma rnamasabaltas phyin pas/ rang gi khang pa rnyed do/ /sang nam langs pa dang / blon po gzhan rnams bltar phyin pas/ la la gzhan gyi khyim du tshud/ la las sgo ma rnyed nas rgya srang na nyal 'dug go /yang mgar gyis nged kyi khang pa rnyed/ gzhan rnams kyis mi rnyed par 'dug lha gcig zhu'o byas pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas da ni zhag gsum gyi nyin shar sgo'i thang la/ bu mo mtshar sdug dang ldan pa sum brgya rgyan gyis brgyan nas gral byed/ de'i khrod du lha gcig 'jog pas/ de ngo susashes pa la bskur ba yin gsungs so/ /de nas mgar gyis gnas mo de dang lus 'brel shing mthun par byas/ zas chang gis mgo bskor te dga' ba'i gtam smras nas/ nged blon po rnams kyis rgya nag tu sleb nas lo gcig 'gro/rig pa de nged rno/ lha gcig 'di nged kyis thob pa la brnyas pa byas ma byin/ lha gcig 'phrul gyi kong jo 'di ma mthong ba la sgra che ba g.yu 'brug sngon mo dang 'dra ba zhig 'dug lha gcig de dang khyod gnyis shin tu mthun par yod 'dug pas/khyod kyis ci 'dra zhig legs par ston dgos/da ni shin tu gal che bar yod do//215

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()da ni zhag gsum gyi nyin kong jo bu mo sum brgya'i dkyil du gral bsgrigs nas/shar sgo'i thang la 'jog pas sur thob pa la ster ba yin gsungs te/ blon po gzhan rnams dbang che bas sngon la kho tsho 'dom du 'ong / khong tsho gang rung gisango shes nas khyer las che/ nged kyi thob par dka'/ gal te khong tshos ngo ma shesapar 'dug nas/ nged kyis ngo shes na'ang / brnyas pa byas mi bskur las che/gzhan yang las kyi dbang gis thob kyang / ci 'dra zhig yod ma shes pas/ khyod kyis legs par ston dgos/ ngas khyod rang gi khyo byas la 'dir sdod/ lha gcig blon po gzhan ma rnams la bskur bas chog byas nas/ gser phye bre gang po de brngan pa la byin no/ /der gnas mo na re/ khyed bod blon rnams bden/rgyal pos nye ring che/ rgyal po gcig po min te/ khyed bod la dga' ba mi gcig kyang mi 'dug bod yi dwags kyi rgyal khams yin zer gyin 'dug lha gciga'adi blon po gzhan rnams kyis thob tu re 'dug cing / khong tsho rig pa lan cig rno yang ster bar 'dug lha gcig 'phrul gyi kong jo 'di/ nga'i dpon mo yin pas rgyusang che ste/ rgya nag rtsis la mkhas pas/ rtsis kyis ngo shes na/ nga gsod 'ong bas/ ngas 'chad mi nus zer ro/ /der mgar na re/ rtsis kyis ngo mi shesapa'i thabs nga la yod zer nas/ khyim gyi nang du sgo bsdams te/ snyed po chen po gsum btsugs/ de'i steng du zangs chen po chus bkang ba gcig bzhag chu de'i steng du bya sna tshogs kyi spu gtor/ phub dmar po zhig gis kha bcad/ de'i steng du gnas mo bzhag gnas mo'i mgo la rdza ma g.yogs/ dzo ma'i mgo la dra bsagayogs/ dzom la bug pa phug bug pa dang dra mig gi nang du zangs dung bcug 216

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long zhwam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//nas/ 'di nas tshur bshad pa'i rtsis kyis zin kyang yid ches mi 'byung bas/khyod kyis legs par shod cig byas so/ /der gnas mo na re/ blon po chen po legs par yid la zungs shig lha gcig 'phrul gyi kong jo de/ bu mo g.yin pas che rgyu med/ /skye gzugs gzhan pas legs rgyu med/ /rgyan gos gzhan pas bzang rgyu med/ /de la mo yi khyad chos ni/ /sku mdog sngo la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa zhig yod/ zhal nas ut+pal sngon po'i dri bro ba/ lus dri zhim pas g.yu'i sbrang ma gcig 'khor gin yod/ mkhur tshos g.yas pa'i steng na cho lo ris/ g.yon pa'i steng na pad+ma ris/ dpral ba'i dkyil na si ra'i thig le'i steng na/ ār+ya tā ra nas tsam zhig yod/ so la so zho yod/ yog ma la og zho yod/ lha gcig kong jo de/ bu mo sum brgya bsgrigs pa'i tha mar yang mi 'ong /dkyil du yang mi 'ong / g.yon gral nas bsgrigs pa'i drug gi gong du 'ong / lha gcig de lus dang gos la gya bsrung ste/ lus dang gos la reg sa med pas/mda' gsar pa zhig la dar leb rgan kha gang thogs la/ lha gcig gi rtsar sleb pa dang / mos dar gos sham bu lnga brtsegs steng na dri ma lcam me ba zhig gon yod pas/ de'i gong ba nas mda'i stong gis bzung la 'then cig zer ro/ /der mgar gyis/ chas de rnams bshig lus sems dga' bdes khyab par gyur nas/ nged bod blon rnams sngon chad kyang mgo thon/ da rung mgo thon pa zhig dgos so/ /nged tshos rgya nag tu tshong la 'ongs pa yang min no/ /bshes gnyen skyong du 'ong ba yang min no/ /lha gcig 'di spyan drongs na/ nged rnams mgo thon pa yin pas/ brtag pa legs po byed dgos so/ /da ni zhag gsum gyi nyin bu 217

ba chen 'od snang la /skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()mo sum brgya'i dkyil nas/ sus ngo shes pa la ster bar thag chod 'dug pas/spyang glen ma nor ba zhig byed dgos zer ro/ /de nas zhag gsum gyi nyin par bu mo rgyan gyis brgyan pa sum brgya shar sgo'i thang la bsgrigs so/ /rgya nag gi mi thams cad ltad mo la 'tshogs/ der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ blon po rnams sngar gyi go rim bzhin bdoms shig gsung ngo / /der rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po'i blon po rnams byung ste/ gral gyi dkyil nas bu mo chas bzang zhing mdzes pa gnyis khrid nas gcig min kyang gcig yin te 'ong zer nas/ 'u sgra dang bso sgra 'debasakyin song ngo / /de'i rjes la stag gzig nor gyi rgyal po'i blon po rnams byung ste/bu mo mdzes ma gnyis khrid nas sngar ltar byas nas song ngo / /de'i rjes la ge sar dmag gi rgyal po'i blon po rnams byung ste/ bu mo mdzes ma gnyis khrid nas/snga ma ltar byas nas song ngo / /de'i rjes la bha ta hor gyi rgyal po'i blon po rnams byung ste/ bu mo mdzes ma gnyis khrid nas snga ma ltar byas nas song ngo / /der blon po mgar gyis bltas pas/ de rnams thams cad min par shes te/ rab tu dga' nas 'dzum mul gyis shor ro/ /der mgar gyis mda' de lag tu khyer/bod blon rnams khrid de/ g.yon gral du gtad phyin nas/ gral gyi mtha' ma'i bu mo de la/ mgar na re/ 'di ni bshan pa'i bu mo 'dra/ /lag pa 'di yi dmar lugs sam/ /de yi gong na 'dug pa de/ /dzomakhan zhig gi bu mo 'dra/ /lag pa'i ser kha mang lugs sam/ /de yi gong na 'dug pa de/ stonang mkhan zhig gi bu mo 'dra/ /gos log 'di yi skya lugs sam/ /de yi gong na 'dug pa de/ khrab mkhan zhig gi bu mo 'dra/ /steng gos 'di yi snum lugs sam/ /de yi gong na 218

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long tham chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//'dug pa de/ /phyis mkhan zhig gi bu mo 'dra/ /'breng bu 'di yi mang lugs sam/ /de yi gong na 'dug pa de/ /mgar ba zhig gi bu mo 'dra/ /gos kyi thu ba'i nag lugs sam/ /de yi gong na 'dug pa de/ /dar 'thag bu mo yin pa 'dra/ /dar zab lus la gon lugs sam/ /de yi gong na 'dug pa de/ /lha gcig kong jo yin pa 'dra/ /sku mdog sngo la dmar mdangs chags/ /zhal nas udzi la sngon po mnam/ /dri zhim g.yu yi sbrang ma 'khor/ /mkhur tshos cho lo pad+ma ris/ /dpral ba rje btsun sgrol mas mtshan/ /so tshags dam zhing so zho can/ /'phrul chen bu mo gzhan bas mdzes/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i yon tan brjod nas/ lha gcig gi gos kyi gong ba nas/ mda'i stong gis bzung nas 'then pas/ lha gcig ngu zhing blon po'i phyir 'brangs so/ /der lha gcig bzhum pa la/ blon po mgar gyis spro ba bskyed pa'i glu blangs te/ thon mi sa stoṭa dang / 'bri se ru gong ston gnyis kyis ram bu bteg nas 'di skad do/ /e ma ngo mtshar che lha gcig kong jo khyed/ /bdag gi tshig la gson/ /bkra shis nyams su dga'/ /bod kyi rgyal khams na/ /rin chen lnga las grub/ /rgyal po'i pho brang na/ /mi rje lha yis mdzad/ /srong btsan sgam po de/ /rigs gzugs dpal gyis brjed/ /mthong na sems yid 'phrog /thugs rje chen po lags/ /rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs/ /'bangs rnams bka' la nyan/ /rgyal blon 'khor 'bangs rnams/ /dga' skyid glu ru len/ /chos kyi nyi ma shar/ /dpa' gyi sgron me bteg /ri la shing sna tshang / /sa gzhi yangs pa la/ /'bru sna lnga yi tshogs/ /go mtshams med par skyes/ /gser dngul zangs lcags sogs/ /rin chen du ma yod/ /gnag 219

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()rta lug gsum rgyas/ /dga' skyid de ltar yod/ /e ma ngo mtshar che/ /lha gcig kong jo gson/ /zhes glu blangs pas/ lha gcig gi bsam pa la/ de ltar bden na nga rang gi yul dang 'dra bar 'dug bsams nas/ mchi ma phyis te/ blon po'i phyir 'brangs so/ /blon pos rta la bskyon te/ khrom bskor nas/ rgya hor gnyisalas lhag pa nged bod yin/ lha gcig nged kyis spyan 'dren pa yin pas/ thamasacad khar mdzub mo chug la sdod byas so/ /der rgya nag gi mi rnams kyis smre sngags bton te/ nged kyi lha gcig mdzangs ma de/ bod 3 pas khyer zer ro/ /der rgyal po'i zhal nas blon po gzhan rnams la'ang / khyed rnams kyang nged rgya nag pa'i gnyen zla yin pas/ khyed rang tshos 'doms pa'i bu mo rnams khrid la/so so'i yul la song shig gsung ngo / /der blon po mgar gyis lha gcig la/ da ni bod du 'gro thabs gyis shig byas nas btang ngo / /der lha gcig gis pho brang du phyin pas/ yab rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyod bod kyi rgyal po'i btsun mor 'gro dgos gsungs pas/ lha gcig na re/ chos med pa/ yul ngan pa/ pha ming dang mi 'phrad pa'i sa thag ring ba der nga mi 'gro zer/ yab kyi zhal nas/ khyod de skad ma zer 'gro dgos/ bod kyi rgyal po de mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu stobasadang ldan pa gcig yod par 'dug ngas ji skad smras kyang / kho bod yul du ma phyin par/ lan yi ge'i nang du 'ong gin 'dug khyod mi 'gro ba khong gis shes nas/ dmag khri phrag lnga tsam 'dir byung nas/ nga bsad/ khyod khyer/ yul mkhar thams cad bcom na ji tshug byed/ blon po de'i byed lugs la ltos dang / de bas phyin pa legasang so gsungs pas/ der lha gcig gisang yab la phyag 'tshal te 220

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long pa ma chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// gsol ba/ yab gcig rgyal pos bka' gnang ngam/ /a ma yum gyis gnang lags sam/ /jo jo ming pos tshig shor ram/ /e ma mi srid ngo mtshar che bod kyi yul der bdag gtong na/ kha ba can gyi yul phyogs der/ /bsil zhing grang la sa rong rtsub/ /lha klu 'dre srin gdug pa mang / /gangs ri gcan gzan mche ba 'dra/ /brag ri 'brong gi rwa dang 'dra/ /nyams mi dga' zhing blo mi bde/ /'bru sna mi gcings mu ge'i gnas/ /gdol pa sha zan srin po'i rigs/ /spyod pa rtsing ba kla klo'i mi/ /mtha' 'khob sangs rgyas zhabs ma bcags/ /chos med ma rig mun pa'i gling / /mchod pa'i rten dang gnas med cing / /bsod nams bsog pa'i rten med pas/ /de 'dra'i yul du 'gro dgos na/ /yab kyi mchod gnas yi dam lha/ shwakya mu yi bdag la zhu/ kha ba can ni bkres pa'i yul/ /rin chen bang mdzod bdag la zhu/ kha ba can ni bsil la grang / /tshe gcig dros pa'i gos cig zhu/ /bod ni gdol ba gtsang btsog med/ /g.yog mo'i skyo grogs bdag la zhu / / de ltar mtha' 'khob yul phyogs der//bod kyi mi dang 'grogs pa'i dus//bdag gis spyod lam ji ltar bya/ /zhes mchi ma phyis nas zhus(pas/ yab kyisathugs brtse ba'i bka' gnang ba/ nga yi mig dang 'dra ba'i bu mo khyod/ /bod ces bya ba kha ba can gyi yul/ /yul las khyad par 'phags pa de yin te/ /gangs ri rang bzhin mchod rten grub pa'i gnas/ /mtsho bzhi g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal bkram pa 'dra/ /ya mtshan gser gyi me tog rgyas pa'i gling / /bsil la mdzes pa lha gnas gzhal yas khang / /chu bo bzhi 'bab shing rtsi nags kyis mdzes/ /'bru sna lnga 'brungs rin chen sna tshogs 'byung / /rkang bzhis kun khyab rtsi thog 221

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()mar la spyod/ /de ltar ngo mtshar che ba'i gnas mchog der/ /rin chen rgyan gyisamadzes pa'i pho brang na/ /mi rje lha yis mdzad pa'i rgyal po de/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po dngos su 'dug /thabs mkhas thugs rje ldan pa'i rgyal po yin/ /mi dge bcu spangs dge bcu'i khrims la gnas/ /mnga' thang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu'i dpal la spyod/ /yon tan mtha' yas rgyal po lha yi sras/ /dpa' mdzangs kun 'dzom 'khor rnams byang chub sems/ /de 'dra'i gnas su bu mo khyod song shig /mdzes ma khyod kyi bsod nams bsags pa'i rten/ /bdag gi mchod gnas ston pa'i sku gzugs 'di/ /yon bdag lha dbang brgya byin khong gis mdzad/ /rgyu ni rin chen rnam pa bcu las grub/ /'di yi bzo bo bi shwa dmes mdzad/ /rab gnas sangs rgyas nyid kyis mdzad pa lags/ /de ltar 'gran med rgyal ba'i sku gzugs 'di/ /mthong thos dran reg gsol ba btab gyur pas/ /sangs rgyas myur du thob par rgyal bas gsungs/ /de ltar phan bde 'byung ba'i jo bo 'di/ /bdag gi snying dang 'dra bar phangs na yang / /mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis badzongs//rin chen bang mdzod mang po nor gyi gter//bdag la gces pa'i rin chen mang po yang / /mdzes ma'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/ /gser g.yu brtsegs pa'i yig tshang chen mo dang / /gtsug lag yi ge sum brgya drug cu dang / /gser g.yu rgyan gyi rnam pa mang po yang mdzesapa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs//g.yos sna zas kyi rnam pa mang po dang //btung ba skom gyi sbyor thabs mang po dang / /gser sga g.yu yi ka leb can la sogs/ /mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/ /za 'og stan thul seng 222

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// ge bya brgyad ma/ /ljon shing cho lo nor bu ris su bris/ /rgyal po ngo mtshar skye phyir khyod la brdzangs/ /rgya yi gab tse gtsug lag sum brgya po/ /legs nyes ston pa'i las kyi me long yang / /mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/ /bkod pa rig byed mdzes par byed pa yi/ /yid 'ong rgyan gyi khyad par 'phags pa dang / /bzo'i rig byed drug cu tham pa yang / /mdzes pa'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams 'joms pa'i sman/ /brtag thabs brgya dang dpyad lnga spyad drug dang / /spyor sde bzhi la sogs pa bdag gis bskur/ /tshe gcig dros pa'i dar gos za 'og sogs/ kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa'i rgyan gos kyang / /stong phrag nyi shu bu mo khyod la brdzangs/ /rigs gzugs lta na sdug cing mdzes pa yin/ /sems mthun skyo grogs byed pa'i bu mo yang / /nyi shu rtsa lnga khyod kyi 'khor du brdzangs/ /e ma 'bral bar mi phod bu mo khyod/ /brtse ba'i snying gtam yin pas sems la shog kha ba can gyi mi rnams 'dul don du/ khyod kyis bya ba spyod lam 'di bzhin gyis/ /lta ba yangasashing spyod lam zhib bar mdzod/ /phyi nang bya ba kun la mkhas par mdzod/ /ngag 'jam smra mkhas gzhi ma legs par mdzod/ /rje la gus shing 'khor la byams par mdzod/ khrel yod ngo tsha bag dang ldan par mdzod/ /ces pa la sogs pa'i 'jig rten mi chos la dgos pa'i bslab bya dpag tu med pa mdzad do/ /yab kyis phyag nas 'jus shing 'bral mi phod pa ltar yod na yang / bod du 'gro dgos par dgongs te/ lha gcig la rdzong bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad do/ /de nas lha gcig g.yog mo de dang 'grogs te/ blon po mgar gyi rtsar byung nas/223

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i cho 'byung gce bsdus/ ()blon po chen po khyed kyi yul du jo bo shākya yang gdan 'dren/ nor dpag tu med pa'ang khyer nas khyed kyi yul du 'gro/ khyed kyi yul na sa kham pa yod dam/ rdo srin zan yod dam/ shing rtseb yod dam/ rtsa dred ma yod dam/ nyung ma yod dam/zer ba la/ mgar na re/ gzhan rnams yod/ nyung ma med byas nas/ la nyung gi sa bon khyer/ de nas shing rta'i 'khor lo byas/ de'i steng du jo bo shākya bzhugs/'khor lo de rgya nag na stobs che ba'i rgyad lha dga' dang / klu dga' gnyis la 'dren du bsan go /gzhan yang rin po che dang / dar dang gos dang / rgyan dang /'phral gyi yo byad rnams bkal ba'i rta dang / dre'u rnga mo la sogs pa mang po brdzangs so/ /bod blon rnams la'ang ston mo gnang sbyin dpag tu med pa mdzad do / / der lha gcig kong jo yang rin po che'i rgyan mang pos brgyan nas/ mdzesapa'i bu mo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i 'khor dang bcas pa rang rang gi rta la chibs nas/ yab yum blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pas skyel thung byas/ yab yum gnyis kyi thugs la 'phreng bzhin du/ 'jig rten mi chos la phan pa'i bslab bya gal che ba dpag tu med pa mdzad nas bod du chas so/ /der skyel thung la byon pa'i gral la/ blon po 'bri se ru gong ston zer ba des/ blon po mgar la phrag dog byas nas/'dir lha gcig gi tshab tu/ blon po rig pa can cig bsdad na/ rgya bod gnyis mthun 'ong zer nas/ blon po mgar la mig cer te bltas pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas nga'i lha gcig mdzangs ma de/ khyed bod kyis thob pas nga la mi tshab tu mgar sdod dgos gsungs so/ /der blon po mgar gyis kyang / se ru gong ston gyis phrag dog byas par go nas/ rgya bod gnyis mthun pa ngas byed do zer nas224

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long tham chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs po// sdod par byas so/ /der mgar gyis thon mi dang nyang gnyis zur du khrid nas/ nga rgya nag tu zla ba lnga las mi sdod/ de'i bar ngan 'byol tshad skyel/ khyed rnamasakyis rdzus ma'i sprang po cig nga'i rtsar thong byas so/ /der blon po thams cad jo bo dang lha gcig la bskor te bod du song ngo / /der rgya nag tu mgar gcig pur lus te/ rgyal pos mgar la bud med cig blangs/ gzhi ma rab cig phog nasabazhag go /de nas mgar yang shin tu skyo zhing / blo ma bde bar gyur nas bud med de'i rtsar ma phyin/ lto yang ma zos te/ lus sngo la rid par byas/ mal 'og tu ko ba rul pa bzhag nas/ lus la dri mi zhim pa yod pa byas/ 'gram pa g.yas su mtshal bcug g.yon du rams bcug nas/ mal gyi phyi rol rnag khrag gi lud pas bkang ste bzhag go /der chung ma rgya mo de na re/ blon po chen po khyed kyi lus la dri mi zhim pa yang snom gyin 'dug mdog kyang sngo bar 'dug pa ci nyes zer ro/ /blon po na re/ nga la tshad pa'i nad byung ba khyod kyis ma tshor ram zer bas/ der mos rgyal po la zhus pas/ rgyal po yang thugs ma bde bar/blon po'i rtsar byon te/ blon po chen po ci byung gsungs pas/ blon po na re/bdag tshad pa'i nad kyis thebs gda' lags zer nas lud pa cig bskur bas rnag khrag gi mdog tu 'dug lus kyi dri mi zhim pa yang tshor te/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ sang sman pa mkhas pa zhig yod pa khrid la 'ong gis gsungs nas bzhud do / / der chung ma rgya mo de la/ blon po na re/ khyod bud med grib che/ sang sman pa byung tsa na/ nga'i rtsa mi rtogs pas/ khyed rang khyim mtshes gyi gan du nyol bar song zhig byas nas gtong ngo / /de'i shul du/ blon pos phag gi khri mthon po cig 225

ba 'a 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos ching tsos bsdus/ ()brtsigs nas/ gdung ma la thi gu btags/ pho mtshan thi gus bcings te/ spyi bo sa la btsugs nas rtsa thams cad 'khrug tu bcug go /de'i sang rgyal pos sman pa khrid byung ste/ sman pa mkhas pa des rtsa bltas pas/ sman pa na re/ lus kyi rtsathams cad 'khrugs par gyur pas na brtag par dka' ste/ rlung las gyur pa yang ma yin/ mkhris pa las gyur pa yang ma yin/ bad rkan kyang ma yin/ 'dus pa'ang min te/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco brgyad kyi nad kyang ma yin/ bgegasarigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i nad kyang ma yin te/ 'byung po'i gdon gyi nad kyang ma yin/ sems ma bde ba snying gi dkyil du phog pa'i gcong cig 'dra te/ sman dpyad rim gro gang gis kyang phan par dka' zer ro/ /der rgyal po'i zhal nas/sman pa de la sang gnang lan re shog la ltos shig gsungs so/ /yang sang sman pa byung dus/ blon pos mchan du zhim bu bcug de'i lag pa la thi gu btags/thig sna la rtsa bltar bcug pas/ gcan gzan tha ma zhig gi rtsa las mi 'dug zer te song ngo / /yang blon pos/ de'i sang bya pho cig mas du sag nas/ de'i lag pa la thi gu btags/ thig sna la rtsa bltar bcug pas/ 'dab chags tha ma zhig gi rtsa las mi 'dug zer ro/ /de nas rgyal po yang thugs shin tu ma bde bar/ blon po chen po khyed rang rig pa can yin pas thabs e yod/ de'i thabasagang 'grub byed gsungs pas/ blon po'i bsam pa la/ da ni glags rnyed par 'dug bsams nas/ rgyal po chen po nga'i nad 'di khyed kyis nga bzung bas/bod kyi lha srungs ma dga' ba yin/ nga bod kyi ri mthong ba'i ri mtho ba zhig gi khar phyin nas lha gsol na phan/ de'i rdzas la/ dar zab bsregs pa'i thal ba 226

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// rkyal pa gang / lug bsad pa'i mcher pa'i khrag grod pa gang / sol ba'i mdung shing gas chag med pa 'dom gsum/ rta mog ro mgo dmar ba zhig rnams dgos/ de rnams ni rnyed par dka' ste mi 'dzom/ rgyal po yang gsan par dka'/ lar deng nga 'chi las che/ shi bas mi chog par nga'i rjes su ltasang na pa bco brgyad 'ong / rgya bod gnyis 'brel chad/ bod kyi rgyal po la mngon shes yod pasang shi ba mkhyen nas/ dmag btang nas/ rgya yul thams cad phung bar 'ong / sa thag ring sa 'dir sleb/ grogs blon po rnams kyis bskyur/ lus la nad kyis thebs/ nga rang gi rgyal po dang / nye du mdza' bshes rnams yid la dran kyang bya thabs med par song / rang gi nor rdzas bza' btung longs spyod kyisaphan par dka' ste/ tshe 'di yang rmi lam lta bur 'dug go zer nas/ mgo hril gyis gtum nas nyal song ngo / /der rgyal po yang shin tu skrag par gyur nas/khyed la phan pa'i thabs gang 'grub byed/lhod de nyol cig gsung nas bzhud do//der rgyal pos nags thams cad la me brgyab pas/ sol ba'i mdung shing kyang ma byung / dar zab thams sa cad bsregs pas/ thal ba rkyal pa phyed kyang ma byung /lug thams cad bsad pas mcher khrag phor pa phyed kyang ma byung / rta mog ro mgo dmar de rnyed do/ /der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ rdzas gzhan rnams ni ma rnyed/rta mog ro mgo dmar de rnyed yod do gsungs pas/ blon po na re/ rdzas gzhan rnams ma rnyed na thabs zad/ rta mog ro mgo dmar la nga'i ro rta gyis la nga bskyon/ rgya yul na bzang ba'i rta zhig la nga'i ro zas dang / ro gos bkal nas bod kyi ri mthong ba'i sar lha gsol du 'gro'o zer ro/ /der lha gsol bar 227

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()'gro ba'i grabs byed gin yod tsa na/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ blon po chen po nam zla dpyid gar song / so nam byed ran pas ji ltar byas na legs/ khyod rig pa can yin pas ston cig gsungs so/ /der blon po na re/ nga'i bod yul na tshobon thams cad sla nga'i nang du ser tsam brngos nas btab pas/ lo tshan che ba/gzugs ring ba/ zla ba gsum song dus smin 'ong zer bas/ der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ bod kyi lugs su gyis shig gsungs nas/ khrims kyi rnga bo che brdungs te/thams cad kyis nas brngos nas yos zhing la btab bo/ /der blon pos rang gi lus gud pa de sos/ lha gsol bar 'gro ba'i grabs byed gin yod dus/ bod blon rnams kyis rdzus ma'i sprang po gcig btang byung ngo / /der blon pos log pa'i skad byas te/ thag ring gi ra pho rgya bo la ngo shes mi bya'o/ kha rog sdod la ku co thong / /nag mo lcags mkhar thug nas yod/ /lung pa phu brdug mda' brdugs su/ /thu ru co brags khong la zhog /dar dkar dril la dar nag bskyod//zla bas nyi ma'i rtsa ru sleb/ /zer nas/ der sprang po de log go /sprang po desakhong rnams la bshad pas ma go bar/ rgya mo kong jos go nas 'di skad zer te/blon po des rgya nag tu ban chen po byas yod par 'dug thag ring gi ra pho rgya bo la ngo shes ma byed zer ba de/ khong rang rgyal po sma ra can la lab ma shod bya ba yin/ da len kha rog sdod la/ bod blon rnams la shod bya ba yin/ nag mo lcags mkhar thugs nas yod zer ba de/ sa bon yos su brngos nas 'debasabacug bya ba yin/ lung pa phu brdugs mda' brdugs su/ thu ru co brags khong la zhog bya ba de/ dong par mda' mang po chug bya ba yin/ dar dkar dril la dar 228

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long sbramachos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//nag bskyod bya ba de/ nyin mo bsdad gin mtshan mo 'ong zer ba yin/ zla bas nyi ma'i rtsar sleb zer ba de/ ngas khyed rnams kyi rtsar mgyogs par sleb bya ba yin zer ro/ /der blon po mgar bod kyi ri mgo mthong ba'i sar lha gsol du 'gro ba'i chas la rta mog ro mgo dmar la zhon/ rta gzhan zhig la rgyags dang gosabakal/ sha skam la tshwa chu byugs pa mang po khyer/ rgyal pos blon po bod du brosadogs nas/ rgyad mi bzhi bsrung du btang ngo / /der mgar med pa'i shul du/rgyal po na re/ nga'i lha gcig de ston mkhan zhig yod thag chod pas/ rtsis gyisashig gsungs so/ /der rtsis byas pas 'di skad zer/ ri gsum gyi steng na mtsho chen po cig 'dug mtsho de'i nang na bya sna gas 'dug de'i steng na thang dmar cem me ba zhig gi kha na/ bud med yin pa la mgo dang lus mnyam pa/ mgo lus thams cad mig gis gang ba/ zangs kyi mchu yod pa zhig gis bstan 'dug zer bas/ rgyal po thugs ma che par rtsis yig thams cad me la bsregs/ spor thang brgyad cu skor ni bod du bskur nas med do/ /der blon po bod kyi ri mthong ba'i sa ru sleb/ lkog tu chang mang po nyos nas sbas/ sha skam kyang zhim po byin nas/ nga'i nad la phan pa yin pas zo cig byas te/ lha gsol lo / / de nas spyad bzhi pos kha skom nas bzod thabs med par byung ba dang /chang mang po byin pas/ khong rnams ra ro ste dbang po med par gyur pa dang / blon pos khong bzhi po'i rta'i sug pa brags/ mtshon cha bcag khong rang rta mog ro mgo dmar la zhon/ rta gzhan de khrid nas 'di skad zer ro/ /dar zab me la bsregs pa'i thal ba de/ /rgyal po nye ring can de'i na bza' mdzod/ /snye ma 'bru 229

'tshe chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()med thal ba nag po de/ /btsun mo ser sna can de'i rgyags phye mdzod/ /nags la me brgyab sol ba'i mdung shing de/ /rgyal bu lus rtsal can de'i mdung shing mdzod/ /lug la mcher khrag med par bsad pa de/ /lha yi drung du sdig bshags smon lam bya/ /lus la nad med mal du nyal ba la/ /sngas mgor sman pa bosanas ci zhig bya/ kho bo mi sdod rang gi yul du 'gro/ /zer te/ rta la lcag brgyab ste song ngo / /der rgya yul du snye nag mo shar ba dang / rgya rnams na re/ snye ma'i nang na 'bru mi 'dug blon po ngan pa des/ dar zab thams cad bsreg tu bcugalug thams cad gsod du bcug nags thams cad la me brgyab/ sa bon thams cad brngos su bcug nas btab pas/ da ni 'bru mi 'dug lha gcig mdzangs ma de bod kyis khyer/ jo bo shākya ni bod kyis gdan drangs/ ngan 'di tsam zhig byas/ kye ma kye hud da ni ji ltar bya/ da kho 'dir 'ong ba mi srid do/ /bod du bros pa srid zer ba'i gtam rgyal po'i snyan du thos so/ /de bden par nges sam snyam nas/ rgya'i rta pa rtsal che ba brgya tham pa 'dzin du btang ngo/ /der rgyad bzhi po yang bzi sangs te 'di snyam du bsam mo/ /rta zhen rgyu med/ mtshon cha yang mi 'dug yul du log na ngo tsha la/ rgyal po'i chad pa yang byung dogs nas/blon po'i phyir 'brangs so/ /der rgya chu khug pa'i rtsar sleb dus/ rgya nag gi 'ded mi rnams kyis kyang nye bar sleb bo/ /der blon pos gyad bzhi po bran du bskul nas/ rgya chu khug pa'i 'gram du rta'i sbangs dang / rta rjes kyi bkang /gna' ba'i rwa me la bsos nas/ gzhu bcos/ rgyad bzhi po gda' rgyag bcug pas/ mda' sgro mtshams bar phud bzhag go /de rnams 'ded mis mthong nas230

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// 'di skad zer te/ kho la bsu ba'i rta pa mang la rtsal che ba byung 'dug nged rang rnams kyis mi thub/ log pa 'thad zer te/ de nas log go /de'i bar la rgya mo bza' la sogs pa'i bod blon rnams kyis ldan ma brag rtsar phebs nas/ brag la byams pa khru bdun pa zhig dang / bzang spyod gnyis brkos mar bzhengs/der zla ba gcig bskug der yang blon po ma byon/ phung po ri la phyag phebs/ la la 'phred lam bcos/ ri dwags bzung nas 'o ma bzhos/ der yang blon po ma byon/ khams kyi pad+ma shang du chag phebs/ zhing btab/ rang thag chu bskor btsugader zla ba gnyis bsgug der yang blon po ma byon/ de nas sgo dong sgo mo'i rtsar phebs/ rgya nag gi sgyu g.yang nyams sa pas/ rgya nag gi lha srung rnam bas kyi mthubs sgo mo 'gags pas der zla ba gnyis lus/ der blon po slebs so/ /de nas sgo dong sgo mo 'gags pa de/ rgya nag gi lha srung ma dga' bsal na par shes nas/ shing sna'i dud pa chen po btang / zas chang gi phud gtor nas 'di ltar byas so/ /gsol lo gsol lo lha la gsol/ /rgya nag rgyal po'i lha la gsol/ /grong khyer zim shi'i lha la gsol/ /rgya rje btsan po'i lha la gsol/ /bkra shis khri sgo'i lha la gsol/ /nags ma gyen la long du gsol/ /bod blon rnams kyi lha la gsol/ kha ba can pa'i lha la gsol/ /rgya mo kong jo bsu ru shog /ces gsol mchod di ri ri byas pa'i nub mo nags thams cad gyen la langs te 'gro thub pa byung ngo / /de nas bye ma'i la dgu 'khyags kha bskor/ mun pa'i rum du mar me bteg seng ldeng gi nags ma g.yas su longs/ gla ba'i nags ma g.yon du longs/ bod du gegs med par sleb byung ngo / /de nas rgyal po'i drung du bang 231

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()chen pa btang ste/ 'di ltar nged blon po rnams kyis/ jo bo shākya dang / lha gcig kong jo la sogs pa gdan drangs nas sleb gin yod pas/ bsu ba dga' ston rgya chen po zhu zhus so/ /der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ 'phags pa sgrol ma'i sprul pa lha gcig de yin par 'dug pas 'phrul che bas/ phyogs gang nas 'ong ngo mi shes pas/ bsu ba legs po gyis shig gsungs so/ /der phyogs bzhi kha ru mthong snang gi sprul par byung ste/ shar phyogs pa rnams na re/ lha gcig ni shar phyogs nas byon/ de'i rgyu rkyen/ rab kyi ming kyang rgya mo rab bya ba yod zer/ lho phyogs pa rnams na re/ lha gcig ni lco phyogs nas byon te/ grib kyi phu'i 'khyag rom la/ dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba 'dra zer ba de dus byung zer/ nub phyogs pa rnams na re/ lha gcig ni nub phyogs nas byon te/ sbal pa tshal gyi brag la phag pa'i sna 'dra bas/ mgon po zhig bzhengs zer ba de dus yin zer/byang phyogs pa rnams na re/ lha gcig ni byang phyogs nas byon te/ lha gcig dang rdzo bo la bsu pa byas pas grong gi ming kyang lha bsu ba bya bar yod zer don dam par byang phyogs sgo la nas byon nas/ ra mo che'i thang la phebs so/ /der ra mo cher shing rta bye ma la bying nas/ rgyad lha dga' dang klu dgas ma drongs par lus so / / der rjo bo'i phyogs bzhir ka ba bzhi btsugs/ dar dkar gyi yol bsabres nas mchod pa byas so/ /de'i sang nyin lha gcig kong rdzo dar sna tshogs kyi gos gon/ gser g.yu'i rgyan du mas brgyan nas/ mdzes ma'i bu mo nyi shu rtsa lnga yang dar zab dang / rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan/ pi wang rol mo dang bcas te/ brag lha'i ne'u thang la gzigs mo la phebs so/ /der blon po bod 232

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// 'bangs thams cad ltad mo la 'tshogs nas/ glu gar rtsed mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas so/ /der brag lha bkra shis kyi gzhal yabang khang rtse nas/ bal mo bzas gzigs pas/ rgya mo bza' dpon g.yog rnams rgyan du mas brgyan pa/brag lha'i ne'u thang la 'dug pa mthong / chags snang gi phrag dog bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig skyes nas 'di skad zer ro/ /kye ma rgya mo kong jo khyod/ /de na g.yog 'khor bcas te 'dug /dka' las byas te snye bos bkug /sa thag ring kyang bod du sleb/ /rgya rje'i sras mo yin lags kyang / /nga dang khyod gnyis khyad par che / / nga ni them pa snga brgal yin/ /bal rje'i sras mo nga yang yin/ /rje yi sku mthong nga snga bas/ /chen ma che rgyu btsun rgyu yin/ /chen ma mi che mi btsun na/sno/'jig rten chos lugs mi bden rdzun/ /chen ma rgyal po'i btsun mo yin/ /chun ma btsun mo'i g.yog mo yin/ /'on kyang rje la bsam nas 'ongs/ /chen chun gnyis po 'gran no ang / /dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod par 'gran/ /chosadang dkon mchog bzhugs pa'i gzhi/ /gtsug lag khang rnams bzhengs par 'gran/ /yar la rje yi zhabs tog 'gran/ /mar la ngan long skyong ba dang / /dad pas dam chos byed par 'gran/ /thad skar skal nor bsog pa dang / /zhing la so nam byed par 'gran/ /yul gyi pha ming che chung dang / /rang la skal brdzangs ci yod 'gran/ /de rnams 'gran par ma nus na/ khyod kyang rje la ma reg zhig /btsun mo'i rang mthong ma che zhig /chen ma che rgyu'i lha khang ni/ /bre tshad tsam zhig ma brtsigs par/ /chun ma chung rgyu'i lha khang ni/ /phul tshad tsam yang ma brtsigasashig /zer ba dang / rgya mo bza'i bsam pa la/ lar skyon che/ rang gi pha ming 233

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()dpal 'byor longs spyod rnams rgyab tu bskur/ yul thag ring nas 'ongs/ sleb ma thag yin pa/ sdod pa'i gnas ma rnyed/ bsten pa'i sam rnyed/ rgyal po'i zhalam mthong / btsun mo'i ming ma thob/ phyi nang gi blon po rnams dang ma 'dris pa'i gang 'dir/ phrag dog gi 'gran tshig 'di bzhin byed pa 'dra mo min/ nged rang gnyis ka sa thag ring nas/ rgyal po'i btsun mo la 'dir lhan du 'dzom/ gcig snying gcig la gtad skyid sdug bsres nas/ blo sems gcig tu dril te rje'i zhabs tog 'bangs kyi skyong bran/ chen chun gyi 'grogs lugs/ phyi nang gi bya ba kun la thob rim bzhin byas na/ tshe 'di'i spun dang 'dra ste/ de bzhin med par sleb ma khad/ phrag dog gi 'gran tshig 'di bzhin yin na/ nged rang gnyisapha ming / skal brdzangs rang sgo/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba/ gang dang spyi rnams ci'i phyir mi mnyam bsams te/ lan smras pa/ e ma ngo mtshar che ste dgod re bro/ kho mos sdod pa'i gnas kyang ma rnyed cing / /rkang pa gnyis kyis them pa ma brgal bar/ /rje yi zhal yang mig gis ma mthong bar/ /btsun mo khyed kyi 'gran tshig sngas pa yin/ /'dab chags mkha' la lding ba'i rtse sgro dang / /rlan drod sal skyes pa'i smyug ma gnyis/ /rang cha dgos pa'i go gnas mnyam lags kyang / /las kyi dbang gis mda' mkhan rtsa ru 'dzom/ /steng 'og byung ba ming gi khyad par yin/ /phu gsum spang la skyes pa'i me tog dang / /mda' gsum sdum rar skyes pa'i ha lo gnyis/ /mtshar sdug blta ba'i cha nas mnyam lags kyang / /rten 'brel dbang gis lha yi drung du 'dzom//snga rting byung yang ming gi khyad par yin/ /bal yul mthil nas byung ba'i khri btsun dang / /bu mo rgya nas long ba'i kong jo 234

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long tham chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//gnyis/ /pha ming skal brdzangs thams cad mnyam lags kyang //smon lam dbang gis rgyal po'i drung 'dir 'dzom/ /chen chun byung ba ming gi khyad par yin/ /snyan dan tshag pa mo dang chen chun sogs/ /mthun por 'grogs na tshe 'di'i spun las lhag /chags sdang byed na rang mgo su drung yin/ /rgya dang bal yul sa thag ring ba na/ /yab gcig rgyal po gnyis ni so sor bzhugs/ /yul gyi pha ming ngom na'ang 'gran pas chog /phan bde'i dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /mthong thos dran reg yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /jo bo rnam gnyis pho na'ang 'gran pas chog /rin chen gser dngul dar zab sna tshogs dang / /rta dang rnga mo drel la sogs pa yi/ /rang gi skal brdzangs ngom na'ang 'gran pasachog /'jig rten bya ba bzo'i rnam 'gyur dang / /rgyan gyi bkod pa zas kyi g.yos sna dang / /phyi yi so nam bkal thag yon tan sogs/ /mdzangs ma'i lag rjes ngom na'ang 'gran pas chog /ces zer ro/ /der blon po mgar gyisakyang / rgya nag rgyal pos nye ring byas pa/ lha gcig kong jog bod la log lta byas pa/ rgya yul du dka' las chen po byung ba rnams yid la dran te/ zla ba gcig ma lon bar du/ kong jo dpon g.yog rnams la 'khor mkhan mi gcig kyang med pa byas so/ /der rgya mo'i 'khor rnams na re/ bod yi dwags kyi rgyal khams yin zer ba bden par 'dug bza' btung longs spyod ni mi 'ong bar 'dug zer ro/ /de thos pa dang / rgya mo bza' yang sems la bzod thabs ma byung bar blon po mgar bos/ blon po chen po khyed rang ji ltar gsungs pa la brten nas 'ong ba yin pa/ khyi bos nas ma brdung / khrel med gdong chung mi byed 235

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()par/ nged dpon g.yog rnams la brgyags dang gos skyol/ nged rnams sa thag ring nas sleb pa yin pas nyen mongs par yod par byas pas/ mgar na re/ nga la zas skom skyel ba'i dbang yang med/ ci byed bal mo bza' dbang che ba yin/khyed rang mo la de skad zhus zer te/ kho log song ngo / /der rgya mo bza' yang yi chad/ yul gyi pha ming dang longs spyod rnams yid la dran te/ 'gyod kyang bya thabs med par song nas/ pi wang la ram 'degs bcol nas glu blangs so/ /bu mo mi sdod yul la 'gro/ /jo bo shākya rdzongs su byon/ /gtsug lag rtsis kyang rdzongs su byon/ /rin chen dar zab rdzongs su khyer/ /'o ma zho ru bsgyur gin 'ong / /zho la mar du 'don gin 'ong / /da ra thud du bsgyur gyin 'ong / /se ba zhib par 'thag gin 'ong / /gres ma thag par 'chos kyin 'ong / kham pa dzo ru bsgyur gyin 'ong / /rang 'thag chu bskor 'dzugs kyin 'ong / khung ma'i sa bon khyer nas 'ong / /rgya nag yul du sgyu g.yang nyams/ /bod du bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /bu mo a ma'i go na mdzangs/ /go rgas sems kyi nad du che/ /bod kyi yul du khyim la 'ong / khyi mo nang du bos nas brdung / /bod la khrel gdong mi 'dug go /gri chung yu ba'i rtsa na rno/ /glu chung rang 'thag go na snyan/ /bu mo a ma'i go na mdzangs/ /rje kha blon pos bsgyur gyin gda'/ /skyes kha mo yisabasgyur gyin gda'/ /thag kha spun gyis bsgyur gyin gda'/ /zhing ngan ram pasabasgyur gyin gda'/ /bu mo nga la sdod thabs med/ /blon po mgar gyis khrel med byas/ /zhes zer te/ jo bo shing rta'i steng du bzhugs/ rta dang drel rnga mo la sogs la khal bkal/ bod ngan pa'i bya ba mthong bas shes zer te/ 'gro ba'i 236

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long sprom chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// grabs byas dus blon po mgar byung nas/ khyed khyim nas pha ming gi yul du log pa mi 'thad/ ngo yang tsha/ rgya yul du 'gro ba'i lam yang mi shog bod du 'ong dus kyang nga med par lam du lus 'dus nas lam ma shog par 'dug pa/ da ngas bal mo bza' la'ang gros 'debs/ rgyal po la'ang zhu shig zer te/ khosamajal bar zhus nas/ rgyal po dga' ston gyi gdan sar byon te/ rgya mo bza' kong jo dang mjal lo/ /der yang mthong lugs rnam par gsum du byung ste/phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi snang ba la/ rgyal po dang / btsun mo gnyis mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis sems can gyi don byed pa'i snang ba byung ngo / /sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snang ba la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs rgyal po srong btsan sgam por skur sprul/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma rgya mo bza' kong jo ru skur sprul nas sems can gyi don byed pa'i snang ba byung ngo / /mi nag tha mal pa rnams kyi snang ba la/ rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis skyems la gsol res byed pa dang / skud pa 'khel res byed pa'i snang ba byung ngo / /de nasargyal po yang kong jo dang zla ba gcig gi bar la ma mjal ba des/ thugs shin tu 'gyod par gyur nas/ kong jo'i sems gso ba'i phyir/ kong jo khyod 'o ma brgyal lam/ nyen ma mongs sam/ bar chad med par bod du slebs pa ngo mtshar che / jo bo ji ltar byas la gdan drangs/ la 'phrang chu gsum la ji ltar byasagasungs/ lha gcig kong jo na re/ jo bo shākya shing rta'i steng du bzhugs/ spyad lha dga' dang / klu dgas 'khor los drangs/ brgya chu khug pa gru yis bcad/ lam sa thag ring yang thabs kyis byon/ bye ma'i la dgu 'khyags kha bskor nas 'ong /237

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos na nga gce4bsdus/ ()mun pa'i rum du mar me bteg nas 'ong / seng ldeng gi nags ma g.yas su bsnyel nas 'ong / gla ba'i nags ma g.yon du bsnyel nas 'ong / rgya nag yul du phywa g.yang nyams/ /bod du bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /bod la khrel gdong mi 'dug go /zer te bshums so/ /der yang blon po tshos sleb tsa na/ shags che/yus che ba byas te/ blon po mgar na re/ spyir rgya nag gi mi thams cad kyisabarnyas pa byas/ gnas mo rgya mo gcig min pa/ sems mkhan mi gcig kyang ma byung / sgos su rgya nag rgyal pos nye ring chen po byas/ lha gcig kong jo khyed rang yin kyang bod la mi dga' ba ji tsam byas zer bas/ der rgya mo bza' skyengs te smra 3 ma byung ngo / /rgya mo bza' kong jo gdan drangs pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'// /ba/cu bzhi pa/ mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi lha khang dang / 'phrul snang ra mo che rnams legs par bzhengs pa'i skor/ de nas lha gcig khri btsun gyis/ rgya mo bza' rtsis la mkhas par shes nas blon po mgar la ngo chen bcol te/g.yog mo la gser phye bre gang yon du bskur nas/ lha khang brtsigs pa'i sa cha gang bzang brtsi ba la btang ngo / /der rgya mo bzas kyang spor thang brgyad cu skor gyi gab rtse bting nas brtsis pas/ kha ba can bod kyi rgyal khams 'di/ srin mo gan rkyal du nyal ba'i gzugs su shes/ 'o thang gi mtsho 'di srin mo'i snying khrag tu shes/ ri gsum po 'di snying gi rus par shes/ sa 'di srin mo'i snying thog rang du 'dug pas/ mtsho 'di bsubs pa'i steng du lha khang 'di brtsig dgos/'di na ngan song gi sgo zhig kyang 'dug ra mo che'i 'og na klu'i pho brang 'dug ste/238

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long tham chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//rdzo bo bzhugs pa 'dis non par 'dug go /klu phug na klu bdud nag po'i nya la sa 'dug pa lha khang brtsigs la phyogs shig smo nub zla ba tshal gyi dug shing gi sdong po rkang gcig gi rtsa ba na the'u rang dang / mi ma yin gyi 'dus sa yod pa gtor cig grib kyi phu nas nyang bran phu sa btsan gyi rgyu srang yod pas bar chu khar mchod rten chen po bzhengs shig shar phyogs na chu srin de'u la 'dring pa lta bu'i sa dgra yod pa lam grum pa ri yin/ de la dung g.yas su 'khyil ba zhig gi kha ston/ shar lho na srin mo mdoms bzed pa 'dra ba'i sa dgra yod pas/ byang stod seng phug yin/ de la dbang phyug chen po'i kha ston/ lho nub na sdig pa nag po bzan la rub pa 'dra ba'i sa dgra yod/ yug ma ri'i shar ri 'di yin/ de la bya khyung ke ru zhig gi kha ston/ nub na bdud nag po bya ra byed pa 'dra ba'i sa dgra yod/ shun gyi brag rtse 'di yin/ de la rdo'i mchod rten zhig gi kha ston/ byang na glang po che g.yul du zhugs pa 'dra ba'i sa dgra yod/ nyang bran dge re gnyis kyi dbus ri yin/ de la rdo'i seng ge zhig gi kha ston/des nye ba'i sa dgra thamasacad non pa yin no/ /de ltar sa dgra thams cad mnan pa dang / yon tan thams cad phyogs gcig tu tshang ste/ shar na ri mchod rten 'dra ba yod/ ban khos bang ba ri yin/ lho na rin po che spungs pa 'dra ba yod/ grib kyi rgyab ri 'di yin/ nub na ri ma sgyu'i steng na dung phor bzhag pa 'dra ba yod/ stod lung brang phu'i ri yin/ byang na ri pad+ma kha phye ba 'dra ba yod/ dge re lha phu'i ri yin/gzhan yang nyang bran 'phan dkar gyi ri la dbu la gdugs/ mal grong gi rgyab ri la spyan la nya/ mdangs mkhar gyi brag la ljags la pad+ma/ grib kyi 'khyag khrom 239

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()la gsung la dung / rdzong btsan gyi ri la mgul la bum pa/ yug ma'i ri ldothugs dpal be lu 'phan dkar gyi ri la sku lus rgyal mtshan/ stod lung brang phu'i spang la phyag zhabs 'khor lo ste/bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad tshang yod do//gzhan yang gar pa'i jo mo ze ze la lcags kyi gter kha/ ra ga brag la zangs kyi gter kha/ la dong gi brag la dngul gyi gter kha/ lcags kha ri'i brag la gser gyi gter kha yod do/ /shar na stag skya bo dga' mo gdong 'og ma/ lho na g.yu 'brug sngon mo chu/ nub na bya dmar po shun gyi brag dmar rte'u'i gdong yin/byang na rus sbal nag po nyang bran pha bong kha yin/ de ltar srin mo gan rkyal du nyal ba'i yan lag dang nying lag rnams non par byed pa la/ mi 'gyur ba'i gzer bcu gnyis zer te/ de yang mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi ni/g.yo ru na khra 'brug spu ru na ka tshal/ g.yas ru gtsang 'phrang gi lha khang / gtsang na grum pa rgyang gi lha khang / des ma thub na/ yang 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi brtsigs/kong po bu chu'i lha khang / 'khon mthing gser gyi lha khang / byams sprin dge rgyas kyi lha khang / spra dun tse'i lha khang / des ma thub na/ ru non gyi lha khang bzhi rtsigs shig de yang / khams su slong thang sgron ma/ bum thang skyer chu'i lha khang / mtshal rigs shes rab sgron ma'i lha khang / tshangs pa rlung non gyi lha khang / de rnams sngon la bzhengs shig ma grub na'ang sa phur thob cig de ltar byas na/ khyod kyis gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa la 'gal rkyen bar chad med do/ /gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ logs bkra shis rtags brgyad/sa yul 'di srin mo'i snying thog rang du 'dug gong gi rten 'brel de rnams rim 240

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long 0mchos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// pa bzhin du mdzod/ mtsho bsubs pa'i thog ma la/ ra dkar mo la sa khol la bsubs shig de'i steng du lha khang legs par bzhengs shig phrag dog gi logalta ma mdzad cig ces rgya mo bzas bal mo bza'i g.yog mo la legs par bslabs so/ /der g.yog mo des khri btsun gyi rtsar/ 'phrin gong 'og 'dzol te/gong gi skyon sel ba/ sa dgra non pa/ yon tan yod pa/ mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi lha khang bzhengs nas/ thabs rten 'brel legs par bshad pa rnams brjed/ der lha khang bzhengs pa'i sa cha gang bzang bar 'dug dris pas/ phyogs mtha' dag rnams su sngon la lha khang bcu gnyis brtsig dgos zer/ ra la sa khol la mtsho bsubs/ de'i steng du lha khang bzhengs zer gyi 'dug byas pas/ khri btsun the tshom du gyur te/ 'on kyang g.yog mos zer ba bzhin/ ra la sa bkal nas mtsho bsubs pas/ bye ba stong gi cha yang zub ma 'dod do/ /der rgya mo bzas ngan bslabs par go nas phrag dog skyes/ shin tu ma dga' bar gyur nas/ rgyal po la yang ma zhus par/ blon po 'ga' zhig gi kha la nyan nas/ la dong gi ni'u thang la sa'i dpyad bzang bar shes nas/ lha khang rmang bting pas/nyin par brtsigs pa thams cad nub mo lha 'dres rjes med par bshig 'dug pas/ khri btsun yi mug cing sdug bsngal bar gyur nas/ rgyal po la zhus/pas/rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyod sdug bsngal bar ma byed/ nga la gros 'dri sa cig yod do gsungs te/ de'i mtshan mo rgyal pos yi dam gyi lha la gsol ba btab pas/yid dam gyi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer zhig 'phros nas mtsho nang du thim par gyur to/ /der rgyal po'i thugs la mtsho bsubs pa'i steng du lha khang bzhengs na 241
