ba chen 'od snang la /gsu'i chos 'gyung gces bsdus/ ()bzang bar dgongs nas/ khri btsun la rgyal po'i zhal nas/ chibs stod cig sang nged gnyis skyo sangs la 'gro'o gsungs so/ /de'i sang rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis mtsho 'gram gyi rne'u thang la skyo sangs la byon te/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/khri btsun la/ khyod rang gi sor gdub phud la nam mkha' la gtor cig de gar babs pa'i thang du lha khang brtsigs pa yin no gsungs pas/ der khri btsun gyisayi dam gyi lha la smon lam btab ste/ sor gdub nam mkha' la 'phangs pas/'od zer gyi gong bur 'dril nas mtsho nang du lhung bar gyur to/ /der khri btsun gyi bsam pa la/ mtsho'i stong du lha khang brtsig dgos na/ skye ba 'di la grub pa mi srid snyam nas/ rta kha nas babs te sdug bsngal bar byas pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas khyod ma ngu bar mtsho nang du ltos shig yon tan du ma dang ldan par 'dug gsungs so/ /der khri btsun gyis mchi ma nyis nas bltas pas/ mtsho'i nang na 'od zer sna tshogs las grub pa'i mchod rten khri 'phang dgu yod pa zhig mthong ngo / /de la brten nas mtsho nang thams cad 'od zer gyi dra bas 'brel te/lha khang gi ri mo lta bur 'dug pas/ khri btsun yid ches te/ rgyal pos kyang lha khang brtsig grogs mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de'i sang rgyal po blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pas rol mo dang bcas te/ tsan+dan gyi sku rang byon gdan drangs te mtsho 'gram du byon no/ /der mtsho'i phyogs bzhir sa phur gdab bo/ /dar po che 'phyar te smon lam btab/ der khri btsun gyis be+eḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed la gsol ba btab pas zas chang dpag tu med pa byung ste/ bod 'bangs thamasacad las la bskul/ skye chu sbo ba gdong la bsgyur/ mtsho'i phyogs bzhir rdo 242

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long nga mchos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// bskyed du bcug nas/ mtsho gru bzhir bcos so/ /mtsho'i phyogs bzhir rdo dpe chen po mtsho'i nang du lhags pa bzhi bzhi byas shing / rgyal pos rdo dpe de rnams kyi steng du byon nas/ mtsho'i dkyil gyi 'od zer gyi mchod rten de la dmigs te smon lam btab/ blon po rnams kyis yi ge drug pa'i sgra dang bcas te/ rdo rnams mtsho nang du bskyur bas/ rgyal po'i smon lam gyi mthu la brten nas/ mtsho de'i dkyil nas rdo'i mchod rten khri 'phang gru bzhir yod pa zhig rang thag gi lte ba lta bur lhun gyis grub ste/ sra zhing brtan la mi 'gyur bar 'dug pa rgyal po yab yum blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pas legs par gzigs pas/ thams cad yid ches shing mos par byas so/ /de nas shing shug pa'i sdong po sbom la ring ba bcu drug bcad nas/ rtsa ba phyogs bzhi'i rdo dpe chen po rnams la gtad/ rtse mo mtsho'i dkyil gyi rdo'i mchod rten rang byon la gto de/ gdugs kyi rtsib mang bzhin du byas so/ /de'i steng du shing gla ba'i sdong po sbom la ring ba mang po bcad nas/ de'i steng du mig mangs ris su byas so/ /de yang sprul pa'i dge slong a ka ra ma ti shī las/ klu'i yul du rdzu 'phrul gyis byon te/ rdo rje'i 'jim pa blangs shing rnams la byugs pas/ bskal pa'i bar du chu nang na gnas kyang mi rul cing / mes kyang mi tshig cing / bcad kyang mi chod do/ /de'i steng du spang leb bsgrigs/ de'i steng du so phag bsgrigs te khro chus bsdams/ de'i steng sa khod snyoms par byas nas/ de ltar sa pho khyi la 'o thang gi mtsho bsubs pas legs par tshar te/ chos rgyal dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi steng du/ lha sa'i rtsig rmang bting pa lags/ sa mo phag la lha khang rmang bting / rked pa tsam brtsigs tshar 243

h+phu go 'od nga la /sa skya'i chos nga gces bsdus/ ()nas thams cad dga' bar gyur pa dang /sang nyin lha 'dres bshig 'dug go/yang khri btsun sdug bsngal bar gyur nas/ rgyal po'i drung du byung ste/ rgyal po chen po mtsho bsubs pa'i steng du lha khang brtsig mi btub par 'dug pa/ bdag gi lha khang la gzigs dang zhes zhus pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyod sdug bsngal ma byed cig nga la gros 'dri sa zhig yod do gsungs so/ /der rgyal pos yi dam gyi lha la gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkha' nas gzugs med pa'i sgra zhig byung ste / rgyal po khyed rang gi sku 'bag jo bo bcu gcig zhal zhig bzhengs na/ khyed kyi lha khang bzhings pa la 'gal rkyen mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro zer te mi snang bar gyur to/ /der rgyal po'i zhal nas bal po'i lha bzo ba la/ khyod kyis nga'i sku 'bag tu ming btags pa'i/ 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal zhig bzhedas nusasam gsungs pas/ nus lags zer te/ de'i bzo rgyu la tsan+dan sprul gyi snying po'i dum bu/ gros gor shi dzi'i dum bu/ byang chub shing gi yal ga rgya mtsho gle'i 'jag ma/ chu bo ni ra3 ra'i bye ma/ dben gnas chen po brgyad kyi sal sogasapa rgya gar nas spyan drangs pa'i ngo mtshar che ba'i rdzas mang po bsags te/legs par brdar nas/ ba dmar po'i 'o ma dang / ra dkar mo'i 'o ma la sbyar te / 'jim pa'i phung po chen po zhig byas/ rgyal po rin po che'i khri'i steng du gzims pa'i dbu sngas su bzhag ste/ rgyal pos yi dam gyi lha la gsol ba btab nas/ nga'i yi dam gyi lha 'di la/ spyan ras gzigs la rigs mang po yod pa ji lta bu zhig bzhengs dgongs pa dang / de rnams kyi nang nas bcu gcig zhal yid bzhin gyi nor bu lhag pa yin pas bzhengs dgos dgongs pa dang /244

rgyal rab gas po ba'i me long mi pa cho 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhug so// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad nyi zer gyi rdul tsam du lhags te / 'jim pa'i phung po la thim pa rgyal pos gzigs pas/ rgyal po'i thugs la/nga'i yi dam 'di la byin rlabs can zhig 'gron par 'dug go dgongs nas/rin po che'i khri'i steng du gzims so/ /nangs par gung langs pa dang / bcu gcig zhal yid bzhin gyi nor bu rang byon du snang ste/ lha bzos bzhengs ma dgos so/ /de la rtsa ba'i zhal gsum dkar po rab tu 'dzum pa zhi ba'i phrin las/ de'i steng gi zhal gsum gser gyi mdog rngams pa'i khro zhal rgyas pa'i phrin las/ de'i steng gi zhal gnyis byi ru'i mdog bshad pa'i khro zhal dbang gi phrin las/ de'i steng gi zhal gnyis nag pa khros shing gdangs pa'i khro zhal drag po'i phrin las/ de'i steng du a mi khyo ba li khri'i mdog can a mi khru ba man rgyal po'i sku tshad dang mnyam pa/ chos sku'i rtsa ba'i phyag bas phyag mtshan ni/ dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na bgrang phreng / gsum pa na 'khor lo/bzhi pa na mchog sbyin/lnga pa na 'od dpag med bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pad+ma dkar po/ gsum pa na ril ba sgyi blugs/ bzhi pa na rin po che/ lnga pa na mda' gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /sprul pa'i phyag rnams ni lha bzo ba bstos/rang byon du byon dus/rtsa rgyug gas bo la mi 2ga longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yan lag sum cu so brgyad yod pa ni/ g.yas phyogs kyi phyag bcu dgu'i rim pa bzhin du/ dang po na rin po che/ gnyis pa na zhags pa/ gsum pa na lhung bzed/bzhi pa na ral gri/ lnga pa na rdo rje/ drug pa na me shel/ bdun pa na chu shel/brgyad pa na gzhu/ dgu pa na lhag ma/ bcu pa na rnga yab/ bcu gcig na phub/245

ba chen 'od snang las/sa 'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/ ()bcu gnyis na bum pa/ bcu gsum na dgra sta/ bcu bzhi na phreng ba/ bco lnga na pad+ma sngon po/ bcu drug na spyi blugs/ bcu bdun na nyi ma/ bco brgyad na chu skyesadakar po/ bcu dgu na 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon gyi yan lag bcadagu'i rim pa bzhin du/ dang po na sprin dkar/ gnyis pa na spyi blugs/ gsumapa na pad+ma/ bzhi pa na ral gri/ lnga pa na dung / drug pa na thod pa/ bdun pa na phreng ba/ brgyad pa na dril bu/ dgu pa na rdo rje/ bcu pa na lcags kyu/ bcu gcig na 'khar gsil/ bcu gnyis na sangs rgyas sprul sku/ bcu gsum na lha khang /bcu bzhi na glegs bam/ bco lnga na 'khor lo/ bcu drug na sangs rgyas kyi sku/bcu bdun na shing thog bco brgyad na pad+ma ge sar/ bcu dgu na rin po che bsnams pa'o/ /sprul pa'i nying lag stong tham pa rab tu mdzes pa/ phyag re re'imathil na ye shes kyi spyan re re yod pa/ phyag dang zhabs la gser gyi gdu gu dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ khro zhal rnams ni spyan gsum re dang ldan pa/ dbu sgra kham pa gyen la 'khyil ba/ sku lus la rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ sku stod la ri dwags kyi lngags pasagayogs nas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad gyis brgyan pa zhig 'od du khrong nge byon 'dug pa rgyal pos gzigs pas shin tu dgyes par gyur to//de nas rgyal po'i zhal nas/ bal po'i lha bzo ba la khyed kyi rten 'di/ ngo mtshar che la mgyogs pa zhig bzhengs tshar 'dug na'ang / rgya gar nas byon pa'i tsan+dan gyi sku rang byon 'di dang / sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi ring bsrel rnams rten 'di'i thugs rkar bzhugs su 'jug rgyu yin lags gsungs pas/ lha bzo ba na 246

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// re / rten 'di bdag gis bzhengs pa ma lags/ rang byon du gda'o zhus pa dang /de ma thag tu sku g.yos par gyur te/ zhabs g.yon pa'i sham thabs bus mo'i gong du brdzes/ thugs ka nas 'od zer byung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel dang /tsan+dan gyi sku rang byon rnams spyan drangs te/ thugs nar ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du bzhugs so/ /a mi khru ba g.yon phyogs su cung yo ba dang / sham thabasakyang bus mo'i gong du lus pa rnams/ phyi rabs su yang de ltar du yod do/ /de la tsan+dan sprul gyi snying po de dbu'i srog shing du gyur/ byang chub kyi shing gnyis zhabs kyi srog shing du gyur/ sngar gyi rdzas rnams la sku lus su gyur te/ me tog gtor ro/ /de nas bal po'i lha bzos 'khor rnams bzhengs pa ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / kha rla pa ṇi dang khro gnyer can dang / sgrol ma dang 'od zer can dang / dbyangs can ma dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang / dpal rta mgrin rnamasabazhengs so/ /der bkra shis pa'i ltas kyis phyogs thams cad du khyab par gyur nas/ g.yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /der rgyal po yab yum blon po'i tshogasadang bcas pas/ mchod rdzas du ma thogs te/ smon lam btab bo/ /de nasargyal po'i rten de'i drung du/ lha khang brtsig pa'i 'gal rkyen bzlog cing/ mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i gsol ba 'debs byin yod tsa na/ nub phyogs zla ba tshal gyi dug shing gi sdong po rkang gcig gi rtsa na/ 'dre srin dang mi ma yin mang po 'tshogs nas/ khong rnams na re/ srong btsan sgam po zer ba'i mgo gnyis yod pa 'dis/nged rang tsho'i 'dug sa bshig rgyu srang bkab/ nged rang tsho yang kho'i lha khang brtsig tu mi 'jug dge ba byed pa'i srog gcod/ sad ser ba dang / nad 247

pa na 'od nga la /ga 'i chos 2 gung gces bsdus/ ()yams gtong zer gin 'dug pa rgyal pos mkhyen nas 'phags pa la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ 'phags pa bzhad pa'i zhal nas 'od zer byung ba me ru gyur/khros pa'i zhal nas 'od zer byung ba rta mgrin dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba gnyis su gyur te/ khro bo gnyis ye shes kyi me dang bcas pas zla ba tshal gyi dug shing gisdong po la brgyab/ sran phung dkyil du thog babs pa bzhin byas te/ 'dre lalani brgyal/ la la ni bog la la skad ban 'don par gyur to/ /der khro bo gnyisakyis ye shes kyi me dang bcas pas de rnams ded de/ phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po la bsgral nas phyir mi ldog pa byas so/ /der ye shes kyi me zla ba tshal gyi brag la phog pas brag de la kha rla pa ṇi rang byon du byon par gyur to/ /de'i sang rgyal po blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pas rang byon de'i drung du byon te/ mchod pa phul zhing smon lam btab nas/ bstod pa mdzad pa/ spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten mgon/ /thub pa'i dbang pos spyi gtsug brgyan/ /sku mdog dkar gsal gangs ri 'dra//nyon mongs ma gos pa smo bzhin//thugs rje che zhing mthu ldan pa//sems can nyam thag phongs rgya yi/ /nad dang sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa/ /mgon du gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rang byon de brag la gsal bar byon na'ang / ma 'ongs pa'i sems can bsod nams bsog pa'i phyir du/ bal po'i lha bzos gsal bar brkos so/ /de nas lha khang brtsigs pa la bgegasamed par dgongs nas/ rje blon kun gyis mtsho bsubs pa'i steng du byon/ sagazhi byin gyis brlabs nas thig gdab bo/ /de'i dus su klu'i rgyal po sangasargyas bcom ldan 'das sku mdog dkar po sbrul gyi gdengs ka can/ spyan gsum 248

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//dang ldan pa byon te/ rgyal po la sprul zhags dkar po zhig phul nas/ rgyal po'i lha khang 'di la stong chung ngu'i bar gyi gnod pa byung na ngas srungs shig nga'i gzugs zhig mdzod cig zer ro/ /yang klu'i rgyal po dga' bo byung nas/ rgyal po'i lha khang 'di la stong gsum gyi bar du chu'i gnod pa byung na ngas srungs shiganga'i gzugs zhig mdzod cig zer ro/ /yang srin po'i rgyal po laṅka mgrin bcu byung nas/ rgyal po la gser gzhed pa gang phul nas/ rgyal po'i lha khang 'di la me'i gnod pa byung na ngas bsrung zhing nga'i gzugs zhig mdzod cig zer ro/ /yang gnod sbyin na ga ku be ra byung nas/ gser gyi thags bzangs shig phul nas/ rgyal po'i lha khang 'di la 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pa byung na ngas srungs shiganga'i gzugs zhig mdzod cig zer ro/ /yang ma hā kā la byung nas/ rgyal po'i lha khang 'di la mtha' dmag dang mi ma yin gyi gnod pa byung na ngas srungs shiganga'i gzugs zhig mdzod cig zer ro/ /yang dpal ldan lha mo byung ste/ lcagasakyi bre ba zhig phul nas/ rgyal po khyed kyi lha khang 'di la mi dang ma mo'i gnod pa byung na ngas srungs shig nga'i gzugs zhig mdzod cig zer ro/ /yang bla ma rnams byon te/rgyal po'i lha khang 'di bla ma'i lugs su bzhengs shig gsung ngo //yang sngags pa rnams byung ste/ rgyal po'i lha khang 'di nged sngags pa'i lugs su bzhengs shig zer ro/ /yang bon po rnams byung ste/ rgyal po'i lha khang 'di bod 'bangs kyi lugs su bzhengs shig zer ro/ /der rgyal po shin tu dgyes nasathams cad zhal gyis bzhes so/ /der rgyal pos bod 'bangs rnams la zas chang gis tshims par byas te las la bskul nas/ la las so phag btang /249

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung cha bsdus/ ()la las rtsig pa byas/ la las 'jim pa btang ste/ 'og khang gi rtsig pa zin par byas so/ /lha sa'i rtsig mang bting pa man/tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes rab byung mdzad pa yan la be+ebasnyen brgya dang bzhi bas zhe lnga 'gro brtog ldan sngo lhas ma gsungs/de nas shing shug pa'i sdong po mang po bcad nas/ rgyal pos sku lus kyi sprul pa brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad de/ lha khang gi sgo bsrung ste/ nang du shing bzo ba ste'u thogs pa brgya rtsa brgyad du sprulanas shing bzo mdzad/ bsang bu yang bal mo bza' min pa gzhan gyis mi skyelalo / / dus nam zhig khri btsun yi dam la mchod pa 'bul ba dang dus 'dzom nas/rgyal po'i bsang bu g.yog mo la bskur ro/ /g.yog mos sgo phyes nas phyin pas/rgyal po med par shing bzo ba cha lugs dbyer mi phyed pa'i ste'u thogs pa brgya rtsabargyad du 'dug ste/ seng ge brgya rtsa brgyad kyi sna'i bzo byed kyin 'dug pagabasang bu gang la 'dren ngo ma shes par phyir log nas/ bsang bu bal mo la gtad do/ /der g.yog mo'i bsam pa la/ rgyal po 'dis sprul pa mkhyen zer gde e bden bsams nas/ khri btsun rgyal po la bsang bu 'dren song ba'i rjesal / g.yog mos sgo phag nas bltas pas thams cad sprul par 'dug pa/ he he zer bgad pas/ rgyal po spyan yengs pa dang ste'u kha 'chor bas shing bzo ba thams cad kyi ste'u kha 'chor nas/ seng ge rnams sna chad do/ /der yang la lasaka ba bcos/ la las gdung ma gshog la las lcam gru bzhir bcos/ yang ldolabs ka ba nga5sngon la la ba'i gdung bkal/ la labs lcam bsgrig la labs spang leb btang / thog phub nas mdzes par byas so/ rdzo po rje'i gter mig 'a mo na/lha shā 'og khang la nyin zhag gnyis la zin pa byas zer bar 'dug ste/thog phub pa der 'dug de ltar rgya tshog250

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//po sprul pa mdzad pas/ rtsig pa la nyin zhag bzhi/ shing bzo la nyin zhag drug thog 'bub pa la nyin zhag gnyis/ dril bas nyin zhag bcu gnyis la/ ra sa'i 'og khang yongs su rdzogs par zin par byas so/ /de yang sgo bzhi dkyil ga bor ris su byas pas bla ma dga'/ ka ba phur pa ris su byas pas sngags pa dga'/zur bzhi g.yung drung ris su byas pas bon po dga'/ re'u mig ris su byasapas bod 'bangs dga'/ gyis zer ba'i gzugs thams cad byas pas/ chosaskyong klu dang gnod sbyin srin po la sogs pa rnams dga'o/ /de yang dga' bzhi 'phrul gyi lha khang gi sgo yang nub phyogs bal po'i yul du gtad do/ /de'i 'phro la khri btsun gyis bal po'i yul nas rig byed la mkhas pa'i bzo bo mang po bos nas steng khang bzhengs so/ /lha 'i steng khang dang /ra mo che gnyis la zla ba ga kha nyi re 'dor te lhan du sgo ro//de dang dus mnyam du rgya mo bzas kyang rgya yul nas shing bzo ba dang / lha bzo ba mang po bos nas/ rgya stag ra mo che'i lha khang bzhengs te/ lha khang gi sgo shar du bstan no/ /de'i bar la rgyal pos sprul pa mdzad nas mtha' 'dul dang / yang 'dul dang / ru gnon gyi lha khang bzhengs pa ni/ srin mo'i dpung pa g.yas gnon pa'i phyir/ sbu ru ka tshal mi 'gyur ba'i lha khang bzhengs/de'i yan lag tu gser shang gi rti'i lha khang bzhengs/ de'i sgrub pa rtse mo gdong gi brag phug tu byas so/ /dpung pa g.yon gnon pa'i phyir/ g.yo ru khra 'brug bkra shis byams snyoms kyi lha khang bzhengs/ de'i yan lag tu tsan thang gi lha khang btab/ de'i sgrub pa phug mo cher byas so/ /dpyi mgo g.yas gnon pa'i phyir/ g.yas ru gtsang 'brang byang chub dge gnas kyi lha khang bzhengs/ de'i 231

ga tsheg 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/ ()yan lag tu dge drung gi lha khang btab/ de'i sgrub pa rtse'i brag phug tu byas so/ /dpyi mgo g.yon gnon pa'i phyir du/ grub pa rgyal dri med rnam dag gi lha khang bzhengs/ de'i yan lag tu 'bre'i lha khang btab/ de'i sgrub pa rgyang gi brag phugasatu byas so/ /de nas yang 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi brtsigs pa ni/ gre mo g.yabarteganon pa'i phyir/shar stag gi mgo steng du/ kong po bu chu'i lha khang bzhengs/ gromo g.yon gnon pa'i phyir/ sto 'brug gi ze steng du/ sto brag mkhon mthing gi lha khang bzhengs/ bus mo g.yas gnon pa'i phyir/ nub phyogs bya dmar po'i sga steng du/ byams chen dge rgyas kyi lha khang bzhengs/ pus mo g.yon gnon pa'i phyir/ byang rus sbal gyi dpral steng du/ pra ngan tse'i lha khang bzhengs/ des kyangam thub dogs na/ ru gnon gyi lha khang bzhi bzhengs te/ lag mthil g.yasaganon pa'i phyir/ khams su glang thang sgron ma'i lha khang mi nyag gis lag dpon byas nas bzhengs/ lag 'thil g.yon gnon pa'i phyir/ rnya phyogs su bum thangaskyer chu'i lha khang tho dkar gyis lag dpon byas nas bzhengs/ rkang mthilagayas gnon pa'i phyir/ nub dpal kha che'i gnas su/ mtshal rig shes rangasgron ma'i lha khang bal pos lag dpon byas nas bzhengs/ rkang mthil g.yon gnon pa la/ byang phyogs su tshangs pa rlung non gyi lha khang hor sba dpal dbyangasakyis lag dpon byas nas bzhengs so/ /gzhan yang shar du ka chu/ dang chu/ gling chu gsum/ nyi zla gza' skar gtan la 'bebs pa'i phyir du bzhengs so/ /sto rusnyal snang gro lha khang / gling thang gnyis/ me lha drang srong bsgrubs te me'i khoganon du bzhengs/ nub tu gu lang shing khun gnyis/ bal bod kyi so mtshams252

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// bsrungs te chu'i kha gnon du bzhengs/ byang du dge ri dang dpal ri gnyis/ lha klu 'dre srin dam la btags te rlung gi kha gnon du bzhengs/ de rnams bzhedasapa'i byin rlabs kyis/ nyi 'og gi rgyal khams zil gyis mnan te/ ra sa phral snang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa la/ 'gal rkyen bar chad med par lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /de nas khri btsun dang kong jo gnyis kyis/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang dang / rgya stag ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang gnyis kyi ri mo gang dang spyi yongs su rdzogs pa rnams la zla ba bcu gnyis re 'gor te lhan du tshar ro / / rgyal pos kyang mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang rnams yongasasu rdzogs pa tshar te/ slar khra 'brug tu phebs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la bkur sti dang / phu dud du mdzad nas/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags yod pa tsam la yang / mgo'i thod ltar du khur zhing gus pas phyag byed la/ nga'i blon 'bangs rnams kyis kyang de bzhin gyis shig gsungs te/ phyi rol du byon pa dang / sbrul bsad pa'i sdig bshags su bzhengs pa'i mchod rten rtse lnga de'i drung na / sprang ban rgan po gcig bla gos hrul po zhig bting nas shig thu gin 'dug pa rgyal pos gzigs pa dang / sprang ban de la rab tu byung ba'i rtags 'dug par mkhyen nas/ rgyal pos phyag mdzad do/ /der rgyal po'i zhal nas/bdag ni rgyal khams la dbang thob pa'i rgyal po zhig yin na'ang mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba lta bu zhig byed par 'dod nas/ gtsug lag khang mang po brtsigs/ de rnams kyi nang du sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang po bzhengs nas mchod pa byas/ rab tu byung ba'i253

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/()rtags yod tsam la'ang phyag byed par dam bcas pa yin pas de ngo mtshar mi che'am gsungs pas/ sprang ban de langs te bla gos hrul po de dpung pa lagazar nas/ rgyal po khyed sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dgongs nas rab tu byung ba la mos gus mdzad de/ bdag sprang ban la phyag mdzad pa de ngo mtshar che ste/nga'i 'di'ang ngo mtshar mi che'am gsungs nas/ mchod rten rtse lnga de lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga'i steng du blangs te bskor ba gcig byas so/ /der rgyal po cung zhig skyengs par gyur nas/ dbu'i la thod phud de/ a mi ṣ+ṭha ba'i zhal bstan nas/ khyed kyi de ngo mtshar che ste/ nga'i 'di'ang ngo mtshar mi che'am gsungs pas/yang sprang ban des brang sgo phye/ mtshon mas brang gshags te/ kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha thams cad byang khog nang du bzhugs pa bstan nas/ rgyal po khyed la lha gcig las mi 'dug nga la 'di tsam yod/ 'di ngo mtshar mi che'am zer bas/ rgyal po shin tu dgyes shing dad par gyur nas mchod gnas su mdzad do / / der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ rab tu byung ba rnams ni bla gos hrul po'am cha lugs dang spyod lam ci 'dra na'ang / log par lta ba ma byed par mos gus gyisashig dper na 'di lta bu'o zhes zhal gdams so/ /mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi lha snang sang / 'phrul snang ra mo che rnams legs par bzhedas pa'i le'u ste bstob paX/khyo/ /lnga/ pa/ lha sa gnyis dang / mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang tshar nas rab tu gnas par mdzad pa'i skor/ de nas khri btsun dang kong jo gnyis kyis gtsug lag khang legs dī/ bzhengs pas yongs su rdzogs par

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// tshar te/ rgyal po spyan drangs nas/ po ta la'i rtser phebs so/ /de'i sang khri btsun gyis gtsug lag khang gzigs par 'bul ba la/ sbos dang rol mo sna tshogs pa dang bcas te/ rgyal po blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'phrul snang du spyan drangasaso / / der khri btsun gyis lha khang gi sgo phyes nas/ rgyal po nang du byon par bzhed pa la mthil gyi zha la chu'i mdog lta bu/ steng phyogs kyi gzugs brnyan thamasacad de la shar ba gzigs pas/ sngar gyi mtsho 'di brdol 'dug dgongs nas/nang du 'byon ma nus pa dang / khri btsun gyis sor gdub phud de gtor bas/khyag thog khar rde'u bskur ba bzhin khrol gyis song ba dang / rgyal pos gzigasapas thugs ches te nang du byon no/ /der khri btsun la khyed kyi lha khang 'di 'phrul du snang ngo gsungs/ dang po ra la sa bkal nas mtsho bsrubs/ de nas rgyal pos 'phrul du snang ngo gsungs pas/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang zhesayongs su grags so/ /de ltar rgyal pos lha khang nang gi ngo mtshar che ba rnamasagazigs pas/ 'di lta ste/ngo mtshar 'gran med rgyal ba'i gzhal yas khang / /yon tan mtha' yas rab tu mdzes pa ste//gzhi ma gru bzhi lhun gyis grub pa la//zur chen bzhi ni g.yung drung ris su byas/ /sgo yi ri bzhi dkyil 'khor lta bur bzos/ /mthil gyi zha la baiḍūr+ya yi mdog /steng gi ri mo nya dang chu srin rnams//me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ji bzhin no/ /steng 'og gnyis kyi ka ba thamasacad ni/ /rab tu mdzes pa rdo rje phur pa'i bzo/ /ka gzhu gdung dang gdung khebs mchod rten brtsegs/ /bzo yi rnam 'gyur ngo mtshar 'gran zla med/ /phyi nang gab spangs ka gzhu thams cad la2/55/sngon gyi sgrung brgyud gsal bar 'bur

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa 'i chos 'byung sa bsdus/()du brkos/ /steng 'og gnyis kyi mthongs kha'i lcam sna la/ /seng ge dkar yogayu ral rgyan dang bcas/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni mchong ba'i tshul du gzigs/ /de yi steng du mu tig dra ba can/ /g.yu pad sngon po in+d+ra ni la'i mdog /steng ṣ+ka rtsig pa pha gu dra phyed dang / /mda' yab bu shu rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes/ /'od zer stong ldan gser gyi gañdzi ra/ /sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan du ma dang / /rnga yab dril bu g.yer kha'i rgyan dang bcas/ khor yug kun tu lcags kyi thag pasangasbrel/ /de ltar ngo mtshar dpag med rgyan bkod pa'i/ /'og gi btsan khangadabus ma'i gzhal yas na/ /'gro ba skyob mdzad skyabs sbyin phyag rgya can/ /de du kyi gtso bo de sang gyi mi 'gro gsung byon yin/mtshan dpes rab brgyan tshogs gnyisadapal gyis brdzid/ /sangs rgyas mar me mdzad ni sprul sku la/ /'khor ni nye ba'i sras brgyad bzhengs pas bskor/khro bo gnyis kyis sgo srung mdzad pa gzigs/ /btsan khang g.yas na sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ /li khri'i mdog can mnyamakhagazhag phyag rgya can/ /ngo mtshar dpag med mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ /spyan ras gzigs dang mthu chen thob la sogs/ /nye ba'i sras brgyad 'khor gyisabaskor ba ni/ /pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje phyed krung bzhugs/ /sgo 'gram g.yas na gsang ba'i bdag po ni/ /nam mkha'i mdog can rdo rje mkha' la phyar/ /sgo 'gram g.yon na khro rgyal smre brtsegs ni/ /byi ru'i mdog can grib sel tshul du bzhugs/ /btsan khang g.yon na rje btsun byams pa ni//chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyag rgya can//gur gum mdog can mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis ba jid/ /phyi nang mchod pa'i lha mos bskor ba ni/2/༵ mtshar dpag med rab mdzes 'gying

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung ga la ba'i me long bzhugs so// ba'i tshul/ /pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje phyed krung bzhugs/ /btsan khang lho na mi bskyod rdo rje ni/ /mtshan dpes rab brgyan sa gnon mnyam gzhag can/ /'od stong 'bar ba gser gyi lhun po ltar/ /rab tu brdzid pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba ni / / stong chen rab 'joms zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ /so sor 'brang ma zhal gcig phyag drug yin/ /gshin rje mthar byed zhabs drug brkyang bskum tshul/ /sku mdog mthing nag zhal drug shin tu khros/ /phyag drug mtshon cha du ma bsnamasapa'o/ shes rab mthar byed sku mdog dkar po ste/ /zhal bzhi phyag brgyad brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /pad+ma mthar byed pad+ma rā ga'i mdog/zhal gcig phyag bzhi rab tu khros pa'i tshul/ /bgegs mthar byed ni mthing nag rngams pa'i tshul/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi bgegs dpung 'joms par mdzad/ /sgo 'gram gnyis na rnam sras bha la/ /sku mdog ser po dbul phongs sel ba'i phyir/ /phyag g.yas rin chen g.yon na rne'u le 'dzin/ /phyi sgo'i 'gram gyi klu yi khang pa na / / klu chen gsum ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis te/ /sprul gyi gdengs ka semasadapa'i skyil krung bcas/ /sku mdog dkar dang dmar dang dmar ser yin/ /sgo 'gram g.yas kyi gnod sbyin khang pa na/ /srin mo laṅka mgrin bcu dbu dgu ste/ /rta mgos dpang bstod sku mdog mthing ga'o/ /gnod sbyin dri za gnyis ni sku mdog dmar/ /zhal gsum phyag bzhi sems dpa'i skyil krung bcas/ /sgo khang steng na sangs rgyas rabs bdun ni/ /mtshan dpes rab brgyan sprul sku'i tshul du bzhugs/ /'og khang logs la rgyal ba'i sku gzugs ni/ /lha yi ri mo gang la ci 'dul gling / /thugs rje chen po 'ji/5 7 brgyad skyob dang / /'jam dbyangs

brtse chen 'od snang las/4skya'i chos 'byung gce4bsdus/()gtso 'khor lnga yi zhing bkod dang / /bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa gzigs/ /lho nub g.yu drung khug na rigs gsum mgon/ /nub phyogs ka tshigs rgyal ba rigs lnga dang / /'gro don mtha' yas rgyal po'i mdzad pa bris/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas 'khor gyis bskor ba ni/ /nub byang g.yu drung khug gi ri mo yin/ /byang dang byang shar mtshams kyi ri mo la/ /thub pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis rdzogasapar yod/ shar gyi logs la sgrol ma spyan ras gzigs/ /thub pa bdud 'dul sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas/ shar lho g.yu drung khug gi ri mo la /bcom ldan sman gyi rgyal po'i lha tshogs bzhugs/ /sgrol ma rta mgrin dkar po la sogs pa'i/ /bar khang nang gi ri mo phal cher ni/ /be bum brgya dang rtsabargyad ji bzhin bris/ /sna tshogs tshon gyi ri mo khra ba sogs/ /de rnams rgyalapos gzigs pas dgyes par gyur/ shar lho'i lcog la seng gi gru skas byas/ /g.yung drung khug der dpal lha'i rten zhig btsugs/ /btsan khang byang ma ngo mtshar mdzes pa la/ /de na lha yi bdag bzung mi 'dug pas/ /sprul pa'i rgyal po de yi dgongs pa la/ /po ta ri nas rang byon bcu gcig zhal/ mang rtar spyan drangs rol mo'i rgyan dang bcas/ /btsan khang byang mar bzhugs dgos dgongasapa la/ /de yi nub mo rang byon gtso 'khor rnams/ /lha yi rol mos bsu ba byasanas ni/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis mkha' la gshegs nas kyang / /btsan khang byang mar gdan khri med par bzhugs/ /'jig rten dbang phyug rgyan gyis mdzes pa dang / /jo mo khro gnyer can dang dbyangs can ma/ /bdud rtsi 'byil ba sgo 'gram g.yas su bzhugs/ kha rla pā ṇi mgri/ ༵ sngo ba dang / /rje btsun sgrol ma lha mo

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//'od zer can/ /rta mgrin rgyal po sgo 'gram g.yon du bzhugs/ /de yi mod la ri dang bcas pa yi/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can rnam pa drag tu g.yos/ /lha rnams kun gyis me tog char pa phab/ /de nas rgyal po ya~X yum blon po'i tshogs/ /dad pa'i shugs kyis mchi mas gdong g.yogs shing / /rang rang mchod pa'i yo byad thogs nas ni/ /rab gus gdung bas phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub thob par gyur//'di yi gzhi bdag bstan pa bsrung ba la//klu rgyal dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo/ /srin po'i rgyal po lang ka mgrin bcu dang / /gnod sbyin dri za'i tshogs dang ku be ra/ /ma hā kā la dpal gyi lha mo sogs/ /lha khang bstan pa srung ba'i bdag por bskos/ /zhes so/ /de nas rgya mo bzas kyang / rgyal po ra mo cher gdan drangs te/ lha khang gzigs su phul bas shin tu dgyes par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal pos 'phrul snang dang / ra mo che gnyis la rab tu gnas pa mdzad par dgongs nas/ dga' ston gyi chas rgya chen po dang / mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshams te/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / rol mo sna tshogs pa dang bcas nas/ de nas rgyal pos dkyil 'khor gyi steng du byon/ phyag tu me tog bzung / thar mo sbyar te bden pa'i tshig brjod pa ni/ rkang gnyis gtso bo thub dbang shākya'i sras/ /grangs med sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa la sogs pa'i/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis bde legs stsol/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje ldan pa'i chu rgyun gyis/ /gang la gang 'dul smin ci( grol bar mdzad/ /rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang la //sdu pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/()kyis bde legs stsol/ /rnam dag dri ma med pa rgyal ba'i bka'/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhis dam chos rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal sras gnas brtan rab 'byor la sogs pa'i/ /'phags pa'i nyan thos rnams kyis bde legs stsol/ /gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad na/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ /gnasa'adir dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/skad cig nyid la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang dpa' bo dang dpa' mo/ dam pa chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa thams cad nyi zer gyi rdul tsam lhags te/ sprin dang na bun bzhin du 'thibs par gyur to/ /de nas sangs rgyasathams cad kyis me tog gtor nas byin gyis brlabs par mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod nas rab tu gnas par mdzad do/ /tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa'i lha rnams kyis me tog gi char chen po phab cing / lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyis kyang gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / lhab lhub dang / rin po che'i phreng ba la sogs pa'i rgyan du ma dang /lha'i rnga bo che dang / gling bu dang / khar rnga dang / cang te'u dang / rol mo'i tshogasadu ma 'brol zhing / lha'i spos dri zhim po rnams kyang / ma la ya'i rlung dal busakhyer ba ltar phyogs bcur khyab pas dri zhim mo/ /lha'i bu dang bu mo de rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu sgra phyung ste/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa gcig bsdus pa'i/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /mtha' 'khob yul der bstan pa rgyas bya'i phyir/ /'phags pa 2)spya ni mi yi bdag por gzungs/ /rig

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long tham chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//gzugs yon tan dpal gyis mngon par mtho/ /srong btsan sgom po sangs rgyasasprul pa'i sku/ /chos rgyal khyed kyi gtsug lag khang gnyis la/ /sangs rgyasarnams kyis rab tu gnas par mdzad/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shi brjod/ /lha rnams kun gyis mchod pa rgya chen phul/ /nam mkha' la ni me tog char pa phab/ /bar snang la ni bdug spos sprin bzhin gtibs/ /sa gzhi thams cad rin chen gcal du bkram/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs par btsugs/ /dam pa chos kyi rnga chen dam pa brdung / /de ring mkha' la chos kyi nyi ma shar/ /de ring dpal gyis sgron mes kun la khyab/ /de ring rgyal pos dbang bskur byin rlabs thob/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyis ma smo'i kha bye ltar/ /de ring blo yi mun pa rab tu bsal/ /dbul pos nor gyi gter kha rnyed pa bzhin/ /chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' khyed kyis ni/ /thugs kyi dbang po dga' bdes tshim par mdzod/ /ces zer te mi snang ba gyur to/ /de ltar 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang dang / ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang gnyis la/ rab tu gnas pa lhan gcig tu lhun gyis grub par mdzad do/ /tshul de lta bu'i gsal la ngos bzung med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu'am/ chu nang gi zla ba lta bur/rje blon 'bangs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mngon sum du mthong bar gyur te/dga' zhing mgu la yi rangs bar gyur to/ /de ltar dga' ston rgya chen po mdzad nas/ bod 'bangs thams cad dang mthun par/ glu gar la sogs pa ltad mo bsam gyis mi khyab par mdzad do/ /de'i dus su rgyal po dga' ston gyi gdan sar rin po che'i khri steng na bzhugs/ 6sdus/ yar la bzhengs te/ tshangs pa'i

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/()dbyangs lta bu'i gsungs phyung nas/ rgyal po dgyes pa'i glu blangs pa/ /thugasarje'i bdag nyid dkon mchog gsum/ /thar pa'i lam ston spyan ras gzigs/ /gus pas yid kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /bkra shis glu la dgongs su gsol/ /de ring mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /sprin phung lta bur bzhugs pa mthong / /bkra shis rab gnas lhun gyis grub/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha rnams kyis/ /sil snyan rol mo'i sgra yang 'brol/ /me tog pad+ma'i char bab pas/ /bkra shis rab gnas lhun gyis grub/ /sangs rgyasabastan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /nag po'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal/ /bdud dpung bcom pa'i mthu dpal gyis/ /bkra shis rab gnas lhun gyis grub/ /dam pa chos kyi rnga chen brdung / /dug lnga'i gti mug rang sar zhi/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rnga sgra yis/ /bkra shis rab gnas lhun gyis grub/ /de ring skyid pa'i nyi ma shar/ /rang dbang med pa'i dga' sems skyes/ /'dod rgu'i longs spyod char bzhin babs/ /bkra shis rab gnas lhun gyis grub/ /yi dam lha yi bkra shis kyis//srong btsan sgam po bkra shis pas//bkra shis glu ru blangs pa yin//nga yi bod 'bangs rnams la bkra shis shog /ces gsungs pa dang / btsun mo dang blon po bod 'bangs dang bcas pa thams cad dga' zhing mgu la yi rangs par gyur nas/ rgyal po la phyag byas shing mchod pa phul lo/ /de nas yang rgyal pos brag lha klu sbugs su lha khang bzhengs te/ rten gyi gtso bo thub pa brag lha mgon po/ de'i g.yas na shā ri'i bu dang / g.yon na mo gal gyi bu/ de'i g.yasan byams pa/ g.yon na spyan ras gaX6 2 / gtso 'khor lnga brag la gsal

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long tham chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// bar byon na'ang / ma 'ongs pa'i sems can bsod nams bsog pa'i phyir du/bal po'i lha bzos 'bur du brkos/ bskor khang brag la brko ba la/ bod 'bangs rnams kyis legs par brkos te/ tshwa la drug cu bed yod pa'i skabs su / brag phye bre re phed pa la/ rgyal pos tshwa bre re brngan par byin/ bre phyed tsam phed kyang / brag phye dang tshwa brje po byas te/ lha khang du lha'i ri mo la sogs pa legs par tshar nas rab tu gnas pa mdzad do/ /lha sa rnam gnyis dang /mtha' 'dul dang yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang la sogs pa legs par tshar nas rab tu gnas pa mdzad pa'i le'u ste bco lnga pa'o// //bas drug phan pa dang bde ba 'byung ba'i phyir/ gter sbas pa dang bod 'bangs thams cad chos la bkod par mdzad pa'i skor/ de nas rgya mo bza' dang bal mo bza' gnyis la sras ma 'khrungs par/ zhad zhung bza' bya ba khab tu bzhes/ de la sras ma 'khrungs/ des thim bu skog pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ 'di lcags kha khong na yod/ de nas ru yong bza' bya ba khab tu bzhes/ de la sras ma gzungs/ des mig mangs tshal gyi lha khang bzhengs/ 'di go sha gling na yod/ de nas mi nyag bza' bya ba khab tu bzhes/ de la'ang sras ma 'khrungs/ des kha brag gser gyi lha khang bzhengs/ 'di mkhar sna gdong na yod/ de nas stod lung mang gi nang nas/ mang bza' khri lcam bya ba khab tu bzhes/ de la sras gcig gcings par lung bstan te/ zla ba dgu ngo bcu lon pa na/ sras gung ri gung btsan zhes pa/ rgyal po'i gdung brgyud 'gran zla dang bral ba gcig lcags mo sbrul gyi lo la brag lha bkra shis kyi ga~X yas khang du 'khrungs te/ btsas ston

nga tshe chen 'od snang las/sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()rgya chen po mdzad nas thams cad dga' bar gyur to/ /yum sras de gnyis kyi thugs dam du yer pa'i gnas ri brag gi dbyibs ni 'phags ma sgrol ma bzhugs pa 'dra ba'i pang du lha khang dang mchod rten bzhengs te/ rab tu gnasapa mdzad nas ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang dang / bstan pa'i srog rtsa gcig par yab kyis smon lam btab bo/ /de nas rgyal pos bod 'bangs rnams dge ba bcu'i khrims la gnas par mdzad pa'i phyir du/ skrag cing 'jigs pa'i khrims rar 'chas te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod pa byasapa dang / bod khrims las 'gal ba byas pa rnams la chad pa gcod pa yin no zhes bsgrags nas sprul pa mdzad de/ mi ma yin rnams la bcing ba dang / brdeg pa dang / mig 'don pa dang / skyid pa gcod pa la sogs pa mdzad de/ don la grub pa med kyang / thams cad dngangs skrag bskyed pa'i thabs mdzad nas/ dge bcu'i khrims la bkod do/ /de'i tshe li yul lcang ra smug po na/ dge tshul gnyisakyis 'phags pa 'jam dpal lo brgyad kyi bar du bsgrubs pas/ ma 'grub par nam mkha' nas sgra byung ste/ dge tshul khyed gnyis dang 'jam dbyangs las 'brel med pas dngos grub brnyes par dka'/ khyed gnyis kyi lha 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yin pas/ 'phags pa de da lta bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams na / bod kyi rgyal po ru sku sprul yod/ der song dang zhal dngos su mjal bar yod do zhes lung bstan te mi snang bar gyur to/ /de thos pa tsam gyis dge tshul gnyis po'i lus kyi ba spu rab tu g.yos par gyur to/ /lus dang srog la mi blta bar rgyags phye khur nas bod du 'ong/ 61/ /der stod lung mda' brgal ba'i

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhug so// 'phrang la slebs pa dang / chu'i 'gram na mi'i ro mgo med pa dang / mig med pa mang po bya khyis za gyin 'dug pa mthong ngo / /der dge tshul gnyis the tshom du gyur te/ bod kyi mi la gtam byas nas/ rgyal po gang na bzhugs/ ro 'di rnams la ci byung ba yin byas pas/ bod kyi mi na re/ rgyal po lha san bzhugs/ ro 'di rnams khrims las 'gal ba la rgyal pos chad pa bcad pa yin zer bas dge tshul gnyis log lta skyes te/ sbyan ras gzigs bdud du 'dug pa/ mi 'di tsam gsod pa/ nged rang gnyis log la 'dong zer te log go /der rgyal pos khong gnyis kyi bsam pa mkhyen nas/ blon po 'bri se ru gong ston la/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ rta zhen la mgyogs par song shig stod lung mda' na rab tu byung ba'i rtags mgo la skra med pa/ gos ngur smig gru bzhi gon pa'i mi gnyis nga'i drung du 'ong rgyu yin pa log lta skyes nas phyir log song yod pas/ zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dir khrid shog gsung ngo / /der blon pos rjes zin te/ khong gnyis shin tu skrag par gyur pa la/ zhi ba'i gtam smras nas rgyal po'i drung du khrid 'ongs so/ /der rgyal pos dge tshul gnyis la phyag mdzad de/ de nas rgyal pos zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te/ dge tshul khyed gnyis kyis bod du ci la 'ong gsungs pas/dge tshul gnyis na re/ nged gnyis li'i yul nas 'ongs pa yin te/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal lo brgyad kyi bar bsgrubs pas ma 'grub par nam mkha' nas sgra byung ste khyod gnyis kyi lha 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yin pas/ 'phags pa de da lta bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams na rgyal po zhig tu sprul yod/ der song dang zhal dngos su mjal bar yod /sbyangs pas/ nged gnyis kyis lus dang

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()srog la ma bltas par bod du 'ong ba yin/ lam kha na mi ro mang po 'dug pasabod kyi mi la dris pas/ rgyal pos khrims las 'gal ba la chad pa bcad pa yin zer bas/ nged gnyis skrag nas phyir log pa yin zer ro/ /der rgyal posakhong gnyis la bza' btung gis tshim par byas nas/ dbu'i thod phud de/ a mi khya ba'i zhal bstan nas/ nga ni bod kyi rgyal po thugs rje chen po yin/ ngas rgyal srid bzung nas da lta phan la sems can la phan btags nas/ thar pa byang chub kyi lam la 'khod pa ma gtogs/ gnod pa khab rtse gang yang skyel ma myong / bod kyi mi 'di rnams spre'u dang brag srin las chad pa yin pas/ drag po'i sprul pa byas pa yin gsungs te/ rtse gol brdab pas/ ro rnams 'ja' yal ba bzhin song ngo / /der dge tshul gnyis dad cing gus par gyur te/ rgyal po wo po nged gnyis lam thag ring nas dka' ba spyad 'ongs pa chos go sla ba'i phyir/ don gsum la 'dus pa'i gdams(pa zhig zhu zhus pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas dge tshul gnyis nyon cig chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba hril gyis dril na don gsum la 'dus te/ lus kyi sgo nas thog gcod pa dang / ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa la sogs pa spangs te/ dkon mchog gsum gyi drung du phyag dang bsgor ba gyis la bde 'gro mtho ris thob pa'i rten du tshul khrims kyi nor bu gces par 'dzin cig bslab pa rin po che'i rgyan dang nam du yang mi 'bral bar gyis shig ngag gi sgo nas rdzun phra ma/ tshig rtsub mo smra ba la sogs pa spangs te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba bsdus pa'i /sdu po/ dge legs dang yon tan thams

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ba ma chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//cad kyi gter mdzod/ phan bde'i dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ gsung mchog yi ge drug pa la bzlas brjod gyis shig yid kyi sgo nas brnab sems/gnod sems/ log par lta ba la sogs spangs te/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhid / khams gsum rig drug na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad rang gi pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pas/ de rnams kyi sdug bsngal bzod thabs med pa rnams rang gi rgyud thog tu len pa'i 'dun pa drag po dang bcas shing / rang gi phan bde gang yod de rnams la ster la/ bdag bas gzhan gces bsgom pa'i bsam pa bzang po dang ldan te/ mdor na byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang skad cig kyang ma bral bar gyis shig chos bzang las bsam bzang lhag pa yin no/ /don 'di gsum dang ldan na tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /don 'di gsum rang rgyud la med na/bka' mdo rgyud lung man ngag thams cad blo la yod kyang / kha chos yin zhing snying po med gsungs so/ /de nas rgyal pos dge tshul de gnyis la thugs rje 'a po'i chos skor gsum dang / mdo pad+ma dkar po dang / yi ge drug pa'i phan yon rnams gsungs nas/ thar pa byang chub kyi lam la 'khod par mdzad do/ /de nas dge tshul gnyis po/ dga' zhing mgu la yi rangs par gyur nas/ rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag byas te/ 'di skad ces gsol to//kye ma chos rgyal sprul pa'i sku//ār+ya pā lo thugs rje can/ /yul du 'gro bas skyel ma zhu/ /zer bas rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyed gnyis gegasa'i med par skad cig la yul du sleb par 'dod dam gsungs pas/ dge tshul gnyis / ༵/ ci nas kyang dka' tshegs med par

brtse chen 'od snang las/skya'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/()yul du sleb par 'dod lags zer bas/ rgyal pos khong gnyis kyi thu bar bye ma bre re byugs nas gser 'gyur gyi byin gyis brlabs te/ khong gnyis kyi mgo la phyag bzhag nas yo byad gang yod sngas su chug la/ khyed rang gnyis kyi yul yid la dran pa gyis la nyol cig gsung ngo / /der khong gnyis kyis de ltar byas nas nyal bas gnyid thum pa zhig song ba dang / khong rang gnyis kyi yul na sleb 'dug go /thu ba'i bye ma de gser du song / skye ba phyi mar de gnyis kyis dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /de nas sras gung ri gung btsan dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes nas/ rgyal srid bzung btsun mo khab tu bzhes pas/ srasamang srong mang btsan bya ba me pho khyi'i lo la 'byungs so/ /gung ri gung btsan gyisargyal srid lo lnga bzung / dgung lo bco brgyad bzhes dus/ po ta la ru sku gshegs so/ /gung ri gung btsan yab kyi gong du 'das/ /de yi bang so don mkhar mda' ru brtsig /gral ni gnam ri srong btsan g.yon na yod/ /ming ni gung chen gung ri lags so skad/ /de nas slar yab rgyal pos rgyal srid bzung ste / bde skyid dang ldan par mdzad do/ /de nas yang rgyal po'i thugs la nga'i ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang dang / rgya stag ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang gnyis la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan dgos te/ rin po che'i gling lta bu sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / dpa' bo dang / dpa' mo ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma re yang tha mal pa'i gzugs su sprul nas rgyun du gnas pa dang / bod yul gyi gtsug lag khang thams cad las mngon par sdu/ zhing mtha' yas pa'i yon tan du ma

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ngam cho 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhug so//dang ldan pa/ gdul bya longs spyod nam mkha' dang mnyam shing / gang la gang 'dod yid bzhin du 'byung ba/ mtha'i nor thams cad gnas 'dir 'du zhing /mtha' bzhi la rnam par rgyal ba/ bod yul na 'gran zla dang bral zhing / 'od dang 'od zer phyogs bcur khyab pa/ snyan pa dang grags pas ni sa'i steng thamasacad khyab ste/ byin rlabs ni nyi zla'i 'od dang mchas/ rin po che dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / gser dang / dngul dang / dbyig dang / rgyan dang / gos dang /zang zing gi long spyod ni char bzhin du 'bab pa/ yon tan du ma dang ldan par byed pa la sa'i yon tan bltas nas gter zhed dgos te/ de yang dper na yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram na/ grong dang grong khyer ci yod kyang / de'i mthu la brten te/ 'byor pa dang ldan pa yod pa ltar/ rin po che'i gter yod pa'i gnas der yang / 'byor pa longs spyod rang bshin gyisa'ong bas/ ma 'ongs pa'i bod 'bangs rnams kyi don du gter sbas pa ni/ ka ba bum pa can dang nye ba'i sar/ dam pa chos kyi gter sbas so/ /de'i yon tan ni bod kyi yul 'dir ma 'ongs pa'i dus su/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba bzhin 'byung ste/ dam chos la longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /ka ba shing lo can dang nye ba'i sar/ /gser dngul rin po che'i gter sbas so/ /de sbas pa'i yon tan ni/ mtha'i nor thams cad dbus su 'du zhing / gser dngul la longasaspyod par 'gyur ro/ /ka ba sbrul mgo can dang nye ba'i sar/ drag sngags mthu'i gter sbas so/ /de sbas pa'i yon tan ni/ mtha' dmag dang / bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad mi 'byung bar ༷// ro/ /ka ba seng mgo can dang nye ba'i

ba chen 'od snang las/sa 'i chos 'byung ka ces bsdus/()sar/ byol song phyugs kyi g.yang yig rnams sbas so/ /de sbas pa'i yon tan ni/bcan phyugs 'phel ba dang / dkar thog bcud dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rin po che rat+na de ba/ gzi'i sgrom bur bcug nas dar zab sna lngas dril la dra la'i 'og tu sbas so/ /de'i yon to ni/ rgyan dang / gos dang / nor dang / 'bru la sogs pa gang la ci 'dod pa thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rin po che stag sha de ba sprul gyi lpags pas gtums nas klu khang du sbas so/ /de'i yon tan ni/lo phyugs rtag tu legs shing char chu dus su 'bab ste/ sa bdag klu'i gnod pa mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /be+eḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed zas sna dpag tu med pas bkang ste / gnod sbyin khang par sbas so/ /de'i yon tan ni/ bza' btung gi longasaspyod gang la ci 'dod pa thams cad 'byung zhing / zas bcud dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /ra sa'i gtsug lag khang la zhig ral byung na gso ba dang / mchod pa rgyun ring por bya ba'i phyir/ gser dang dngul dang rin po che sna tshogs las zangs chen po zhig bkang ste/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i 'og tu sbas so/ /lasadang skal bar ldan pa'i gang zag la smon lam btab bo/ /gzhan yang sa cha 'od dang ldan pa dang / char chu dus su 'bab ste/ 'bru sna smin pa/ than pa dang / sad dang / ser ba dang / btsa' dang / mu ge mi 'byung ba dang / nad yams dang /mtha' dmag gi gnod pa mi 'byung zhing / dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du bkra shis shing / dge legs kyis khyab par bya ba'i phyir/ rin po che gser dngul la sogs pa rnams rin po che'i snod du dar zab sna tshogs kyis dril nas bcug gnod sbyin khang pa dang / klu ༷/ 0dang / lha khang gi nang skor thams cad

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//du sbas so/ /'di dag ni zur tsam yin gyis/ gter sbas lugs rnams rgyas par shes 'dod na/ rgyal po bka'i thang yig la gzigs shig de nas rgyal po'i zhal nas/ gter 'di rnams sbas pa'i yon tan ni/ nga'i gtsug lag khang 'di la snyan pa dang grags pa ni nyi zlas slebs pa'i gnas su khyab ste/ 'dzam bu gling na 'gran zla dang bral ba yin no/ /gdul bya dang zhabs tog mtha' nas rgyas te/mtha' mi thams cad dbang du 'dus nas/ dpal 'byor nam mkha' dang mnyam pa yin no/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus su nga'i dbon sras dang / btsun mo blon po bod 'bangs thams cad kyis gtsug lag khang bzhengs par 'dod na/ nga'i ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang 'dir sa phud dang / rdo phud bskyal nas rab gnas lhun gyis grub cing bdud dang log 'dren gyi bgegs med par bkra shis shing yon tan du ma dang ldan par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /de nas rgyal pos lha sa rne'u thang du dbon sras mang srong mang btsan gyi dbu la phyag bzhag nas/ spang skong phyag brgya pa dang / mdo pad+ma dkar po dang / dam chos zla ba sgron ma dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub skor bshad rgyud rnams dang / ma 'ongs pa gab pa mngon du phyung ba dang / lha sar zhabs tog byas pa/ phyag dang mchod pa bskor ba byas pa/ mthong thos dran reg gi yon tan bstan pa/ phyi'i rag gso ba dang / nang gi lha la zhabs tog byas pa la phan yon yod pa rnams legs par gsungs te/ sras kyis yi ger bris nas gnod sbyin khang par gter du sbas so//gzhan yang nga nas gdung rabs lnga pa na/ rgyal po khri dang lde zhes bya ba 'byung ste/de'i dus su rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍita ma ṭ+wāṃ byon nas dam pa'i chos thams cad

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa 'i chos 'byung ba rjes bsdus/()bsgyur zhing yang dag par gtan la 'bebs/ gtsug lag khang mang po bzhedas/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur te/ rab tu byung ba bslab pa gsum gyi rgyan gyis rab tu mdzes pa/ ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan gsol ba mang po 'byung bar 'dug ste/ nga'i dbon sras rnams kyi dbu'i mchod gnas byed/ 'tsho ba blang nas sbyor phan bde dang dge legs thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pas/ blon po mgar gyis de ma thag tu zangs kyi byang bu la bris nas/'ching phu'i dkor mdzod du sbas so/ /gzhan yang phyi blon/ nang blon/ bod 'bangs kyi skyes pa dang bud med/ byis pa yan la rim pa bzhin du 'jig rten la dgos pa'i zhal gdams dpag tu med pa gsungs nas/ thugs rje chen po'i bskyed rim gyis/ yi ge drug pa'i chos la bkod do/ /'di yang blon po 'bri rtses gong ston gyis/ma 'ong pa'i bod 'bang rnams la phan pa'i phyir yi ger bri bzhag go/gsan yang rgyal po nyid kyi rnam thar rnams la rgyas 'bring gsum du mdzad/ shog dril gsum byas nas ka ba bum pa can gyi 'og tu sbas te/ las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gang zag la smon lam btab bo/ /de nas rgyal po dang btsun mo'i mdzad pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs te/ bod kha ba can pa'i re zhig ltos pa'i pha ma lta bu / 'gro ba sgrol ba'i ded dpon lta bu/ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu lta bu/mun pa sel ba'i sgron me lta bu/ nye ring med pa'i nyi zla lta bur mdzad de/ lasathabs mkhas pas phyi na dgra med/ bka' drin bzang pos nang gi 'bangasarnams skyongs/ mnga' 'og gi bod 'bangs thams cad 'byor pa dang ldan zhing /dga' bde la longs spyod do/ /phan pa ༵༵ bde ba thams cad 'byung bar bya ba'i

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long tham chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhug so//phyir/ gter sbas pa dang bod 'bangs thams cad chos la bkod par mdzad pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //bcu bdun/ rgyal po yab yum gyi mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs te/ rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs kar thim pa'i skor/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ lha thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po la/ sras gung srong gung btsan gyis/ nangs par nyi ma shar ba dang dbu rtse'i yang thog tu yab rgyal po chen po la rang gi na bza' la bzhugs gdan byas nas zhal zas mang po drangs/ phyag dang bskor ba mang du byas nas zhu ba 'di skad ces gsol to/ /e ma ho/ sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las/ /snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs rje/ /bde ba can gyi pho nya/ /bod 'bangs yongs kyi skyabs gnas/ /bdag cag kun la thugs rjes gzigs pa yi/ /rgyal ba'i sku dang tha mal mjal/ /zab mo'i thugs dgongs snang mod kyang //chos nyid don gyi thugs rje de/ rgyal ba'i thugs la mi gab par/ gab pa mngon du phyung nas ni/ /rang snang yul med bstan du gsol/ /blo 'das byar med bstan du gsol/ /ma bcos ngang nas bstan nas kyang / /byar med ngang gis gnas pa la/ /sku gsum shugs las 'char ba yi/ /bdag cag blo la sbyar du gsol/ /zhes phyag 'tshal te zhus pa dang / der yab rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/ lha sras chen po nyon cigabadag ni sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las yin/ /snang ba mtha' yas drung du dam yang bcas/ /byang chub sems kyi bod 'bang don la 'ong / /nga dang rgyal ba gnyis su med/ /'gro ba nga yi 2 73 yin/ khyed kun 'phags pa'i byin

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()rlabs yin/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs rgyud zab mo rnams/ /'phags pa'i lam steg yin mod kyang / /chos nyid don gyi thugs rje de/ /blo dman rnams la bstan par mi 'os kyang / /brtse ba'i sems kyis gab pa mngon phyung 'di/ /ma rtogs sgro dang skur ba'i gzhi/ /skyabs med rnams la ye gsang chod/ /tsit+ta snying gi dkyil du chongs//chos nyid zad par skyel ba yang //nga yis legs par bstan gyis nyon//sna tshogs dag kyang rang snang yin/ /yul med de ni blo las 'das/ /blo 'das de ni byar med yin/ /ji bzhin pa yi ngang gnas yin/ /gnas pa med par lhod pa'i mchog /de ltar go ba'i gang zag gis/ /mtha' bral spros pa chod pa la/ /lta ba'i ming du btags pa yin/ /rang gsal 'dzin pa stong pa la/ /sgom pa ming du btags pa yin/ /don dang bral ba med pa la/ /spyod pa ming du btags pa yin/ /spang blang 'dzin pa zhig pa la/ /'bras bu ming du btags pa yin/ /rtsol med 'gro don byed pa la/ /thugs rje ming du btags pa yin/ /de la skyo dub med pa la/ /chen po ming du btags pa yin/ /'gro don mdzad kyang skyon ma gos/ /'phags pa ming du btags pa yin/ /snying rje dbang du 'dus pa la/ /rgyal po ming du btags pa yin/ /'gro ba'i kha lo snyoms pa la/ /srong btsan ming du btags pa yin/ /blo la gang phan bshad pa la/ /ga dmasang ga ming du btagasapa yin//brjed tho shul du bzhag pa la//bka' brgyud ming du btags pa yin//'gro ba dang ba 'dren pa la/ /gtsug lag ming du btags pa yin/ /rnam rtog rang sar grol ba la/ /sangs rgyas ming du btags pa yin/ /'gro ba lam du 'dzud pa la/ /dam chos ming du btaga~X yin/ /byar med blo la sbyor ba la/ /

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long mim chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//dge 'dun ming du btags pa yin/ /rtsol med rang lugs gnas pa la/ /byar med ming du btags pa yin/ /tha mal rtog pa bsgyur ba la/ /bskyed rim ming du btags pa yin/ /blo yi khrid thabs sna tshogs pa/ /chos spyod ming du btags pa yin/ /rtsa bral nang du shes pa la/ /go ba ming du btanas pa yin/ /don go gcig las med pa la/ /nyag gcig ming du btags pa yin/ /du ma ngo bo gcig pa la/ /chos sku ming du btags pa yin/ /dag snang lha ru snang ba la/ /longs sku ming du btags pa yin/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dren pa la/ /sprul sku ming du btags pa yin/ /rtog med rang sa zin pa la/ /mngon 'gyur ming du btags pa yin/ /btags pa thams cad ming yin gyis/ /ming ni 'dzin pa med par zhog /bsam pa thams cad blo yin gyis/ /blo yi byed pa shog la spong / /zhog ces bya ba tshig yin gyis/ /tshig gi 'dzin pa bor la thong / /thong zhes bya ba blo yin gyis/ /blo yi byed pa dbyings su sbos/ /sped pa bya ba bzang rtog yin/ /bzang ngan med par khad de ba/ /gab sbas med par lha nge ba/ /'gro 'ong med par gsal le ba/ /spang blang med par lhug ge ba/ /phyogs ris med par phyam me ba/ /btang bzung med par khyil le ba/ /gsal 'grib med pa lhang nge ba/ /brjed yeng med par tur re ba/ /gtang bzhag med par wal le ba/ /blo lasa'adas pa'i yul la stos/ /tshig las 'das pa'i don la ltos/ /bzang ngan med pa'i yul la ltos/ /phyi nang med par sems la stos/ /pho mo med pa'i sems la ltos/ /gnyis 'dzin bral ba'i don la ltos/ /don zhes bya ba blo las 'das/ /'das pa'i rjes su ma 'brang bar/ /blo shā/ bral ba'i ngang la ltos/ /bltas pas

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa 'i chos 'gung bslus bsdus/()mthong ba'i yul med kyis/ /ma bltas bzhag pas chos nyid mthong / /ma bsgrub bzhag pas sems nyid grub/ /ma bzung ma glod rang sar grol/ /de ltar mthong ba'i gang zag la/ /'khor 'das gnyis su ngas ma mthong / /dge sdig gnyis su ngas ma mthong / /bzang ngan gnyis su ngas ma mthong / /rtag chad gnyis su ngasam mthong //pho mo gnyis su ngas ma mthong //bde sdug gnyis su ngas ma mthong /yin min gnyis su ngas ma mthong / /nye ring gnyis su ngas ma mthong mtho dman gnyis su ngas ma mthong / /gsal 'grib gnyis su ngas ma mthong /mthong ba med pa'i rang nyid nas/ /sna tshogs shar ba rang nyid yin/ /sna tshogasa'agag pa med par zhog /sna tshogs 'dzin pa med par shog /sna tshogs spang blang med par zhog /sna tshogs 'dzin bral chos sku yin/ /ma 'gags gsal ba longs sku yin//sna tshogs bral ba sprul sku yin//tha mal rtog med chos sku yin//chos nyid 'dod pa tha mal yin/ /blo las 'das pa de nyid yin/ /'dod pa bral na don dang bral/ /gnyis 'dzin grol na gnas su rtogs/ /spang blang med na dngos grub thob/ /'gro don byed na phrin las rdzogs/ /blo thag chod na 'gro sar phyin/ /phyin pa med na brdol ba yin/ /de lta bu yi gang zag la/ /rig pa thamasacad rang rig yin/ mas pa thams cad rang shes yin/ /grol ba thams cad rang grol yin/ /gsal ba thams cad rang gsal yin/ /stong pa thams cad rang stong yin/ /'dug pa thams cad rang 'dug yin/ /gnas pa thams cad rang gnas yin/ /bde ba thams cad rang bde yin/ /sdug bsngal thams cad rang sdug yin/ /thams cad rang rig ༵༵ snang yin/ /sgom du med pas bsam

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long zhwam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//du med/ /rgyud la bya med yengs su med/ /bzhag rgyu med de btang rgyu med/ / brjed rgyu med de nor rgyu med/ /ye shes de la rgyun chad med/ /ting nge 'dzin la thun mtshams med/ /dmigs pa la yang btang bzung med/ /rnam rtog la yang bzang ngan med/ /yid yul la yang phyi nang med/ /dngos med la yang phyi nang med/ /re dogs spangs na skyon dang bral/ /'dod pa med pas thob pa med/ /rtsol ba med pas skyon rnams sangs/ /'bras bu la re mkhan med pas sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa zhig bsam brjod blo las 'das pas smra ba'i ngag dang bral/ de ltar du rang dbang thob tsa na/ brgyud pa rang gis zin/ grol cha nang nas rnyed/ gzung 'dzin mtshan ma zhig snang srid bka' brgyud du shes/ byed spyod chos spyod du 'gro/ mthong thos sku gsum du byon/ ye shes nang nas brtol/nyon mongs kun rang sar dag dad gus rang la tshud do/ /'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba rang rig tu shes/ skyid sdug gsal 'debs su shes/ bdag 'dzin chos skur grol lo/ /gzhi mthong bas lta ba med/ rtsad chod pas sgom du med/ rang gzin pas sgrub tu med/ rang sems ngo shes pas sangs rgyas med do/ shes rab rang brdol du byon pas/ wal le brjed med du 'dug pa/ sna tshogs 'gag med du grol ba/ tshor ba rjes med du sangs pas/ rig pa glan sar chags pas/ chosasku gcer mthong du grol ba/ rig pa rkyang ded du 'dug pas gnyis su med pa'i sku / rang snang chen po'i ngang la lus so/ /rang byung du yin pas lhun grub tu byung /rang gsal yin pas gting gsal du shar/ rang snang yin pas 'od gsal du snang / rang rig yin pas chos skur 2 7/7rang grol yin pas zangs thal du byung

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()ngo / / de yang rang gis ma byas par gzhan byed dam/ rang la bsam du med par gzhan la mtshon du rnyed dam/ rang ma rig par sems can thul lam/ 'du 'bral med par btsal bas rnyed dam/ phyin pa med par bsdad pas zin nam/dngos po med par lag tu lon nam/ bstan rgyu med par mig gis mthong ngam/da lta nga la yod pa'i steng la tshol lam/ gsal ba'i steng la lta'am/ grol ba'i steng la bshigs sam/ dag pa'i steng la 'khru'am/ ngoms pa'i steng la 'thung bam/ 'grang pa'i steng la za'am/dronas pa'i steng la sreg gam/ shes pa'i steng 'a/'thams sam/ de ltar sems la rgyu rkyen bral bas rtsol sgrub kyi blo dang bral te/dngos med la gnyen pos bcos su 'dug gam/ long med kyi snang ba ma thosapas/ rtag chad kyi snang ba rang sar dag gnyis 'dzan rang sar grol bas re dogs kyi mtha' spang / zhen 'dzin nang nas grol bas skye med rang sa zin/ rtog med nang nas mthong bas dgra bgegs rang sar thul lo/ /'o de ltar du rig pa rgya yan gnyen po med pa la ye shes rang snang gi spyod pa zer ba yin no/ /rtog med rang lugs gnas pa la spang blang med pa zer ba yin no/ /ye shes nang nasashar ba la rnam rtog rang grol zer ba yin no/ /yin min blo las 'das pa la dgag sgrub bral ba zer ba yin no/ /'bad rtsol ngos zin pa la chos nyid klong brdol zer ba yin no/ /lhun grub skye ba med pa la 'bras bu rang shar zer ba yin no/ /'o de ltar du go ba dang rtogs pa dus mnyam/ shes pa dang grol ba dusamanyam/ gsal ba dang mthong ba dus mnyam/ 'byar dang reg pa dus mnyam/brlan pa dang gsher ba dus mnyam/ /7 snyi ltar shes pa'i gang zag gis/ lta ba

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long sprom chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//la phyogs ris med kyis nam mkha' gon/ sgom pa la gsal 'grib med kyis nyi ma khur/ spyod pa la thog brdug med kyis rlung la zhen/ 'bras bu la blang dor med kyis gser gling ltos/ de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la/ lta ba la lta rgyu gda' ye/ bsgom pa la bsgom rgyu gda' ye/ spyod pa la spyod rgyu gda' ye/'bras bu la bsgrub rgyu gda' ye/ des na rig pa gshis thog tu skyel/ mtshan ma rang grol du thong / phyi nang gi 'dzin pa shigs/ bzang ngan gyi blang dor spangs/chags zhen gyi 'dzin pa khrol/ bzang 'dod kyi nga rgyal thong / 'gran sems kyi phrag dog khrol/ zhe sdang gi me chen gsod/ gti mug gi ma rig pa sangs/ byar med kyi ngang la yengs med du zhog gnyis 'dzin gyi blo ni nam mkha'i dbyings su rgyas thob/ don la bsgom rgyu med kyis rang sar zhag 'o de lta bu'i gang zag gis/ bskyed rim bsgom na yi dam lha ru 'gyur/ /rdzogs rim dran na gzung 'dzin mtshan ma zhig /zung 'brel 'dod na bar snang 'ja' tshon ltos/ /don go mthong na tha mal chos mi ltos/ /ma mthong bar du bka' brgyud bla ma bsten/ /chos spyod byed na rang 'dod zhen pa spangs/ /mi 'jig go cha 'dod na sgo gsum lha ru bsgyur/ /gzhan don byed na 'gro la phan sems bskyed/ /rang don bsgrubs na 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba spongs/ /dgra bgegs 'dul na rtsa bral snying rje bskyed/ /phyi ma bde 'bras 'dod na da lta dka' ba spyod/ /'gro ba dbang du sdud na bdag bas gzhan gces kyis/ /snyom las dran na 'chi ba mi rtag bsgom/ /chags zhen 'dzin pa byung na rmi lam sgyu ma bsgom/ /bar chad bdud kyis bred na rang sems gtan la phob/ /chos bzhi/ spyad na chos min thams cad spong / /nga

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(te/dang 'grogs kyang de las med/ /sangs rgyas gzhan dang mjal yang de bas med/ /ces chos skyong ba'i rgyal pos dgongs pa mngon du phyung ba dang / de nasadus de nyid du lha sras rje 'bangs thams cad chos nyid rang shar rang grol chen po'i gling du 'bad pa dang rtsol ba med par grol lo/ /dus de nyid du bde sdug la spang blang med/ 'khor 'das la bzang ngan med/ 'di phyi la gdams kha med par 'phags pa rnams kyi zhal mthong bya mthong byed med par mi la mis blta ba bzhin gzigs so/ /de ltar mi thams cad rig pa rang shar rang grol gyi dgongs pa la/ bzhag bya dang bzhag byed med par byas par gyur to/ /de nasalha sras rje 'bangs thams cad rjes su yi rangs te phyi nang gi mchod pa rgya chen pos yab rgyal po mnyes par mdzad nas shin tu drin gzo'i/ /de nas yang dar gcig yab rgyal po nyid dgongs pa la bzhugs nas ci yang mi gsung bar/spyan bar snang la khrol khrol mdzad nas 'di skad gsungs so/ /ag sam rgyal sras chen po gson cig /lan cig dus kyi tha ma la/ /nga yi lha sa'i gnas gzhi 'di/ /nya 'dra sbal 'dra 'jong 'dra sprel yang 'dra/ /rim pa bzhin du chu yisagacod par byed/ /nya 'dra rgyal ba yum gyi rang bzhin yin/ /ras ris phyogasabacu'i sangs rgyas dngos dang 'dra/ /rgyal bas rgyal ba'i zhabs tog mdzad pa yin/ /nya 'dra kha ru de dag su yod pa/ /rgyal ba'i yum la reg dang khyad par med/ /de yang sngon du sbyangs pa song ba yin/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' ru phyin pa yin/ /'bad pa don chen yin no bod 'bangs rnams/ /rdo bang gseg ma 'jim pa bya sgong tsam/ /gang zhig de lha/ 0phyogs su spung byed pa/ /sangs rgyas

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long tham chos 'gung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//rnams la sman pa byas pa yin/ /de yang bde ba'i lam la tshud pa yin/ /nga yi rig can rnams kyis bkur ba'i tshe/ /nya 'dra'i dus su gzhog ltar bsgron g.yin/ /sbal 'dra'i dus su zhwa ltar bkon pa yin/ /'jong 'dra'i dus su gdan ltar 'ding ba yin/ /sprel 'dra'i dus su gzugs su gyur tsa na/ /rgya chen mchod pa bshams nas ni/ /mos gus gsol 'debs gces pa yin/ /de ltar byasanas cung zhig gnas par 'gyur/ /nang gi lha rnams gsos na phyi yi rag la phan/ /phyi yi rag rnams gsos na nang gi lha rnams dgyes/ /mchod pa bshams shing gsol ba btab byas na/ /bod 'bangs bsam pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /dus kyi tha ma sdig spyod mang mod kyang / /nga yi lha sa mthong thos reg pa yi / / 'gro ba phal cher 'khor ba'i gnas nas thar/ /de yang 'phags pa rnamasakyi thugs rje ste/ /nga yi bod 'bangs rnams kyi bsod nams yin/ /de phyir nga yi skyabs gnas pho mo rnams/ /rtsol ba ma zhen snying stobs bskyed mdzod la/ /nga yi lha sa mthong thos reg par mdzod/ /de yang thar pa'i lam la btsug pa yin/ /skyon rnams thams cad sel bar 'dod pa dang / /yon tan gang zhig bsgrub par 'dod pa yi/ /nga yi lha sa zhabs tog mos byas pas/ /bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'dod pa rgyal ba rnams la zhus/ /zhesayab rgyal po chen pos lha sras la bka' stsal pa/ lha sras chen po pa/ dus lan cig lha sa la chus nyen nas/ gso dgos pa yod par 'dug pas/ de'i zhig gsos kyi theb la/ gser dngul la sogs dkor nor rnams gter du sbos shig gsungs pa dang / de nas lha 2 /sa kyang lha sar zhabs rtag bya thabs

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i cho 'gung gces bsdus/()dang / gser dngul dang dkor nor la sogs pa nor mang po dus de nyid du/gnod sbyin na ga ku be ra'i brla g.yas kyi dar sham 'og tu gter du sbas nas las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gang zag la gtad rgya smon lam btab bo/ /desakyang lho dang nub kyi phyogs su 'gro don byed par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos gab pa mngon phyung du gdams pa'o/ /de nas chos kyi rgyal po de/dgung lo bdun cu tham pa rgyal sa bzung / rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ sangasargyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba lta bur mdzad/ 'dod yon dang longs spyod kyi char pa phab/ bod 'bangs thams cad bde ba la bkod/ dgung lo brgyad cu gya gnyis pa lcags pho khyi'i lo smin drug zla ba'i tshes bcu la 'phrul snang gi btsan khang byang mar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi drung du/ sprul pa'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po de'i g.yas su bal mo bza'/ g.yon du rgya mo bza'/ rgyab tu mang bza' khri lcam/ zhabs drung du dbon sras mang srong mang btsan/ mdun du blon po thon mi dang mgar gnyis/ lha khang phyi'i sgo srung la/ zhang blon sna chen po dang / sbas lcang dpal gyi pags bzang gnyis kyis sgo bsrungs/ mchod rdzas du ma thogs te/ rgyal pos yi dam gyi drung du mchod pa phul nas smon lam btab bo / / de nas rgyal pos dpon sras la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu ngas ni rgyal khrims chos khrims su bsgyur nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar byas/ bod 'bangs bde ba la bkod pa yin no/ khyod kyis kyang nga'i rgyal srid 'di ma nyams par chos bzhin du skyongs shig nga'i gtsug lag khang 'di gnyis kyi zhabs tog khyod kyis gyis la/ dar du chug cig ༷༷ 2pho brang lha'i gnas dang 'dra ba 'di'i

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long spro pa chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//'dzin skyong gyis shig nga'i btsun mo dang / blon po bod 'bangs thams cad re zhing ltos pa'i pha ma lta bu gyis la/ phan pa dang bde bas khyab par gyis shig nga nas gdung rabs lnga pa la/ /'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa ste/ /rgyal po lde zhes bya ba 'byung / /des kyang dam chos rgyas par byed/ /de nas gdung rabasaganyis pa la/ /phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa ste/ /rgyal po khri zhes bya ba 'byung / /desakyang dam chos rgyas par byed/ /de nas bdud kyi sprul pa ste/ /rgyal po dud 'gro'i ming can 'byung / /glang dar ma yin/de yi thugs la gdon gsol nas/ /lha khang snyel zhing dam chos bsgrub/ /sde snod 'dzin pa'i srog kyang gcod/ /chos mdzad thams cad bsad cing bcom/ /glegs bam thams cad me la bsregs/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dmig shing des/ /bla ma slob dpon bran du bskul/ /rab byung btsun pa chos dang phral/ /dge bshes rnams la shan pa bcol /sangs rgyas na bza' chu la bskur/ /rten gsum mchod cha rdo yis brdungs/ /chos kyi ming yang med par byed/ /de nas yer pa'i brag khung na/ /phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa ste/ /dpal zhes bya ba'i dge slong gis/ /sdig can rgyal po sgrol bar 'gyur/ /de nas lo skor brgyad kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa med par gyur/ /e ma sems can snying re rje/ /nga yi yi dam 'di rnams kyang / /gtsug lag khang 'dir gter bzhin sbed/ /de nas lnga brgya tha ma la/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i me ro zhig /mdo khams sgang nas longs par 'gyur/ kha ba can pa'i sems can la / / mar me 'chi khar gsal ba bzhin/ /bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur/ /dad can mchod pa 'bul ba dang / /pa/ 'tshal bskor ba byed par 'gyur/ /

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(te/rab byung btsun pa mang po dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar bar 'gyur/ /chebazhigasungs te byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so/ /'di dag ni zur tsam yin gyis/ ma 'ongs lung bstan gyi zhal gdams rgyas par jo bo rjes gter nas thon pa'i ka khol ma che ba na gsal lo/ /de nas dar cig lon pa na/ rgyal po'i zhal nas nga'i phyi nang gi blon po bod 'bangs rnams nga rgyal po srong btsan sgam po dang mjal bar 'dod do zer du 'ong gi nga dang 'phrad par 'dod na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba thob cig nga dang 'phrad pa dang khyad med do gsungs so/ /yang bal mo bza' khri btsun gyis kyang / zhal phyir log mdzad nas/ bod 'bangs blo nye ba rnams nga bal mo bza' khri btsun dang mjal bar 'dod do zer du 'ong gi nga dang 'phrad par 'dod na jo mo khro gnyer can la gsol ba thob cig nga dang 'phrad pa dang khyad med do gsungs so/ /yang rgya mo kong jo zhal phyir log mdzad nas/ bod 'bangs nga la zhen che zhing dga' ba rnams la/ rgya mo kong jo dang mjal bar 'dod do zer du 'ong gi nga dang 'phud par 'dod na rje btsun sgrol ma la gsol ba thob cig nga dang 'phrad pa dang khyad med do gsungs so/ /der blon po mgar gyis rgyal po chen po 'di tsam pa'i zhal gdams gsungs pa yab yum gsum gar 'byon zhus pas/ nged gsum po thag ring du mi 'a11 gsungs te/ rgyal po yar la bzhengs nas/ phyag g.yabs pa bal mo bza' khri btsun la reg pas/ khri btsun me tog ut+pal dkar po zhig tu gyur nas/ rgyal po'i sku phrag g.yas su thim mo/ /phyag g.yon rgya mo kong rdzo la reg pas/ kong jo me tog ut+pal sngon po zhi/ / gyur nas/ rgyal po'i sku phrag g.yon

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long pa mcho 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhug so//du thim mo/ /de nas rgyal po rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi drung du phyin te/'phags pa la bstod pa/ chos sku stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhengs pa'i sku/ /zhi ba'i zhal bzhi khro zhal bdun/ /bcu gzhig zhal la phyag 'tshal lo//rtsa ba'i zhi zhal dkar po gsum//rab tu 'dzum zhing mdzas pa ste/ /las dang nyon mongs zhi mdzad pa/ /chos sku'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de steng btso ma gser mdog can/ /rngams pa'i zhal gsum bzhad pa'i dpal/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor gsum/ /rgyas par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de steng byi ru ltar dmar ba'i/ /dbang gi las mdzad zhal gnyis po/ /rnam par gtsigs pa'i khro gnyer can/ /longs sku'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de steng drag po'i las mdzad pa/ /dud sprin mdog 'dra zhal gnyis po/ /'jigs shing rngams pa'i spyan gsum bgrad/ /sprul sku'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de steng bla ma sprul pa'i sku/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus li khri'i mdog /'od dpag med mgon rgyal ba yi/ /gtsug rgyan can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma'i 'dab 'dra dang po yin/ /phyag gnyis thugs skar thal sbyar nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje rnams/ /bskul bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yas kyi phyag bzhi rim pa bzhin/ /bgrang phreng 'khor lo mchog sbyin dang / /dus gsum sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ /legs par bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon gyi phyag bzhi rim pa bzhin/ /pad dkar spyi blugs rin po che/ /thabs shes zung 'jug mda' dang gzhu/ /legs par bsnams la phyag 'tshal 31/ /g.yas kyi yan lag bcu dgu na / / rin chen zhags pa lhung bzed sdi/85/rdo rje me shel chu shel gzhu/ /lhag ma

pa tshe chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/()bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnga yab phub dang bum pa bzang / /dgra sta phreng ba pad+ma sngo/ /spyi blugs nyi ma chu skyes dkar/ /snye ma bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo /g.yon gyi yan lag bcu dgu na/ /sprin dkar spyi blugs pad+ma gri/ /dung thod phreng ba dril bu dang / /rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lcags kyu 'khar gsil sprul pa'i sku/ khang bzangs glegs bam 'khor lo dang / /sku gzugs shing thog ge sar bcas/ /rin chen bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku'i rtsa phyag rnam pa bcu/ /longs sku'i yan lag sum cu brgyad/ /sprul sku'i nying lag stong mnga' ba'i/ /nam mkha'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /pad+ma lta bu'i phyag mthil la/ /ut+pal 'dra ba'i spyan mig gis/ /rgyu skar bzhin du rnam bkra ba'i/ /nam mkha'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /dbu la rgyal ba'i gtsug rgyan bcas/ /phyag zhabs gser gyi gdu bu 'brol/ /sku la dri zhim sbosang da ldan/ /nam mkha'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' gsol/ /rin chen du ma'i rgyan gyis spras/ /blta bas mi ngoms mdzes pa'i sku/ /nam mkha'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /ri dwags lhags pas nu ma bkab/ /yan lag rigs bzhi khi sprul gyis brgyan/ /mtshan dpe gzi brdzid 'bar ba'i sku/ /nam mkha'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /gangs ri'i ngogs ltar mdzes pa la/ khung zad dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i 'od dkar 'phro ba'i sku/ /nam mkha'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /lha rgyal gtsug gi nor bu yis/ /legs par bzhengs pa'i zhabs gnyis po/ /pad zla'i steng du 'gying ba'i sku/ /nam mkha'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi lha/sdu pa rin po che/ /thabs mkhas thugs

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long 0pa chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhug so// rje ldan pa khyed/ /sems can rnams la gzigs su gsol/ /'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gnas khyed/ /sdug bsngal du mas gtses pa yi/ /nyam thag phongs pa'i sems can la/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i sems can rnams/ /las ngan bsags pas lus ngan blang / /ngan song gsum du lhung ba rnams/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus gzung du gsol/ /zhesagasungs te/ dbu'i la thod phud nas/ yi dam gyi thugs kar gtugs nas/'phags pa khams gsum 'khor ba na 'khyams pa'i sems can nyam thag pa rnams la gzigs shig ces dad pa'i shugs kyis spyan chab phyung nas/ gsol ba drag tu btab pa'i ngang la/ rgyal po 'od du zhu nas rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs zhar thim mo/ /'phags pa'i thugs rkar phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba la/kha phye na yod pa de'ang de dus su byung ba yin no/ /de ltar thams cad kyis mngon sum du mthong yang bya thabs med par gcig gdong gcig la blta zhing / mig hu re lus so/ /de nasamang bza' khri lcam gyis/ rgyal po yab yum gsum de ltar mdzad nas mi bzhugs na/ da ji ltar byed/ su la re thugs rjes gzung du gsol zhes zhusapas/ rang byon gyi thugs ka nas rgyal pos dbu nyug mdzad de 'di skad cesagasungs so/ khyed rnams nyon cig skyes nas 'chi thag chod pa dang gciga'adus byas kyi mtshan nyid mi rtag pa yin pa dang gnyis/ tshe la long med pa rtswa kha'i zil pa lta bu dang gsum/ da lta'i spyod lam 'di rnams rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes par gyis shig gsungs so/ /bal mo bza' khri btsun kyang / nu ma g.yasapa'i steng nas dbu nyug mdzad de 'di // gsungs so/ /tshe la nges pa med pa

ba chen 'od snang las/ga skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bu dang gcig ngag la nges pa med pa bar snang gi 'brug lta bu dang gnyis/ lus la nges pa med pa sos rka'i me tog lta bu dang gsum/ da lta'i spyod pa 'di me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur shes par gyis shig gsungs so/ /rgya mo kong jo nu ma g.yon pa'i steng nas dbu nyug mdzad de 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /lus mi rtag pa sdong rgan rtsa ba rul pa lta bu dang gcig tshe mi rtag pa nam mkha'i glog sprin lta bu dang gnyis/ nor mi rtag pa sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi lta bu dang gsum/ da lta'i spyod pa 'di chu'i lha ba lta bur shes par mdzod cig gsungs te mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas blon po gnyis kyis rgyal po chen po de ltar mdzad nas mi bzhugs na/ nged phyi nang gi blon po/ bod 'bangasarnams ci ltar byed/ thugs rjes gzung du gsol zhes zhus pas/ yang rgyal posadabu nyug mdzad nas 'di skad gsungs so/ /legs par nyon cig bdag gi 'khor 'bangs rnams/ /tshe 'di mi rtag rto kha'i zil pa 'dra/ /de la snyom lasale lo ma byed cig /'chi bdag bdud ni ri gzar chu dang 'dra/ /de la long yod rtag par ma 'dzin cig /sgyu lus phung po sos da'i me tog 'dra/ /me tog sad kyis nam khyer nges pa med/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba spang la dam chos mdzod/ /mi rtaga'achi bar bsams la brtson 'grus bskyed/ /nga dang khyed rnams 'bral med rtag tu 'grogs/ /gsungs te mi snang bar gyur to/ /der khong rnams gcig la ga ṇi ga lta zhikho / yab yum gsum sprul pa'i skur 'dug pa la/ bzhugs pa'i dus mos gus chung 'dug ces smra zhing yod pa la/ zhang blon sna chen po dang /sbas lcang dpal gyi legs bzang 2 8 sang ste/ rgyal po yab yum gsum gar

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//bzhud ces lan gsum zer ba la/ yab yum gsum de ltar mdzad/ yi dam la thim pa bshad kyang yid ches mi 'ong bsams te/ 'chad ma shes nas gcig gdong gcig la blta zhing mig hu re lus so/ /der khong gnyis khros te/ rgyal po yab yum gar bzhud lan gsum dris pas mi 'chad par ngan pa khyed gnyis gsod pa yin zer nas ral gri phyung bas/ der mang bza' na re/ rgyal po yab yum sprul pa'i skur 'dug pa/ yab yum gsum ga rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs rkar thim nas bzhud do/ /zer nas ngus pas/ de la yang yid ma chesapar dbon sras la zhus pas/ der dbon sras kyis/ dang por zhal gdams rgyas par gsungs pa/ de rjes btsun mo gnyis rgyal po la thim pa/ de nas mesargyal po yang yi dam gyi thugs dar thim pa sogs rgyas par gsungs pas/ der khong gnyis kyang yid ches so/ /der blon po thon mis rgyal po sprul pa'i skur 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan/ khra 'brug tu ban sprang la a mi khru ba'i zhal bstan pa dang /li yul gyi dge tshul gnyis la a mi khru ba'i zhal bstan pa/ lha sa'i rab gnasamadzad dus rgyal pos gsol ba btab pas/ skad cig la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon sum du nam mkha' la byon pa la sogs pa bshad pas/ der thams cad yid ches te/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigasadangos yin par 'dug pa/ yab yum gsum bzhugs pa'i dus su mos gus chung 'dug zer te/ chos rgyal sprul pa'i sku zer zhing thams cad mya ngan gyis sa la 'gyel lo/ /der yang lha rnams kyis me tog gi char phab ste/ sa yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /de nas rang byon bcu //ga zhal gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer kha

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()dog sna tshogs pa brgyad byung ste/ 'od zer gcig jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje'i thugasarkar thim/ li ma/ 'od zer gcig byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo'i thugs kar thim/li ma/'od zer gcig sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi thugs kar thim/ 'od zer gcig sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa'i thugs dar thim/ 'od zer gcig khro rgyal smre ba brtsegs kyi thugs kar thim/ 'od zer gcig sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po'i thugs kar thim/ 'og khang shar lho'i gci rung khug na yod bris /'od zer gcig rta mgrin dkar po'i thugs skar thim/ bris su bar khang na yod/'od zer gcig rje btsun sgrol ma'i thugs kur thim/ bris bar khang na yod/de rnams ni 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha brgyad yin no/ /yang lha de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas lha khang nang gi lha thams cad la phog nas/ 'od zer gyi dra bsa'abrel bar gyur to/ /de ni 'phrul snang gi gsang ba'i rab gnas lhun gyis grub pa yin no/ /de nas dbon sras dang / btsun mo blon po la sogs de na yod pa thams cad mya ngan gyi sdug bsngal zhi nas/ zag med kyi bde ba la gnas par gyur to/ /de nas blon po thams cad gros byas te/ sras gung ri gung btsan ni yab kyi gong du 'das/ dbon sras ni chung bas bang so brtsigs dgos pas/yab yum gsum po rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs dar thim pa gsang ste/'phan yul zal mo sgang du 'das pa yin no zhes phyogs bcur bsgrags nas/yar lung 'chong po'i nang du yab yum gsum da'i bang so/ 'gran zla dang bral bar brtsigs so/ /rgyal po yab yum gyi mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs te/ rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs por thim pas bye'u ste bcu bdun pa'o/ /de ltar sprul

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// pa'i chos rgyal chen po de/ /dgung lo bsnyen cu tham pa rgyal sa bzung / /lha khang bzhengs shing dam chos rgyas par mdzad//dkon mchog zhabs tog bka' khrims chos la bsgyur/ /dgung lo brgyad cu spya gnyis bzhengs pa na/ /le lo can rnamasabartson 'grus bskyed pa dang/ /snyom las can rnams chos la bkod pa dang / /rtag par 'dzin pa skyo ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /'phrul snang nang gi btsan khang byang ma ru / / rgyal po yab yum 'od du rab zhu nas/ /yi dam lha yi thugs kar thim par gyur//sangs rgyas mi ru sprul pa'i 'gro don can/ /spyan ras gzigs dang gnyis su med pa'i sras/ /sdig can chos la 'khod pa'i thugs rje can/ /mtha' yas sems can rnams kyi mgon gcig pu//chos rgyal sprul pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi//'phags pa thugs rje can gyis byin gyis rlobs/ /de yi bang so 'chong po'i nang du btab/ /che chung tshad ni dpag tshad gcig tsam la/ /bang so gru bzhi dkyil du re mig byas//dar dang shog bu bsres pa'i 'jim pa la/ /de la chos rgyal chen po'i sku bzhengs nas/ khreng rtar spyan drangs rol mor bcas nas ni/ /sku de bang so'i nang du bzhugs pa mdzad/ /nang gi re mig thams cad nor gyis bkang / /bang so nang rgyan can du grags par gyur/ /nang du lha khang lnga yang bzhugs so zer/ /bang so gru bzhir brtsigs pa de nas byung / /ming yang sku ri sprug po lags so skad/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams dang nyan thos dang / /byang chub sems dpa' dam can chos skyong rnams/ /gnas der lhags nas bang so de la ni/ /bkra shis rab tu gnas pa'i phrin las mdzad/ /dbon sras mang srong mang btsan la sogs pa'i/ /blo/ mi/ bod 'bangs 'khor dang bcas pa
