brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/()rnams/ /mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /gnas der khyer nas phyag dang mchod pa phul/ /de ltar 'gran med rgyal po'i bang so de/ /yul de'i la srung rnams la phrin bcol mdzad//gsol ba btab nas slar yang yul du byon/ /phan bde'i 'od kyis phyogs bcur khyab par mdzad/ /ces so/ /bco brgyad pa/ dbon sras mang srong mang btsan gyi skor/ des na dpon sras mang srong mang btsan gyis/ dgung lo bcu gsum lon dus rgyal srid bzung /btsun mo 'bro bza' khri ma lod bya ba khab tu bzhes/ rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ 'di'i dus su rgya'i rgyal pos rgyal po srong btsan sgam po mi bzhugs par shes/ mgar gyis rgya yul phung bar byas pa rnams dran nas/ rgya'i dmag 'bum tsho lnga btang nas bod 'joms pa dang / jo bo shākya gdan 'dren zer ba la sogs kyi gtam byung ba la skrag nas/ jo bo ra mo che nas lha sar gdan drangs/lho sgo me long can du bzhugs nas/ sgo la zha la bgyis te/ 'jam dbyangasabazhengs so/ /rgyal srid lo bco lnga bzung ste/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun la gtsang gi bar snang snang du 'das so/ /mang srong bang so de yi g.yon na yod/ /bang so de yang rin chen nor gyis bkang / /ming ni sngo gzhe hral po zer ba lags/ /bcu dgu pa/ 'dul srong mang po rje rlung nam 'phrul gyi skor/ mang srong mang btsan gyi sras la/ 'dul srong mang po rje rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal po yin te/yab 'das zhag bdun lon dus chu pho byi ba la sgrag phu ru 'khrungs/ mgar gyi sras gnya' btsan ldem bu dang / stag ra khong lod gnyis kyis blon po byas nasargyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ mchim ༵༵'a btsun mo tog bya ba khab tu bzhes/

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// rgyal po 'di'i dus su blon po rtsal po che mi bdun byung ste/ rngog ring la nag posaglang po che theg rngog gling khams kyis g.yag grus po che khyog sdon rgyal mtshan gyis mda' ste'u kha mas bya khra rked par bcad/ dbas 'dong sgong gis mig rgyang gsum re la mda' rgyang res sleb/ 'gos g.yag chung gis sha ba'i rlud phur bye mas bkang ste glad la bskor nus/ co ro 'brong sher gyis 'brong mthur la rgyug pa gyen la 'then thub/ snon khri bdun g.yu byin gyis rta g.yang la mchong ba gyen la 'then thub pa rnams byung / mnga' thang dpal 'byor ni lha dang mnyam/ stobs dang mthu rtsal gyis ni mtha' bzhi las rgyal te/ lha sar mes thong btsan sgam po'i dgongs dus kyi mchod pa btsug mtha'i rgyal po yang dbang du 'dus pa tsam byung nas/ snga gong bod kyi rgyal po rim par byon pa rnams las mthu stobasache ba zhig byung ste/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu rgyal srid bzung nas ljang gi yul du 'das so/ /'phrul rgyal bang so mang srong g.yon na yod/ /bang so lha ri can zhes grags pa/ ge/ /de ni hor gyi mi sdes brtsigs pa lags/ /ming ni seng ge brtsag rnyi sdo/ ṭ+wāṃ khri /lde/ gtsug brtan mes ag tshom gyi skor/ rgyal po 'dul srong mang po btsan gyi sras/ khri lde btsug brtan mes ag tshom du grags pa ste/lcags pho 'brug gi lo la pho brang ldan dkar du sku gzungs/ dgung lo bcu la rgyal srid bzung / blon po skyi bzang stong btsan/ mchims rgyal shugs steng /'bro chu bzang 'or gsum gyis blon po byas/ rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ ljang mo khri btsun bya ba'i btsun mo khab tu ༵byes/ rgyal po des 'phyin phu nas/ mes

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/()srong btsan sgam po'i zhal chems zangs kyi byang bu la bris pa rnyed de/ gzigs pas nga ni gdung rabs lnga na rgyal po khri dang lde zhes bya ba'i dus su dam pa'i chos dar/ paṇ+ḍi ta mang po byon nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par 'gyur zhes pa de/ rgyal po khong rang yin dgongs nas/ bran kha mu le sho ka dang gnyags dzha na ku ma ra gnyis pho lhar brdzangs te/ gangs ri ti se la paṇ+ḍita sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis spyan 'dren du btang bas gdan ma 'drongs pa dang / theg pa chen po'i mdo sde lnga blo la bzung nas 'ongs te/ yi ger bris nas glegs bam lnga bzhengs nas de rnams kyi bzhu/kas sa la lha khang lnga brtsigs te/ brag dmar ka sa kha che 'grin bzang / lha sa kha brag 'phyin phu nam ral/ mang gong gi lha khang dang lnga bzhengs/ rgya yul ke ma shi nas mdo gser 'od dam pa dang / 'dul ba las rnam par 'byed pa bsgyur ro/ /pe tsi tsan+d+ra shrīs sman dpyad mang po yang bsgyur ro/ /de rnams kyi yon tan gyis btsun mo ljang mo khri btsun la sras ljang tsha lha dbon zhes bya ba lha'i gzugs byad lta bu shin tu mtshar ba cig 'byungs so/ /de la bod na khab 'os pa ma rnyed nas/ mesasrong btsan sgam po'i lugs su bya zer/ rgya nag gi rgyal po dzung dzung rgyal po'i sras mo kyim shing kong jo la rin dang skyes bskur nas len du btang ngo / /der bod kyi blon pos rgya rje la rin dang skyes phul bas/ rgya rjes sras mo la 'gro'am mi 'gro gsungs pa dang / kong jos legs nyes ston pa'i me long zhig yod pa la dmod bor te legs par phyis nas bltas pas/ tshe 'di'i grogs skal bod na yod par shes shing / rgyal bu de yang /9 4 zhing yid du 'ong ba zhig mthong nas

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long bam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs po//bod du 'gro bar mos so/ /der yang rgyal po des rdzongs dpag tu med pa bskur/rgyal po yang 'khor mang po dang bcas pa bu mo sems la 'phreng bas/ zhing pheng lhan zer ba'i mkhar rtsig chen po gcig yod pa'i sa cha bar du skyel thung mdzad do / / der gur chen po phub cing / bod kyi gser yig pa rnams la ston mo chen po byas te/ rgyal po'ang spyan chab mang po phyung nas/ sras mo la bslab bya mang po mdzad/ mkhar de la gtogs pa'i nyes pa can thams cad thar du bcug go /lo gcig gi bar la dmag dang 'dab nor thams cad med par mdzad de/ mkhar de'i ming kyim shing lhan bya bar btags so/ /de nas blon po che ba gnyis dmag dang bcas pa'i skyel ma btang ste bod du 'ongs so/ /der rgya bod kyi mtshams su sleb pa dang / bod du blon po rnams kyis rgyal bu gdan drangs te/ mtshan mo zla ba'i 'od la thams cad kyis rta rgyugs pa la der rgyal bus kyang rta rgyugs pas/rtas bsgyur te 'das so//de ltar btsun mo sleb khar/ rgyal bu grongs nas thams cad mya ngan gyis non no/ /ljang tsha lha dbon bang so mes kyi mdun/ /zlum por brtsigs nas gter yang sbas so skad/ /de nas kong jo dpon g.yog rnams kyis/ rgya bod kyi mtshams su slebs pa dang / kong jo la glo bur du snying la mda' phog pa'i sdug bsngal 'dra ba zhig byung nas/ de ma khad me long phyis nas bltas pas/ sngar gyi rgyal bu gzugs byad mdzes pa de med par rgad po bzhin mi sdug pa byad spus khengs pa zhig 'dug nas shin tu yi mug par gyur te 'di skad zer ro / / me long gi brda chad mthong ba na/ /bu mo'i snying la gcong cig zhugs/ /rang yul du log pa shul thag ring / /bu mo/ ༵ ming snying ring po/ /bod du 'gro ba'i

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()re thag chad/ /bod kyi blon po sdig po che/ /cha med yul du rgyus med 'khyam/ /las kyi me long bslu ba mkhan/ /zer te me long la brdeg cing ngus so/ /de nasabod kyi rgyal pos pho nya btang ste/ rgya mo dpon g.yog rnams la khyod kyi skyes pa'i 'osanga'i bu lha dang 'dra ba zhig yod pa de/ rkyen ngan pas 'das/ da de khyed rang yul du log gam/ nged la bltas nas 'ong zhes yi ge btang bas/ der rgya mo na re / bu mo'i 'dun ma lan cig yin pa skyid sdug ci byung yang bod du 'gro zer 'ongs so/ /der bod du slebs pa dang / rgya mo na re/ nga'i a de'i lha khang blta'o zer te/ ra mo cher phyin pas/ de na jo bo mi bzhugs par 'dug nas 'phrul snang du 'ongs pa dang / jo bo lho sgo me long can na bzhugs par shes nas sgo phye ste / jo bo de nas bton nas/ btsan khang dbus mar bzhugs su gsol/ lha zhal mthong gi mchod pa btsug jo bo gdung rabs gsum gyi bar la mun khang du bzhugs pa la/ rgya mos mchod pa btsugs pa yin no/ /de nas 'phyin phur byon te / mes rgyal po'i btsun mor mnga' gsol lo/ /de nas lo dus 'khor ba na/rgyal bu lus la zhugs pa dang / btsun mo che ba sna nam bza' bzhi stengs zer ba zhig yod pa phrag dog skyes nas/ nga la'ang rgyal po'i gdung brgyud lus la yod do zhes rdzun smras te/ der rgya mo la rgyal po khri srong lde btsan lcags pho rta'i lo la brag dmar du sku zhakhrungs pas/ sna nam bza' rgya mo'i rtsar byung / shin tu blo nye ba ltar byas nas/ rgya mo'i bu chung 'phrog ste/ nga rang la skyes pa yin no zer bston byas so/ /der rgya mos rang gi nu ma bstan/ smre sngags bton/ cho ngesabos kyang bu chung ma btang bas/ blon dī /mas sbran/ rgyal po la zhus pas/ der

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs // sna nam bzas kyang rang gi nu ma la 'a ma ༄rdong babs kyi rdzas byug ste/ spyo zho 'ongs pa byas nas blon po rnams la bstan pas/ blon po rnams kyang the tshom du gyur nas ma shes so/ /der rgya mo'i bu chung btsun mo che bas phyogs pas/ dbang shed mos ni ma thub/ byed thabs med par song ngo / /der rgya mo sems la da de bu chung 'dis nga la phan pa dka'/ bod 'di phung ba'i las zhig byed dgos bsams nas ri'i dpyad bltas pas/ rgyal po'i gdung rabs chad pa'i phyir/rje'i bla ri seng ge gnam du mchong ba 'dra ba'i mgo la/ mngal khrag gis 'khor lo bris nas mchod rten gyis mnan/ blon po rig pa can mi 'ong ba'i phyir/ blon po'i bla ri la khro chus sna bcad/ stag ri seng ri gnyis gzhug 'jug)pa sbrel ba'ang bcad/ mu ge 'ong ba'i phyir/ yar lung me sna'i ri 'bras kyi ljang pa 'dra ba'i rtsa ba bcad/ bod du mdze 'ong ba'i phyir/ mang mkhar gyi ri khyung chen gnam la lding ba 'dra ba'i mchu bcad do/ /de rnams zin pa dang / sras kyis lo 'khor te / zhabs 'dzugs kyi dga' ston la/ btsun mo gnyis po'i pha ming rgya dang sna nam nas bos so/ /der sna nam pa rnams kyis bu chung dga' bar byed pa'i yo byad/ rgyan dang / gos dang / me tog gi phreng ba rnams khyer 'ongs so/ /der rgya dang / sna nam gnyis nas/ btsun mo gnyis po'i pha ming rnams bod du slebs so / / der rgyal po'i pho brang du rgyal po gser khri'i steng du gung la bzhugs/g.yas na sna nam pa rnams kyis bsdad/ g.yon na rgya rnams kyis bsdad/ der yab rgyal pos sras rgyan du mas brgyan te/ gser skyogs 'bras chang gis gang ba sras kyi lag tu gtad nas/ yab / mi// ma gnyis las skyes pa'i bu gcig

brtse chen 'od snang las/ga skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()po / / lus chung yang lha yi rnam 'phrul can/ /snod gser skyogs chang gis gang ba 'di/ /bu khyod rang gi shad po'i lag tu gtod/ /ma gang yin gyi yid ches de la byed/ /gsungs te/ dmod bor nas sras gom pa thub tsam de btang nas/ der sras kyi gom pa bor nas byon pa dang / sna nam pa rnams kyis gos dang / rgyan dang / me tog gi phreng ba la sogs bstan nas bos kyang / 'gror ma nyan par rgya rnams kyi rtsar byung ste/gser skyogs rgya la gtad nas 'di skad zer ro/ /nga khri srong lde btsan rgya tsha yin/ /sna nam zhang gi don mi 'tshal/ /zer te/ zhang po rgya'i pang du song ngo / /der yum rgya mo shin tu dga' ste 'di skad zer ro/ /tshe sngon ma'i las kyi 'phen pa yis//nga rgya nas 'ongs pa'i bu mo la//rje 'dren 'gran )med rgyal po'i sras zhig gcings/ /las gang yang srid pa'i sngon chad la/ /bu rang la skyes pa g.yin gyis phrogs//gtam bden pa'i tshig la ma nyan zhing //brang nu ma bstan kyang ma gtad pas/ /nga rgya mo'i lus sems gzhob tu thal/ /sems khong khro'i na tsha ma bzod par/ /yul bod kyi ri dpyad nyams su bcug /dus de ring lha yi nyi ma shar/ /bu khyod kyis zhang ngo shes pa lags/ /nga a ma'i lus sems ma la du bde/ /yul bod kyi ri dpyad nyams pa de/ /ri de rnams la skyon med bcos su yod/ /ces zer ro/ /der rgya mo'i sras yin par ngo shes nas/ dga' ston gyi ston mo chen po byas so/ /der sras dgung lo lnga lon dus yum 'das so/ /yab rgyal po mes ag tshom ni/ dgung lo drug cu re gsum la yar 'brog sba tshal mkhar gshegs so/ /de'i bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs/ /gral ni 'phrul gyi rgyal po'i g.yon / 9spyad/ /ming ni lha ri gtsug nam bya ba

ge zhesaXs gsal ba'i me long ba ma chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// lags/nye/tre /snag/ pa/ / de nas chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis dgung lo brgyad lon pa dang / rgyal srid bzung nas rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ rgyal po sku nar ma son pa'i dus su ma zhang khron tham spro skyes la sogs pa blon po chos la mi dga' ba rnams kyis chos byar mi gnang ba'i khrims bcas nas/ lha sa'i jo bo rin po che slar rgya yul du skyel grabs byas pas/ mi stong gis kyang ma drangs/mkhar brag tu sa thams su bcug pas/ blon po chos la mi dga' ba la la ni spyo 'bog byung nas la la rgyab gas nas shi sar rnag dong /mu ge dang / nad yams dang / bkra mi shis pa'i ltas mang po byung bas/ ltas mkhan thams cad kha mthun par rgya'i lha bye thams 'ams )su bcug pas lan 'dug zer nas/ sa'og nas btane te/ rgya gar du skyel bar bsams pas dre'u gnyis kyi theg nasamang yul du phebs pa'i dus su/ lam la ma thar zhes glengs nas/ rdzo bo mang yul du lo bcu bzhi bzhugs/ yar lung rdzo po bsgrig pa'i rgyal rab dang /gzhan na'ang 'dig zhag jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje rgya yul du skyel rgyu la/ shar phyogs do mo'i thang la bskyal/ der zhag bdun lus pa/ khong rang gi rdzo bo min pa ngo shes nas bzhag pa yin 2ga'o rgyal thang zer cho lung ra 'a/slar ra mo cher bzhugs su bcug go /rgyal po chos la dga' na'ang / blon po ma zhang khron tham ༄ skyes dang / stag ra klu gong la sogs dbang ches pas/ gzhan gyis rgol ma nus so/ /de nas rgyal po sku nar son te/ rje blon rnams chos bya bar blo mthun te/ thabs sna tshogs kyis mgo bskor nas/ ma zhang stod lung bra~X 9 9 ru gson por bang sor bcug stag

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()ra klu gong byang la sprugs go /de nas thams cad la chos bya ba'i bka' gnang nas/ thog mar mang yul nas jo bo shākya shing rtar gdan drangs bsu ba rol mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te ra sa'i gtsang khang dbus mar bzhugs su gsol/ dus der kha che skyes bzangs kyi bu ā nan+da zer ba de ra sa dang ra mo che gnyis kyi bar na/ dar tshags dgung seb kyi tshong dus sar/ tshong byed kyin yod pa bos nas de la lo tsā bcol te/ chos dang bon gnyis rtsod pa 'gran pas/bon khungs ngan par byung nas/ bon gyi chos thams cad brag dmar la sogs par gter du sbas so/ /la la chu la bskyur/ 'phral gyi 'gal rkyen bzlog pa tsam min pa ma gnang ngo / /de nas rgyal blon thams cad gros bgyis te/ sngon mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi drung du/ khye'u gsum gyis smon lam btab pa'i mthu la brten nas/ sba gsal snang rgya gar du mkhan po bo dhi sa twa gdan 'dren du btang bas/ gsal snang gis mkhan po gdan drangs te pho brang du phebs pa dang /rgyal pos sku rags ma bcingasa'i par/ gser phye bre gang phyag tu bsnams naba'imakhan po'i bsu ba la byon pas/ mkhan po'i zhal nas/ rgyal po khyed kyi dbu la la thod gsol bas/ stod du mnga' ris zhwa tsam zhig la khrims shig chags/zhabs la chag gsol bas smad du mdo khams lham tsam la khrims shig chags/sku lus la sku rags ma bcings pas/ bar 'dir rgyal khrims myur du 'jig nyen yod/ 'on kyang rin po che'i phyag rten phul bas chos byar btub gsungasaso / / de nas kha che ā nan+da sa lo tsā bgyis te/ rje blon rnams la chos gsungasapas/ nag po'i phyogs 'dre srin gdu/ ༵ can ma dga' bar/ thog dang / lo

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long zhwam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// nyes/ nad yams byung bas/ 'dre srin dam la 'dogs pa'i phyir du u rgyan gyi yul nas slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas gdan drangs te/ bod kyi 'dre srin dam la btags te/ rje blon chos byed pa la 'gal rkyen med par mdzad do/ /slob dpon gyis rgyal po la rig 'dzin gyi tshe chu gnang bas/ blon po chos la mi dga' ba rnams kyis rgyal po la mon gyi spyo chu dug yin pas/ mi gsol bar zhu zhus pas/ rgyal po yang the tshom du gyur nas ma gsol/ nad du mdze mi 'ong ba'i phyir/klu'i rgyal po mal gro gzi chen dam la btags nas rdo rje bsnun pas gzi chen gyis khye'u zhig tu sprul nas/ rgyal po la grogs po bcol lo/ /rgyal po la ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub ster bar khas blangs nas/ rgyal pos klu'i ngo chen mdzad nas thugs dam blang ngo / /yang slob dpon gyis ngam shod kyi bye thang thams cad ne'u thang du gtang bzhed pa la/ blon po ngan pa rnams kyis rgyal po la zhus te/slob dpon gyis rdzu 'phrul yin pas ring du mi gnas shing mi rung ngo zhes zer te mdzad par ma zhus/ gzhan yang slob dpon gyis rgyal po'i btsun mo mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyaladabang yon du khab tu bzhes pas/ blon po thams cad ma dga' bar/rgyal po la snyan 'phra zhus nas/ rgyal pos slob dpon gyi zhal la ma nyan pas mdzol pa chen po gsum byung zer ba la sogs dang /slob dpon mthu che bas rgyal srid la gnod par nges/ slob dpon yul la gshegs par zhu zhus so/ /bsam mas kyi bka' gtsig na/slob dpon slar u rgyan yul du bzhud zer ba 'dug ste/rgyal po dang gros mdzad nas/tsa ri la sogs su bzhugs/ma zhad khron 61mo)pa skye bsad rting /slar bsam la su byon ra/de nas rgyal pos pod 'bangs rnams bsags te/snga gong bod du rab tu byung ba'i dpe 3 0'dug pas/ bod du rab tu byung ba e

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(te/'ong blta ba'i phyir/ blon po dang 'bangs kyi bu blo rno ba bdun/ bo dhi sa waṃ drung du rab tu byung ste/de'ang sba sang shi'i bu rat+na/mchims a nu'i bu shākya bra bakhre bha)/pa gor rat+na'i bu be+e ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ rma a tsar+ya rin chen mchog 'khon klu'i dbang po bsrung ba/ lo rgyu smi na/la con klu'i dbang po sad mi mi bsnyen la mi the zer ba'ang 'dun gtsang legs grub ste/ bdun gyis rab tu byung bas/sad mi mi bdun zhes grags so/ /de bzhin du btsun mo dang / blon po 'bangs la sogs pa'i bu sum brgya rab tu byung ste/ rgya gar du blo sno ba rnams brdzangs te/sgra dang lo tsā slob tu btang ngo / /de nas rgyal po'i thugs la dpal bsam yasami 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs par 'dod nas/ blon po 'gos la sogs pa'i chos blon rnams dang gros mdzad de/ dka' ba'i las rnams ma bsten na/ /sla ba'i las la grub pa med/ /gsungs te/ mnga' 'og gi blon po bod 'bangs rnams bsags te/ rgyal po'i zhal nas sngon chad bod kyi rgyal po byon pa la nga che/ ngas lag rjes chen po zhig 'jog dgos/ rgyu shel las grub pa'i mchod rten shar ri dang mnyam pa zhig 'chos sam shad po rgya'i yul mthong ba'i mkhar zhig brtsig gam/ has po ri zangs kyis 'thum mam/dka' bcu thang la khron pa 'dom dgu brgya dgu bcu yod pa 'bru'am/ wa lung grog mo gser phyes 'gengs sam/ gtsang po sbubs su 'jug gam/ dkon mchog gsum kyi rten bzhugs pa'i lha khang bre tshad tsam zhig bzhengs sam 'doms shig gsungs pas/ der thams cad kyis rgyal po'i bka' de gser gyi pha bong bzhin sems thog tu ldi bar /sdu nas/ zhu ma shes par mig hu re lus

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long bam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//so / / der blon po 'gos dang / ko nyang bzang dang / gnyer stag btsan 'dong gzigs la sogs pa'i chos blon rnams bzhengs te/ rje gcig lags/ shel gyi mchod rten shang ri dang mtho dma' mnyam pa ni skye ba 'di la grub pa mi srid/rgya yul mthong ba'i mkhar bsam pas 'grub pa mi srid/ bod mnga' rigs kyi zangs thams cad bsdus kyang / has po ri 'thums pa med/ wa lung grog mo gser phye ma'i bye mas kyang mi khengs/ khron pa 'dom dgu brgya bas brgya yang 'bru mi thub/ gtsang po sbubs su dgun spyod kyang dbyar mi tshud/ de bas rje'i thugs dam/ 'bangs kyi skyabs gnas/ phan bde thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi ma / gtsug lag khang bre tshad tsam zhig bzhengs pa lags zhus pas/ der thams cad kha 'cham par de bzhin legs so zhes gda'o/ /de nas rgyal po'i zhal nas/slob dpon chen po nga'i pha ma gnyis po gang na 'dug zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ rgyal po khyed kyi yab ni/ rgya gar gyi yul na/ paṇ+ḍita chen po zhig tu skyes 'dug ste/ khyed kyi dbon sras kyi dus su/ paṇ+ḍita dwa na thi la yin par lung bstan bod du 'byon par 'dug khyed kyi yum ni/ zung mkhar na dbul po bza' mi gnyis kyi bu mor skyes 'dug ste/ ming dang rus ni 'di ltar ro zhes lung bstan/de nas rgyal pos btsun mo lnga khab tu bzhes pa la/ tshe spang yong ༄za' me tog sgron/ 'khar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal/ bas mo 'di slob dpon la dbang yon du phul lo/ /'bro bza' byang chub sgron/ mchims bza' lha mo btsan rnams so/ /yang yum gyi drin bsab pa'i phyir/ dbul po bza' mi'i bu mo khab tu bzhes te/ pho yong bza' rgyal mo btsun zhes grags so/ /lo /rdo/ga na/ rgya po po'i yum gyi skye ba bu mo de/'ag khrul

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()zur chu nas rnyed zer ba 'dug ste/gang ltar na'ang pho yong bza' yin par don mthun no//de nas slob dpon gyis gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i sa dpyad gzigs pas/ shar ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra de bzang / ri chung bya mas bu la sgab pa 'dra de bzang / sman ri rin chen spungs pa 'dra de bzang / ltas po ri bas mo dar dkar gyi na bza' gsol ba 'dra de bzang / ri nag lcags phur sa la btab pa 'dra de bzang / me yar dre'u chu 'thung ba 'dra de bzang / del thang dar dkar gyi yol ba 'then pa 'dra de bzang / sa gzhi ni gser gzhong gur gum gyis bkang ba 'dra de bzang bas/ rje'i thugs dam 'dir bzhengs shig gsungs nas phyag bris mdzad do/ /de nas slob dpon gyis 'dre srin gdug pa can rnams dam la btags nas 'gal rkyen med par mdzad de/ ya rabs rigs btsun zhing pha ma drug khrung )ldan gyi bu dang bu mo rgyan du mas brgyan pa lnga bcu/ rin po che'i bum par bkra shis kyi chus gang ba thogs te/ sa phur btab/ sa gzhi byin gyisabarlabs so/ /de nas rgyal pos blon po dang / bod 'bangs thams cad las la bskul te/ dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab la dpe blangs nas/ dbu rtse chen mo rmang bting tsam na/ rje btsun ma sgrol mas lung bstan nas/ snga sor ār+ya pa lo gling bzhengs te/ rten gyi gtso bo la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ de'i g.yasasu sgrol ma/ g.yon du 'od zer can/ yang g.yas su yi ge drug pa/ g.yon du dpal rta mgrin la sogs pa/ gtso 'khor lnga bzhengs so/ /steng du 'od dpag med gtso 'khor lnga bzhengs so/ /de nas slob dpon gyis rgyal po la rta mgrin sgrub pa'i lung gnang nas sgrub pa maX/ sdus/ rgyal pos rta mgrin 'grub nas/

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long spro pa chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// rta skad lan gsum brtan pas 'dzam bu'i gling sum gnyis su thos te/ rgyal po'i chab srid kyang 'dzam gling sum gnyis la dbang bsgyur ba yin gsungs/ de nas yos kyi lo la dbu rtse chen po'i 'og khang bzhengs te/ rten gyi gtso bo la has po ri nas spyan drangs pa'i rdo'i thub pa rang byon la rin po che'i 'jim pas g.yogs te/ mtshan dpe dang ldan par bzhugs/ g.yas gral la byams pa/spyan ras gzigs/ sa'i snying po/ dga' ba'i dpal/ khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal la sogs pa'o/ /g.yon gral la kun tu bzang po/ phyag na rdo rje/ 'jam dpal/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ dge bsnyen dri ma med pa/ khro bo mi g.yo ba dang /gtso 'khor bcu gsum rnams bod kyi lugs su bzhengs/ lte ba'i phyi lha'i ri mo mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ kha nang lta la tog gi rgyud ris/ sngar khang rje'i thugs dam gyi rgyud ris rnams bzhengs/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i mgo can la gtad/ de nas bar khang bzhengs te/ rten gyi gtso bo la sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad/g.yas phyogs la mar me mdzad/ g.yon na byams pa / mdun na shākya thub pa/sman gyi lha/ snang ba mtha' yas gsum bzhugs/ g.yas g.yon na byang semasanye ba'i sras brgyad/ dge bsnyen dri ma med pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ba'i dpal/ khro bo dang dang zhing / bzo rgya nag gi lugs su bzhengs/ rgyud risal yum rgyas pa gling gzhi'i le'u gdong la rgyal chen bzhi/ bskor khang kha phyir lta la mchod rten brgyad pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyud ris/ kha nang lta la sprin chen po'i rgyud ris/ sngags khang la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs/ bsam yas kyi /0 5 rnams kyi 'bag chos skyong rgyal

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gce4bsdus/()po shing bya can la gtad/ steng khang gi gtso bo sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kun tu zhal re re la 'khor gnyis re/ byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad/ nang gi lha byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje rgyal mtshan la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems/ khro bo mi g.yo ba dang phyag na rdo rje/ bzo rgya gar gyi lugs su bzhengs/ rgyud ris mdo sde sa bcu pa/ chos skyong rgyal po zangs ma'i 'be log can la gtad/ thog rgya phub za 'og ris su byas/ lcog bzhi na sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dpal la 'khor byang chub sems dpas bskor ba/ chosaskyong lag na rdo rje gos sngon can bzhi la gtad/ de nas 'khor sa bar pa brtsigs te/ sto phyogs klu'i bang mdzod rol mas bkang / gnod sbyin lag na dbyug tho thogs pa mched gsum la gtad/ nub phyogs mdo rgyud chos kyi bang mdzod sum brgya dang / bod dang rgya'i dpe cha glegs bam gyis bkang ste/ a tsa ra lag na spu gri thogs pa gsum la gtad/ byang phyogs rin chen gter gyi bang mdzod gsum gser dngul zangs la sogs pas bkang ste/ gshin rje gshed lag na be cen can gsum la gtad/ rgyud ris la rgya cher rol pa bris/ de'i bar la sangs rgyas stong dang khri la sogs pa bris so/ /de nas 'khor sa chen po bskor te/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad ngan song spyong ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhengasaso / / mda' yab kyi ngos gsum na rigs lnga'i lder so zhal phyir blta ba/ nang du stug po brgyan pa/ nor bu bzang po chos skyong klu'i rgyal po ā nan+da la gtad/rgyab tu rdo ring btsugs chos skyong si ha mu kha la gtad/ dbu rtse'i sgo gsum rnam par thang pa'i sgo/ /gru skas drug ni pha /16 phyin pa drug /'og khang rdo la bar khang

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long sbram chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//so phag yin/ /steng khang gzhal yas rin chen shing las grub/ /bzo rnamasathams cad 'dul ba'i lugs dang bstun/ /rgyud ris thams cad mdo sde'i lugs dang bstun/ /lder so thams cad gsang sngags dag dang bstun/ /zhesaso / / de nas shar lus 'phags po'i gling gsum zla gam ris su yod pa la dpe blangs nas/ shar du lha khang gsum brtsigs te/ de yang rnam dag khrims khang gling na rten gyi gtso bo shākya thub pa gtso 'khor lnga/ mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud ris/ chos skyong tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can la gtad/ mkhyen rab 'jam dpal gling na/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gtso 'khor bdun/ sgo srung gshin rje gshed gnyis 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang / ngan song skyong ba'i rgyud gnyis/ chosaskyong gshin rje'i 'khor lo can la gtad/ brda sbyor tshangs pa gling na shākya thub pa gtso 'khor bdun/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyud ris/ chos skyong 'brug gi glog ba can la gtad/ lho 'dzam bu gling gi gling gsum sog khar yod pa la dpe blangs nas/ lho phyogs su lha khang gsum bzhengs te/ de yang bdud 'dul sngags pa gling na/ thub pa bdud 'dul lugs gtso 'khor lnga/ lte ba la mdo sde sa bcu pa'i rgyud ris/ 'khor sa la nam mkha'i snying po'i rgyud ris/ chos skyong dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad la gtad/ ār+ya pa lo gling na/ kha rla pa ṇi gtso 'khor lnga/ steng na snang ba mtha' yas gtso 'khor lnga/ blo sgru༄bur na tsan+dan la dngul g.yogs pa'i rgyal po'i sku 'dra gcig mchod rten gcig rgyud ris/ za ma tog lha mo stong rtsa gnyis chos skyong drang srong sto rā dza la gto/ sgra sgyur rgya gar gling na thub pa rgya gar lugs ma /rdo 'khor lnga/ rgyud ris la tshe dpag med

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()dang / lo paṇa sgra bsgyur pa'i gzugs so/ /chos stong gnod sbyin rā hu la la gtad/ nub ba lang spyod kyi gling gsum zlum por yod pa la dpe blangs nas/nub tu lha khang gsum brtsigs te/ de yang dpa' bo be+e ro tsa na gling na rnam par snang mdzad zangs la bzhedas pa/ 'khor gsang ba yum bzhi/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud ris/ chos skyong gnod sbyin glang gi mgo can la gtad/ dga' ldan byams pa gling na/ mgon po byams pa gtso 'khor bdun/ sgo srung gshin rje gshed gnyis/ rgyud ris la gnas brtan bcu drugabasam yas bzhengs lugs dang / 'jig rten gtan bzhag rnams bris/ chosaskyong khro bo gos sngon can la gtad/ mi g.yo bsam gtan gling na/ rnam par snang mdzad rigs lnga/ nyan thos bcu drug rgyud ris la gser 'od dam pa nas khye'u chu 'bebs kyi ri mo/ chos skyong rgyal po dngul mgo can la gtad/ byang sgra mi snyan gyi gling gsum gru bzhir yod pa la dpe blangs nas/ byang du lha khang gsum bzhengs te/ de'ang rin chen sna tshogs gling na shākya thub pa gtso 'khor lnga/ rgyud ris la dga' ldan du bcom ldan 'das kyis yum la chos gsungs pa/ drin lan bsabs pa rnams bris/ chos skyong rgyal po lcags kyi sder mo can la gtad/sems bskyed byang chub gling na sangs rgyas pad+ma can/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ phyag na rdo rje/ bdud rtsi 'byil ba/ rgyud ris mdo sde dkon mchog sprin dang / rtag tu ngus shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa btsal ba rnams bris/ chos skyong mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i mgo can la gtad/ pe dkar dkor mdzod gling na shākya thub pa gtso 'khor dgu/ yab sras mjal ba'i rgyu~X /sa/ glo 'bur rnams na bsam yas

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// bzhengs pa'i nor lhag ma/ 'di na 'di yod kyi rtsis yig de'i srung ma khram khang gi rgyal po la gtad/ lha khang spyi'i bstan srung la/ slob dpon gyis za hor gyi yul nas/ lha'i dge bsnyen chen po/ bdud kyi dmag dpon chen po/ snang srid kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad la dbang byed cing / skye 'gro thams cad kyi dbugs len/srog bdag chen po pe ha ra la gtad cing / pe dkar gyi gling du rten btsugs so//nyi ma lha khang yag sha gong ma gang ba bzang po'i lha khang na shākya thub pa gtso 'khor lnga/ rgyud ris sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis/ zla ba lha khang yag sha 'og ma nor bu bzang po'i lha khang na/ lha khang rgyud ris gong dang mthun/ tshang mang ke'u gling na steng na ba so lha khang / dag byed khrus khang gling na khron pa tsan+dan gyis gang ba / mthu gtad klu khang gling na/ se ba phung po yal ga brgyad yod pa gcig la/klu chen brgyad/ dbus na phyag na rdo rje/ zhi ba 'dul byed rgyud ris/ rus sbal nya chu srin la sogs pa'o/ /de nas mchod rten dkar po byang chub chen po'i mchod rten nyan thos kyi lugs seng ges brgyan pa/ shud pu dpal gyi seng ges lag dpon byas nas bzhengs/ chos skyong gnod sbyin skar mda' can la gtad/ 43 rten dkar po'i phyog shing rgyal chen bzhis btsugs nas bzhugs la sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel ma ga dha'i bre'i khal gcig gnyen po gsang ba yab kyi yi dam/mdo sde lnga rnam sa bzhugs pas byin rlabs che/mchod rten dmar po chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i lugs pad+mas brgyan pa/ sna nam rgyal tsha lha gnang gis lag dpon byas nas bzhengs/ chos skyong gza' mig dmar la gtad/ mchod rten nag po rang sangs rgyas kyi lugs/ ngam stag sgra klu gong gis lag dpon byas nas bzhe sdu/9chos skyong gnod sbyin lcags kyi mchu

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()can la gtad/ mchod rten sngon po dpal lha las babs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i lugs/ lha khang sgo mo bcu drug gis brgyan pa/ mchims rdo rje sprel chung gis las dpon byas nas bzhengs/ chos skyong gnod sbyin nyi ma'i gdong la gtad/ de'i tshe 'dre mo 'od can mas mi thams cad la gnod 'tshe byas pas/slob dpon gyis byams pa gling du mchod rten 'od 'bar ba brtsigs te/ 'dre mo mnan/ gnod 'tshe med par mdzad do/ /de nas lcags ri zur mangs rdo rje 'gros ni/ mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad kyi tshul du bzhugs nas re re la sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel re re bzhugs so/ /de nas btsun mo gling gsum ni/ 'gro bza' byang chub sgron gyis dge rgyas bye ma gling bzhengs te/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas gtso 'khor bdun li ma ru bzhengs/ g.yas na rigs gsum mgon po / g.yon na sman gyi bla/ kun tu bzang po/ mi g.yo ba rnams bzhugs/ srasamed pha ming thag ring bas/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su lha khang la zhig ral byung na/gso mkhan ma byung dogs nas/ rtsig pa so phag la zha nye'i chus sbyar/ zangs kyis thog phub/ rol mor jang btan mar me'i tshab tu nor bu 'od kha gdung mar btag yon chab tu khron pa bcos so/ /tshe yang bza' me tog sgron la srasagasum zhakhrungs te/ mu ne btsad po/ mu rug btsad po/ mi mug btsad po sad na legs dang gsum yod pa'i yab kyi dbu rtse rigs gsum la dpe blangs nas/khams gsum zangs khang gling gi lha khang bzhengs so/ /pho yang bza' rgyal mo btsun gyis bu tshal gser khar gling rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhengs/lha bzo la sogs pa bzo bo rnams dī sdus re la zas sna bcu gsum re drangs

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// pas/ de'i bzang lan du bzo khyad bcu gsum byas pa la/ phyi na rtsig pa med de/rdo rje lta bur sra ba bzo'i khyad/ nang na ka ba med de/ gur lta bur mdzes pa bzo'i khyad/ sa gzhi ra gan las byas pa/ g.yu'i gdung ma la gser gyi rta rgyug pa / gser gyi gdung ma la g.yu'i 'brug yod pa/ rgya phub khyabs)ba phyi lta dang nang lta yod pa/ nang gi lha rnams la spyi gdugs re dang/ sgos gdugs re yod pa / sgo 'byed gcod la gser gyi bye rus skad 'don pa/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis 'bur du dod pa sogs/ bzo'i khyad ngo mtshar can bcu gsum byas so/ /de ltar dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang sde skor legs par bzhengs pa'i bzo phud la/ lha sar shing bzo'i phud la/ btsan khang dbusama'i mdun du sgo mo che rta babs kyis brgyan pa dang / sa'i phud la sgo srung rgyal chen bzhi bzhengs su gsol/ de ltar yos kyi lo la bsam yas kyi ming bting nas yos kyi lo la yongs su rdzogs par tshar te/ lo skor gcig 'gor ro/ /de nas rab tu gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ bza' btung gi longs spyod dpag tu med pa bsags/ mnga' zhabs kyi mi thams cad 'dus te/ dga' ston rgya chen po mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal pos slob dpon dang bo dhi sa twa la gser gyi phyag rten phul/ rgyal pos kyang rin po che du mas brgyan pa'i na bza' gsol te/ dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang sde skor dang bcas pa la / rab gnas ngo mtshar che ba'i rnam grangs yod pa lan bdun mdzad/ sprul pa'i skur bstan no/ /de'i rgyud ris kyang / dbu rtse'i sgo rgyab dang / gcor sa'i sgo 'gram gnyis la bris yod do/ 3//sdu'i thang yig che mo las/de ltar dpal gyi

brtse chen 'od snang las/ga skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()bsam yas la/ /rab gnas dga' ston mdzad pa'i dus/ /mtsho mo gur gyi dkyil drung der/ /pad+ma'i sdong po skyes pa'i gnas/ /rgyal po gser khri'i steng du bzhugs/ /yid 'ong btsun mo lnga po yang / /mdzes pa'i rgyan dang bcas te bzhugs/ /mchod gnas lo paṇa thams cad kyang / /dgyes shing chos kyi sgrog gleng mdzad/ /chos blon gtso bo thams cad kyang / /rgyal po bzhugs pa'i mtha' la bskor/ /de ltar mnga' 'og spyod pa'i 'bangs/ /dbus gtsang sde rigs thams cad nas/ /ma 'tshogs bya ba gang yang med/ /bza' btung longs spyod sna tshogs kyis/ /gang la ci 'dod thams cad tshims/ /dga' ba'i bro brdung skyid pa'i glu/ /nyin re bzhin du rgyun chad med/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs/ /gung la nyi ma grib pa tsam/ /'dab chags bya la 'phur sa med/ /mgo nag mi yis sa gzhi khengs/ /sil snyan rol mo 'brug bzhin ldir/ /gyi ling rta la rgyug sa med/khye'u bu mo thams cad kyis/ /chas brgyan lag na rnga ma thogs/ /rnga brdung glu len gar stabs bsgyur/ /g.yag seng dar seng stag seng dang / /'brug dang seng phrug gar mkhan dang / /dpal mdzes rnga thogs 'cham po sogs//rgyal po'i sku la mchod pa 'bul//de ltar rje 'bangs thams cad kyis//dga' ba'i lus la rang dbang med/ /bro brdung nam mkha'i char pa 'dra/ /skyed pa'i sems la dran 'dzin med/ /rang rang mos pa'i glu re len/ /de ltar mi rje lhas mdzad pa/ /chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan des/ /rin chen khri las bzhengasanas ni/ /rgyal po dgyes pa'i glu blangs pa/ /nga yi dbu rtse rigs gsum 'di/ /rin chen lnga las grub pa ste/ /brtsiga~X mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ /nga yi lha khang ngo

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long sprom chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// mtshar che/ /mthong ba tsam gyis nyams re dga'/ /de phyir bsam gyi blo re bde/ / lus 'phags gling la dpe blangs nas/ shar gyi lha khang gsum po 'di/ /rin chen lnga las grub pa ste//brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ /nga yi lha khang ngo mtshar che / / mthong ba tsam gyis nyams re dga'/ /de phyir bsam gyin blo re bde/ /'dzam bu gling la dpe blangs nas/ /myo yi lha khang gsum po 'di/ /rin chen lnga las grub pa ste/ /brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ /nga yi lha khang ngo mtshar che/ /mthong ba tsam gyis nyams re dga'/ /de phyir bsam gyin blo re bde/ /ba glang spyod la dpe blangs nas/ /nub kyi lha khang gsum po 'di/ /rin chen lnga las grub pa ste/ /brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ /nga yi lha khang ngo mtshar che/ /mthong ba tsam gyis nyams re dga'/ /de phyir bsam gyin blo re bde/ /sgra mi snyan la dpe blang sa nas/ /byang gi lha khang gsum po 'di/ /rin chen lnga las grub pa ste/ /brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ /nga yi lha khang ngo mtshar che/ /mthong ba tsam gyis nyams re dga'/ /de phyir bsam gyin blo re bde/ /nga yi yak+ṣa gong 'og 'di/ /mkha' la nyi zla shar ba 'dra/ /nga yi btsun mo gling gsum 'di/ /g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal bkod pa 'dra/ /nga yi mchod rten dkar po 'di/ /dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba 'dra/ /nga yi mchod rten dmar po 'di/ /me lte gnam la bsnyegs pa 'dra/ /nga yi mchod rten sngon po 'di/ /g.yu yi ka ba btsugs pa 'dra/ /nga yi mchod rten nag po 'di/ /lcags phur sal btab pa 'dra/ /nga yi mchod rten ngo mtshar che/ /mthong ba tsam gyis nyams re dga'/ /de phyir bsam gyin blo re bde/ /de la sogs pa 3 3 glu/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha dbang

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gtses bsdus/()gis/ /lha yi glu la dpe blangs nas/ /g.yu khang gser khri bya ba blangs/ /lha sras mu yi btsan po yis/ /'jig rten sgron me bya ba blangs/ /lha sras mu tig btsan po yis/ /seng ge 'gying ba bya ba blangs/ /btsun mo rnams kyis glu blangs pa/ /g.yu mtsho 'khyil ba bya ba blangs/ /mchod gnas rnams kyis glu blangs pa/ /mkhan po bo dhi sa twa yis/ /sgam phreng dkar po bya ba blangs/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /lha 'dre zil gnon bya ba blangs/ /mkhas pa be+e ro tsa na yis/ /dbyangs yig khug pa bya ba blangs/ /gnubs ban nam mkha'i snying po yis/ /mkha' la khyung lding bya ba blangs/ /ngan lam btsun pa rgyal mchog gis/ /rta mgrin 'gying dbyangs bya ba blangs/ /mkhas pa cog ro dpal bzang gis/ /skyid pa'i dpal dgu bya ba blangs/ /blon po rnams kyis glu blangs pa/ /chos blon chen po 'gos rgan gyis/ /drang shing dkar ba bya ba blangs/ /de sras yab lhag khri bzangs kyis/ /mdzangs yig 'phrul gyi lde mig blangs/ khri1da pu dpal gyi seng ge yis/ /ngur chung g.yu rings bya ba blangs/ /dmag dpon lha bzang klu dpal gyis//zar chen zar chung bya ba blangs//nyang bzang zhang po khri rgyal gyis//seng ge 'grel chen bya ba blangs/ /sbas kyi bstan bzang dpal legs kha kyis/ /'dod pa re brgyad bya ba blangs/ /mgar gyi khyung po dum tshugs kyis/ /bya rgod lding ba bya ba blangs/ /mchims kyi rdo rje sprel chung gis/ /mchims kyi brjed glu bya ba blangs/ /sna nam rgyal tsha lha snang gis/ /lha shug gong ma bya ba blangs/ khri 'bring lha 'od khug chos kyis/ /mdo chod rab 'bring tha gsum blangs/ /gnyags kyi khri bzang yang bon gyis/ /zla 'od 3 4 gdal bya ba blangs/ /li ngam stag sgra

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long 0pa chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// klu gong gis/ /lcags sprel gdong drug bya ba blangs/ /gtso bo rnams kyis glu blangs pa/ /ya mtshan gser gyi me tog blangs/ /stag shar rnams kyis glu blangs pa / / stag ru dgu brtsegs bya ba blangs/ /mo btsun rnams kyis glu blangs pa/ /me rtag phreng ba bya ba blangs/ /sman shar rnams kyis glu blangs pa/ /grong zer ring mo bya ba blangs/ /gzhan yang brjod kyis mi long ste/ /lo skor gcig gi bar du ni / / mi res glu re blangs pa yin//skyid pa'i dus su dpal gyi 'dom brkyang ste/ /dga' bde skyid pa'i dpal la longs spyad de/ /phan bde nyi zla'i 'od lta bur/ /lo skor gcig gi bar du phyogs thams cad du khyab par mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal po'i zhal nas/ tshe 'dir thar pa byang chub don du gnyer 'dod pas/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid 'dis kyang nges par bslus gsungs te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par bzhed nas/ rgya gar gyi yul nas paṇ+ḍita bi ma la mi tra la sogasapa'i mkhas pa mang po spyan drangs/ sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba bai ro tsa na dang / kha che a nan+da dang / 'dan ma rtse mangs dang / gnyags ku mā ra dang / me a tsār+ya rin chen mchog dang / 'khon klu'i dbang po/ ka ba dpal brtsegs/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan dang / zhang sna nam ye shes sde la sogs pas lo tsā byas te/ sgra bsgyur rgya gar gling du gzhi bzung nas/ sde sdod gsum ka bod du bskur/lo tsā ba snga tshar gsum/bar tshar gsum/phyi tshar gsum ste yongs su grags pa lo tsā ba dgu/dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba lta bur dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ /de nas bod 'bangs thams cad dge ba bcu'i khrims la gnas te/bde skyid dang ldan par gyur to/ /de 3 1 /khan po bo dhi satwa'i zhal nas/ slob

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()dngo na pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags pas/ bod du mu stegs pa mi 'ong gis/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su nang pa dang lta ba mi mthun pa'i dus shig 'ong / de'i dus su nga'i slob ma ka ma la shī la bya ba yod kyis de gdan drongs shig des lta ba phyogs gcig tu mthun par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs te/ mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas rgyal pos chos kyi ring lugs ye shes dbang po la bskos/ de nas mkhan pos ji ltar gsung ba bzhin/ rgya nag gi yul nas ha shang ma hā ya na bya ba bod du byon nas/ dbu ma'i lta ba la ston min pa bya ba dang / tsen min pa bya ba gnyis su byung nas/ nang pa dang lta ba ma mthun par rtsod pa byed do/ /de'i tshe mkhan po'i zhal chems bzhin/ ye shesadabang pos mkhas pa ka ma la shī la gdan drangs te bod du byon/ bsam yas kyi thad ga'i pha ri'i chu 'gram du phebs pa dang / ha shang na re/ bdag gis kyang paṇ+ḍi ta byon pa la bsu ba byed do gsungs te tshu ri'i chu 'gram du byon no/ /der ha shang byon pa ka ma la shī las gzigs te/ ka ma la shī la'i thugs la ha shang 'di rigs pa dang ldan na bdag gis nges par thul gyis rigs pa dang mi ldan na mi thul dgongs te/ ha shang gi rigs pa brtag pa'i phyir du/ khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyam pa'i rgyu ni gang yin zhes 'dri ba'i bde ston pa'i phyir du/ ka ma la shī las khong rang gi dbu la phyag shing lan gsum bskor bas/ de ha shang gis gzigs te/ 'khor bar 'khyam pa'i rgyu gzung 'dzin gnyis las byung zhes lan 'debs pa'i phyir du/ ber gyi thu ba nas bzung ste/ lan gnyis sa la brdab pas/ ka ma la shī la'i thugs la ha sha /gas pa dang ldan pa zhig 'dug pas/

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long 0pa chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// bdag gis thul bar 'dug go dgongs nas shin tu dgyes par gyur to/ / de nas bsam yas su phebs pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas/ bdag ni sangs rgyasakyi bstan pa la rab tu mos nas/ gtsug lag khang sde skor dang bcas pa bzhengs/ rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍita gdan drangs/ sde sdod gsum gyi chos thams cad bsgyur zhing yang dag par gtan la phab/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ chos la dgongs pa gcig tu mthun pa zhig yin na'ang / rgya nag nas ha shang byon te/chos la lta ba ma mthun par so sor bye bas/ mkhas pa ka ma la shī la gdan drangs pa yin/ bstan pa gcig la ston pa gnyis mi 'ongs pas/ sangs rgyasabacom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa mthun par sgro gleng gi rtsod pa mdzod la nga rgyal ma mdzad par rtsod pa su rgyal de la pham pa des me tog gtor cig gsungs so / / der sems bskyed byang chub gling du gdan khri chen po bshams te/ rgyal po gung la bzhugs/ g.yas phyogs su ha shang dpon slob rnams bzhugs/ g.yon phyogs su ka ma la shī la dpon slob bzhugs/ rtsod pa byas pas mkhas pa ka ma la shī la rgyal bar gyur te/ ha shang gis pham blangs nas me tog gtor ro/ /de nas ha shang slar rgya yul la bzhud pa dang / lham ya cig bod du lus pas ha shang gi zhal nas da rung bod du nga'i lta ba 'dzin pa 'ga' re yod par 'dug gsungs so/ /de ltar yang rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍita mkhas pa byon/ rgyal pos yon bdag mdzad/ lo tsā ba mkhas pas bsgyur zhing gtan la phab pa'i chos la 'jug par gyis shig ces rgyal pos bka' bstsal to/ /mkhas pa rnams dgongs pa gcig tu mthun cing / dam3 pas chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ sras

brtse chen 'od snang las/gci'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/()mu ba btsan po la rgyal srid gtad nas/ yab zung mkhar smyug ma mkhar gyi pho brang la byon te bzhugs so/ /'di dag ni zur tsam bsdus pa yin gyis/ rgyasapar 'dod na bsam yas kyi bka' gtsigs chen mo la gzigs shig de ltar chos rgyal khri sgong lde btsan de dgung lo lnga bcu nga drug pa shing mo glang gi lo la zung mkhar du gshegs so/ /de'i bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs/ /gral ni yab kyi rgyab ngos g.yas na yod/ /de ni ma grongs pa nas nyid kyis brtsigs/ /ming ni 'phrul ri btsug snang bya bar btags/ /de yi rtsa na rdo ring zhig kyang yod/ /bang so phyi rgyan can du grags par gyur/ /zhes so/ /nyer gnyis pa/ sras mu ne btsan po ni/ chu pho stag gi lo la brag dmar du sku 'thungs/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad la rgyal srid bzung / rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ btsun mo ru yong bza' mdo rgyal khab tu bzhes/ dge ba bcu'i khrims bzung / yab kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir du 'dul ba dang mngon pa dang / mdo sde gsum gyi mchod pa btsugs/ mchod rten chen po bzhi'i gdugs dang / dbu rtse'i bya 'dab lcags thag gis sbrel/ dar po che/ 'phan chen po rnams 'phyar/ mchod pa dpag tu med pa phul te/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/nga'i yab kyi gtsug lag khang 'di rnams la/ khyed bod 'bangs thams cad kyis rta phyugs dang / mtshon cha ma ga rta ges pa/ gzhan gser dngul/ g.yu mu tig la sogs pa'i dngos po gang 'dug phul cig gsungs pas/ rje'i bka' btsan pas/ la las ni gser dngul rin po ༵ snang po phul/ la las ni g.yu dang ber

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long zhwam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//dar zab phul/ la las ni gos dang rgyan phul/ la las ni gos hrul po dang / ras slag la sogs pa phul bas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyed bod 'bangs rnams dad pa che chung khyad re che/ la las ni nor dpag med 'bul/ la las ni rasahrul dang ras slag min pa mi 'bul lo zhes gsungs pas/ bod 'bangs rnamasan re/ dad pa che chung yod pa ma lags te/ phyug po rnams la 'bul rgyu yod/dbul po rnams la 'bul rgyu med pas lan zhes zhus pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/nga'i mnga' 'og 'dir mi rnams la ltogs phyug khyad 'di tsam 'ong ba mi 'os gsungs te/ ltogs phyug lan gsum snyoms pas/ lo re tsam ma gtogs phyug po rnams ni sngar ltar phyug dbul po rnams ni sngar bzhin ltogs pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ ltogs phyug lan gsum snyoms kyang / skyid sdug la khyad 'di tsam yod pa ci yin/ gang gis lan zhes gsungs pas/ mchod gnas rnams na re / 'di dag ni sngon gyi sbyin shugs yin zhes zhus pas/ las rgyu 'bras la rgyal po thugs ches so/ /de ltar rgyal pos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad de/ mchod gnas rnams dang / rab tu byung ba rnams ni dbu'i la thod bzhin khur/'tsho ba bla nas spyor/chab srid ni phan pa dang bde bas bskyangs so//btsun mo pho yong bza' rgyal mo btsun zer ba de/ yab rgyal po'i yum rgya mo bza'i skye ba yin pas/ yab kyi thugs la 'phreng bar gyur te/ yab zung mkhar du byon dus sras la gtad mnyer mdzad pas sras kyis khyab tu bzhes/ yab rgyal po grongs dus/ pho yong bzas rgyan ma bkrol/ mya ngan ma byas zer ba la bsnyad btags nas/ yum tshe spong ba/sdu phrag dog skyes te/ gshed ma bskos

brtse chen 'od snang las/tsho skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()nas gsod du btang bas/ sras rgyal pos bskyabs pas/ yum log lta skyes te sras la gsol ngan drangs te/ sras rgyal po mu yi bcan po lo gcig dang zla ba dgu la rgyal srid bzung nas/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu la pho brang yum bur grongs so / / sras mu rne btsan po'i bang so ni/ ag tshom bang so'i g.yas ngos mdun na yod/ /ming ni lha ri ldem po zer ro skad/ /ces so/ /nyer gsum pa/ de nas sras 'bring po mu tig btsan po la rgyal srid gtad rgyu la/ mu tig btsan pos kyang snga gong yab bzhugs dus/ blon zhad dbu ring nyes med du bsad pa'i ngan len du sna nam pas bkrongs so/ /de'i bang so don 'khor mda' ru brtsigs/ /ming ni kya ri kyang ldem lags so skad/ /de nasasras chung ba khri lde srong btsan sad na legs 'jing yon la rgyal srid gtad/rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ sngar med pa'i mdo dang sgra bsgyur/ mchod gnas paṇ+ḍi ta bi shwa ka ra/ be+e ro tsa na mchog ces/ ka ma la shī la 'a )sogs pa'i mchod gnas rnams la zhabs tog byas/ snga gong yab kyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams la mchod pa dang mar me phul/ dgung lo bcu dgu lon dus btsun mo lha rtse bya ba khyab tu bzhes/ de la sras gcig 'khrungs pa/rtsigs lo bcu gsum lon dus yab 'das/ bang so don mkhar mda' rnyi rdor la/sna /pa/ sras ldeng khri dgung lo bcu bzhi la rgyal srid bzung /btsun mo chen ma la gsum/ btsun mo chung ma zhig la sras lha rje lhun grub gnyis te lnga 'khrungs so/ /dge 'dun gyi sde 32 0 / yab mes kyis bzhengs pa'i

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long tham chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long ba khugs so//gtsug lag khang rnams la zhabs tog rgyas par mdzad do/ /rgyal po de dgung lo lnga bcu nga lnga bzhes dus/ me mo bya lo la sgrags kyi phur 'das so/ /de yi bang so 'phrul rgyal g.yon na yod/ /bang so de yang rin chen nor gyis bkang / /yum gyi /ba gang bskang pas mtho ba yin/ /ming ni rgyal chen bang so zer ro skad/ /zhesagor ra/ / nyer lnga pa/ der sras che ba gtsang ma ni chos la dga' ste rab tu byung / dar ma ni sdig la dga' ste rje'i 'os min/ bar pa ral pa can la srid gtad do/ /rgyal po mnga' bdag ral pa can de/ me pho khyi la sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gnyis la yab 'das te/ rgyal sar btan/ bka'i blon po bran kha dpal gyi yon tan gyis byas/ rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur/ btsun mo cog ro bza' dpal gyi ngang tshul la sogs pa btsun mo che chung lnga khab tu bzhes/ dge ba bcu'i khrims bzung / rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra/ shī la spre bo dhi/ dwa na shi la la sogs pa spyan drangs/ lo tsā ba ka ba dpal brtsegs/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ ban+de ye shes sde rnams kyis chos bsgyur te/ chos thams cad skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/ bka' bcad rnam pa gsum du mdzad do/ /tha na bre srang / zho la sogs pa thams cad kyang rgya gar dang bstun/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgom grwa btsugs/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bshad grwa btsugs/ chosasde sum cu tham par dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi 'dul grwa btsugs/ rab tu byung ba re re'i zhabs rtag la 'bangs mi khyim bdun phul/ rgyal po gung la bzhugs pa la//snyi'i ral pa g.yas g.yon gyi sne la dar

brtse chen 'od snang las/ga skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()yug btags/ dge 'dun bzhugs pa'i gral g.yas g.yon la bting / de'i steng du dge 'dun bzhugs par mos la dge 'dun dbu sde gnyis zhes grags so / / thugs dam du 'u shang rdo dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs par 'dod nas/ li'i yul nas rig byed la mkhas pa'i bzo bo bos/ bal po'i yul nas lha bzo dang / rdo bzo ba mang po bos nas lha khang dgu thog tu mdzad pa la/ 'og gi thog gsum sgo dpe dang bcas pa rdo las grub/bar gyi thog gsum sgo dpe dang bcas pa so phag las grub/ steng gi thog gsum sgo dpe dang bcas pa shing las grub/ rgya phub dgu brtsegs yod pa/ rgya phub re re'i bya 'dab bar na/ rab tu byung ba chos nyan bshad byed pa bzhugs/ steng gi rgya phub gser 'brug g.yu 'brug dang bcas pa/ rlung gis bskyod dus gdugasaltar 'khor ba/ bar gyi rtsig pa'i steng na/ rin po che'i pha gu la/ mda' yab dang pu shu/ dra ba dang dra ba phyed pas mdzes pa/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /rin po che'i phreng ba dang / dar gyi cod pan dang / dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra 'brol ba / rgya phub rtse'i gser 'bru rgyab ri dang mtho dman mnyam pa/ bod yul kun na 'gran zla dang bral zhing mthong ba tsam gyis dang bar byed la/ rlung chen rgya phub kyi phyogs bzhir lcags thag btang ste phyogs bzhir rdo'i seng ge dang sbrel/ de la steng gi thog gsum na rje'i thugs dam bzhugs/ bar gyi thog gsum na mchod gnas dge 'dun bzhugs/ 'og gi thog gsum na rje blon 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /de ltar 'u shang rdo dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i phud la/3/ sar sa phud/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin/

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// shing bzo'i phud la gnam yas ka ba bzhi rin po ches brgyan pa dang / ri mo'i phud la rnying pa gso rgyu nyan pa/ be bum brgya rtsa brgyad lugs ma'i phud du ljang lasogs pa rnams phul lo/ /gzhan yang rgyal po'i mchod gnas/ nyang sha'i spyan dang / blon po 'ga' zhig gis/ lha sa'i shar du/ /ru dang rme sa lho ru dga' ba dang / dga' ba'i 'od/ byang du bran khang dang / bran khang tha ma la sogs pa'i lha khang bzhengs so/ /de ltar rgyal po khri gtsug lde btsan ral pa can de/ mkhyen pa ni 'phrul gyi tshul chags/ mdzad pa ni lha'i lugs dang mthun/ mnga' thang dpal 'byor ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang mnyam/ dbang dang mthu stobs kyis ni bdud sdig can sgrag par byed pa/ mtha' bzhi las rnam par rgyal te/ 'dzam bu gling gsum gnyis la dbang mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar yang snga gong nas rgya bod kyi 'brel tshul/ btsan po dbon zhang rim bzhin byon pa rnams kyi lo rgyusamathun nas skyes 'bul res mdzad pa dang / 'khon nas dmag 'dren resamadzad pa'i rnam grangs mang du mdzad de/ de'ang rgya'i deb zer chen po zhu thu han chan bya ba na/ bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong dang lnga brgya drug cu rtsa drug lon pa'i dus rgya nag gi rgyal po thang zhes bya ba byung ste/ bod kyi rgyal po gnam ri sgong btsan dang dus mnyam/ de'i sras tha'i dzun rgyal po'i dus/srong btsan sgam po dang dus mnyam ste/ bod kyi rgyal pos rgya rje'i sras mo slong ba'i pho nya btang bas rgya rjes bu mo ma byin par bod du log ste/ rgyal po la rdzun zhus nas/ rgya rje de nged rang la shin tu dga' nas bu mo ster bar yod pa la/hor ser thu lu shun gyis rgya rje la phra / 23 lan zhes zhus pas/ bod kyi

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/()rgyal po khros nas bod dmag 'bum phrag gcig khrid de/ zung ci'u bya ba'i sa cha bar du byon/ de nas blon po g.ya' thung bya ba la dmag bskur nas/ thu lu hūd gyi yul 'joms su btang ba la/ thu lu jun rnams gtsang kha'i mtsho sngon phan la bros/ shul du lus pa'i mi nor thams cad bod kyis khyer ro/ /de nas bod kyi rgyal pos/ blon po se le stong btsan la rin po che sna tshogs bskur nas/ rgya rje'i sras mo slong du btang bas/ tso shing kong jo/ jo bo shākya/ rdzongs mang po dang bcas pa bod du sleb/ lcags pho khyi'i lo la/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po 'dasanas/ rgya yul nas bang so mchod pa la nor mang po khyer ba'i pho nya byung ngo / /rgya'i dmag bod du byung ste/po ta la me la sregs/do po rin po che btsal bas ma rnyed/mi bskyod rdo rje snga dro gcig gi bar khyer zer ba sogs rgya'i deb zer na 'dug go/rgyal po 'di'i dus/ de'i dbon po mang srong dgung lo bcu gsum la rgyal srid bzung bas na so gzhen te/ rgyal srid bya ba cher ma byung kyang / blon po mgar gyis mtha' bzhi'i khrims bsrungs/de'i dus su rgya'i dmag bod du byung nas 'joms pa dang / bod kyis kyang blon po mgar gyis dmag dpon byas nas/ bod dmag 'bum tsho gnyis khrid de/ rgya rnams pham par byas/ yul 'khor rnams bcom nas/ blon po mgar kyang dmag thog tu 'das so/ /rgyal po de'i sras 'dul srong 'phrul gyi rgyal po'i dusasu / yab kyi bang so mchod pa la/ rgya yul nas nor mang po khyer ba'i pho nya byung ngo / / de rjes mgar gyi sras snyan btsan ldem bu dang / thu lu ཿna gyi blon po ngo log gnyis dang bcas pas dmag khri tsho gsum khrid nas me chu'i 'gram na yod pa'i mkhar dang / mi sde 'joms su phyi/ zlos/ rgya'i yi kying he na chen gyi dmag

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// dang phrad nas/ 'thabs pas rgya rnams pham/ de ma khad ling kying gis rgya'i dmag sum stong bsnan nas/ bod dang 'thab tu 'ongs pas/ bod kyi dmag phyir bros so/ /bod kyi rgyal po 'dul srong mang po rje de'i stobs dang / mnga' thang dang / dbang phyug ni gzhan las che ba yin no/ /rgyal po de'i sras/ khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshom gyi dus su/ rgya rje dzung dzung rgyal po dang dus mnyam ste/ rgya rje de'i sras mo kyim shing kong jo bod du byon pa yin no/ /bu mo'i rdzongs la dar zab khri tsho mang po dang / bzo'i rigs byed sna tshang dang / rgyal po'i mdun la 'gro ba'i lag cha'i rigs gang yin byin nas za ya tha'i byang kun g.yang gu'i lhan zer ba'i mi dpon gnyis kyis mgo byas dmag mi mang po/ skyel du btang ste mthun pa'i gtam byas so/ /byang ngos dang gha'i sa cha yang lo sum cu'i bar du bod kyis bdag byas/ de'i sras rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su dbon zhang ma mthun par dmag rgyag res mang du byas 'dug cing / zhang rgya tsha lha gnang /dmag dpon lha bzang klu dpal la sogs pas bod dmag 'bum tsho gnyis tsam khrid nas/ shing kun dang / ce'u mkhar dang / sman ce'i yul rnams bco pa/dbon shad mthun pa'i skyes phul/ 'khon med par chad na'ang bod kyi rgyal posakha la rang re dang mthun par bya zer kyang / sems shin tu gnag par byung zer ro / / de ltar sras mu yi btsad po dang / sad na legs kyi dus su yang / skabasare mthun nas skyes 'bul ba dang / 'khon nas dmag 'dren res byas pa mang du 'dug go /de ltar/ mnga' bdag ral pa can gyis kyang / dbon zhang dang ma mthun par bod dmag khri tsho mang po 3// nas/ rgya'i yul mkhar thams cad

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()bcom/ rgya'i ha shang dang / bod kyi mchod gnas rnams kyi bar dang gna' dpang mdzad nas dbon po dgyes pa'i skyes phul/ da phyis 'khon med par chad nas/rgya yul rme ru bya ba'i so mtshams su btsan po dbon zhang gnyis kyis lha khang re brtsigs/ pha bong la nyi zla bris nas/ gnam la nyi zla zung gcig sal btsan po dbon shad / rgya'i rme ru man la bod kyi dmag mi drangs/ de yan la rgya'i dmag mi drangs/ phan tshun du sa mtshams bsrung ste/ sa sa ma la/rdo rdo mal du gnas nas/ bod bod yul na skyid/ rgya rgya yul na skyid pa'i khrims mdzad nas/dkon mchog gsum dang / nyi zla dang / gza' skar dang / lha gnyan rnams dpang du btsugs te/ dbon shad gnyis kyis dbu bsnyung dang bro bor ro/ /de ltar chad mol gyi yi ge rdo ring gsum la byas te/ rdo ring gi zheng che ba gnyis la btsan po dbon shad gnyis kyis chad mal la bgyis pa'i mna' tshigs kyi yi ge bris/ zhed chung ba gnyis la bod dang rgya'i blon po/ bka' la gtogs pa'i rtsisapa rnams kyi ming rus bris nas/ rdo ring gcig lha sar btsugs/rdo ring gcig rgya rje'i pho brang mdun du btsugs/ rdo ring gcig rgya bod kyi mtshams rme ru ru btsugs so/ /gal te chad mol bgyis pa'i yi ge 'di la ma bsam par bod kyis rgya la dmag drangs na/ rgya rnams kyis rgya rje'i pho brang gi mdun gyi rdo ring gi yi ge lan gsum klog na bod thams cad phung bar 'gyur la/ rgya rnams kyisabod la dmag drangs na/ lha sa'i rdo ring gi yi ge lan gsum klog na/ rgya thamasacad phung bar 'gyur ro zhes btsan po gnyis kyis ni phyag rgyas btab/ bod dang rgya'i blon po bka' la gtogs pa 3 2 rdos ni dmod btsugs so/ /de dag ni

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhug so// zur tsam yin gyis/ bod dang rgya'i chad mol gyi yi ge zhib par 'dod na/lha sa'i rdo ring gi yi ge la gzigs shig de rjes sog po'i dmag dpon bod du byung ste/ blon po khyung zhags bsad pas des rkyen nas bod dang rgya gnyis 'brel chad pa yin zer ro/ /rgya bod lo rgyus deb ther 'di/ rgya nag tha'i dzung rgyal po'i dus kyi yig mkhan su khyi han gyis bsgrigs pa las rim pa bzhin du bcos te/dus phyis rgya'i lo tsā ba 'u kyang dzus/ shing khun sde chen du bod skad du bsgyur ba la/lo grangs mi mthun pa 'ga' re dang de dus kyi mi'i ming rnams la 'dra min re 'dug na'ang bla ma gu shrī rin chen grags rgya yul na bzhugs dus/ rgya bod kyi 'brel tshul 'di rnams gtan tshigs su bzhed nas/ shing mo bya'i lo la shing kun sde chen du par du btab ste kun la rgyas par mdzad pa yin no/ /'di ni zur tsam yin gyis/ bod dang rgya'i 'brel tshul dang / dbon shad gi lo rgyus rnamasazhib par 'dod na/ par ma de nyid la gzigs shig de ltar rgyal po mnga' bdag ral pa can des/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la dgongs nas/dbang dge 'dun la gtad/ chos khrims dang / rgyal khrims gnyis gtan la phab/ lha sa/ bsam yas/ dkar chung la sog bas pa'i yab mes(kyibs bzhed bangapa'i lha khang rnams la zhabs tog mdzad/ bod 'bangs thams cad dge ba bcu'i khrims la bkod de/ rku dang / jag dang / g.yo zol sogs byed pa med par gyur nas/ blon 'bangs chos la mi dga' ba thams cad spyod pa shin tu dog par gyur to/ /de nas 'bangs rnams kyis nged rang rnams 'di tsam pa'i spyod pa dog pa 'di gang gis lan zhes gci/ ༵ gcig gis smras pa dang / de dag ni

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()'di rnams kyis lan no zer te/ btsun pa rnams la mdzub mo gtad nas/ mig ngan bltas pas/ rgyal pos gsan te/ nga'i rab tu byung ba rnams la sdigasamadzub gtad nas mig ngan lta bar mi rigs pas/ da phyis sus byas na'ang mig phyung la mdzub mo chod cig gsungs so/ /de ltar rgyal po chos la shin tu dkar ba de la/ sbas stag rna can la sogs pa sdig blon rnams shin tu ma dga' nas/chos khrims 'jig pa'i gros byas nas/ rgyal po ma bkrongs na chos khrims 'jig mi thub zer/ la la na re/ rgyal po bgrongs kyang / lha sras gtsang ma dang /blon po bran kha dpal yon gnyis chos la dga' bas chos khrims 'jig mi thub zer/ der snga sor lha sras gtsang ma dang / bran kha dpal yon gnyis med pa byas/ de rting la rgyal po bkrong bar thag bcad/ mo rtsis pa rnams la brngan pa byin nas/ thams cad kha mthun par lha sras gtsang ma 'dir bzhugs na/ sku tshe la bar chod 'ong zhing / rgyal srid 'jig par 'gyur zhes glengs nas/ lha srasagatsang ma dpa' gro mon la sprugs/ de'i rjes la rgyal po la sbas stag rna can gyis phra ma zhus te/ chos blon chen po bran kha dpal gyi yon tan dang / bzhi mo cog ro bza' dpal gyi ngang tshul gnyis mi 'os pa'i spyod pa byas so zer nas/chos blon chen po nyes med la skyon phab nas bkrongs so/ /de rjes la rgyal po dgung lo sum cu so drug pa lcags mo bya'i lo la/ rgyal po 'bras chang gsol nas gzims pa la/ sbas stag rna can dang / cog ro lha lod gnyis kyis rgyal po ltag pa bskor nas bkrongs so/ /'di yan la skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu gsum dang / shin tu skyid pa'i disa~X rabs lnga zer/ mnga' bdag ral

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ngam cho 'gyung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// pa can gyi bang so ni/ /don mkhar mda' yi g.yon zur de ru brtsig /bang so de'ang rin chen nor gyis bkang / /ming ni khri steng slong ri zer ro skad/ /de nasarje'i mnga' thang ni dgun kha'i 'bab chu bzhin bri/ dge bcu'i rgyal khrims ni sog rul gyi phon thag bzhin zhig bod 'bangs kyi bsod nams ni snum zad kyi mar me bzhin song / chab srid phan bde ni nam mkha'i 'ja' bzhin yal/ nag phyogs kyi spyod pa ni yul ngan gyi 'tshub ma bzhin langs/ bzang byed kyi bsam blo ni mdang sum gyi rmi lam bzhin brjed/ de ltar du gyur te/ lo paṇa dang mchod gnas la zhabs tog med par so so'i yul la bzhud/ chos bsgyur 'phro rnams bsgyur/ blon 'bangs chos la dga' ba rnams ni mya ngan gyis non te bya thabs med par gyur to/ /nyer drug pa/ de nas sbas stag rna can la sogs pa'i sdig blon ngan pa rnams dbang ches pas rgyal po khri glang dar ma dbu dum btsan bdud kyi sprul pa/chos la mi dga' zhing / sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa de/ rgyal sar bskos te rgyal khams la dbang byas so/ /dus der paṇ+ḍi ta dwa na shwe las lha sa'i shar rme ru lha khang du mtshams bcad nas/ ṭ+wāṃ lha bsgrubs pas dka' bar byung ba dang /paṇ+ḍi ta khros te/ ṭ+wāṃ lha 'jim gzugs de'i grod par mkhar sil gyi rting pas brgyab pas/lcags kyi rdo rje yin zer ba'ang 'dun grod pa nas gser mang po byung ba dang / de la rgyu byas te sku'i rten du kha rla pa ṇi/ gsung gi rten du gser khri/thugs kyi rten du dngul bya khun bu can rnams bzhengs/ de'i nye gnas kha che ut+pa las dngul gyi byams pa bzhengs/ sdo/9 kyi mchod pa btsugs/ dus

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa 'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()der sad dang ser ba dang / btsa' dang / mu ge dang / mi nad phyugs nad la sogs pa byung bas/ de la snyad byas/ rgyal po'i thugs la gdon gsol nasasangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs so/ /rab tu byung ba rnams la la shan pa bcol/ la la rtags dang phral/ la la ri dwags bskor du bcug ma nyan pa rnams srog dang phral/ lha khang 'jig pa'i sngon ma lha sal byas te/ jo bo rnam gnyis chu la bsgyur gsungs pa chos blon rnams kyis thabs byas te/ rang rang gi khri'i 'og tu sbas/ byams pa'i sku ras kyis dril nas/ 'o thang gi mtsho 'gram du sbas/ nang gi lder sku rnams chu la bskyur bsams nas/ phyag na rdo rje'i mgul la thag pa btags pas/ 'dogs mkhan skad cig la khrag skyugs nas shi bas lha khang 'jig 'phro bcad/ lha sa dang bsam yas la sogs pa'i sgo rtsigarme ru ma gtogs/gzhan lha khang chung ba thams cad bshig glegs bam la la chu la bsgyur/ la la me la sregs/ la la gter bzhin sbas so/ /blon po chos la dga' ba rnams kyis rgyal po'i thugs la gdon gsol bar shes nas mya ngan drag tu byed cing mgrin gcig tu rgyal po chen po sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che smad par mi rigs/ sngar srol bzang po la dgongs nas/ yab mes kyi mig tshangs la gzigs shig ces ngus so/ /dus der chu bo ri'i sgom grwa na/ g.yo dge 'byung / gtsang rab gsal/ dmar shākya mu yi gsum sgom gyin yod pa la/btsun pa gcig gis sham thabs brjes lag tu mda' gzhu thogs/ mgo la bya sgro btsugs nas 'phral du khyi khrid nas ri dwags bshor gyin 'dug pa g.yo dge 'byung gis mthong nas/ ban rgan lus/ lam/ btsun pa spyo zer ci byung dris

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byurigs la ba'i me long bzhug so// pas/ ri dwags pa de bstan nas khong gnyis na re/ khyed cag ma gzul/ btsun pa spyo 'dug zer te/ btsun pa de rtsar bos nas rgyu mtshan dris pas/ btsun pa na re / khyed cag gsum po rgyal po'i chad pa ma phog pa nyen re che zer nas/ chosasgrubs pa'i lo rgyus rgyas par bshad pa dang / khong gsum po shin tu sgrag par gyur nas/ skad cig kyang sdod pa'i longs med par 'dul ba'i pu sti drel rgyab gsum khyer nas/ byang lam la phyin khams su bros te/ dan tig shel gyi brag phug tu bzhugs so/ /de'i rjes la ka 'od mchog grags pa dang rong ston seng ge rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis mngon pa dang mdzod kyi pu sti mang po khyer nas khams la bros te/ san chung gnam rdzong gi brag khung du bzhugs so/ /de'i dus su lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje yer pa'i brag khung na/ sgom byed kyin yod pa la nam phyed na lha sa'i bstan srung dpal lha mo byung nas da lta bod na grub thob khyed las mi 'dugargyal po glang dar mas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bar gcod byas/ rgyal po sdig can gsod ran kho mos grogs bya yis/ snying ma chung cig zer ro/ /sang nye gnas la rgyu mtshan dris pas bden par 'dug nas rang gi srog blos btang ste/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bsam ste/ rgyal po gsod pa'i spobs pa bskyed nasathabs sna tshogs byas te/ rta dkar po la sol ba byugs nas nag po byas/ ber phyi nag pa nang dkar ba byas te gon/ mgo la zhwa nag po gon/ gdong la sol snum byug phu thung du mda' gzhu bcug rta nag la zhen te/ bdud nag po bkrag med yin no zhes zer te lha sar 'ongs so/ /der rgyal po rdo ring gi yi ge gzigs kyin 'dug pa'i drung du phyin /3//phyag byed pa ltar byas nas yi dam la

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/()dmod btsugs te/ phu thung nang nas mda' gzhu btan/ phyag dang po la mtheb sprad/ gnyis pa la mda' bkang / gsum pa la rgyal po'i dpral ba la mda' brgyab nas bros so/ /der rgyal pos phyag gnyis kyis dpral ba'i mda' la 'jus te mod la grongs so/ /rgyal po glang dar ma glang lo la gsangs/bya lo la rgyal sa bzung /lo lnga'i bar du chos snabs/dgung lo sum na so brgyad lon pa'i stag lo la grong pa yin no/ /der ra mda' bos nas phyogs bzhir rgyugs pas/ shar phyogs pa rnams na re/ zin la khad yod pa la dga' mo gdong nas gros nas ma mthong bar shor zer ro/ /lho phyogs pa rnams na re/ grib kyi chu 'gram nas sa sros nas ma mthong bar shor zer/ nub phyogs pa rnams na re/ shun gyi 'brang nas sa sros nas ma mthong bar shor zer/ byang phyogs pa rnams na re/ mdong mkhar gdong nas phros nas ma mthong bar shor zer/ nges pa can du grib kyi mdar gdong gi chu la lte nyal byas pas/ rta la sol ba byugs pa dag ste dkar por song / zhwa nag bskyur/ gdong gi sol snum bkrus/ ber dkar po phyir bstan nas gon te/ nga ni lha gnam thel dkar po yin no zer nas song ngo / /der phyogs bzhir rgyugs pa'i ra mda' ba rnams kha ma 'cham par so so'i mdun du sprul pa re re byung bas/ 'di ni lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje yin nges zer nas mer ba'i brag la 'tshol du btang ngo / / der dpal gyi rdo rjes brag khung der/ bsam gtan la yod pa'i lugs su byas/ phug ron gcig bzung nas sa rdul 'bebs su bcug de'i steng du mug ma dang grog sbur la sogs pa btang bas de rnams kyi rjes mis mthong ba dang min par shes nas log go /mi rig rdo steng ldan pa zhig nang du byung ste/ khong gi

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byurigs la ba'i me long bzhugs so// snying gar lag pa bzhag pa dang / snying 'dar ba shes te/ spyi'i tha ba la/ sgos su shol mi bcog zer nas song ngo / /de nas shin tu sgrag par gyur te/ skad cig kyang sdod pa'i longs med par khams la bros so/ /nyer bdun pa/ der rgyal po sdig can bkrongs pa'i rjes su btsun mo chung ba zhig la gdung brgyud kyi sras stor zhig byung ba dang / btsun mo che ba'i bsam pa la 'dis bdag gi mnga' thang la gnod par nges bsam ste/ lus la gos kyis dkris nas nga la'ang sras stor zhig yod do zhes bu chung che rdzun byas so / / der btsun mo chung ba'i zla dus thim pa dang / gdung brgyud yin nges kyi sras 'khrungs te/ sku shin tu gces pas nyin mo ni mis bskor/ mtshan mo ni mar me'i 'od kyis bsrungs pas na mnga' bdag 'od srungs zhes zer ro/ /der btsun mo che bas kyang sprang po'i bu chung skyes ma khad cig nyos nas sha la sbyar te/nga la'ang 'di skyes pa yin no zer bas/ thams cad the tshom za bar gyur kyang /yum btsun mo dbang che bas smra ma nus te/ yum ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin brtan du bcug pas/ mnga' bdag yum brtan zhes zer ro/ /mnga' bdag 'di gnyis sku nar ma son kyang / blon po chos la dga' ba rnams kyis zhus te/ jo bo rnam gnyis dang / byams mgon rnams 'og nas brtan nas/ rang rang gi khri la bzhugs nas mchode pa byas/ lha khang zhig pa rnams slar gsos so/ /de nasasrid la ma 'cham pas/ 'od srungs kyis g.yo ru bzung nas 'khrug pa byas so/ /sa mo glang la gyen log byung / me mo bya la bang so rnams bzhig go /mnga' bdag 'od srungs kyi sras/ rje dpal ༷/ra btsan/ de'i chen ma'i sras skyid sde

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/(te/nyi ma mgon/'di nas ya tshe dang mnga' ri kyi rgyal po byung /chun ma'i sras bkra shis brtsegs pa/ 'di nas la stod pa dang yar lung jo bo byung /'di gnyis kyi srid gang yod rnams yum brtan gyis phyogs pas/ mnga' ris la bros nas mnga' ris rgyal po mdzad pa yin no/ /sprang phrug gces par gsos pas mnga' bdag yum brtan byung / /rigs ngan dpon du bskos pas dge bcu'i rgyal khrims med/ sha gong nyung mas bcad pas phan bde'i nyi ma 'gribs/ /rgyal brgyud mtha' la phud pas rje yi gdung rabs chad/ /ces pa'o/ /nyer brgyad pa/ yum brtan gyi sras la/ khri de mgon snyan/ de la srasaganyis zhas pas pa'i che ba rig pa mgon/ chung ba nyi ma mgon/ nyi ma mgon gyi sras nyi 'od dpal mgon/ 'di'i brgyud rlung shod/ 'phan yul/ mdo khams na mang ngo / khri rig pa mgon la sras gnyis zhakhrungs pa'i che ba lde bo/ chung ba rdo rje 'bar lde po'i brgyud bug pa can pa dang / thang la brag pa rnams so/ /rdo rje 'bar gyi sras khri dbang phyug btsan/ de'i sras tsha na ye shes rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras mnga' bdag khri pa/ yab sras 'di gnyis kyi dus su bstan pa'i me ro mdo khams nas lang pa yin no/ /mnga' bdag khri pa la sras bzhi 'khrungs pa/ a tsa ra / dge slong / bla ma/ lha btsun bo dhi ra tsa'o/ /a tsa ra'i brgyud/ 'phrong po ba/lcang rgyab pa/ glag pa lam pa/ grib pa/ snye thang pa/ lus pa gtsang bo la the snags pa rnams yin no/ /bla ma la brgyud med/ dge slong gi brgyud dpe bzhi pa/ 'on rdo mong mkhar pa rnams yin no/ /bo dhi ra tsa'i brgyud la/ lha btsun sngon mo snyug rum pa/ lha 'bri sgang pa la sogs pa 31sdum yas na da lta yod pa rnams yin

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long pa ma chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// no / / de rnams kyi brgyud phyogs thams cad du so sor 'phel bas kyi g.yor kun nā ra ze paX jo bor ming btags pa rnams yin pas/ rigs shin tu ma dag pa yan go/ ṭ+wāṃ/ dgu/ pa de ltar rgyal po glang dar mas lcags mo bya la chos bsnubs/lcags mo bya la bstan pa'i me ro langs nas/ lo skor dgu'i bar du dbus gtsang na chos med do zer kyang / nges pa can du lo skor brgyad/ lo dgu brgya go brgyad kyi bar chos kyi ming tsam yang med do/ /de ltar gong du bshad pa ltar chu bo ri nas bros pa'i g.yo dge 'byung / gtsang rab gsal/ dmar shākya mu yi gsum khams su bros so/ /de'i rjes la ka 'od mchog grags pa dang / rong ston seng ge rgyal mtshan/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje dang gsum snga rting du bros so/ /de'ang thog mar khams su slob ma byung ba ni/ bon po'i bu me za gsal gyis phyugs 'tshor phyin pas/ chu bo ri nas byon pa'i dge slong gsum po dang mjal te/ las 'phro'i dbang gis dad pa skyes nas rab tu byung bar zhus pas gnang ste/ mkhan slob song ste gsum kha'i mtshan nas dras te/ shākya dge ba gsal du btags/sde snod gsum la mkhas par gyur to/ /de la brten nas khams pa'i mi bal rdo rje dbang phyug snubs dpal gyi byang chub/ yang gong ye shes g.yu sa sbar rin chen/ lcang ye shes seng ge co ro shes rab byang chub/ gzhan yang shod chung ba shes rab grags/ an 'bar ba byang chub/ grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ gnubasadapal gyi byang chub/ sgro mañdzu shī la sogs pa'i mkhas btsun mang po byon no/ /de'i tshe rgyal po sdig can gyis chos ba/5 lo drug cu lon pa na/ 'phan

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung brtes bsdus/()yul shog na rmu gsal gshen 'bar bya ba'i bon po'i bu/ rmu za 'phan bya ba'i byis pa zhig gis/ snang gsal lha khang bya ba'i nang du phyin pas/ rab tu byung ba chos nyan bshad byed pa 'dra ba'i gzugs gyang ris la 'dug pas ci yin dris pas/ de na 'dug pa'i rgan mo zhig na re/ rab tu byung ba bya ba'i gzugs yin byas pas/ byis pa de sngon gyi las 'phro'i dbang gis dad pa skyes nas mchi ma phyung ste/ rab tu byung ba da lta e yod dris pas/ rgan mo na re/ nga bu mo'i dus na yin te/ rgyal po glang dar mas chos sgrubs pa'i dus/ rab tu byung ba rnams phab pas/ rtags dang phral/ la la bsad/ la la shi da lta dbus gtsang na rab tu byung ba med do/ /chu bo ri dang mer pa la sogs nas khams su bros pa'i rab byung mang po da lta khams na yod thag chod 'dug zer bas/ rab tu dga' ste/lus dang srog la ma bltas par byis pa des khams su phyin pas/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje dang mjal nas/ dad pa skyes nas rab tu byung bar zhus pas/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje'i zhal nas/ bdag gis rgyal po sdig can bsad pas nga la sdom pa med/ ngas grogs bya yis gsungs nas/ mkhas btsun de rnams dang mjal rab tu byung bas/ ming yang bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal du grags so/ /de ltar khams na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing / bod na chos med par mun pa'i smag rum du gyur pa na/ rgyal po sdig can gyis chos bsnubs nas lo brgyad cu lon pa na bsam yas kyi mnga' bdag tsha na ye shes rgyal mtshan des bdag rkyen mdzad nas khams su sdom pa len pa'i thog mar/ dbus gtsang gi mi bdun du grags pa ni/ klu mes shes rab tshuX 3sdoms/ 'bri ye shes yon tan/ tshong ge

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long sngam rdzo 'byung gsal ba'i me thong spa sa so// shes rab seng ge lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug sum pa ye shes blo gros/ rgya blo gro shes rab/ gzhon ban chos mchog dang bdun gyis grum ye shes rgyal mtshan la mkhan po zhus/ co ro shes rab byang chub la slob dpon zhus nas bka 'a drin mnos so/ /de'i rting la phyin pa lnga ni/ mtha' bzhi rgyal 'phags/ rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sba btsun blo gros dbang phyug skyes legs nyang bran chos skyabs/ grum shing shes rab smon lam mo/ /de ltar sngon la khams su sdom pa len du phyin pa'i mi bdun po des sdom pa blangs nas phyir 'ongs pa dang / rting la phyin pa'i mi lnga po dag lam la 'phrad de/ gar 'gro dres pas/ khams su sdom pa len du 'gro zer bas/ sngon ma rnams na re/ nged rnams kyi sdom pa gsum ldan du blangs yod pas nged kyis sdom pa phog pas chog thag ring la 'gro mi dgos zer ba la ma nyan par khams su phyin te/ sngar gyi mkhas btsun rnamasadang mjal/ sdom pa blangs te phyir dbus gtsang du slebs nas bsam yas kyi btsad po tsha na ye shes rgyal mtshan grongs 'dug na'ang / de'i sras btsad po khri pas bdag rkyen mdzad de/ klu mes la sogs pa rnams kyis dbus gtsang thams cad du lha khang bsam gyis mi khyab pa brtsigs dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin bo che slar shing skam gyi phung po la me 'bar ba lta bur phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas pa na bstan pa'i srog rtsa legs par bzung me ro bslangs nas bod mun pa'i gling du sgron me 'bar bar mdzad pa gong du bshad pa'i khams dbus kyi mkhas btsun rim par byon pa de rnams dang mnga' bdag ye shes rgyal mtshan yab sdu/ rnams sku drin shin tu che'o/ /

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung zhes bsdus/()sum cu pa/ de ltar bstan pa rin po che la bka' drin che ba'i bod rgyal po'i gdung brgyud gong du bshad pa ltar/ rje dpal 'khor btsan gyi chen ma'i sras/ skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyis mnga' ris kyi rgyal po mdzad/ spu rangs la'ang dbang bsgyur/ de la sras gsum che ba dpal gyi mgon gyis mang yul bzung /'di na rdzo bo ra 'a gyi bar du brgyud/bar pa bkra shis mgon gyis spu rangs bzung /chung pa lde btsun mgon gyis zhang zhung bzung / 'di gsum la stod na bzhugasapa'i mgon gsum zer/ lde btsan mgon la sras gnyis te/ 'khor re dang srong nge gnyis so/ /srong nges sku tshe'i stod la btsun mo khab tu bzhes pas sras gnyisagazungs pa'i na ga ra tsa dang / khyo ba ra tsa'o/ /sku tshe'i smad la rab tu byung nas/lha bla ma ye shes 'od du mtshan gsol/ mthon mthing dpal gyi lha khang bzhengs/lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po dang / rngog legs pa'i shes rab la sogs pa blo rno ba nyi shu rtsa gcig rgya gar du chos slob pa la btang / paṇ+ḍita shurnya ka ra dang warma ta gnyis spyan drangs te/ mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang / rgyud sde bzhi po bsgyur zhing gtan la phab/ 'dul ba stod lugs dar bar mdzad do/ /gcen po 'khor resakha char gyi lha khang bzhengs/ de'i sras lha lde pos paṇ+ḍita su bha ṣi da dang paṇ+ḍi ta rme ru spyan drangs/ lha lde po la sras gsum 'khrungs pa'i che ba zhi ba 'od/ 'bring ba lha bla ma byang chub 'od/ chung ba 'od lde'o/ /'di gsum gyi dus su lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dgongs nas/ rgya gar du paṇ+ḍita gdan 'dren byon pas lam du mu stegs pa'i dmag gis bzung / dge phyogs kyi yon tan skyed pa'i rtsa sgo thams cad me) sdus bsregs te rmongs par byas so/ /

rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bab gas so//de'i gtam lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis gsan te/ nor dpag med bskur na sablu ru btang bas/ gser lus dang ljid mnyam pa dgos zer ba dang / yang gser gang yod bskur bas rgya ma la bteg dus dbu'i cha tsam zhig gser gyis ma long par khong na re/ da ni khyed rnams kyis bdag blus kyang yon tan med/nga'i rtsa sgo me btsas bsregs nas dud 'gro lta bu yod pas bdag shi na'ang bla'i/nga blu ba'i gser rnams khyer la rgya gar na rgyal po dge ba dpal gyi sras bi kra ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang na/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi gta lnga brgya pa rnams kyi nang nas gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa/ jo bo rje di paṃ kā ra zhesabya ba bzhugs yod par 'dug de la gser phul bod du gdan drangs la/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzod cig gsungs te grongs pa dang / bur yul du spyan drangs nas mchod rten du bzhugs so/ /so gcig pa/ der khong gis lung bstan bzhin/ jo bo gdan 'dren pa la rgya brtson seng la sogs pa la gser bskur nas btang ngo / /bod du 'byon pa la thabs du ma'i sgo nas gsol ba btab pas/ jo bos kyang bod mnga' ris kyi gdul bya la dgongs/ rje btsun ma sgrol mas kyang lung bstan pa bzhin bod du byon nas/ slob ma nag tsho dang khu rngog 'brom gsum/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po / lo chung legs pa'i shes rab la sogs pa mkhas bstun du ma byon te/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba lta bur mdzad pas na/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od de bod la bka' drin che ba lags so/ /339

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung tha rjes bsdus/()so gnyis pa/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyi gcung po 'od ldes paṇ+ḍita kha che dwa na shrī spyan drangs/ de'i sras btsan lde/ de'i sras bha lde/ de nas rim pa bzhin du bkra shis lde bha re na ga lde rnams byung ba 'di rnams kyis gu de spu rangs mang yul la sogs pa'i rgyal khams la dbang byas pa yin no/ /yang na ga lde'i srasabatsan phyug ldes ya tsher byon te rgyal po mdzad/ de'i sras bkra shis lde/ de'i srabs grags btsan lde/ de'i sras grag bas pa lde/ de'i srabs a rog lde/ de'i srasasa.a sog lde/ de'i sras dzi dar smal dang / a nan+da smal gnyis so/ /a nan+da smal gyi sras/ ri lu smal gyis lha sar jo bo rin po che'i dbu thog tu gser thog phub/de la sras gnyis sang gha smal dang / 'dzi thar smal gnyis so/ /'dzi thar smal gyi sras a 'dze smal/ de'i sras ka len smal/ de'i sras bar rti smal/ de nas ya tshe'i rgyal brgyud chad nas spu rangs nas mnga' bdag bsod nams lde ya tsher gdan drangs nas rgyal sa bzung / pu ṇi smal bya bar mtshan btags/ de'i srasapyi ti smal dang / blon po dpal ldan grags gnyis kyis lha sar bcu gcig zhal gyi steng du gser thog phub/ stod na bzhugs pa'i rgyal brgyud 'di rnams/gser thog pa rin rdor gyi yig tshang las zur tsam bris pa yin gyis rgyal po re re bzhin gyi mdzad pa phrin las rnams zhib par shes 'dod pa de nyid kyi/ yig tshang la gzigs shig /so gsum pa/ yang bod kyi rgyal po'i gdung brgyud gong du bshad pa ltar rje dpal 'khor btsan gyi chun ma'i sras/ 'di nas la stod dang /gtsang stod tsong kha mdo smad yar lung jo bo la sogs bod kyi rgyal brgyud yin nges rnams yin no/ /bkra shis brtsegs pa 340
