rgyal rab gsal ba'i me long sprom chos 'byung gsal ba'i long bzhugs so// la sras gsum byung ba dpal lde 'od lde skyid lde gsum yin te/ 'di gsum la smad du bzhugs pa'i lde gsum zer/ sras che ba dpal lde'i sras ni sngon po tshom por thugs te/ khab gung ba klu rgyal ba spyi pa lta rtse glang lung btsad 'khor ba rnams te/ la stod man chod pa rnams yin no/ /sras chung ba skyid lde shangs rta nag tu phog sras drug byung ba'i lnga byang du gshegs te/ 'bro'i btsad po dang /g.yas ru ru lag gi btsad po pam dang / mus pa dang 'jang nyang stod na yod pa rnams so/ /sras 'bring po 'od lde la sras bzhi byung ba/ pha ba de se khri lde khri chung nyag lde'o/ /pha ba de se'i brgyud snub yul dang rong dang / g.yag sde nyang stod stag tshal na yod do/ khri lde'i brgyud ni shar myong kha'i rgyal po spyan mnga' don chen la sogs pa mdo smad kyi btsad po da lta bzhugs pa rnams yin no/ /nyag lde'i brgyud gtsang g.yas ru na yod/ skyin mkhar btsad po'i bar du'o/ khri chung gis/ yar lung jo po'i yang mes/yar lung du byon nas sku mkhar 'phying ba stag rtse bzung / de'i sras 'od skyid 'bar/ de la sras bdun byung ba'i che ba zhad rje tsha khri 'bar/ de'i gcung po btsad pa tsha spun drug shad rje tsha khri 'bar gyi sras drug la g.yu thog gi brgyad sna mo ba 'phying nga ba don mkhar ba thang 'khor ba rnams so/ /gcung po btsad pa tsha spun drug ni lha spyad dang /brgyud med/g.yu can gnyis 'di nasayar lung rjo bo byung /dar dang brgyud med lhun po gnyis brgyu med 'od lde dang gung btsan gnyis te drug go /'od btsan dang gung btsan gyi brgyud ni khra 'brug pa bying ba byar ba chu mig gog po na yod pa rnams so/ /g.yu can ni gar mi yon tan g.yu rung gis gdan drangs nas byas sar spya/ te bzhugs/ de'i sras jo dga'/ de

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa 'i cho 'byung gce bsdus/()la sras gsum yod pa'i srabs che ba bya bas lha chen/'di bya sa'i lha khang bzhedas/khri dar ma gcung por rab tu byung / khri dar ma la sras bzhi byung ba gtsug lde/srasamed/khri gtsug jo bo rnal 'byor 'di 'tsho gsas gsas/jo bo smon lam mo/ /'di rab tu byung nas spu gu'i gzims khang dkar po brtsigs te bzhugs/khri btsug gis byas dang dos sngon bzung / de'i sras khri btsan/ de'i sras kha khri/ de'i sras lha khri la sogs pa yar mda' ba rnams yin no/ /jo bo rnal 'byor la sras gsum byung ba che ba ja 'bag byung ba/ 'bring ba lha chen no/ /'di spyil phu'i gdan mdzad/chung ba lha ngam shod pa'o/ /'di rab tu byung na sras med/jo 'bag la sras lnga gzungs pa'i jo bo shākya mgon po/ lha 'gro ba'i mgon po/'di sbyi la phu'i gdan sa mdzad pas gdus bya che / lde po 'di 'ban tshigs bzung /lde chung 'di grong gra med/rdzo rgyal rnams so/ /'disasrid bang /lde po'i sras jo bo shākya rgyal/ de'i sras rjo bo shākya dpal/ 'dis 'gro mgon 'phag pa'i drung du rab tu byung na gra med/jo rgyal gyi sras jo 'bar/ de'i srasaganyis pa'i che ba lha zur khang pa/'di kyang la phu'i gdan sa mdzad/chung ba khrom po ba rnams kyis dpon du gdan drangs te lha khrom po par grags/ jo bo shākya mgon pos gcung po rnams tha thang du phog nas/ khong rang gi pho brang gnas chung btab/mnga' thang dpal 'byor nam mkha' dang mnyam/ de'i sras jo bo shākya bkra shisakyis pho brang rnying ma btab/ de la sras gnyis byung ba che ba lha brag kha pa/ chung ba mnga' bdag grags pa rin chen gyis 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i chag phyi la rgya yul du byon/ se chen rgyal po'i lung blangs nas pho brang brag kha la sogs pa'i pho brang mang du btab thams cad la 3 4 /sgyur/ mnga' thang dpal 'byor nam

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long ngam chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so//mkha' dang mnyam/ de la sras gsum 'khrungs pa'i che ba blo gros 'od/ gnyis pa mnga' bdag shākya mgon po/ 'dis spyil phu'i gdan sa mdzad/shākya mgon po rting ma yin pas/dpal 'byor che/chung ba lha btsun tshul khrims bzang po/ gdan sa zil du rab tu byung /'di rnams nas bzung ste/ yar lung gi jo bo da lta yan la rim par byon pa 'di rnams bod rgyal po'i gdung brgyud zam ma chad pa yin pas rigs gzugs yon tan khyad par 'phags pa yin/ 'di dag ni zur tsam bsdus pa yin gyis/ yar lung jo bo rim par byon pa rnams kyi mdzad pa phrin las rgyas par 'dod na/ lha btsun tshul khrims bzang pos bsgrigs pa'i rgyal rabs la gzigs shig bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i lo rgyus dang / rgya dkar nag gi rgyal po dang / hor dang mi nyag gi rgyal rabs dang /khyad par du'ang bod kyi chos rgyal rim par byon pa rnams kyi rnam thar bsdus te zur tsam yin no/ /'di dag ni gzhan gyi kha rgyug dang rang gi blo tshod dang rnam rtog gis kun nas bslangs pa'i yid dpyod rnams spangs te/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' mdo rgyud dang / rgyal po'i bka' 'bum lha sa dang bsam yas kyi bka' gcigs chen mo/ jo bo rje'i gter yig che chung / chos 'byung gi yi ge che chung /rgyal po bka'i thang yig hor gyi yig tshang / gzhan yang tshal pa la sogs pa'i sde dpon/ bstan bcos la mkhas pa'i gang zag rnams kyis bsgrigs pa'i rgyal rabs kyi yi ge mang po bsags nas/ re re bzhin zhib mor bltas/ yin min gyi the tshom rnams bsal/ snang lan 'a ༄skad dang / brda skad go dka' ba rnamasabacos te gsal bar byas/ snyan ngag3 // sdeb sbyor gyi rgyan gyis ma bsgrigs

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()par rang gzhan thams cad kyis go sla bar byas nas dad ldan bstan pa'i lo )rgyus 'dod pa rnams mos gus dang / spro ba skye ba'i phyir du legs par bkod pa 'di bden par shes pa mdzod cig gzhan yang dus phyis kyi gang zag 'di dag la don gnyer byed pa rnams kyis yin min gyi cha mtshon the tshom du gyur na/ sngar gyi yi ge rnying pa rnams la zhib mor gzigs la 'jug tu rung ngo / /mi shes pa rnams kyis 'a 〉ra chos shig/'di ni gangs can bstan pa'i dar tshul te/ /bstan pa rgyas mdzad chos rgyal mes dbon gyis/ /ston pa'i bstan pa phyogs bcur spel ba 'dis/ /bstan pa dar rgyas yun du gnas par shog /tshogs gnyis lhun po'i khyon ltar mngon mtho zhing / khrims gnyis chos bzhin skyong ba'i dgongs pa can/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sa skyong rje rnams kyi/ /chab srid phan bde'i dpal la spyod par mdzod/ /chos rgyal rnams kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus 'di/ /lha btsun rin chen dpal gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis//'gal 'khrul spangs te leg bas par bsgrigs pa yin/ /'di yi dge bas sprin med nam mkha' la/ /thub bstan rgyas pa'i rta bdun 'od stong gis/ /gsung rab phan bde'i pad tshal kha phyes nas/ /dad ldan bung ba'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzod/ /bod yul mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir ston pa yang dag par rje'ogs pa'i sangs rgyas des zhabs kyis ma bcags kyang gsung gi 'od zer gyis khyab par mdzad nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigasadabang phyug des/ gang la gang 'dul 3snros sems can thams cad thar pa byang

rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long zimachos 'byung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// chub kyi lam la 'god par mjad cing / khyad par 'phags pa de'i thugs kyi sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po la sogs pa bod kyi chos rgyal rim par byon pa blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis thabs du ma'i sgo nas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i rnam thar/ chos 'byung gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba 'di bstan pa dar tshul gyi 'ad rgyus 'dod khrarang / dad ldan rnams spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir du sa skya nga bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis sa pho 'brug gi 31 la dpal bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang chen por legs par /lhag/ ge'o dis/ dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du bkra shis par gyur 345

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/tshangs po/4che chen lto 554(147sa skya'i chos //sdiX /ces bsdus/sa skya'i dpe rnying bsdu ces khang nas bsgrigs/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun te bkram/pe cin skang dbyi pa ra 'debs drod yod kung sis dpa ra btab/ tsha 2 ṭ+wāṃ cho drir sa mi dad//ba sa/52 pa/dpa|༷//bya/de//༷༷7270
ci ji tsho byeru tsho tsho wa bye sgyu rdzo tre snre 13 5978—7—0253—35—2 ge tsho rje 9 787802 53 352 〉 — 1— ——rjo
